name: AlexNet
summary: 以 GPU、ReLU、dropout 和深卷积组合首次规模化训练 ImageNet 级深 CNN。
summary_en: First large-scale ImageNet-grade deep CNN trained end-to-end by combining dual-GPU parallelism, non-saturating ReLU activations, dropout regularization, and stacked convolutions.

nodes.label: 输入图像
nodes.description: RGB 图像经随机裁剪、翻转与均值处理进入网络。
nodes.description_en: RGB image enters the network after random cropping, horizontal flipping, and mean subtraction.

nodes.label: 11×11 Conv
nodes.description: 大步幅卷积快速降采样，ReLU 取代易饱和激活。
nodes.description_en: Large-stride convolution rapidly downsamples spatial resolution while ReLU replaces saturating activations.

nodes.label: Pool + LRN
nodes.description: 重叠最大池化压缩空间；原版使用局部响应归一化。
nodes.description_en: Overlapping max-pooling compresses spatial dimensions; original formulation applies Local Response Normalization (LRN).

nodes.label: 5×5 分组卷积
nodes.description: 原始双 GPU 实现按通道分组计算第二层卷积。
nodes.description_en: Original dual-GPU implementation partitions channels into two parallel groups for second-layer convolution.

nodes.label: 3×3 Conv 堆叠
nodes.description: 连续三层卷积组合中层纹理与高层形状证据。
nodes.description_en: Three consecutive 3×3 convolutional layers compose mid-level textures and high-level shape cues.

nodes.label: FC6–FC7
nodes.description: 两层大容量全连接层，训练时以 dropout 抑制共适应。
nodes.description_en: Two high-capacity fully connected layers regularized via dropout during training to suppress co-adaptation.

nodes.label: 分类头
nodes.description: 线性层把高维特征映射到固定类别 logits。
nodes.description_en: Linear classifier projects high-dimensional features onto closed-set class logits.

nodes.label: Softmax
nodes.description: 将 logits 归一化为封闭类别概率。
nodes.description_en: Normalizes raw logits into closed-set categorical probabilities via Softmax.

paper.title: ImageNet Classification with Deep Convolutional Neural Networks

paper_figure.label: Figure 2 · PDF p.5
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 手工特征占主导，深 CNN 计算昂贵且易饱和或过拟合
keypoints.核心想法: GPU 训练的深层卷积分类器，以 ReLU、dropout 和增强扩大可训练规模
keypoints.关键改进: 5 个卷积层加 3 个全连接层，结合 GPU、ReLU、dropout 与数据增强
keypoints.医学适配: 推动通用 CNN/ImageNet 表示迁移，后续被医学 2D 任务广泛采用
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 历史里程碑；不再是医学强基线

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Hand-crafted features dominated vision; deep CNNs were computationally prohibitive and prone to saturating gradients or severe overfitting.
keypoints_en.核心想法: End-to-end GPU-trained deep convolutional classifier scaling capacity via ReLU, dropout, and aggressive data augmentation.
keypoints_en.关键改进: 5 convolutional layers + 3 fully connected layers integrating multi-GPU execution, ReLU non-linearity, dropout, and crop/color augmentations.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Catalyzed transfer of generic ImageNet CNN representations across 2D medical imaging classification and detection.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Historical milestone; superseded as a competitive medical backbone.

name: ResNet
summary: 显式 identity shortcut 与残差相加 y=x+F(x)。
summary_en: Explicit identity shortcut connections combined with additive residual learning y = x + F(x).

nodes.label: Stem
nodes.description: 卷积与下采样建立第一层局部特征。
nodes.description_en: Initial convolutional stem and downsampling extract low-level local features.

nodes.label: 块输入 x
nodes.description: 同时进入残差分支与恒等捷径。
nodes.description_en: Splits tensor simultaneously into the non-linear residual branch and the identity shortcut.

nodes.label: F(x)
nodes.description: BasicBlock 用两层 3×3；Bottleneck 用 1×1–3×3–1×1。
nodes.description_en: BasicBlock stacks two 3×3 convolutions; Bottleneck uses a 1×1–3×3–1×1 channel compression-expansion design.

nodes.label: Identity
nodes.description: 维度不变时直接传递；变化时用 projection shortcut。
nodes.description_en: Passes features directly when dimensions match, or applies a 1×1 projection shortcut when stride/channels change.

nodes.label: 残差相加
nodes.description: 计算 y=x+F(x)，保留近似恒等映射与短梯度路径。
nodes.description_en: Computes y = x + F(x), preserving an unattenuated identity reference and short gradient highway.

nodes.label: 分层 Stage
nodes.description: 重复残差块并逐级降低分辨率、增加通道。
nodes.description_en: Stacks residual blocks across stages while progressively halving spatial resolution and doubling channels.

nodes.label: 全局平均池化
nodes.description: 把最终空间特征聚合为图像级向量。
nodes.description_en: Pools final spatial feature maps into a global image-level representation vector.

nodes.label: 任务头
nodes.description: 连接分类头，或把多尺度 stage 特征交给检测/分割解码器。
nodes.description_en: Feeds the classification head or exports multi-scale stage features to detection/segmentation decoders.

paper.title: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition

paper_figure.label: Figure 2 · PDF p.2
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 网络加深后出现优化退化，训练误差反而上升
keypoints.核心想法: 用恒等捷径学习残差映射 y=x+F(x)
keypoints.关键改进: identity shortcut 与必要时的 projection shortcut 使百层网络可优化
keypoints.医学适配: 3D ResNet、Residual U-Net 与 nnU-Net ResEnc 的核心结构
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 仍是必须精通的强主干和公平对照

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Deepening plain networks triggered optimization degradation where training error paradoxically increased with depth.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Reformulate layers to learn residual perturbations y = x + F(x) relative to an identity reference.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Parameter-free identity shortcuts and 1×1 projection shortcuts enable stable optimization beyond 100+ layers.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Foundational building block for 3D ResNet, Residual U-Net, and nnU-Net ResEnc across medical modalities.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Mandatory foundational backbone and fair baseline across 2D and 3D biomedical tasks.

name: DenseNet
summary: 每层对所有前层输出做通道 concat，而非仅连接相邻层或做残差相加。
summary_en: Every layer concatenates feature maps from all preceding layers along the channel axis rather than summing adjacent residuals.

nodes.label: 卷积 Stem
nodes.description: 建立初始低层视觉特征。
nodes.description_en: Extracts initial low-level visual feature representations.

nodes.label: 特征库
nodes.description: 保存 dense block 内此前所有层的输出。
nodes.description_en: Accumulates feature maps produced by all preceding layers within the dense block.

nodes.label: 通道拼接
nodes.description: 第 l 层输入为 [x0,…,x(l−1)]，不是逐元素相加。
nodes.description_en: Layer l receives channel concatenation [x_0, …, x_{l-1}] rather than element-wise addition.

nodes.label: 1×1 Bottleneck
nodes.description: BN–ReLU–1×1 Conv 控制进入 3×3 卷积的通道成本。
nodes.description_en: Pre-activation BN–ReLU–1×1 bottleneck compresses channel width prior to 3×3 spatial convolution.

nodes.label: 3×3 Growth
nodes.description: 每层只新增 k 个通道，k 为 growth rate。
nodes.description_en: Each composite layer appends exactly k new feature channels governed by growth rate k.

nodes.label: Dense Block
nodes.description: 新特征回写特征库并供所有后续层直接访问。
nodes.description_en: Appends newly generated features to the shared bank for direct access by all subsequent layers.

nodes.label: Transition
nodes.description: 1×1 Conv 与平均池化压缩通道和空间尺寸。
nodes.description_en: Transition layer (1×1 conv + 2×2 average pooling) compresses both channel count and spatial grid resolution.

nodes.label: GAP + Head
nodes.description: 全局池化后输出分类，或导出 dense features 供下游使用。
nodes.description_en: Applies global pooling for classification or exports multi-scale dense features to downstream decoders.

paper.title: Densely Connected Convolutional Networks

paper_figure.label: Figures 1 and 2 · PDF pp.1, 3
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 深层网络中特征传播与梯度传递受阻，并会重复学习相似表示
keypoints.核心想法: 每层接收全部前层特征的拼接并以 growth rate 控制宽度
keypoints.关键改进: 密集短路径带来显式特征复用和较少参数
keypoints.医学适配: DenseNet-121 成为胸片经典主干，H-DenseUNet 用于肝肿瘤分割
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 结构思想仍有价值，但 activation memory 较大

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Deep networks suffered from attenuated feature propagation and redundant re-learning of low-level representations.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Feed each layer the channel-wise concatenation of all prior layers within a block while bounding width via a fixed growth rate k.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Dense short paths enforce explicit multi-scale feature reuse with high parameter efficiency.
keypoints_en.医学适配: DenseNet-121 became a canonical chest X-ray backbone (CheXNet); H-DenseUNet extended dense connectivity to 3D liver tumor segmentation.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Enduring architectural principle, though channel concatenation incurs high GPU activation memory in 3D.

name: ConvNeXt
summary: 7×7 depthwise spatial mixer 加 inverted bottleneck 的现代纯卷积块。
summary_en: Modernized pure ConvNet block pairing a 7×7 depthwise spatial mixer with an inverted channel bottleneck.

nodes.label: 4×4 Patchify
nodes.description: kernel=stride=4 的卷积 stem 直接生成低分辨率特征。
nodes.description_en: Non-overlapping 4×4 strided patchify stem downsamples input directly into quarter-resolution feature maps.

nodes.label: 7×7 DWConv
nodes.description: 逐通道大核卷积扩大局部感受野而控制参数量。
nodes.description_en: Depthwise 7×7 spatial convolution expands the effective receptive field while keeping parameter count low.

nodes.label: LayerNorm
nodes.description: 通道后置格式下归一化，贴近现代 Transformer 训练配方。
nodes.description_en: Applies channels-last LayerNorm aligned with modern Vision Transformer training recipes.

nodes.label: 4× 扩展
nodes.description: pointwise 线性层扩张通道，形成 inverted bottleneck。
nodes.description_en: Pointwise 1×1 linear layer expands channel dimension by 4× in an inverted bottleneck configuration.

nodes.label: GELU
nodes.description: 在扩展通道空间进行平滑非线性变换。
nodes.description_en: Applies smooth GELU non-linear activation within the expanded channel space.

nodes.label: 通道投影
nodes.description: 第二个 pointwise 层压回原通道数。
nodes.description_en: Second pointwise 1×1 projection compresses channels back to the block dimension.

nodes.label: 残差相加
nodes.description: 配合 layer scale 与 stochastic depth 稳定深层训练。
nodes.description_en: Residual connection combined with learnable LayerScale and Stochastic Depth stabilizes deep optimization.

nodes.label: Stage Downsample
nodes.description: 独立归一化与 stride-2 卷积构建四级金字塔。
nodes.description_en: Separate LayerNorm + 2×2 stride-2 convolution downsamples features across a four-stage pyramid.

nodes.label: GAP + Head
nodes.description: 输出分类，或提供多尺度特征给检测/分割解码器。
nodes.description_en: Outputs class logits or supplies four-stage hierarchical features to dense prediction heads.

paper.title: A ConvNet for the 2020s

paper_figure.label: Figures 3 and 4 · PDF pp.4, 5
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: Transformer 与 CNN 的比较混入了训练配方和层级设计差异
keypoints.核心想法: 以现代训练配方和大核 depthwise 卷积重构纯卷积层级主干
keypoints.关键改进: 7×7 depthwise conv、inverted bottleneck、LayerNorm/GELU 与 patchify stem
keypoints.医学适配: 直接启发 3D MedNeXt，并作为医学 Transformer/SSM 的强 CNN 对照
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 现代强 CNN 主干，适合公平架构比较

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Comparisons between Vision Transformers and CNNs conflated self-attention with modern training recipes and macro-architecture design.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Modernize a pure hierarchical ConvNet using Transformer-era training recipes and large-kernel depthwise convolutions.
keypoints_en.关键改进: 7×7 depthwise conv, inverted bottleneck (1×1 expansion), LayerNorm, GELU, and a 4×4 patchify stem.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Directly inspired 3D MedNeXt and serves as a rigorous modern CNN control against medical Transformers and SSMs.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: State-of-the-art pure CNN backbone ideal for controlled architectural ablations.

name: FCN
summary: FC→Conv 的整图 dense prediction，加 pool3/pool4 分数级 skip fusion。
summary_en: Converts image-level FC layers into 1×1 convolutions for arbitrary-size dense prediction with pool3/pool4 skip score fusion.

nodes.label: 卷积 Backbone
nodes.description: VGG 式卷积与池化逐级生成 pool3、pool4 和深层语义特征。
nodes.description_en: Ingests arbitrary-size 2d image and prepares initial tensor representations (convolution Backbone).

nodes.label: FC→Conv
nodes.description: 把分类器全连接层改写为卷积，使网络可处理任意尺寸输入。
nodes.description_en: Executes FC→Conv to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: Score32
nodes.description: 在最深低分辨率特征上预测粗语义分数图。
nodes.description_en: Performs Score32 within the core dense prediction with skips computation pathway.

nodes.label: 2× 上采样
nodes.description: learned deconvolution 将粗分数恢复到 pool4 尺度。
nodes.description_en: Performs 2× upsampling within the core dense prediction with skips computation pathway.

nodes.label: Pool4 Score
nodes.description: 用 1×1 Conv 把中层 pool4 特征映射为类别分数。
nodes.description_en: Performs Pool4 Score within the core dense prediction with skips computation pathway.

nodes.label: FCN-16s 融合
nodes.description: 深层语义分数与 pool4 分数逐元素相加。
nodes.description_en: Performs FCN-16s fusion within the core dense prediction with skips computation pathway.

nodes.label: 再 2× 上采样
nodes.description: 把融合结果提升到 pool3 尺度。
nodes.description_en: Performs 2× upsampling within the core dense prediction with skips computation pathway.

nodes.label: Pool3 Score
nodes.description: 较浅层特征提供更细空间定位。
nodes.description_en: Performs Pool3 Score within the core dense prediction with skips computation pathway.

nodes.label: FCN-8s 融合
nodes.description: 加入 pool3 分数，形成更精细的类别响应。
nodes.description_en: Applies FCN-8s fusion to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: 8× 上采样
nodes.description: 将融合分数恢复到原图并输出逐像素预测。
nodes.description_en: Produces pixel-aligned semantic class probability map via 8× upsampling.

paper.title: Fully Convolutional Networks for Semantic Segmentation

paper_figure.label: Figure 3 · PDF p.5
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 分类网络只能给图级标签，逐 patch 推理低效且边界粗
keypoints.核心想法: 将分类 CNN 的全连接层卷积化，端到端输出像素级预测
keypoints.关键改进: learned deconvolution，并在 FCN-16s/8s 中逐步加入浅深特征 skip fusion
keypoints.医学适配: 是 U-Net 等医学 encoder-decoder 分割网络的直接祖先
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 范式基础；具体结构已被更强解码器替代

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Classification CNNs produced only image-level labels; sliding-window patch classification was redundant and boundary-coarse.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Transform fully connected layers into convolutions and append transposed-convolution upsampling for end-to-end pixel-wise training.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Learned deconvolution combined with multi-scale coarse-to-fine skip score fusion (FCN-32s → FCN-16s → FCN-8s).
keypoints_en.医学适配: Direct progenitor of U-Net and all modern medical encoder–decoder segmentation networks.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Foundational dense-prediction paradigm; asymmetric score-only upsampling is superseded by symmetric U-Net decoders.

name: U-Net
summary: 对称 U 形多尺度解码器与 encoder–decoder 同尺度 concat long skips。
summary_en: Symmetric U-shaped multi-scale decoder coupled with same-scale encoder–decoder channel concatenation long skips.

nodes.label: 输入图像
nodes.description: 原始实现结合强弹性形变增强以扩充少标注数据。
nodes.description_en: Strong elastic deformation augments the small annotated biomedical image set in the original training recipe.

nodes.label: 高分辨率 Encoder
nodes.description: 重复 3×3 Conv 提取边缘、纹理与小结构位置。
nodes.description_en: Repeated 3×3 convolutions capture local boundaries, texture and fine spatial detail.

nodes.label: 下采样金字塔
nodes.description: max pooling 逐级扩大视野并增加通道。
nodes.description_en: Max pooling reduces spatial resolution; deeper levels increase channel capacity and capture a wider context.

nodes.label: 语义瓶颈
nodes.description: 最低分辨率层编码大范围上下文与任务语义。
nodes.description_en: The lowest-resolution level aggregates the broadest context. The original architecture reaches 1024 feature channels here.

nodes.label: Up-conv
nodes.description: 转置卷积提升空间分辨率并降低通道。
nodes.description_en: Learned up-convolution increases spatial resolution and reduces channel count before decoder fusion.

nodes.label: 同尺度 Concat
nodes.description: 裁剪/对齐 encoder 特征后与 decoder 特征按通道拼接。
nodes.description_en: Crop the encoder feature map to align spatial sizes, then concatenate it with the decoder features along the channel axis.

nodes.label: Decoder Conv
nodes.description: 融合定位与语义后逐级细化边界。
nodes.description_en: Convolutions after concatenation combine fine localization with deeper semantic context and refine the predicted boundaries.

nodes.label: 1×1 分割头
nodes.description: 将最终特征映射为每像素类别 logits。
nodes.description_en: A 1×1 convolution maps the final features to per-pixel class logits.

paper.title: U-Net: Convolutional Networks for Biomedical Image Segmentation

paper_figure.label: Figure 1 · PDF p.2
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: FCN 上采样边界粗，生物医学标注稀缺
keypoints.核心想法: 对称 encoder-decoder 与同尺度长跳连联合语义和精确定位
keypoints.关键改进: concat skips、强弹性增强与面向少样本的 U 形多尺度拓扑
keypoints.医学适配: 成为医学分割基础设施，U-shaped encoder-decoder 也被广泛复用于重建和去噪
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 领域基础设施；必须从零实现和保留为强基线

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: FCN upsampling lost fine boundary localization, while annotated biomedical datasets were small.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Pair a contracting semantic encoder with a symmetric expanding decoder linked by same-scale feature concatenation skips.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Concatenation long skips, distance-weighted boundary loss, and elastic deformations tailored for few-shot biomedical segmentation.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Universal infrastructure of biomedical segmentation; the U-shaped topology is also standard across denoising, reconstruction, and diffusion.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Cornerstone domain infrastructure; mandatory to master from scratch and retain as a primary baseline.

name: 3D U-Net
summary: 把 U-Net 的卷积、池化、上采样和 long skip 全部扩展为原生 3D，并支持稀疏切片监督。
summary_en: Extends all U-Net convolutions, pooling, upsampling, and long skips to native 3D tensors with support for sparse slice annotations.

nodes.label: 3D Volume
nodes.description: 输入为 C×D×H×W 体数据而非独立切片。
nodes.description_en: Ingests 3d ct/mri sub-volume or whole volumetric scan and prepares initial tensor representations (3D Volume).

nodes.label: 3D Conv Encoder
nodes.description: 3×3×3 卷积同时聚合层内与层间邻域。
nodes.description_en: Executes 3D Conv Encoder to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: 3D Pool
nodes.description: 体素三轴下采样扩大体积感受野。
nodes.description_en: Performs 3D Pool within the core volumetric u net computation pathway.

nodes.label: 体语义瓶颈
nodes.description: 编码器最低尺度建模器官形状与跨切片连续性。
nodes.description_en: Performs Stage 04 within the core volumetric u net computation pathway.

nodes.label: 3D Up-conv
nodes.description: 三维转置卷积逐级恢复体素分辨率。
nodes.description_en: Performs 3D Up-conv within the core volumetric u net computation pathway.

nodes.label: 3D Skip Concat
nodes.description: 同尺度体特征跨越瓶颈拼接到解码器。
nodes.description_en: Performs 3D Skip Concat within the core volumetric u net computation pathway.

nodes.label: 3D Decoder
nodes.description: 融合体上下文与高分辨率边界。
nodes.description_en: Performs 3D Decoder within the core volumetric u net computation pathway.

nodes.label: Voxel Head
nodes.description: 1×1×1 卷积输出每体素类别。
nodes.description_en: Applies Voxel Head to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: 稀疏监督
nodes.description: 只在有标注切片/体素处计算监督损失。
nodes.description_en: Produces dense 3d voxel-wise segmentation volume via Stage 09.

paper.title: 3D U-Net: Learning Dense Volumetric Segmentation from Sparse Annotation

paper_figure.label: Figure 2 · PDF p.4
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 逐切片 2D 网络忽略层间上下文和体结构连续性
keypoints.核心想法: 把 U-Net 全部算子扩展为 3D，并从稀疏标注切片学习体素级输出
keypoints.关键改进: 3D 卷积、3D elastic augmentation 与体素级 dense prediction
keypoints.医学适配: 奠定 CT/MRI 体分割母体，支持稀疏体标注
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 经典 3D 基线；显存、patch context 与各向异性仍是瓶颈

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Slice-by-slice 2D segmentation ignores inter-slice z-axis continuity and 3D anatomical topology.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Generalize U-Net operators to native 3D volumetric tensors and train with weighted loss on sparsely annotated slices.
keypoints_en.关键改进: 3D convolutions, 3D batch normalization, smooth 3D elastic augmentations, and dense volumetric inference.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Foundational parent of volumetric CT, MRI, and microscopy segmentation pipelines.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Canonical 3D baseline; bounded by GPU activation memory, patch field-of-view, and anisotropic slice spacing.

name: V-Net
summary: 3D residual FCN 与直接可微 Dice overlap objective 的结合。
summary_en: Volumetric 3D residual encoder–decoder trained directly with a differentiable Dice overlap objective.

nodes.label: 3D 输入
nodes.description: 体数据直接进入全卷积分割网络。
nodes.description_en: Ingests 3d medical imaging volume and prepares initial tensor representations (3D input).

nodes.label: Residual 3D Stage
nodes.description: 多层 3D Conv 的输出与 stage 输入相加。
nodes.description_en: Executes Residual 3D Stage to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: Strided Conv
nodes.description: 用可学习 stride-2 卷积替代固定池化完成降采样。
nodes.description_en: Performs Strided Conv within the core residual volumetric segmentation computation pathway.

nodes.label: 深层体上下文
nodes.description: 低分辨率残差块聚合大范围三维结构。
nodes.description_en: Performs Stage 04 within the core residual volumetric segmentation computation pathway.

nodes.label: 3D Deconv
nodes.description: 转置卷积逐级恢复体素尺度。
nodes.description_en: Performs 3D Deconv within the core residual volumetric segmentation computation pathway.

nodes.label: Encoder Skip
nodes.description: 编码器特征与对应解码尺度融合。
nodes.description_en: Performs Encoder Skip within the core residual volumetric segmentation computation pathway.

nodes.label: 体素概率头
nodes.description: 全卷积输出前景概率体。
nodes.description_en: Applies voxel to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: Dice Objective
nodes.description: 直接优化预测与真值集合的重叠，而非被背景主导的逐体素准确率。
nodes.description_en: Produces foreground probability volume or multi-class voxel segmentation via Dice Objective.

paper.title: V-Net: Fully Convolutional Neural Networks for Volumetric Medical Image Segmentation

paper_figure.label: Figure 2 · PDF p.3
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 3D 前景极小，交叉熵易被背景主导
keypoints.核心想法: 3D residual FCN 直接优化 Dice 型目标
keypoints.关键改进: 残差 3D 编解码器与面向重叠度的 Dice loss
keypoints.医学适配: 推动 Dice 型目标在医学体分割中的普及
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 经典强基线；并非唯一 3D 默认网络

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Small 3D anatomical targets occupy a tiny fraction of voxels, causing standard cross-entropy to collapse toward background.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Combine a 3D residual convolutional encoder–decoder with a differentiable soft Dice loss.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Strided 3D convolutions replacing pooling, block-wise residual shortcuts, and direct overlap optimization.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Popularized Dice-family losses (Dice + CE) as the standard training objective for medical volumetric segmentation.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Classic 3D baseline; Dice loss alone remains insensitive to boundary Hausdorff outliers and topological breaks.

name: nnU-Net
summary: dataset fingerprint 驱动的自配置、交叉验证与推理后处理闭环，而不是单一新算子。
summary_en: Dataset-fingerprint-driven self-configuration, 5-fold cross-validation ensembling, and post-processing loop rather than a new neural block.

nodes.label: 原始数据集
nodes.description: 影像、标签、模态、尺寸与物理 spacing 构成配置输入。
nodes.description_en: Ingests new medical segmentation dataset with raw images, masks, and physical voxel spacing metadata and prepares initial tensor representations (Stage 01).

nodes.label: Dataset Fingerprint
nodes.description: 统计强度、形状、spacing、类别与病例规模。
nodes.description_en: Executes Dataset Fingerprint to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: Experiment Planner
nodes.description: 按显存预算推导 target spacing、patch、batch、kernel 和 pooling。
nodes.description_en: Performs Experiment Planner within the core self configuring pipeline computation pathway.

nodes.label: 2D/3D/Cascade
nodes.description: 生成适用的 2D、3D full-resolution 与低分辨率级联配置。
nodes.description_en: Performs 2D/3D/Cascade within the core self configuring pipeline computation pathway.

nodes.label: 预处理
nodes.description: 重采样、裁剪、归一化并缓存可复现实验输入。
nodes.description_en: Performs Stage 05 within the core self configuring pipeline computation pathway.

nodes.label: U-Net 训练
nodes.description: CE+Dice、foreground sampling、深监督和强增强构成统一 recipe。
nodes.description_en: Performs U-Net training within the core self configuring pipeline computation pathway.

nodes.label: 5-fold CV
nodes.description: 各配置交叉验证并保存 fold 模型与 out-of-fold 预测。
nodes.description_en: Performs 5-fold CV within the core self configuring pipeline computation pathway.

nodes.label: 滑窗 + TTA
nodes.description: 重叠滑窗、Gaussian weighting 与镜像 TTA 生成全体预测。
nodes.description_en: Performs + TTA within the core self configuring pipeline computation pathway.

nodes.label: 后处理选择
nodes.description: 仅在交叉验证证实有益时采用连通域等后处理和 ensemble。
nodes.description_en: Applies Stage 09 to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: 最终分割
nodes.description: 输出配置、权重、预测与完整可复现 pipeline。
nodes.description_en: Produces self-configured, cross-validated, and post-processed end-to-end segmentation system via Final Segmentation.

paper.title: nnU-Net: a self-configuring method for deep learning-based biomedical image segmentation

paper_figure.label: Figure 1 · PDF p.4
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 新数据集依赖大量专家手调，论文比较常被 pipeline 差异混淆
keypoints.核心想法: 根据数据集 fingerprint 自动配置预处理、网络、采样、训练与推理
keypoints.关键改进: 规则与经验结合选择 spacing、patch/batch、2D/3D/cascade、增强和后处理
keypoints.医学适配: 在多器官、多模态分割中成为统一、可复现的基础设施
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 在适用的数据与任务设置下，是新分割方法应比较的必做基线

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Segmentation performance was dominated by manual per-dataset tuning, confounding architectural comparisons across papers.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Automate preprocessing, network topology, patch/batch sizing, sampling, training schedule, and post-processing directly from dataset statistics.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Couples rule-based domain heuristics (spacing, anisotropy, modality normalization) with empirical cross-validation model selection.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Serves as the undisputed reproducible infrastructure across multi-organ and multi-modality medical segmentation benchmarks.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Mandatory first-line baseline against which any newly proposed segmentation architecture must be benchmarked.

name: UNETR
summary: 多深度 ViT token skips 连接到卷积 U 形解码器的 3D hybrid。
summary_en: 3D hybrid segmentation architecture connecting multi-depth Vision Transformer token representations to a convolutional U-shaped decoder.

nodes.label: 3D Volume
nodes.description: 体数据按非重叠 3D patch 切分。
nodes.description_en: Ingests 3d medical imaging volume and prepares initial tensor representations (3D Volume).

nodes.label: 3D Patch Tokens
nodes.description: 每个体 patch 线性投影为 token，并加入位置编码。
nodes.description_en: Executes 3D Patch Tokens to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: ViT L3
nodes.description: 浅层 token 保留较多局部与位置细节。
nodes.description_en: Performs ViT L3 within the core vit cnn 3d decoder computation pathway.

nodes.label: ViT L6/L9
nodes.description: 中层全局 self-attention 逐步形成体积语义。
nodes.description_en: Performs ViT L6/L9 within the core vit cnn 3d decoder computation pathway.

nodes.label: ViT L12
nodes.description: 深层 token 具有一层可达全局的体上下文。
nodes.description_en: Performs ViT L12 within the core vit cnn 3d decoder computation pathway.

nodes.label: Token→3D Map
nodes.description: 不同深度 token reshape，并经卷积投影为多尺度体特征。
nodes.description_en: Performs Token→3D Map within the core vit cnn 3d decoder computation pathway.

nodes.label: CNN Decoder
nodes.description: 转置卷积逐级上采样并融合 Transformer skip。
nodes.description_en: Performs CNN Decoder within the core vit cnn 3d decoder computation pathway.

nodes.label: 浅层 CNN Skip
nodes.description: 直接从输入卷积路径补充最高分辨率定位信息。
nodes.description_en: Applies CNN Skip to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: 3D Seg Head
nodes.description: 卷积头输出每体素类别 logits。
nodes.description_en: Produces high-resolution 3d volumetric semantic segmentation via 3D Seg Head.

paper.title: UNETR: Transformers for 3D Medical Image Segmentation

paper_figure.label: Figure 2 · PDF p.4
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 纯卷积的显式全局关系有限
keypoints.核心想法: 以 3D patch token 的 ViT encoder 接 U 形 CNN decoder
keypoints.关键改进: 从不同 Transformer 深度向 decoder 建立多尺度 skip
keypoints.医学适配: 把全局 Transformer encoder 系统引入 3D 医学分割
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 重要范式节点；从头训练和二次注意力成本明显

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Pure 3D CNN encoders have restricted explicit global receptive fields across large volumetric scans.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Tokenize 3D volumes into non-overlapping 3D patches processed by a ViT encoder, projecting intermediate layers into a 3D CNN decoder.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Multi-depth reshape-and-deconvolution skip pathways bridging sequence-level ViT tokens back to spatial voxel grids.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Pioneered global Transformer encoders for 3D multi-organ CT/MRI segmentation.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Important hybrid milestone, though flat 3D patch attention incurs high quadratic compute and data hunger from scratch.

name: Swin UNETR (SSL)
summary: 3D shifted-window hierarchy 与旋转、重建、对比联合自监督的 Swin UNETR。
summary_en: 3D shifted-window hierarchical Swin encoder coupled to a U-shaped CNN decoder and pretrained with multi-task 3D self-supervision.

nodes.label: 3D CT Crop
nodes.description: 从体数据采样子体积并构造自监督视图。
nodes.description_en: Ingests unlabeled 3d ct sub-volumes for pretraining; labeled 3d volumes for fine-tuning and prepares initial tensor representations (3D CT Crop).

nodes.label: 3D Patch Embed
nodes.description: 将局部体块投影为层级 Transformer 的初始 token 网格。
nodes.description_en: Executes 3D Patch Embed to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: Window MSA
nodes.description: 在固定 3D 窗口内计算 self-attention，避免全局二次矩阵。
nodes.description_en: Performs Window MSA within the core hierarchical 3d transformer ssl computation pathway.

nodes.label: Shifted Window
nodes.description: 下一块平移窗口，使信息跨原窗口边界传播。
nodes.description_en: Performs Shifted Window within the core hierarchical 3d transformer ssl computation pathway.

nodes.label: Patch Merging
nodes.description: 逐级减小 D/H/W 并增加通道，形成多尺度体金字塔。
nodes.description_en: Performs Patch Merging within the core hierarchical 3d transformer ssl computation pathway.

nodes.label: 三类 SSL Heads
nodes.description: 联合旋转预测、局部重建/遮挡恢复与对比表示学习。
nodes.description_en: Performs SSL Heads within the core hierarchical 3d transformer ssl computation pathway.

nodes.label: Swin Encoder
nodes.description: 预训练后的四级体特征作为下游共享编码器。
nodes.description_en: Performs Swin Encoder within the core hierarchical 3d transformer ssl computation pathway.

nodes.label: UNETR Decoder
nodes.description: 卷积上采样并融合各 Swin stage 的 skip 特征。
nodes.description_en: Applies UNETR Decoder to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: 3D Mask
nodes.description: 分割头输出体素级类别。
nodes.description_en: Produces pretrained hierarchical 3d swin encoder and dense downstream volumetric segmentation via 3D Mask.

paper.title: Self-Supervised Pre-Training of Swin Transformers for 3D Medical Image Analysis

paper_figure.label: Figure 2 · PDF p.3
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 平坦 UNETR token 序列昂贵且缺自然多尺度，3D 标注有限
keypoints.核心想法: 层级 shifted-window Transformer 与 U 形解码器结合，并在 5050 个 CT 上自监督预训练
keypoints.关键改进: 窗口注意力、跨窗 shift、层级特征和多任务 3D 预训练
keypoints.医学适配: 成为 MONAI 中重要的 3D Transformer 分割与预训练基线
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 预训练时有价值；同配方从头训练未必优于现代 CNN

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Flat UNETR tokens lack multi-scale spatial pyramids and scale poorly to high-resolution 3D volumes under limited labels.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Replace flat ViT with a 3D shifted-window Swin pyramid and pretrain on 5,050 unlabeled volumetric CT scans.
keypoints_en.关键改进: 3D W-MSA / SW-MSA window hierarchy, patch merging, and tri-objective 3D SSL (inpainting + rotation + contrastive).
keypoints_en.医学适配: Standard 3D Transformer segmentation and pretraining baseline within the MONAI ecosystem.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Valuable when leveraging pretrained weights; from-scratch training under matched recipes does not consistently beat modern 3D CNNs.

name: MedNeXt
summary: 贯穿 encoder、decoder 和上下采样的全 3D 大核 depthwise ConvNeXt block。
summary_en: Fully 3D large-kernel depthwise ConvNeXt blocks deployed uniformly across encoder, bottleneck, decoder, and residual up/downsampling.

nodes.label: 3D Stem
nodes.description: 将输入投影到 MedNeXt 基础通道。
nodes.description_en: Ingests 3d medical imaging patch and prepares initial tensor representations (3D Stem).

nodes.label: k³ DWConv
nodes.description: 大核逐通道 3D 卷积扩大感受野，k 可随配置扩展。
nodes.description_en: Executes k³ DWConv to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: GroupNorm
nodes.description: 适应 3D 小 batch，并在通道混合前稳定激活。
nodes.description_en: Performs GroupNorm within the core large kernel 3d conv unet computation pathway.

nodes.label: 1×1×1 扩展
nodes.description: pointwise 卷积扩展通道后以 GELU 非线性变换。
nodes.description_en: Performs 1×1×1 within the core large kernel 3d conv unet computation pathway.

nodes.label: 1×1×1 压缩
nodes.description: 投影回块宽度并与输入做 residual add。
nodes.description_en: Performs 1×1×1 within the core large kernel 3d conv unet computation pathway.

nodes.label: Residual Down
nodes.description: 可学习下采样块保持 MedNeXt block 语义连续。
nodes.description_en: Performs Residual Down within the core large kernel 3d conv unet computation pathway.

nodes.label: 大核 Bottleneck
nodes.description: 最低分辨率用深度与大核聚合广域 3D 上下文。
nodes.description_en: Performs large-kernel Bottleneck within the core large kernel 3d conv unet computation pathway.

nodes.label: Residual Up
nodes.description: 转置卷积式 MedNeXt block 恢复分辨率。
nodes.description_en: Performs Residual Up within the core large kernel 3d conv unet computation pathway.

nodes.label: U-shape Skips
nodes.description: 编码器同尺度特征连接到解码器，并可用 UpKern 初始化大核。
nodes.description_en: Applies U-shape Skips to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: Seg Heads
nodes.description: 主头和深监督头输出不同尺度分割。
nodes.description_en: Produces multi-scale deep-supervised 3d segmentation logits via Seg Heads.

paper.title: MedNeXt: Transformer-driven Scaling of ConvNets for Medical Image Segmentation

paper_figure.label: Figure 1(a) · PDF p.4
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 传统 3D U-Net block 陈旧，Transformer 数据饥渴且代价高
keypoints.核心想法: 把 ConvNeXt 大核 depthwise 设计系统扩展为全 3D encoder-decoder
keypoints.关键改进: 残差上下采样、inverted bottleneck 与 depth/width/kernel compound scaling
keypoints.医学适配: 在统一医学分割复测中形成现代强纯卷积基线
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 高价值对照；大核版本训练较慢

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Legacy 3D U-Net 3×3×3 blocks had limited receptive fields, while 3D Transformers were memory-heavy and data-hungry.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Generalize ConvNeXt's large-kernel depthwise inverted bottleneck into a fully 3D encoder–decoder with iterative kernel up-kernelling.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Residual inverted-bottleneck resampling layers and compound scaling across depth, width, and 3D kernel size (3³ → 5³ → 7³).
keypoints_en.医学适配: Establishes a top-performing pure 3D ConvNet baseline across large-scale unified medical segmentation benchmarks.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Essential modern 3D CNN baseline; large 7×7×7 kernels increase training wall-clock time.

name: Models Genesis
summary: 多种 3D 变形与遮挡的统一恢复式自监督，而非从 2D ImageNet 迁移。
summary_en: Unified restorative 3D self-supervised learning from non-linear intensity, local pixel shuffling, and in-/out-painting perturbations.

nodes.label: 原始 3D Crop
nodes.description: 从 CT 体数据采样含解剖结构的子体积。
nodes.description_en: Ingests unlabeled 3d ct/mri sub-volumes and prepares initial tensor representations (3D Crop).

nodes.label: Nonlinear Warp
nodes.description: 对强度施加非线性变换，迫使模型恢复组织对比。
nodes.description_en: Executes Nonlinear Warp to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: Local Shuffle
nodes.description: 局部像素重排破坏纹理但保留粗空间布局。
nodes.description_en: Performs Local Shuffle within the core restorative 3d self supervision computation pathway.

nodes.label: In/Out-paint
nodes.description: 内部或外部 cutout 移除区域，要求利用上下文补全。
nodes.description_en: Performs In/Out-paint within the core restorative 3d self supervision computation pathway.

nodes.label: 3D Encoder
nodes.description: 共享卷积编码器从受损体数据提取解剖表示。
nodes.description_en: Performs 3D Encoder within the core restorative 3d self supervision computation pathway.

nodes.label: 3D Decoder
nodes.description: 恢复原始子体积的形状、纹理和强度。
nodes.description_en: Performs 3D Decoder within the core restorative 3d self supervision computation pathway.

nodes.label: 恢复目标
nodes.description: 预测干净体数据并与原始 crop 比较重建误差。
nodes.description_en: Applies objective to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: 迁移 Encoder
nodes.description: 丢弃恢复 decoder，将 encoder 初始化到分类或分割任务。
nodes.description_en: Produces transferable 3d encoder-decoder representations for segmentation and classification via Encoder.

paper.title: Models Genesis: Generic Autodidactic Models for 3D Medical Image Analysis

paper_figure.label: Figure 1 · PDF p.3
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 2D ImageNet 迁移无法充分覆盖 3D 医学体数据
keypoints.核心想法: 通过恢复受变换的 3D CT 子体积学习通用解剖表示
keypoints.关键改进: 多种恢复式自监督任务与跨多个 3D 下游任务验证
keypoints.医学适配: 奠定医学 3D 自监督预训练路线
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 奠基价值明确；当前与 MAE、自蒸馏等目标并存或被后者补充

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: 2D ImageNet weights fail to capture native 3D volumetric context, while 3D medical annotations are scarce.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Train a 3D encoder–decoder to restore native volumes corrupted by non-linear intensity transformations, local shuffling, and masking.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Combines four complementary appearance and spatial corruption tasks into a single restorative pretraining objective.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Established the foundational paradigm for native 3D self-supervised pretraining in volumetric radiology.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Foundational 3D SSL milestone; now complemented by masked autoencoding (MAE) and self-distillation.

name: VISTA3D
summary: 127 类自动分支、3D 点提示分支和 supervoxel 蒸馏共存的统一 3D segmentation FM。
summary_en: Unified 3D CT segmentation foundation model integrating a 127-class automated branch, a 3D point-prompt branch, and 2D supervoxel distillation.

nodes.label: 3D CT
nodes.description: 体数据进入共享 3D 图像编码路径。
nodes.description_en: Ingests 3d ct volume with optional 3d click coordinates or target anatomical class ids and prepares initial tensor representations (3D CT).

nodes.label: 3D Image Encoder
nodes.description: 提取多尺度体素特征与解剖先验。
nodes.description_en: Executes 3D Image Encoder to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: Class Embedding
nodes.description: 编码 127 个已知解剖类别，驱动自动分割分支。
nodes.description_en: Performs Class Embedding within the core unified 3d promptable segmentation computation pathway.

nodes.label: 3D Point Prompt
nodes.description: 正负点提示定义目标，并支持未见结构交互分割。
nodes.description_en: Performs 3D Point Prompt within the core unified 3d promptable segmentation computation pathway.

nodes.label: Automatic Head
nodes.description: 利用类别先验一次预测预定义解剖结构。
nodes.description_en: Performs Automatic Head within the core unified 3d promptable segmentation computation pathway.

nodes.label: Point Head
nodes.description: 把点嵌入与体特征融合，响应用户修正。
nodes.description_en: Performs Point Head within the core unified 3d promptable segmentation computation pathway.

nodes.label: Supervoxel Prior
nodes.description: 以 3D supervoxel 组织区域，并蒸馏 2D foundation 特征以扩展结构知识。
nodes.description_en: Performs Supervoxel Prior within the core unified 3d promptable segmentation computation pathway.

nodes.label: Unified Decoder
nodes.description: 融合自动类别、提示和共享体特征，保持一个模型接口。
nodes.description_en: Applies Unified Decoder to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: 3D Masks
nodes.description: 输出自动、交互修正或提示条件下的新结构分割。
nodes.description_en: Produces automated 127-class 3d segmentation masks or interactive point-prompted 3d masks (including zero-shot novel structures) via 3D Masks.

paper.title: VISTA3D: A Unified Segmentation Foundation Model for 3D Medical Imaging

paper_figure.label: Figure 1 · PDF p.2
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 自动模型难交互修正，2D SAM 对复杂 3D 解剖和标注流程不匹配
keypoints.核心想法: 单一 3D 模型统一自动分割、点提示交互和提示条件下的新结构 zero-shot
keypoints.关键改进: 127 类自动分割、3D prompt 接口与 supervoxel 蒸馏的 2D foundation 特征
keypoints.医学适配: 面向 CT 的可复用 3D 标注与交互式修正接口
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 代表 3D promptable segmentation 的实质进展，仍需前瞻跨机构验证

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Closed-set 3D models cannot interactively refine errors, whereas slice-wise 2D SAM loses 3D volumetric coherence.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Unify automated multi-organ 3D segmentation, interactive 3D point prompting, and novel-structure zero-shot transfer in one 3D backbone.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Dual class/point prompt decoder coupled with 3D supervoxel feature distillation from 2D foundation models.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Provides a versatile 3D CT annotation acceleration and interactive correction interface.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Substantial step forward in 3D promptable segmentation; prospective multi-center workflow validation remains ongoing.

name: S4
summary: 结构化 A 矩阵使线性 SSM 可在长卷积训练与递推推理间等价切换。
summary_en: Parameterizes state matrix A as Normal Plus Low-Rank (NPLR) so linear SSMs switch exact equivalence between O(N log N) convolutional training and O(1) recurrent inference.

nodes.label: 输入序列
nodes.description: 每个时间步先投影到 SSM 通道。
nodes.description_en: Ingests long 1d sequence x_1 … x_n and prepares initial tensor representations (input sequence).

nodes.label: 连续 SSM
nodes.description: 定义 ḣ=Ah+Bx、y=Ch+Dx 的线性动力系统。
nodes.description_en: Executes continuous SSM to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: Structured A
nodes.description: 以 HiPPO/结构化参数约束状态矩阵，兼顾稳定性和长记忆。
nodes.description_en: Performs Structured A within the core structured state space computation pathway.

nodes.label: 离散化
nodes.description: 按采样间隔把 A、B 转为离散状态更新矩阵。
nodes.description_en: Performs discrete within the core structured state space computation pathway.

nodes.label: SSM Kernel
nodes.description: 将线性递推等价为长卷积核，并用结构化计算高效生成。
nodes.description_en: Performs SSM Kernel within the core structured state space computation pathway.

nodes.label: 长卷积路径
nodes.description: 训练时对完整序列并行卷积，常通过 FFT/结构化算法实现。
nodes.description_en: Performs convolution within the core structured state space computation pathway.

nodes.label: 递推状态
nodes.description: 推理时可按 h_t=Āh_{t−1}+B̄x_t 逐步更新。
nodes.description_en: Performs Stage 07 within the core structured state space computation pathway.

nodes.label: S4 Block
nodes.description: SSM 输出经非线性、门控/混合和 residual 组成深层网络。
nodes.description_en: Applies S4 Block to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: 序列输出
nodes.description: 保留每步表示或汇聚为下游预测。
nodes.description_en: Produces long-range sequence representation y_1 … y_n preserving distant history via sequence output.

paper.title: Efficiently Modeling Long Sequences with Structured State Spaces

paper_figure.label: Figure 1 · PDF p.2
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: RNN 难训练，CNN 与 Transformer 难稳定覆盖超长序列
keypoints.核心想法: 用结构化状态矩阵把长程递推等价为可高效计算的长卷积
keypoints.关键改进: 稳定的结构化 A 与高效 Cauchy/Vandermonde 核计算
keypoints.医学适配: 为长 EEG 与波形提供直接机制基础，也启发后续 3D 序列适配
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 现代 SSM 的数学基础；并行训练常为近 O(N log N) 的长卷积路径，递推推理可线性扩展

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: RNNs suffer from vanishing gradients and sequential training bottlenecks, while Transformers scale quadratically O(N²) on long sequences.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Initialize state matrix A with HiPPO orthogonal polynomial projections and decompose it into diagonal plus low-rank form for fast kernel evaluation.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Mathematically unifies continuous-time ODEs, O(1)-step autoregressive recurrence, and parallel FFT convolution training.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Provides the mathematical foundation for long-horizon EEG, ECG, waveform modeling, and subsequent visual/3D SSMs.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Foundational structured SSM; linear time-invariant (LTI) dynamics lack content-dependent selection until Mamba.

name: Mamba
summary: 由当前输入生成 Δ、B、C 的 selective SSM，并用硬件感知并行 scan 执行。
summary_en: Makes SSM discretization step Δ and projections B, C functions of the current input x_k, executed via a hardware-aware parallel associative scan.

nodes.label: 输入 Tokens
nodes.description: 序列先经线性层扩展并分成内容分支与门控分支。
nodes.description_en: Ingests sequence of n tokens or continuous signal samples and prepares initial tensor representations (input Tokens).

nodes.label: 内容分支 x
nodes.description: 承担局部混合与状态空间更新的主信号。
nodes.description_en: Executes Stage 02 to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: 门控分支 z
nodes.description: 经 SiLU 产生与输入相关的输出门。
nodes.description_en: Performs Stage 03 within the core selective state space block computation pathway.

nodes.label: 1D DWConv
nodes.description: 短核因果卷积在 selective scan 前编码局部邻域。
nodes.description_en: Performs 1D DWConv within the core selective state space block computation pathway.

nodes.label: Δ/B/C 选择器
nodes.description: 由当前 token 生成步长与输入/输出状态参数。
nodes.description_en: Performs Δ/B/C within the core selective state space block computation pathway.

nodes.label: Selective Scan
nodes.description: 硬件感知并行扫描按 token 决定保留、忘记和输出状态。
nodes.description_en: Performs Selective Scan within the core selective state space block computation pathway.

nodes.label: SiLU Gate
nodes.description: 选择性状态输出与 z 分支逐元素门控。
nodes.description_en: Performs SiLU Gate within the core selective state space block computation pathway.

nodes.label: 输出投影
nodes.description: 将扩展通道压回模型维度。
nodes.description_en: Applies output projection to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: Residual
nodes.description: 块输入与投影输出相加形成深层 Mamba stack。
nodes.description_en: Produces content-selectively filtered long-range sequence representations via Residual.

paper.title: Mamba: Linear-Time Sequence Modeling with Selective State Spaces

paper_figure.label: Figure 3 · PDF p.8
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 固定 SSM 不擅长按内容选择保留、遗忘和输出信息
keypoints.核心想法: 让状态更新参数随输入变化，并以硬件感知 selective scan 线性处理序列
keypoints.关键改进: input-dependent B、C、Delta 与并行 selective scan
keypoints.医学适配: 吸引 3D 分割、长生理信号和视频作为低成本全局 mixer
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 序列领域重要；医学中尚无普遍替代 CNN/Transformer 的证据

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Linear time-invariant SSMs (S4) use static transition matrices and cannot selectively remember or ignore tokens based on content.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Parameterize (Δ_k, B_k, C_k) dynamically from input x_k and compute the resulting time-varying recurrence in SRAM via parallel prefix scan.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Input-dependent selective state updates + kernel-fused GPU associative scan achieving O(N) time and memory scaling.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Adopted across 3D volumetric segmentation, gigapixel WSI, and long physiological waveforms as a linear-complexity global mixer.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Major sequence modeling milestone; in 2D/3D medical imaging, standalone superiority over tuned CNNs/Transformers is not universal.

name: VMamba
summary: SS2D 将二维网格沿四个方向 selective scan 后再逆映射融合。
summary_en: 2D Selective Scan (SS2D) unfolds spatial feature maps along four directional traversal paths, applies selective SSMs, and merges them back.

nodes.label: 输入图像
nodes.description: 图像先经卷积式 patch embedding 形成二维 token 网格。
nodes.description_en: Ingests 2d image tensor and prepares initial tensor representations (Input Image).

nodes.label: Patch Embed
nodes.description: 保持 H×W 拓扑并映射到 VSS 通道。
nodes.description_en: Executes Patch Embed to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: 四向展开
nodes.description: 生成横向正反与纵向正反四条扫描序列。
nodes.description_en: Performs unrolled within the core hierarchical 2d cross scan ssm computation pathway.

nodes.label: SS2D
nodes.description: 每条方向执行 selective scan，传播长程二维上下文。
nodes.description_en: Performs SS2D within the core hierarchical 2d cross scan ssm computation pathway.

nodes.label: Cross-scan Merge
nodes.description: 把四向输出逆排列并融合回原二维坐标。
nodes.description_en: Performs Cross-scan Merge within the core hierarchical 2d cross scan ssm computation pathway.

nodes.label: VSS Block
nodes.description: SS2D、归一化、门控/MLP 与 residual 构成视觉状态块。
nodes.description_en: Performs VSS Block within the core hierarchical 2d cross scan ssm computation pathway.

nodes.label: Patch Merging
nodes.description: 逐级降低分辨率，形成类似 Swin 的层级金字塔。
nodes.description_en: Performs Patch Merging within the core hierarchical 2d cross scan ssm computation pathway.

nodes.label: 多级 VSS
nodes.description: 在四个尺度重复 cross-scan 并扩大语义范围。
nodes.description_en: Applies VSS to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: 任务头
nodes.description: 全局池化分类，或导出各级特征给 dense decoder。
nodes.description_en: Produces four-stage hierarchical visual feature maps or classification logits via Task Head.

paper.title: VMamba: Visual State Space Model

paper_figure.label: Figure 3(a) · PDF p.5
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 将图像按单条 1D 序列展平会破坏二维拓扑
keypoints.核心想法: 以四方向 2D selective scan 和层级 VSS block 建模视觉结构
keypoints.关键改进: SS2D cross-scan 与多尺度层级 backbone
keypoints.医学适配: 作为医学 2D SSM 的视觉初始化和对照；原生 3D 仍需改造扫描与层级结构
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 重要视觉 SSM 基线；未普遍淘汰 ConvNeXt/Swin

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Flattening a 2D image into a single 1D causal raster scan destroys 2D spatial proximity along non-scan directions.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Traverse 2D feature grids simultaneously along four complementary corner-to-corner paths before summing the selective scan outputs.
keypoints_en.关键改进: SS2D four-way cross-scan module embedded within a hierarchical Visual State-Space (VSS) backbone.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Serves as the primary 2D vision SSM backbone and initialization for medical 2D segmentation and classification.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Important visual SSM baseline; native 3D volumetric extension requires tri-axial or multi-directional scan adaptations.

name: U-Mamba
summary: 在 nnU-Net 风格 residual CNN encoder/bottleneck 中插入 selective SSM，同时保留 CNN long skips。
summary_en: Embeds flattened 1D selective Mamba blocks inside an nnU-Net-style residual CNN encoder/bottleneck while retaining CNN decoder and long skips.

nodes.label: nnU-Net Planner
nodes.description: 按数据 fingerprint 决定 2D/3D、patch、kernel、spacing 与通道。
nodes.description_en: Ingests 2d or 3d medical image within the automated nnu-net pipeline and prepares initial tensor representations (nnU-Net Planner).

nodes.label: 医学影像
nodes.description: 预处理后的 2D 图像或 3D patch。
nodes.description_en: Executes Stage 02 to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: Residual CNN
nodes.description: 高分辨率路径先编码局部边缘与空间细节。
nodes.description_en: Performs Residual CNN within the core self configuring cnn ssm unet computation pathway.

nodes.label: Spatial→Sequence
nodes.description: 在 bottleneck 或各 encoder stage 将空间特征展平为序列。
nodes.description_en: Performs Spatial→Sequence within the core self configuring cnn ssm unet computation pathway.

nodes.label: Mamba Layer
nodes.description: selective scan 沿序列传播远程依赖；Bot/Enc 变体决定放置范围。
nodes.description_en: Performs Mamba Layer within the core self configuring cnn ssm unet computation pathway.

nodes.label: Sequence→Spatial
nodes.description: 把状态输出恢复到原特征网格。
nodes.description_en: Performs Sequence→Spatial within the core self configuring cnn ssm unet computation pathway.

nodes.label: CNN Long Skips
nodes.description: 未被序列瓶颈替代的高分辨率 CNN 特征直达 decoder。
nodes.description_en: Performs CNN Long Skips within the core self configuring cnn ssm unet computation pathway.

nodes.label: CNN Decoder
nodes.description: 逐级上采样并融合局部 skip 与全局 Mamba 表示。
nodes.description_en: Applies CNN Decoder to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: Seg Head
nodes.description: 输出医学分割 logits。
nodes.description_en: Produces dense pixel- or voxel-level segmentation map via Seg Head.

paper.title: U-Mamba: Enhancing Long-range Dependency for Biomedical Image Segmentation

paper_figure.label: Figure 1 · PDF p.3
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 3D CNN 全局依赖弱，而全局注意力成本高
keypoints.核心想法: 在 nnU-Net 风格 CNN 中加入 Mamba 作为 bottleneck 或 encoder 全局建模器
keypoints.关键改进: 自配置 U-Net pipeline 加 CNN-SSM hybrid block
keypoints.医学适配: 覆盖多类 2D/3D 医学分割任务
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 高热度研究基线；后续统一配方消融未发现稳定的 Mamba 独立增益

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Pure 3D CNNs have local receptive fields, whereas 3D self-attention incurs prohibitive quadratic memory on large patches.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Augment residual CNN blocks with flattened Mamba layers inside the self-configuring nnU-Net framework to combine local priors with long-range mixing.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Plug-and-play U-Mamba_Bot and U-Mamba_Enc hybrid architectures preserving nnU-Net preprocessing and long skip connections.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Evaluated across multi-organ CT, MRI, and endoscopy segmentation benchmarks.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: High-visibility hybrid baseline, though subsequent controlled ablations show matched MedNeXt / nnU-Net ResEnc often perform comparably.

name: SegMamba
summary: GSC + Tri-oriented Mamba 的 TSMamba block，以及 FUE 过滤的多尺度 skip。
summary_en: Combines Gated Spatial Convolution (GSC) with Tri-oriented Mamba (ToM) scans along axial, coronal, and sagittal axes plus Feature Uncertainty Estimation (FUE) skips.

nodes.label: 3D Input
nodes.description: C×D×H×W 体数据进入大核 depthwise stem。
nodes.description_en: Ingests 3d volumetric medical scan (ct / mri) and prepares initial tensor representations (3D Input).

nodes.label: 7³ DW Stem
nodes.description: stride-2 大核逐通道卷积建立首级体特征。
nodes.description_en: Executes 7³ DW Stem to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: GSC
nodes.description: Gated Spatial Convolution 在序列化前补充局部三维空间关系。
nodes.description_en: Performs GSC within the core tri oriented 3d mamba unet computation pathway.

nodes.label: Tri-oriented Mamba
nodes.description: 沿 D、H、W 三种取向执行 Mamba，融合各轴长程依赖。
nodes.description_en: Performs Tri-oriented Mamba within the core tri oriented 3d mamba unet computation pathway.

nodes.label: TSMamba Block
nodes.description: GSC、LayerNorm、ToM、MLP 与两级 residual 组成主块。
nodes.description_en: Performs TSMamba Block within the core tri oriented 3d mamba unet computation pathway.

nodes.label: 多尺度 Encoder
nodes.description: 下采样后重复 TSMamba，通道逐级增大。
nodes.description_en: Performs multi-scale Encoder within the core tri oriented 3d mamba unet computation pathway.

nodes.label: FUE
nodes.description: Feature-level Uncertainty Estimation 过滤和加权多尺度 skip 特征。
nodes.description_en: Performs FUE within the core tri oriented 3d mamba unet computation pathway.

nodes.label: Residual Decoder
nodes.description: 转置卷积上采样并融合经 FUE 筛选的 encoder 特征。
nodes.description_en: Applies Residual Decoder to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: Seg Head
nodes.description: 输出每体素类别概率。
nodes.description_en: Produces multi-scale fused 3d volumetric segmentation via Seg Head.

paper.title: SegMamba: Long-range Sequential Modeling Mamba For 3D Medical Image Segmentation

paper_figure.label: Figure 1 · PDF p.3
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 高分辨率全体积 Transformer 的显存成本不可承受
keypoints.核心想法: 用多尺度 3D Mamba 处理 whole-volume 长序列依赖
keypoints.关键改进: 线性 scan 覆盖中低分辨率 feature grid 上的数十万 token，并保留多尺度解码
keypoints.医学适配: 代表同行评议的 medical Mamba 3D 分割路线
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 值得复现；仍缺统一配方、多中心和边界/小病灶证据

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: High-resolution whole-volume 3D Transformers exceed GPU memory, while single-direction 3D flattening loses tri-planar anatomy.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Apply gated 3D spatial convolutions followed by tri-directional Mamba scans across forward, reverse, and inter-slice axes.
keypoints_en.关键改进: TSMamba block (GSC + Tri-oriented Mamba) paired with uncertainty-weighted multi-scale skip refinement.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Representative peer-reviewed 3D medical Mamba architecture for brain tumor and colorectal segmentation.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Worth reproducing as a 3D SSM reference; still requires broader multi-center and boundary-level validation.

name: Transformer
summary: 无递归的多头 self-attention encoder 与 masked self-/cross-attention decoder。
summary_en: Recurrence-free multi-head self-attention encoder paired with a masked self- and cross-attention decoder.

nodes.label: 源 Tokens
nodes.description: 词嵌入与位置编码相加后送入 encoder。
nodes.description_en: Ingests source token sequence and right-shifted target token sequence and prepares initial tensor representations (Tokens).

nodes.label: Encoder MHA
nodes.description: 每个源 token 以 Q/K/V 对全部源 token 做多头 self-attention。
nodes.description_en: Executes Encoder MHA to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: Encoder FFN
nodes.description: 逐位置前馈网络配合 residual 与 LayerNorm。
nodes.description_en: Performs Encoder FFN within the core encoder decoder attention computation pathway.

nodes.label: Encoder Memory
nodes.description: 堆叠 encoder blocks 后形成供 decoder 查询的上下文。
nodes.description_en: Performs Encoder Memory within the core encoder decoder attention computation pathway.

nodes.label: 目标 Tokens
nodes.description: 训练时输入右移真值；推理时输入已生成 token。
nodes.description_en: Performs objective Tokens within the core encoder decoder attention computation pathway.

nodes.label: Masked MHA
nodes.description: 因果 mask 阻止目标 token 看到未来位置。
nodes.description_en: Performs Masked MHA within the core encoder decoder attention computation pathway.

nodes.label: Cross-attention
nodes.description: decoder query 从 encoder memory 的 key/value 聚合源信息。
nodes.description_en: Performs Cross-attention within the core encoder decoder attention computation pathway.

nodes.label: Decoder FFN
nodes.description: 跨模态/跨序列融合后逐位置变换。
nodes.description_en: Applies Decoder FFN to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: Linear + Softmax
nodes.description: 预测下一个目标 token 的词表分布。
nodes.description_en: Produces autoregressive target token probabilities or contextualized sequence embeddings via Linear + Softmax.

paper.title: Attention Is All You Need

paper_figure.label: Figures 1 and 2 · PDF pp.3–4
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: RNN 串行且长依赖路径长，卷积需堆层获得远程交互
keypoints.核心想法: 以 scaled dot-product multi-head self-attention 并行建模 token 间关系
keypoints.关键改进: Q/K/V 动态全局交互、位置编码、残差和前馈网络
keypoints.医学适配: 是 ViT、医学 VLM、长生理信号模型的共同基础
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 基础设施级方法；高分辨 3D 仍受 O(N²) 限制

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Recurrent networks precluded parallel training across time steps and struggled with long-range dependencies.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Replace recurrence and convolution entirely with parallel multi-head scaled dot-product attention and position encodings.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Content-dependent Q/K/V all-pair affinity matrices, multi-head subspace projection, residual LayerNorm, and position-wise FFN.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Foundational operator underlying Vision Transformers, medical VLMs, multimodal EHR fusion, and biosignal foundation models.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Universal deep learning infrastructure; direct application to dense 3D voxels is bottlenecked by O(N²) attention complexity.

name: Vision Transformer (ViT)
summary: 非重叠 patch 线性 token 化、CLS 汇聚与全局 Transformer encoder，完全移除卷积主干。
summary_en: Splits images into non-overlapping patches, linearly projects them into tokens with positional embeddings, and processes them via a pure global Transformer encoder.

nodes.label: 输入图像
nodes.description: 图像被规则切成互不重叠的 P×P 区块。
nodes.description_en: Ingests fixed-resolution 2d image (or 3d sub-volume patches) and prepares initial tensor representations (Input Image).

nodes.label: Patchify
nodes.description: 每个 patch 展平，使二维空间问题变成长度 N 的序列。
nodes.description_en: Executes Patchify to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: 线性 Patch 嵌入
nodes.description: 共享线性投影把每个 patch 映射到 D 维 token。
nodes.description_en: Performs Patch embedding within the core patch token encoder computation pathway.

nodes.label: CLS + 位置
nodes.description: 序列前置可学习 CLS token，并叠加可学习绝对位置编码。
nodes.description_en: Performs CLS + within the core patch token encoder computation pathway.

nodes.label: 全局 MSA
nodes.description: 所有 patch token 在每层内进行全局多头自注意力。
nodes.description_en: Performs global MSA within the core patch token encoder computation pathway.

nodes.label: MLP Block
nodes.description: 两层前馈网络逐 token 做通道变换；MSA 与 MLP 均带 pre-norm residual。
nodes.description_en: Performs MLP Block within the core patch token encoder computation pathway.

nodes.label: L× Encoder
nodes.description: 重复 Transformer encoder，空间分辨率与 token 数保持不变。
nodes.description_en: Applies L× Encoder to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: CLS Head
nodes.description: 取最终 CLS 状态，经 LayerNorm 与线性头完成分类。
nodes.description_en: Produces global [cls] representation, patch token grid, or classification logits via CLS Head.

paper.title: An Image Is Worth 16x16 Words: Transformers for Image Recognition at Scale

paper_figure.label: Figure 1 · PDF p.3
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: Transformer 缺少二维图像输入接口，视觉模型长期依赖卷积
keypoints.核心想法: 把图像切成 patch token 并使用标准 Transformer encoder
keypoints.关键改进: patch embedding、位置编码和 class token 形成可扩展视觉编码器
keypoints.医学适配: 成为医学 foundation encoder 主流，但 3D 和小病灶需更细致 token 化
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 大规模预训练时强；小数据从头训练不一定优于 CNN

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Standard Transformers could not directly ingest pixel grids due to quadratic cost, leaving computer vision reliant on CNNs.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Treat non-overlapping 16×16 image patches as sequence tokens and apply a standard isotropic Transformer encoder.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Linear patchify stem, learnable 1D positional embeddings, and global self-attention from the very first layer.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Dominant backbone for large-scale self-supervised pathology (UNI, Virchow) and multimodal medical foundation models.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Excels under massive pretraining (MAE, DINOv2, CLIP); underperforms CNNs when trained from scratch on small medical cohorts.

name: Swin Transformer
summary: W-MSA 与 SW-MSA 交替实现局部高效注意力和跨窗连接，并以 patch merging 形成层次金字塔。
summary_en: Alternates regular Windowed Multi-Head Self-Attention (W-MSA) with Shifted-Window Attention (SW-MSA) across a patch-merging multi-scale pyramid.

nodes.label: 输入图像
nodes.description: 以 4×4 patch 为基本单元建立高分辨率 token 网格。
nodes.description_en: Ingests 2d image (or 3d volume in video/3d swin) and prepares initial tensor representations (Input Image).

nodes.label: Patch 嵌入
nodes.description: 相邻像素块映射为 C 维 token，保留二维布局。
nodes.description_en: Executes Patch embedding to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: 窗口划分
nodes.description: 特征被切成 M×M 非重叠局部窗口。
nodes.description_en: Performs Stage 03 within the core hierarchical shifted window transformer computation pathway.

nodes.label: W-MSA
nodes.description: 注意力只在各局部窗口内部计算，复杂度相对图像大小近似线性。
nodes.description_en: Performs W-MSA within the core hierarchical shifted window transformer computation pathway.

nodes.label: 循环移位 + Mask
nodes.description: 下一 block 将窗口平移 M/2，并用 attention mask 保持有效边界。
nodes.description_en: Performs + Mask within the core hierarchical shifted window transformer computation pathway.

nodes.label: SW-MSA
nodes.description: 移位窗口让上一层不同窗口的 token 在本层直接交互。
nodes.description_en: Performs SW-MSA within the core hierarchical shifted window transformer computation pathway.

nodes.label: Patch Merging
nodes.description: 拼接 2×2 邻域并线性投影；分辨率减半、通道增宽。
nodes.description_en: Performs Patch Merging within the core hierarchical shifted window transformer computation pathway.

nodes.label: 四级 Stage
nodes.description: 重复 W-MSA/SW-MSA 对并逐级下采样，形成 CNN 式层次结构。
nodes.description_en: Applies Stage to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: 多尺度输出
nodes.description: 各 stage 特征可送入分类头、检测 FPN 或分割 decoder。
nodes.description_en: Produces four-stage multi-scale hierarchical feature pyramid or task predictions via multi-scale output.

paper.title: Swin Transformer: Hierarchical Vision Transformer using Shifted Windows

paper_figure.label: Figure 3 · PDF p.4
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: ViT 单尺度且全局注意力在高分辨率图像上二次增长
keypoints.核心想法: 在局部窗口做注意力并通过 shifted windows 和 patch merging 建层级特征
keypoints.关键改进: 固定窗口近线性计算、跨窗传播与 CNN 式多尺度金字塔
keypoints.医学适配: 广泛用于 2D/3D 医学分割、检测和 Swin UNETR
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 层级 Transformer 长期有价值；窗口与 patch 尺度仍是新超参数

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Isotropic ViT maintains a single coarse token resolution and scales quadratically with image area, hindering dense segmentation.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Restrict self-attention to local non-overlapping windows for linear scaling, shifting window boundaries between consecutive layers to bridge context.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Alternating W-MSA / SW-MSA, relative position bias, and 2×2 patch merging producing a CNN-like multi-scale hierarchy.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Core backbone for Swin UNETR, TransMorph, MARS, and high-resolution 2D/3D medical dense prediction.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Enduring hierarchical Transformer standard; window size and anisotropic voxel spacing require careful tuning.

name: Mask2Former
summary: 上一层预测 mask 反向约束下一层 query cross-attention 的迭代集合分割。
summary_en: Iterative set-prediction segmentation where predicted foreground masks from layer l-1 constrain query cross-attention in layer l.

nodes.label: 输入图像
nodes.description: 单一图像入口，不预设任务专属输出格式。
nodes.description_en: Ingests 2d image and prepares initial tensor representations (Input Image).

nodes.label: 多尺度 Backbone
nodes.description: CNN 或 Swin 产生低至高分辨率特征层。
nodes.description_en: Executes multi-scale Backbone to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: Pixel Decoder
nodes.description: 多尺度可变形 attention/FPN 融合并输出逐像素特征。
nodes.description_en: Performs Pixel Decoder within the core query masked attention segmentation computation pathway.

nodes.label: Mask Features
nodes.description: 高分辨率共享特征供所有 query 生成最终 mask。
nodes.description_en: Performs Mask Features within the core query masked attention segmentation computation pathway.

nodes.label: 对象 Queries
nodes.description: 固定数量可学习 query 表示潜在区域/实例。
nodes.description_en: Performs Queries within the core query masked attention segmentation computation pathway.

nodes.label: Masked Cross-Attn
nodes.description: 每层 query 只关注上一层预测 mask 内的多尺度像素，而非整图。
nodes.description_en: Performs Masked Cross-Attn within the core query masked attention segmentation computation pathway.

nodes.label: Self-Attn + FFN
nodes.description: query 间竞争/去重，并更新其语义状态。
nodes.description_en: Performs Self-Attn + FFN within the core query masked attention segmentation computation pathway.

nodes.label: 类别 Head
nodes.description: 每个 query 输出类别或 no-object 概率。
nodes.description_en: Performs Head within the core query masked attention segmentation computation pathway.

nodes.label: Mask Embedding
nodes.description: query mask embedding 与共享 mask features 点积得到像素 logits。
nodes.description_en: Applies Mask Embedding to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: 任务 Mask 集
nodes.description: 按类别和 query 组合规则得到语义、实例或全景结果。
nodes.description_en: Produces set of class-labeled binary masks unifying semantic, instance, and panoptic segmentation via Mask.

paper.title: Masked-attention Mask Transformer for Universal Image Segmentation

paper_figure.label: Figure 2 · PDF p.3
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 语义、实例和全景分割依赖各自专用结构，全图 cross-attention 昂贵
keypoints.核心想法: 把分割统一为一组 mask queries 的分类与掩膜预测
keypoints.关键改进: masked cross-attention 只关注当前预测区域，配合多尺度 pixel decoder
keypoints.医学适配: 启发医学多实例细胞、病灶和开放词汇 mask 接口
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 任务接口影响持久；3D、小目标和 matching 稳定性仍是门槛

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Semantic, instance, and panoptic segmentation relied on fragmented task heads, while global cross-attention converged slowly.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Formulate all segmentation tasks as mask-classification set prediction using learnable object queries and masked cross-attention.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Multi-scale high-resolution pixel decoder + masked cross-attention attending strictly within each query's predicted foreground region.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Inspires unified multi-instance nuclei, lesion, and open-vocabulary query segmentation in pathology and radiology.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Influential universal task interface; 3D memory scaling, tiny lesions, and bipartite matching stability remain challenging.

name: SimCLR
summary: 无动量教师或队列，以大 batch 内的两视图实例对和非线性投影头训练 NT-Xent。
summary_en: Trains an encoder and non-linear MLP projection head via in-batch NT-Xent contrastive loss across dual augmented views without momentum queues.

nodes.label: 原始样本
nodes.description: 一个 batch 中每幅图像作为一个实例类别。
nodes.description_en: Ingests pair of randomly augmented views (x̃_i, x̃_j) of the same image and prepares initial tensor representations (Stage 01).

nodes.label: 增强视图 A
nodes.description: 随机裁剪、翻转、颜色扰动等组合生成第一视图。
nodes.description_en: Executes Stage 02 to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: 增强视图 B
nodes.description: 独立随机增强生成同一实例的第二视图。
nodes.description_en: Performs Stage 03 within the core siamese contrastive pretraining computation pathway.

nodes.label: 共享 Encoder f
nodes.description: 两个视图通过完全共享参数的 ResNet 得到 h。
nodes.description_en: Performs Encoder f within the core siamese contrastive pretraining computation pathway.

nodes.label: 非线性投影 g
nodes.description: 两层 MLP 将 h 映射到训练对比损失的 z 空间。
nodes.description_en: Performs projection g within the core siamese contrastive pretraining computation pathway.

nodes.label: L2 归一化
nodes.description: z 归一化后以内积表示余弦相似度。
nodes.description_en: Performs L2 normalization within the core siamese contrastive pretraining computation pathway.

nodes.label: Batch 相似矩阵
nodes.description: 2N 个视图两两比较；同源两视图为正对，其余为负对。
nodes.description_en: Performs Batch matrix within the core siamese contrastive pretraining computation pathway.

nodes.label: NT-Xent
nodes.description: 温度缩放交叉熵拉近正对并推远 batch 内负对。
nodes.description_en: Applies NT-Xent to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: 下游表征 h
nodes.description: 预训练后丢弃投影头，保留 encoder 输出微调或线性评估。
nodes.description_en: Produces transferable visual representation h = f(x) (discarding projection head g after pretraining) via representation h.

paper.title: A Simple Framework for Contrastive Learning of Visual Representations

paper_figure.label: Figure 2 · PDF p.2
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 监督预训练依赖人工标签，早期自监督常依赖手工 pretext task
keypoints.核心想法: 用两种增强视图和 NT-Xent/InfoNCE 学实例级表示
keypoints.关键改进: 强增强、非线性 projection head、大 batch 与长训练
keypoints.医学适配: 医学中推动患者级、多视图和体数据对比学习
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 对比学习基础；医学增强和正负样本定义必须重设

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Supervised pretraining required costly manual labels, while early heuristic pretext tasks learned brittle representations.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Maximize agreement between differently augmented views of the same sample in a projected latent space while repelling all other batch samples.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Composition of strong augmentations, learnable non-linear MLP projection head g(·), and temperature-scaled cosine contrastive loss.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Sparked patient-aware, multi-view, and slice-proximity contrastive learning across radiology and pathology.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Foundational contrastive SSL paradigm; requires large batch sizes and careful medical augmentation design to avoid false negatives.

name: MoCo
summary: 由 EMA key encoder 维护一致编码、由 FIFO queue 提供大规模跨 batch 负样本的对比字典。
summary_en: Decouples contrastive negative dictionary size from mini-batch size using a FIFO queue of encoded keys updated via a momentum (EMA) encoder.

nodes.label: Query 视图
nodes.description: 第一随机增强作为当前 mini-batch 的查询。
nodes.description_en: Ingests query view x^q and key view x^k of the same image and prepares initial tensor representations (Query).

nodes.label: Key 视图
nodes.description: 第二随机增强作为与 query 匹配的正 key。
nodes.description_en: Executes Key to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: Query Encoder
nodes.description: 由损失直接反向传播更新的主编码器。
nodes.description_en: Performs Query Encoder within the core momentum dual encoder queue computation pathway.

nodes.label: Momentum Encoder
nodes.description: 参数是 query encoder 参数的指数移动平均，不接收梯度。
nodes.description_en: Performs Momentum Encoder within the core momentum dual encoder queue computation pathway.

nodes.label: Key Queue
nodes.description: FIFO 字典保存跨多个 mini-batch 的已编码负 key。
nodes.description_en: Performs Key Queue within the core momentum dual encoder queue computation pathway.

nodes.label: 点积 Logits
nodes.description: query 与正 key 及队列负 key 的归一化点积形成 logits。
nodes.description_en: Performs Logits within the core momentum dual encoder queue computation pathway.

nodes.label: InfoNCE
nodes.description: 辨认匹配 key 的对比交叉熵只更新 query 分支。
nodes.description_en: Performs InfoNCE within the core momentum dual encoder queue computation pathway.

nodes.label: EMA 更新
nodes.description: θ_k ← mθ_k +(1−m)θ_q，使字典中的 key 编码保持一致。
nodes.description_en: Applies EMA update to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: 下游 Encoder
nodes.description: 预训练后导出 query encoder 进行微调。
nodes.description_en: Produces contrastively pretrained query encoder representation via Encoder.

paper.title: Momentum Contrast for Unsupervised Visual Representation Learning

paper_figure.label: Figure 2(a–c) · PDF p.3
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: SimCLR 的负样本规模与 batch size 强绑定
keypoints.核心想法: 用 momentum encoder 与 queue 构造大而一致的动态负样本字典
keypoints.关键改进: EMA 更新 key encoder，把字典规模从当前 batch 解耦
keypoints.医学适配: 适合医学小 batch、患者级采样和算力受限 SSL
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 经典实现；其 momentum/EMA teacher 思想被后续方法继承，queue 本身并非统一模板

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: End-to-end contrastive learning (SimCLR) required massive multi-GPU batch sizes to supply sufficient negative samples.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Maintain a large dynamic dictionary queue of negative embeddings encoded by a slowly progressing Exponential Moving Average (EMA) key encoder.
keypoints_en.关键改进: EMA key parameter update θ_k ← m θ_k + (1−m) θ_q paired with an enqueue/dequeue FIFO memory bank.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Well-suited for compute-constrained 2D/3D medical contrastive pretraining where GPU memory restricts batch size.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Classic contrastive mechanism; its EMA teacher principle directly informed BYOL, DINO, and modern SSL.

name: MAE
summary: 高比例随机遮蔽后仅编码可见 patch，再用轻量 decoder 重建 mask patch 的非对称自编码器。
summary_en: Asymmetric autoencoder that masks 75% of image patches, encodes only the 25% visible tokens with a heavy ViT, and reconstructs pixels via a lightweight decoder.

nodes.label: 输入图像
nodes.description: 图像切成固定大小的非重叠 patch。
nodes.description_en: Ingests image with a high proportion (e.g., 75%) of randomly masked patches and prepares initial tensor representations (Input Image).

nodes.label: 随机遮蔽 75%
nodes.description: 每幅图随机打乱 patch，仅保留少量可见 token。
nodes.description_en: Executes masked 75% to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: 可见 Tokens
nodes.description: 只有未遮蔽 patch 被线性嵌入并送入 encoder。
nodes.description_en: Performs Tokens within the core asymmetric masked autoencoder computation pathway.

nodes.label: 重型 ViT Encoder
nodes.description: 高容量 encoder 仅处理约 25% token，显著降低预训练计算。
nodes.description_en: Performs ViT Encoder within the core asymmetric masked autoencoder computation pathway.

nodes.label: 补 Mask Token
nodes.description: 把可见编码投影到 decoder 维度，插入共享 mask token 并按原位置复原序列。
nodes.description_en: Performs Mask Token within the core asymmetric masked autoencoder computation pathway.

nodes.label: 轻量 Decoder
nodes.description: 较浅、较窄的 Transformer 同时处理可见与 mask token。
nodes.description_en: Performs Decoder within the core asymmetric masked autoencoder computation pathway.

nodes.label: 像素预测头
nodes.description: 每个 token 预测对应 patch 的归一化像素值。
nodes.description_en: Performs pixel prediction within the core asymmetric masked autoencoder computation pathway.

nodes.label: Masked MSE
nodes.description: 均方误差只在被遮蔽 patch 上计算。
nodes.description_en: Applies Masked MSE to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: 下游 Encoder
nodes.description: 预训练结束后丢弃 decoder，仅迁移 encoder。
nodes.description_en: Produces reconstructed masked patches during pretraining; high-capacity vit encoder for downstream fine-tuning via Encoder.

paper.title: Masked Autoencoders Are Scalable Vision Learners

paper_figure.label: Figure 1 · PDF p.1
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 对比学习依赖强增强和大 batch，ViT 预训练计算昂贵
keypoints.核心想法: 高比例遮挡图像 patch，仅让重型 encoder 处理可见 token，再轻量重建
keypoints.关键改进: 约 75% masking 与非对称 encoder-decoder 显著降低计算
keypoints.医学适配: 成为 2D、3D MRI/CT 与病理预训练的基础方法
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 基础设施级 SSL；像素重建可能偏重低层强度

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Contrastive SSL depended heavily on hand-crafted view augmentations, while full-token ViT pretraining was computationally expensive.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Exploit high spatial redundancy in images by dropping 75% of patches before the encoder and reconstructing raw normalized pixels.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Asymmetric encoder–decoder design (encoder processes only 25% visible tokens → >3× compute reduction) + high masking ratio.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Workhorse self-supervised pretraining method for 3D CT/MRI volumes, gigapixel pathology, retinal OCT, and biosignals.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Core SSL infrastructure; pixel-level MSE emphasizes fine texture and intensity, shining brightest under downstream fine-tuning.

name: DINO
summary: 无负样本的 EMA teacher–student 跨视图概率匹配，以 centering 与 sharpening 防止塌缩。
summary_en: Negative-free self-distillation where a student ViT matches the centered, temperature-sharpened probability distribution of an EMA teacher across multi-crop views.

nodes.label: Multi-Crop 视图
nodes.description: 每图生成两个全局 crop 和多个局部 crop；teacher 只看全局视图。
nodes.description_en: Ingests 2 global views and multiple local lower-resolution crops of an unlabeled image and prepares initial tensor representations (Multi-Crop).

nodes.label: Student ViT
nodes.description: student 处理全部全局与局部视图并接收梯度。
nodes.description_en: Executes Student ViT to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: Student Head
nodes.description: MLP 与归一化/权重归一化层输出高维概率 logits。
nodes.description_en: Performs Student Head within the core self distillation ema teacher computation pathway.

nodes.label: EMA Teacher
nodes.description: teacher 与 student 同构，参数由 student 的指数移动平均更新。
nodes.description_en: Performs EMA Teacher within the core self distillation ema teacher computation pathway.

nodes.label: Teacher Head
nodes.description: 仅对全局 crops 生成无梯度目标分布。
nodes.description_en: Performs Teacher Head within the core self distillation ema teacher computation pathway.

nodes.label: Center + Sharpen
nodes.description: teacher logits 减去移动中心并用较低温度锐化，协同避免塌缩。
nodes.description_en: Performs Center + Sharpen within the core self distillation ema teacher computation pathway.

nodes.label: Cross-View CE
nodes.description: 每个 teacher 全局视图监督来自另一视图的 student 输出。
nodes.description_en: Performs Cross-View CE within the core self distillation ema teacher computation pathway.

nodes.label: 动量更新
nodes.description: 训练后期提高 teacher 动量，使目标平滑稳定。
