nodes.description_en: Applies update to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: 语义特征
nodes.description: 导出 student/teacher backbone；ViT attention 常呈现无监督对象区域。
nodes.description_en: Produces self-distilled vit global [cls] and dense patch representations via feature.

paper.title: Emerging Properties in Self-Supervised Vision Transformers

paper_figure.label: Figure 2 · PDF p.2
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 无标签 ViT 缺少稳定的语义学习目标与 collapse 控制，对比方法又依赖负样本
keypoints.核心想法: student 预测 EMA teacher 在多 crop 上的锐化、居中分布，无标签无显式负样本
keypoints.关键改进: self-distillation、EMA、stop-gradient、centering 与 multi-crop
keypoints.医学适配: 其 patch 表示直接启发病理和放射 foundation encoder
keypoints.适用范围与证据: DINOv2 的直接祖先；机制与 collapse 控制仍必须理解

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Contrastive ViTs required explicit negative pairs or memory banks, while naive self-distillation collapsed to trivial constant outputs.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Train a student network to predict the output distribution of a momentum-updated teacher across global-to-local crops, preventing collapse via centering and sharpening.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Multi-crop local-to-global correspondence + EMA teacher centering/sharpening yielding emergent object part segmentation in ViT attention.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Directly underpins pathology tile foundation models (UNI, Virchow) and radiology self-supervised ViTs.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Essential precursor to DINOv2; emergent attention maps reflect spatial grouping but should not be over-interpreted as causal proof.

name: iBOT
summary: EMA teacher 同时充当在线视觉 tokenizer，以图像级 DINO 蒸馏和被遮 patch token 蒸馏联合训练。
summary_en: Uses the EMA teacher simultaneously as an online visual tokenizer to jointly distill masked patch tokens alongside global [CLS] self-distillation.

nodes.label: Crops + Patch Mask
nodes.description: student 视图随机遮蔽部分 patch；teacher 观察对应未遮蔽全局视图。
nodes.description_en: Ingests multi-crop augmented views with random block-wise patch masking applied to the student and prepares initial tensor representations (Crops + Patch Mask).

nodes.label: Student ViT
nodes.description: 输出 CLS token 与所有 patch token，接收梯度。
nodes.description_en: Executes Student ViT to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: EMA Teacher
nodes.description: 同构 teacher 在完整图像上产生在线目标，参数由 EMA 更新。
nodes.description_en: Performs EMA Teacher within the core online tokenizer image patch distillation computation pathway.

nodes.label: CLS Heads
nodes.description: student 与 teacher 的 CLS 概率用于跨视图图像级自蒸馏。
nodes.description_en: Performs CLS Heads within the core online tokenizer image patch distillation computation pathway.

nodes.label: Patch Heads
nodes.description: teacher patch 输出作为在线视觉 token；student 对被遮位置预测这些分布。
nodes.description_en: Performs Patch Heads within the core online tokenizer image patch distillation computation pathway.

nodes.label: 全局蒸馏
nodes.description: 不同 crops 的 CLS 概率交叉熵继承 DINO 的图像级不变性。
nodes.description_en: Performs global distillation within the core online tokenizer image patch distillation computation pathway.

nodes.label: Masked Patch 蒸馏
nodes.description: 只在 student 被遮蔽位置匹配 teacher 对应 patch 分布。
nodes.description_en: Performs Masked Patch distillation within the core online tokenizer image patch distillation computation pathway.

nodes.label: 联合目标
nodes.description: 图像级与 patch 级自蒸馏共同更新 student。
nodes.description_en: Applies objective to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: 全局 + 稠密特征
nodes.description: CLS 服务分类，patch tokens 服务检测、分割和对应关系。
nodes.description_en: Produces vit representations capturing both global image semantics and fine-grained local patch semantics via global + feature.

paper.title: iBOT: Image BERT Pre-Training with Online Tokenizer

paper_figure.label: Figure 3 · PDF p.4
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: BEiT 依赖离线离散 tokenizer，局部与全局目标割裂
keypoints.核心想法: 用 EMA teacher 作为在线 tokenizer，同时蒸馏 masked patch 和全局 class token
keypoints.关键改进: 联合在线 tokenization、patch-level MIM 与 image-level self-distillation
keypoints.医学适配: 成为病理 Phikon、TITAN 等医学 foundation 配方的重要来源
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 重要训练思想；常与 DINO 系目标组合使用

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: BEiT required a separately pretrained offline discrete VAE tokenizer, decoupling local token recovery from global semantic learning.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Turn the EMA teacher network itself into an online continuous/categorical tokenizer supervising masked student patch tokens.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Unifies DINO-style global self-distillation with masked image modeling (MIM) in a single single-stage online teacher–student loop.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Core pretraining ingredient in DINOv2, Phikon, UNI, Virchow, and TITAN pathology foundation models.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Highly effective dense + global SSL objective; standardly deployed in tandem with DINOv2 recipes.

name: DINOv2
summary: 以 LVD-142M 数据策展配合 DINO+iBOT+KoLeo 复合自监督，并通过跨尺寸蒸馏形成模型家族。
summary_en: Combines automated deduplication/retrieval curation (LVD-142M) with a composite DINO + iBOT + KoLeo objective and multi-resolution distillation.

nodes.label: 原始图像池
nodes.description: 从超大规模未整理网络图像出发。
nodes.description_en: Ingests large-scale deduplicated and rebalanced unlabeled image corpus and prepares initial tensor representations (Stage 01).

nodes.label: LVD-142M 策展
nodes.description: 用种子数据、相似检索、去重与重平衡构造 1.42 亿图像训练集。
nodes.description_en: Executes LVD-142M to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: Multi-Crop + Mask
nodes.description: 全局/局部 crops 与 patch masking 同时生成训练视图。
nodes.description_en: Performs Multi-Crop + Mask within the core curated data composite self distillation computation pathway.

nodes.label: Student ViT
nodes.description: ViT-g/14 等 student 输出 CLS 与 patch tokens，并接收梯度。
nodes.description_en: Performs Student ViT within the core curated data composite self distillation computation pathway.

nodes.label: EMA Teacher
nodes.description: teacher 产生平滑的图像级和 patch 级目标。
nodes.description_en: Performs EMA Teacher within the core curated data composite self distillation computation pathway.

nodes.label: DINO Loss
nodes.description: 跨视图 CLS 自蒸馏学习图像级语义不变性。
nodes.description_en: Performs DINO Loss within the core curated data composite self distillation computation pathway.

nodes.label: iBOT Loss
nodes.description: student 在被遮位置预测 teacher patch 分布。
nodes.description_en: Performs iBOT Loss within the core curated data composite self distillation computation pathway.

nodes.label: KoLeo 正则
nodes.description: 鼓励 batch 内特征在单位超球面更均匀分散，提升多样性。
nodes.description_en: Performs KoLeo regularization within the core curated data composite self distillation computation pathway.

nodes.label: 跨尺寸蒸馏
nodes.description: 用大 teacher 训练更小 ViT，保留高质量表征并降低部署成本。
nodes.description_en: Applies distillation to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: 通用视觉特征
nodes.description: 冻结 backbone 即可支持分类、检索、深度与密集预测。
nodes.description_en: Produces out-of-the-box transferable frozen global and dense patch embeddings across model scales via feature.

paper.title: DINOv2: Learning Robust Visual Features without Supervision

paper_figure.label: Figure 3 · PDF p.4
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 早期 SSL 的数据治理与大规模训练配方难扩展、难复现
keypoints.核心想法: 在清洗的 LVD-142M 上结合 DINO、iBOT 与 KoLeo 训练可复用视觉特征
keypoints.关键改进: 自动数据筛选、复合自蒸馏目标和多尺寸蒸馏
keypoints.医学适配: 直接支撑 UNI、Virchow 等病理 foundation encoder
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 强通用特征底座；自然图像域不能自动覆盖灰阶、3D 和微小病灶

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Prior self-supervised models degraded on uncurated web noise and often required full end-to-end fine-tuning for dense tasks.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Curate a balanced, deduplicated pretraining corpus via embedding retrieval and train a scalable ViT family with composite self-distillation.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Automated data curation pipeline + DINO + untied-head iBOT + KoLeo sphere uniformity regularizer + high-resolution short adaptation.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Forms the direct algorithmic backbone of modern pathology foundation encoders (UNI, Virchow, Prov-GigaPath) and RAD-DINO.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Gold-standard frozen visual feature extractor; natural-image weights still benefit from in-domain medical adaptation for 3D/grayscale.

name: CLIP
summary: 完全分离的图像/文本双塔，通过批内 N×N 对称对比目标对齐，并用文本 prompt 充当开放词表分类器。
summary_en: Aligns separate image and text encoders in a shared embedding space via symmetric in-batch N×N contrastive loss, turning text prompts into zero-shot classifiers.

nodes.label: 图像批次
nodes.description: N 幅图像构成视觉分支输入。
nodes.description_en: Ingests mini-batch of n paired (image, natural-language caption) samples and prepares initial tensor representations (Stage 01).

nodes.label: Image Encoder
nodes.description: ResNet 或 ViT 将每幅图像编码为一个全局向量。
nodes.description_en: Executes Image Encoder to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: 图像投影 + Norm
nodes.description: 线性投影并 L2 归一化到共享 d 维球面。
nodes.description_en: Performs projection + Norm within the core dual tower image text contrastive computation pathway.

nodes.label: 文本批次
nodes.description: 与图像配对的 captions，零样本时替换为类别 prompt。
nodes.description_en: Performs Stage 04 within the core dual tower image text contrastive computation pathway.

nodes.label: Text Transformer
nodes.description: 因果 Transformer 取 EOT token 作为句子表示。
nodes.description_en: Performs Text Transformer within the core dual tower image text contrastive computation pathway.

nodes.label: 文本投影 + Norm
nodes.description: 线性投影并 L2 归一化到同一嵌入空间。
nodes.description_en: Performs projection + Norm within the core dual tower image text contrastive computation pathway.

nodes.label: N×N 相似矩阵
nodes.description: 所有图像与所有文本做余弦相似度并乘可学习温度尺度。
nodes.description_en: Performs N×N matrix within the core dual tower image text contrastive computation pathway.

nodes.label: 双向 CE
nodes.description: 图像找文本与文本找图像的交叉熵取平均。
nodes.description_en: Applies CE to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: Prompt 分类
nodes.description: 候选类别写成文本模板，图像按与各文本向量的相似度分类。
nodes.description_en: Produces l2-normalized shared-space image/text embeddings and cosine zero-shot classification logits via Prompt.

paper.title: Learning Transferable Visual Models From Natural Language Supervision

paper_figure.label: Figure 1 · PDF p.2
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 监督分类器只能识别固定类别，类别标签表达有限
keypoints.核心想法: 双编码器以对称图文对比损失建立开放词汇共享嵌入空间
keypoints.关键改进: 海量图文弱监督、prompt zero-shot 与高效检索
keypoints.医学适配: 奠定 CXR-report、病理-caption 和医学 zero-shot VLM 路线
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 医学 VLM 基础设施；global embedding、false negatives 与校准仍有限

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Closed-set classifiers could not generalize to unseen diagnostic categories or leverage rich free-text clinical descriptions.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Train dual image and text encoders jointly on 400M image–text pairs to maximize cosine similarity of true pairs against N²−N negatives.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Scalable dual-encoder contrastive pretraining + natural-language prompt templates enabling zero-shot open-vocabulary transfer.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Foundational blueprint for ConVIRT, GLoRIA, BioViL, BiomedCLIP, CONCH, and multimodal radiology/pathology retrieval.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Core VLM infrastructure; global pooled vectors lack fine spatial localization and require calibration before clinical thresholding.

name: BLIP-2
summary: Q-Former 的 learnable queries 作为冻结图像 encoder 与冻结 LLM 之间唯一可训练的视觉信息瓶颈。
summary_en: Bridges a frozen pretrained image encoder to a frozen LLM using a lightweight Querying Transformer (Q-Former) with learnable query tokens as an information bottleneck.

nodes.label: 输入图像
nodes.description: 图像由已预训练且冻结的视觉主干读取。
nodes.description_en: Ingests image + text caption (stage 1) or image + natural-language instruction prompt (stage 2) and prepares initial tensor representations (Input Image).

nodes.label: 冻结 Image Encoder
nodes.description: 高容量 ViT 产生空间视觉 tokens，BLIP-2 训练时不更新。
nodes.description_en: Executes Frozen Image Encoder to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: 可学习 Queries
nodes.description: 固定数量 query token 是视觉信息进入语言侧的可训练瓶颈。
nodes.description_en: Performs Learnable Query Tokens within the core frozen vision qformer frozen llm bridge computation pathway.

nodes.label: Q-Former
nodes.description: 共享 self-attention 的两个 Transformer 子模块中，query 以周期性交叉注意力读取冻结视觉 tokens。
nodes.description_en: Performs Q-Former within the core frozen vision qformer frozen llm bridge computation pathway.

nodes.label: 表征学习三目标
nodes.description: 图文对比、图文匹配与图像条件文本生成共同训练 query–vision 对齐。
nodes.description_en: Performs representation objective within the core frozen vision qformer frozen llm bridge computation pathway.

nodes.label: LLM 投影
nodes.description: Q-Former 输出线性映射到目标 LLM 的 token embedding 维度。
nodes.description_en: Performs LLM projection within the core frozen vision qformer frozen llm bridge computation pathway.

nodes.label: 文本 Prompt
nodes.description: 任务指令或问题与视觉前缀共同构成 LLM 上下文。
nodes.description_en: Performs Text Prompt within the core frozen vision qformer frozen llm bridge computation pathway.

nodes.label: 冻结 LLM
nodes.description: OPT 或 FlanT5 等语言模型保持冻结，仅由视觉前缀条件化。
nodes.description_en: Applies Frozen LLM to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: 条件生成
nodes.description: LLM 自回归/序列到序列地产生描述、答案或其他文本。
nodes.description_en: Produces fixed-length visual query embeddings and autoregressive image-conditioned text generation via Stage 09.

paper.title: BLIP-2: Bootstrapping Language-Image Pre-training with Frozen Image Encoders and Large Language Models

paper_figure.label: Figure 1 · PDF p.1
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 端到端训练大型视觉语言模型成本过高
keypoints.核心想法: 冻结视觉 encoder 与 LLM，只训练 Q-Former 连接视觉查询和语言空间
keypoints.关键改进: 两阶段图文表示与生成训练的轻量 connector
keypoints.医学适配: 成为最有影响力的 connector-based 医学 MLLM、VQA 和报告生成模板之一
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 架构影响持久；语言先验可能覆盖真实视觉证据

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: End-to-end joint pretraining of giant vision encoders and multi-billion-parameter LLMs was computationally prohibitive.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Keep both the vision encoder and LLM frozen, training only a lightweight Q-Former bottleneck to extract language-informative visual features.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Two-stage pretraining: Stage 1 vision–language representation learning (ITC + ITM + ITG) followed by Stage 2 vision-to-LLM generative alignment.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Canonical connector architecture behind medical VQA, report generation, and multimodal LLM assistants.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Highly influential modular paradigm; strong frozen LLM priors can still hallucinate plausible text detached from visual query tokens.

name: Segment Anything (SAM)
summary: 可缓存的重型 image encoder、轻量 prompt encoder 与双向 attention mask decoder 解耦，并以动态 hypernetwork 输出多候选 mask。
summary_en: Decouples a heavy cacheable ViT image encoder from a lightweight spatial prompt encoder (points/boxes/masks) and an ambiguity-aware two-way attention mask decoder.

nodes.label: 输入图像
nodes.description: 图像统一缩放/填充到模型分辨率。
nodes.description_en: Ingests 2d image + interactive spatial prompts (foreground/background points, bounding box, or coarse mask) and prepares initial tensor representations (Input Image).

nodes.label: ViT Image Encoder
nodes.description: 重型 ViT 一次性计算稠密图像 embedding，可对多次提示复用。
nodes.description_en: Executes ViT Image Encoder to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: 点 / 框 / Mask
nodes.description: 正负点、边界框为 sparse prompts；已有 mask 为 dense prompt。
nodes.description_en: Performs Mask within the core promptable segmentation three part computation pathway.

nodes.label: Prompt Encoder
nodes.description: 坐标位置编码加类型 embedding 表示点/框，卷积表示 mask。
nodes.description_en: Performs Prompt Encoder within the core promptable segmentation three part computation pathway.

nodes.label: Two-Way Transformer
nodes.description: prompt tokens 与 image tokens 双向 cross-attention，既更新提示也回写图像表示。
nodes.description_en: Performs Two-Way Transformer within the core promptable segmentation three part computation pathway.

nodes.label: Mask Tokens
nodes.description: 若干输出 token 分别表示候选 mask；另有 IoU token 估计质量。
nodes.description_en: Performs Mask Tokens within the core promptable segmentation three part computation pathway.

nodes.label: 上采样 Embedding
nodes.description: 转置卷积把低分辨率图像 embedding 提升到 mask 网格。
nodes.description_en: Performs upsampling Embedding within the core promptable segmentation three part computation pathway.

nodes.label: 动态 Mask Head
nodes.description: 每个 mask token 经小 MLP 生成权重，与上采样图像 embedding 逐点内积。
nodes.description_en: Applies dynamic Mask Head to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: 多 Mask + IoU
nodes.description: 对歧义提示输出多个候选，并以预测 IoU 排序。
nodes.description_en: Produces multiple candidate binary segmentation masks with predicted iou quality scores via Mask + IoU.

paper.title: Segment Anything

paper_figure.label: Figure 4 · PDF p.5
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 传统分割绑定固定数据集和标签集，每换目标需重新训练
keypoints.核心想法: 可复用 ViT image encoder 加点、框、mask prompt encoder 与轻量 mask decoder
keypoints.关键改进: promptable mask proposal、候选 mask/IoU 预测与 SA-1B 数据引擎
keypoints.医学适配: 成为医学交互标注和专科适配的重要底座
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 标注基础设施；原版对低对比、小结构、血管和 3D 不可靠

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Traditional segmentation networks were locked to fixed training classes and could not interactively segment arbitrary user-specified targets.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Amortize heavy image feature extraction once per image, then decode masks in real time (<50 ms) conditioned on flexible spatial prompts.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Decoupled ViT-H encoder + positional prompt encoder + 2-layer two-way Transformer decoder + SA-1B 1.1-billion-mask data engine.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Transformed interactive medical image annotation, semi-automated contour refinement, and specialist adapter development.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Annotation infrastructure; zero-shot SAM struggles on low-contrast boundaries, thin branching vessels, and unprompted 3D volumes.

name: MedSAM
summary: 在 SAM 提示式架构上以大规模多模态医学分割监督做领域适配，并将 box prompt 作为稳定的目标定位接口。
summary_en: Adapts the promptable SAM architecture across 1.57 million medical image–mask pairs spanning 10 imaging modalities using bounding-box prompts.

nodes.label: 医学图像
nodes.description: CT、MR、X-ray、超声、内镜和病理等二维图像统一强度与尺寸接口。
nodes.description_en: Ingests normalized 2d medical image slice + target anatomical/lesion bounding box prompt and prepares initial tensor representations (Stage 01).

nodes.label: 领域适配 Image Encoder
nodes.description: 以 SAM ViT 为初始化，从大规模医学图像-mask 对学习医学视觉特征。
nodes.description_en: Executes Image Encoder to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: Box Prompt
nodes.description: 真值 mask 外接框在训练时可加入扰动，模拟用户或检测器提供的近似框。
nodes.description_en: Performs Box Prompt within the core box prompted medical sam adaptation computation pathway.

nodes.label: SAM Prompt Encoder
nodes.description: 框的两个角点经位置编码和类型 embedding 形成 sparse prompt tokens。
nodes.description_en: Performs SAM Prompt Encoder within the core box prompted medical sam adaptation computation pathway.

nodes.label: Mask Decoder
nodes.description: SAM two-way Transformer 融合医学 image embedding 与 box tokens。
nodes.description_en: Performs Mask Decoder within the core box prompted medical sam adaptation computation pathway.

nodes.label: 动态 Mask Head
nodes.description: mask token 生成动态权重，并与上采样图像特征组合成 logits。
nodes.description_en: Performs dynamic Mask Head within the core box prompted medical sam adaptation computation pathway.

nodes.label: 医学 Mask 监督
nodes.description: 跨模态、跨器官的像素级标注驱动领域适配，不改变提示式接口。
nodes.description_en: Applies Mask to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: 目标 Mask
nodes.description: 输出框内外一致的单目标分割，可由人工框或检测器框触发。
nodes.description_en: Produces box-conditioned binary segmentation mask for the target medical structure via objective Mask.

paper.title: Segment Anything in Medical Images

paper_figure.label: Figure 2(b) · PDF p.3
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 原 SAM 跨到医学低对比、多模态图像时 zero-shot 波动大
keypoints.核心想法: 在 157 万医学 image-mask pairs 上领域微调 SAM
keypoints.关键改进: 覆盖 10 种模态的大规模 box-prompt 训练和内外部任务评估
keypoints.医学适配: 用于跨模态交互式医学分割与标注加速
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 强领域适配证据；仍依赖 box prompt，非全自动 3D 终点

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Out-of-the-box natural-image SAM exhibited high variance and boundary leakage on low-contrast, multi-modality medical scans.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Fine-tune SAM's image encoder and mask decoder on a massive multi-modality medical corpus using bounding boxes as a reliable spatial prompt.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Curated 1.57M medical image–mask dataset across 10 modalities + end-to-end domain adaptation with extensive internal/external validation.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Standard interactive box-prompted segmentation tool for radiology, oncology, endoscopy, and pathology annotation.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Strong domain-adaptation evidence; remains reliant on manual or detector-generated bounding boxes per slice/ROI.

name: SAM 2
summary: 在 SAM 提示式 decoder 外加入 memory attention、mask-conditioned memory encoder 和 object pointer，构成可交互的流式时序闭环。
summary_en: Extends promptable SAM with a streaming memory bank, memory cross-attention, mask-conditioned memory encoder, and occlusion score head across sequences.

nodes.label: 当前帧
nodes.description: 同一接口既处理单张图像，也处理视频流中的一帧。
nodes.description_en: Ingests video stream or 3d slice stack + spatial prompts (points/box/mask) on one or more reference frames and prepares initial tensor representations (Stage 01).

nodes.label: Hiera Image Encoder
nodes.description: 层次化视觉 backbone 输出多尺度当前帧特征。
nodes.description_en: Executes Hiera Image Encoder to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: Prompt Encoder
nodes.description: 点、框或 mask 提示编码为当前对象的条件 tokens。
nodes.description_en: Performs Prompt Encoder within the core streaming promptable segmentation memory computation pathway.

nodes.label: Memory Bank
nodes.description: 保存近期提示帧/预测帧的空间记忆与对象指针，并控制容量。
nodes.description_en: Performs Memory Bank within the core streaming promptable segmentation memory computation pathway.

nodes.label: Memory Attention
nodes.description: 当前帧 tokens 通过 self-attention 与 cross-attention 检索历史对象证据。
nodes.description_en: Performs Memory Attention within the core streaming promptable segmentation memory computation pathway.

nodes.label: SAM Mask Decoder
nodes.description: 融合当前提示、带记忆的图像特征与对象指针，预测候选 mask。
nodes.description_en: Performs SAM Mask Decoder within the core streaming promptable segmentation memory computation pathway.

nodes.label: Object Pointer
nodes.description: 从 mask token 提取紧凑对象身份向量，帮助跨帧区分对象。
nodes.description_en: Performs Object Pointer within the core streaming promptable segmentation memory computation pathway.

nodes.label: 当前帧 Mask
nodes.description: 输出对象 mask、质量/存在性信息，可接受下一轮纠正提示。
nodes.description_en: Performs Mask within the core streaming promptable segmentation memory computation pathway.

nodes.label: Memory Encoder
nodes.description: 将预测 mask 与当前图像特征融合、压缩为空间记忆表示。
nodes.description_en: Applies Memory Encoder to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: 流式记忆更新
nodes.description: 新空间记忆和 object pointer 写入 bank，供后续帧读取。
nodes.description_en: Produces temporally/slice-propagated segmentation masks with updated object memory state via update.

paper.title: SAM 2: Segment Anything in Images and Videos

paper_figure.label: Figure 3 · PDF p.5
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: SAM 缺少跨帧时间一致性和纠错记忆
keypoints.核心想法: 用 streaming memory 在图像和视频中传播 prompt 与对象状态
keypoints.关键改进: memory bank、任意帧交互纠正与大规模 SA-V 数据引擎
keypoints.医学适配: 适合内镜、超声视频和 CT/MRI 切片提示传播
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 交互工具潜力高；相邻切片不等于真实 3D 几何

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Static 2D SAM required re-prompting every frame or slice independently, lacking temporal or inter-slice memory propagation.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Condition current-frame image features on a FIFO memory bank of past prompted frames and predicted object pointers via memory attention.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Streaming memory attention + mask-conditioned memory encoder + occlusion prediction head + SA-V video data engine.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Enables rapid interactive propagation of prompts across surgical endoscopy videos, echocardiography, and 3D CT/MRI slice stacks.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: High utility for interactive 3D/video annotation; sequential slice tracking does not replace native 3D volumetric topology priors.

name: ConVIRT
summary: 将自然生成的医学图像–报告对输入全局双塔，通过双向跨模态对比预训练医学视觉 encoder。
summary_en: Pretrains medical visual encoders directly from naturally occurring paired radiology images and free-text reports via bidirectional contrastive loss.

nodes.label: 医学图像
nodes.description: 放射影像经随机视觉增强送入图像分支。
nodes.description_en: Ingests paired medical image (e.g., chest x-ray) and corresponding clinical radiology report sentence and prepares initial tensor representations (Stage 01).

nodes.label: Image Encoder
nodes.description: 卷积主干与全局池化提取整幅影像表示。
nodes.description_en: Executes Image Encoder to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: 图像投影
nodes.description: MLP/线性头将影像特征投影并归一化到共享空间。
nodes.description_en: Performs projection within the core medical image report dual encoder contrastive computation pathway.

nodes.label: 放射报告
nodes.description: 与图像同期生成的自然语言报告提供无人工标签监督。
nodes.description_en: Performs Radiology Report within the core medical image report dual encoder contrastive computation pathway.

nodes.label: Text Encoder
nodes.description: BERT 类编码器将 token 序列聚合为报告级语义向量。
nodes.description_en: Performs Text Encoder within the core medical image report dual encoder contrastive computation pathway.

nodes.label: 文本投影
nodes.description: 报告表示投影并归一化到与图像相同维度。
nodes.description_en: Performs projection within the core medical image report dual encoder contrastive computation pathway.

nodes.label: 跨模态相似矩阵
nodes.description: mini-batch 内所有图像与报告两两计算相似度。
nodes.description_en: Performs cross-modal matrix within the core medical image report dual encoder contrastive computation pathway.

nodes.label: 双向对比损失
nodes.description: 图像检索报告和报告检索图像两个方向共同优化。
nodes.description_en: Applies loss to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: 下游影像特征
nodes.description: 丢弃训练投影头后，图像 encoder 可微调到分类等医学任务。
nodes.description_en: Produces contrastively aligned visual encoder representation for downstream low-label classification via feature.

paper.title: Contrastive Learning of Medical Visual Representations from Paired Images and Text

paper_figure.label: Figure 2 · PDF p.6
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: ImageNet 或纯图像 SSL 对医学高类间相似度与临床语义帮助有限
keypoints.核心想法: 对配对医学影像与报告做双向全局对比学习
keypoints.关键改进: 用自然语言报告作为弱监督，并展示少标签迁移
keypoints.医学适配: 奠定医学 CLIP 式胸片表示学习
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 医学图文对齐 landmark；局部定位能力有限

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: ImageNet pretraining struggled with subtle gray-scale radiographic findings, while rule-based report labelers (CheXpert) lost clinical nuance.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Use naturally co-occurring clinical radiology reports as free-form weak supervision via bidirectional image–text contrastive learning.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Domain-specific image and clinical text dual towers trained with symmetric InfoNCE, achieving strong label efficiency with 1%–10% labels.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Pioneered the medical CLIP paradigm before or alongside general-domain CLIP, establishing report-supervised radiology pretraining.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Landmark medical VLM foundation; global pooling captures study-level semantics but remains coarse for tiny focal lesions.

name: GLoRIA
summary: 在全局图文对比之外，以词为 query 对 CNN region grid 做软 attention 并训练局部区域–词对齐。
summary_en: Combines global image–report contrastive alignment with word-queried soft attention over local CNN image grid regions for fine-grained phrase grounding.

nodes.label: 胸片图像
nodes.description: 整幅 X-ray 输入视觉主干。
nodes.description_en: Ingests medical image (chest x-ray) + paired free-text radiology report and prepares initial tensor representations (Chest Radiograph).

nodes.label: 局部 Region Grid
nodes.description: CNN 保留 H×W 空间特征，每个位置代表一个影像区域。
nodes.description_en: Executes local Region Grid to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: 全局图像向量
nodes.description: region grid 经聚合得到检查级视觉表示。
nodes.description_en: Performs global vector within the core global local image report alignment computation pathway.

nodes.label: 报告 Tokens
nodes.description: 报告分词后送入语言 encoder。
nodes.description_en: Performs Tokens within the core global local image report alignment computation pathway.

nodes.label: 词级特征
nodes.description: 每个报告 token/词保留上下文化表示。
nodes.description_en: Performs feature within the core global local image report alignment computation pathway.

nodes.label: 全局文本向量
nodes.description: 报告序列聚合成检查级文本表示。
nodes.description_en: Performs global vector within the core global local image report alignment computation pathway.

nodes.label: Global Alignment
nodes.description: 在 batch 内对比配对的全局图像和报告表示。
nodes.description_en: Performs Global Alignment within the core global local image report alignment computation pathway.

nodes.label: 词→区域 Attention
nodes.description: 每个词按相似度从所有视觉 regions 聚合其对应图像上下文。
nodes.description_en: Performs → Attention within the core global local image report alignment computation pathway.

nodes.label: Local Alignment
nodes.description: 对齐词特征与其 attention 加权的局部视觉上下文。
nodes.description_en: Applies Local Alignment to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: 全局 + 局部表征
nodes.description: 联合目标后的特征支持少标签分类、检索和定位。
nodes.description_en: Produces globally aligned image/text embeddings + word-grounded local spatial attention maps via global + local representation.

paper.title: GLoRIA: A Multimodal Global-Local Representation Learning Framework for Label-efficient Medical Image Recognition

paper_figure.label: Figure 2 · PDF p.4
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: global 图文 embedding 难定位细粒度征象
keypoints.核心想法: 同时对齐整图-报告和局部影像区域-报告词语
keypoints.关键改进: 基于 attention 的 global-local contrastive objectives
keypoints.医学适配: 支持胸片检索、少标注分类/分割和 phrase grounding
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 开启医学 local grounding 主线；attention map 不等于因果解释

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Global image–report embeddings collapse spatial coordinates, failing to localize focal findings like small pneumothoraces or nodules.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Align individual report words with attention-weighted combinations of local convolutional sub-regions alongside global study alignment.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Joint global contrastive loss + word-to-region attention-weighted local contrastive objective without requiring bounding-box annotations.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Enables zero-shot phrase grounding, text-to-image retrieval, and label-efficient chest X-ray segmentation/classification.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Established local grounding in medical VLMs; soft attention heatmaps remain coarse and do not guarantee causal localization.

name: BioViL
summary: 以放射报告专用 CXR-BERT 提升文本语义，再联合学习检查级图文对比与短语–视觉 patch grounding。
summary_en: Pairs a radiology-specialized text encoder (CXR-BERT with RSM masked pretraining) with joint global and local patch–phrase contrastive alignment.

nodes.label: 胸部 X-ray
nodes.description: 单幅胸片进入保留空间特征的视觉 encoder。
nodes.description_en: Ingests chest radiograph + radiology report findings/impression text and prepares initial tensor representations (Chest X-Ray).

nodes.label: CXR Image Encoder
nodes.description: 卷积主干同时产生全局检查向量和局部 patch/region 表征。
nodes.description_en: Executes CXR Image Encoder to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: 视觉投影
nodes.description: 全局与局部视觉特征映射到共享图文维度。
nodes.description_en: Performs Visual Projection within the core radiology specialized global local vision language computation pathway.

nodes.label: 报告 / 短语
nodes.description: 放射报告既提供完整句义，也提供可定位的短语查询。
nodes.description_en: Performs Stage 04 within the core radiology specialized global local vision language computation pathway.

nodes.label: CXR-BERT
nodes.description: 先在放射报告上领域预训练的语言 encoder 表达否定与专业术语。
nodes.description_en: Performs CXR-BERT within the core radiology specialized global local vision language computation pathway.

nodes.label: 文本投影
nodes.description: 句级和 token/短语级语言特征映射到共享空间。
nodes.description_en: Performs projection within the core radiology specialized global local vision language computation pathway.

nodes.label: 全局图文对比
nodes.description: 检查级图像与对应报告在 batch 内双向对齐。
nodes.description_en: Performs Global Image–Text Alignment within the core radiology specialized global local vision language computation pathway.

nodes.label: 短语–Patch 对齐
nodes.description: 短语向量与视觉网格计算相似图，强化局部语义。
nodes.description_en: Applies –Patch to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: BioViL 表征
nodes.description: 支持零/少样本分类、图文检索和短语 grounding。
nodes.description_en: Produces negation- and clinical-syntax-aware visual-linguistic embeddings and local phrase grounding maps via BioViL representation.

paper.title: Making the Most of Text Semantics to Improve Biomedical Vision-Language Processing

paper_figure.label: Figure 1 · PDF p.3
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 通用文本 encoder 不理解放射学否定、关系和叙述结构
keypoints.核心想法: 以放射学专科语言模型增强全局图文对齐和局部 grounding
keypoints.关键改进: 强化文本侧临床语义，并联合 image-text contrastive learning
keypoints.医学适配: 在胸片 phrase grounding、分类、分割和检索上形成强专科模型
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 证明文本建模不是附属模块；模态范围仍以 CXR 为主

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Generic BERT text encoders mishandled radiological negations ('no pleural effusion'), temporal comparisons, and clinical syntax.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Pretrain a dedicated radiology language model (CXR-BERT) with radiology section matching, then align it globally and locally with chest X-rays.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Domain-tailored text modeling + symmetric global/local contrastive projection + MS-CXR phrase grounding benchmark.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Strong specialist baseline for chest X-ray zero-shot classification, phrase grounding, and semantic report evaluation.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Proved that clinical text modeling is as critical as visual architecture; scope is primarily specialized to chest radiography.

name: BiomedCLIP
summary: 以 PMC-15M 广域生物医学 figure–caption 语料、ViT 视觉塔和 PubMedBERT 文本塔训练领域 CLIP。
summary_en: Domain-specific CLIP trained on PMC-15M (15 million biomedical figure–caption pairs from PubMed Central) using a ViT vision tower and PubMedBERT text tower.

nodes.label: 生物医学图像
nodes.description: 来自论文的显微、放射、病理、图表等多样视觉内容。
nodes.description_en: Ingests biomedical image (radiology, pathology, microscopy, chart) + scientific figure caption and prepares initial tensor representations (Stage 01).

nodes.label: ViT Image Tower
nodes.description: 视觉 Transformer 将图像 patch 汇聚为全局向量。
nodes.description_en: Executes ViT Image Tower to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: 图像投影
nodes.description: 视觉向量投影并归一化到共享嵌入空间。
nodes.description_en: Performs projection within the core biomedical figure caption dual tower computation pathway.

nodes.label: 论文 Caption
nodes.description: 与 figure 配对的生物医学描述包含实体、模态和实验语境。
nodes.description_en: Performs Caption within the core biomedical figure caption dual tower computation pathway.

nodes.label: PubMedBERT Tower
nodes.description: 领域语言 encoder 处理生物医学术语和论文句法。
nodes.description_en: Performs PubMedBERT Tower within the core biomedical figure caption dual tower computation pathway.

nodes.label: 文本投影
nodes.description: caption 向量投影并归一化到视觉同一空间。
nodes.description_en: Performs projection within the core biomedical figure caption dual tower computation pathway.

nodes.label: 对称 CLIP Loss
nodes.description: 在 PMC-15M batch 内进行图像↔caption 双向对比。
nodes.description_en: Applies symmetric CLIP Loss to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: 开放词汇嵌入
nodes.description: 以文本 prompt 做零样本分类，或用于检索和下游适配。
nodes.description_en: Produces open-vocabulary biomedical multimodal embeddings for retrieval, zero-shot classification, and vqa via Open-Vocabulary Embedding.

paper.title: BiomedCLIP: a multimodal biomedical foundation model pretrained from fifteen million scientific image-text pairs

paper_figure.label: Figure 1(c) and 1(d) · PDF p.15
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 既有医学 CLIP 多局限于胸片单一模态
keypoints.核心想法: 在 PMC-15M 科学 figure-caption pairs 上训练 ViT 与 PubMedBERT 双编码器
keypoints.关键改进: 扩大到多类生物医学图像和专科文本的开放预训练
keypoints.医学适配: 用于跨模态检索、zero-shot 分类和 VQA
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 开放权重且覆盖广；科学 figure 与真实 DICOM 分布仍不同

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Prior medical CLIP models were restricted to single modalities (mostly chest X-rays) and lacked broad biomedical taxonomy coverage.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Harvest 15M diverse biomedical figure–caption pairs from PMC open-access articles and train a ViT + PubMedBERT dual encoder with long context.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Large-scale multi-specialty biomedical corpus (PMC-15M) + domain-specific PubMedBERT text encoder + patch-dropout scaling.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Widely used open-weight backbone for cross-modality biomedical retrieval, zero-shot triage, and VQA initialization.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Broadest open biomedical CLIP model; scientific publication figures differ in resolution and calibration from raw clinical DICOMs.

name: UNI
summary: 在超过一亿病理图块上以 DINOv2 式 teacher–student 训练 ViT-L/16，向多类病理任务提供统一冻结 tile encoder。
summary_en: ViT-L/16 tile encoder pretrained via DINOv2 self-distillation and iBOT masked patch modeling on over 100 million H&E histopathology patches (Mass-100K).

nodes.label: WSI 库
nodes.description: 跨器官、染色和机构的大规模全视野病理切片。
nodes.description_en: Ingests 256×256 h&e histopathology tissue tiles extracted from whole-slide images (wsis) and prepares initial tensor representations (WSI).

nodes.label: 组织 Tile 采样
nodes.description: 组织检测后从 WSI 提取高倍率图块，去除大面积背景。
nodes.description_en: Executes Tile sampling to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: Multi-Crop + Mask
nodes.description: 对 tile 生成局部/全局 crops 与遮蔽 patch 视图。
nodes.description_en: Performs Multi-Crop + Mask within the core pathology tile dinov2 foundation encoder computation pathway.

nodes.label: ViT-L/16 Student
nodes.description: 大容量视觉 Transformer 输出 tile 的 CLS 与 patch 表征。
nodes.description_en: Performs ViT-L/16 Student within the core pathology tile dinov2 foundation encoder computation pathway.

nodes.label: EMA Teacher
nodes.description: 同构 teacher 提供平滑的全局和局部自蒸馏目标。
nodes.description_en: Performs EMA Teacher within the core pathology tile dinov2 foundation encoder computation pathway.

nodes.label: DINO 图像目标
nodes.description: 跨增强视图对齐 tile 级 CLS 语义。
nodes.description_en: Performs DINO objective within the core pathology tile dinov2 foundation encoder computation pathway.

nodes.label: iBOT Patch 目标
nodes.description: 在遮蔽位置预测 teacher patch 表示，保留组织局部结构。
nodes.description_en: Performs iBOT Patch objective within the core pathology tile dinov2 foundation encoder computation pathway.

nodes.label: 冻结 Tile Embedding
nodes.description: 预训练后每个病理 tile 被编码为通用向量。
nodes.description_en: Applies Tile Embedding to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: 任务级 Aggregator
nodes.description: 线性探针、kNN、MIL 或其他聚合器把 tile 向量变为 ROI/WSI 预测。
nodes.description_en: Produces frozen transferable tile embeddings for roi tasks or mil whole-slide aggregation via Aggregator.

paper.title: Towards a General-Purpose Foundation Model for Computational Pathology

paper_figure.label: Figure 1(b) · PDF p.Official HTML Figure 1 asset
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: ImageNet 或小规模 TCGA encoder 跨组织迁移弱
keypoints.核心想法: 在超过一亿病理 patches 上用 DINOv2 训练 ViT-L 通用 tile encoder
keypoints.关键改进: 大规模多组织 WSI 数据、自监督预训练与 34 个临床任务评估
keypoints.医学适配: 原论文及后续比较报告较强的病理 label efficiency 和跨任务迁移
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 病理 foundation model 的成熟代表；slide 聚合仍常需任务训练

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: ImageNet-pretrained encoders and small TCGA-only models generalized poorly across diverse tissue types and rare cancers.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Scale DINOv2 self-supervised pretraining to >100M non-public diagnostic tissue tiles across 20 major tissue types (100,000+ WSIs).
keypoints_en.关键改进: Massive non-TCGA clinical tissue diversity + DINOv2/iBOT recipe evaluated systematically across 34 clinical pathology tasks.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Widely adopted frozen tile feature extractor for cancer subtyping, biomarker prediction, ROI retrieval, and cell segmentation.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Mature pathology tile foundation model; slide-level diagnosis still requires training an MIL or slide aggregator on top.

name: CONCH
summary: 在病理领域把 CLIP 式全局对比与 CoCa 式图像条件 caption decoder 联合训练，同时服务判别与生成。
summary_en: CoCa-style computational pathology vision–language foundation model jointly trained with contrastive image–text alignment and generative caption decoding on 1.17M pairs.

nodes.label: 病理图像
nodes.description: 组织图像进入视觉 encoder，保留供对比与生成使用的视觉 tokens。
nodes.description_en: Ingests histopathology image tile/roi + paired pathology text description or prompt and prepares initial tensor representations (Histopathology Image).

nodes.label: Image Encoder
nodes.description: ViT 将病理形态编码为全局向量和空间 token 序列。
nodes.description_en: Executes Image Encoder to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: 病理 Caption
nodes.description: 由人类撰写/筛选的病理描述提供细粒度形态与诊断语义。
nodes.description_en: Performs Caption within the core pathology contrastive captioner computation pathway.

nodes.label: Text Encoder
nodes.description: 语言 Transformer 把 caption 编码为全局文本向量。
nodes.description_en: Performs Text Encoder within the core pathology contrastive captioner computation pathway.

nodes.label: 共享嵌入
nodes.description: 图像与文本全局向量投影、归一化后进入共同空间。
nodes.description_en: Performs embedding within the core pathology contrastive captioner computation pathway.

nodes.label: 图文对比
nodes.description: CoCa 式 contrastive loss 对齐配对图像与文本并分离非配对样本。
nodes.description_en: Performs Image–Text Contrastive Loss within the core pathology contrastive captioner computation pathway.

nodes.label: Multimodal Decoder
nodes.description: 文本解码器以因果 self-attention 和对视觉 tokens 的 cross-attention 生成 caption。
nodes.description_en: Performs Multimodal Decoder within the core pathology contrastive captioner computation pathway.

nodes.label: Captioning Loss
nodes.description: teacher-forcing 的 next-token loss 要求视觉特征保留可描述的细节。
nodes.description_en: Applies Captioning Loss to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: CONCH 表征
nodes.description: 支持零样本分类、图文/图图检索、分割适配与图像描述。
nodes.description_en: Produces shared multimodal retrieval/zero-shot embeddings + autoregressive pathology caption/text generation via CONCH representation.

paper.title: A Visual-Language Foundation Model for Computational Pathology

paper_figure.label: Figure 1(c) · PDF p.Official HTML Figure 1 asset
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: vision-only 病理 encoder 缺少 zero-shot 与跨模态检索接口
keypoints.核心想法: 以 117 万病理 image-caption pairs 学开放语义视觉语言表示
keypoints.关键改进: 病理专科图文对齐，统一分类、检索、caption 和分割迁移
keypoints.医学适配: 支持病理 zero-shot/few-shot 和文本驱动检索
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 独立 benchmark 表现强；caption 构造和术语覆盖决定上限

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Vision-only pathology foundation models (UNI, Virchow) lack native text interfaces for zero-shot classification or cross-modal search.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Pretrain a ViT vision encoder, text encoder, and multimodal caption decoder on 1.17M curated human histopathology image–caption pairs.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Unifies CLIP-style dual-encoder retrieval/zero-shot transfer with CoCa-style generative captioning in computational pathology.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Enables zero-shot cancer subtyping, text-to-tile search, WSI zero-shot MI-Zero classification, and pathology captioning.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Top-performing multimodal pathology foundation model; performance is bounded by educational/caption terminology coverage.

name: Prov-GigaPath
summary: DINOv2 病理 tile encoder 与 LongNet 膨胀注意力 slide encoder 两级串联，并以 masked tile reconstruction 预训练全切片上下文。
summary_en: Two-stage gigapixel pathology foundation model pairing a DINOv2 tile encoder with a LongNet dilated-attention whole-slide encoder pretrained via masked tile reconstruction.

nodes.label: 全视野切片
nodes.description: 真实临床流程产生的 gigapixel WSI，单图远超普通视觉模型输入范围。
nodes.description_en: Ingests whole-slide image (wsi) decomposed into tens of thousands of tissue tiles with 2d spatial (x, y) coordinates and prepares initial tensor representations (Whole-Slide Image (WSI)).

nodes.label: 组织 Tiling
nodes.description: 检测组织区并提取大量定尺度 tile，同时保留其二维坐标。
nodes.description_en: Executes Tiling to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: DINOv2 Tile Encoder
nodes.description: 第一阶段在约 13 亿病理 tiles 上自监督训练 ViT，逐 tile 输出形态向量。
nodes.description_en: Performs DINOv2 Tile Encoder within the core two level tile and long context slide encoder computation pathway.

nodes.label: Tile 序列 + 坐标
nodes.description: 一张 WSI 的 tile embeddings 按空间位置组成超长序列。
nodes.description_en: Performs Tile sequence + within the core two level tile and long context slide encoder computation pathway.

nodes.label: Masked Tile 输入
nodes.description: slide 预训练时遮蔽部分 tile embeddings，要求模型利用跨区域上下文恢复。
nodes.description_en: Performs Masked Tile input within the core two level tile and long context slide encoder computation pathway.

nodes.label: LongNet Slide Encoder
nodes.description: 膨胀注意力以稀疏、多尺度连接覆盖数万 tile，避免全局 N² attention。
nodes.description_en: Performs LongNet Slide Encoder within the core two level tile and long context slide encoder computation pathway.

nodes.label: Slide MAE 目标
nodes.description: 由上下文预测被遮 tile 表征，训练 whole-slide 级关系建模。
nodes.description_en: Performs Slide MAE objective within the core two level tile and long context slide encoder computation pathway.

nodes.label: WSI Embedding
nodes.description: 聚合后的长上下文表示包含跨区域组织结构与病灶异质性。
nodes.description_en: Applies WSI Embedding to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: 病例级 Head
nodes.description: 接分类、检索、分型或预后任务头进行少量适配。
nodes.description_en: Produces contextualized whole-slide representation and patient/case-level diagnostic or genomic predictions via Head.

paper.title: A Whole-Slide Foundation Model for Digital Pathology from Real-World Data

paper_figure.label: Figure 1 · PDF p.3
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 独立 tile 表示无法捕获病例级、跨区域关系
keypoints.核心想法: DINOv2 tile encoder 加 LongNet/MAE slide encoder 建模超长全切片上下文
keypoints.关键改进: 在 13 亿 tiles 上预训练并进行 whole-slide long-context aggregation
keypoints.医学适配: 面向病理病例级诊断、分型和预后迁移
keypoints.适用范围与证据: whole-slide 建模是实质变化；跨国家流程仍需验证

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Tile-level encoders treat patches independently, while standard self-attention cannot scale to 40,000+ tiles per gigapixel WSI.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Encode tiles via DINOv2, then model whole-slide spatial dependencies across all tiles using LongNet dilated attention pretrained with MAE.
keypoints_en.关键改进: 1.3B-tile real-world clinical pretraining (171,189 WSIs) + LongNet linear-scaling dilated slide attention + vision-language report alignment.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Targets whole-slide cancer subtyping, mutation/biomarker prediction, and prognostic modeling across health-system cohorts.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Represents true whole-slide context pretraining; external multi-institutional calibration remains essential.

name: Merlin
summary: 以 I3D ResNet-152 原生编码完整 CT，并用 EHR phenotype prediction 与 Clinical Longformer 报告对比进行多源多任务预训练。
summary_en: Native 3D abdominal CT foundation model encoding whole volumes with an I3D ResNet-152 supervised jointly by EHR diagnosis codes (phenotypes) and radiology reports.

nodes.label: 3D CT Volume
nodes.description: 完整体积经统一视野与体素预处理输入，而不是随机单切片。
nodes.description_en: Ingests volumetric 3d abdominal ct scan + paired free-text radiology report + longitudinal ehr icd diagnosis codes and prepares initial tensor representations (3D CT Volume).

nodes.label: I3D ResNet-152
nodes.description: 将 2D ResNet 卷积核沿深度维膨胀，原生编码层间解剖与全体积上下文。
nodes.description_en: Executes I3D ResNet-152 to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: CT Embedding
nodes.description: 3D feature map 经聚合/投影得到检查级向量，同时保留可供下游 decoder 使用的空间特征。
nodes.description_en: Performs CT Embedding within the core native 3d ct multitask vision language computation pathway.

nodes.label: EHR Diagnosis Codes
nodes.description: 检查相关的结构化表型/诊断代码提供多标签临床监督。
nodes.description_en: Performs EHR Diagnosis Codes within the core native 3d ct multitask vision language computation pathway.

nodes.label: 表型预测 Head
nodes.description: 由 CT embedding 预测多种 diagnosis-code phenotypes，注入结构化疾病语义。
nodes.description_en: Performs prediction Head within the core native 3d ct multitask vision language computation pathway.

nodes.label: 放射报告
nodes.description: 长篇 findings/impression 等检查文本作为非结构化监督。
nodes.description_en: Performs Radiology Report within the core native 3d ct multitask vision language computation pathway.

nodes.label: Clinical Longformer
nodes.description: 长上下文临床语言 encoder 处理最长 4,096 tokens 的报告内容。
nodes.description_en: Performs Clinical Longformer within the core native 3d ct multitask vision language computation pathway.

nodes.label: CT–报告对比
nodes.description: 检查级 CT 与配对报告在共享空间对齐，并与非配对报告分离。
nodes.description_en: Performs CT– within the core native 3d ct multitask vision language computation pathway.

nodes.label: 多任务预训练
nodes.description: 结构化 EHR 预测与报告对比可联合/分阶段优化同一 3D encoder。
nodes.description_en: Applies multi-task pretraining to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: 临床任务接口
nodes.description: 冻结/适配后用于零样本 findings、检索、疾病预测、报告生成和 3D 分割。
nodes.description_en: Produces study-level 3d visual-linguistic representation supporting zero-shot findings, ehr phenotype prediction, and 3d segmentation via Stage 10.

paper.title: Merlin: a Computed Tomography Vision-Language Foundation Model and Dataset

paper_figure.label: Figure 1 · PDF p.Official HTML Figure 1 asset
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 逐切片 2D VLM 无法充分建模体积解剖和检查级上下文
keypoints.核心想法: 联合 3D CT、EHR diagnosis codes 与报告学习检查级视觉语言表示
keypoints.关键改进: 原生 3D encoder、多源临床监督与 44098 个外部 CT 的验证
keypoints.医学适配: 代表腹部 CT 主训练域上的原生 3D VLM 与外部大规模评估
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 已发表证据较强的 3D CT FM 之一；仍为回顾性且非自治报告安全证明

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Slice-wise 2D VLMs fail to capture 3D volumetric continuity, while report-only supervision misses structured longitudinal EHR outcomes.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Train a native 3D convolutional encoder on 15,331 paired abdominal CTs using both free-text reports (Clinical-Longformer) and 1,692 EHR phenotypes.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Synergistic dual supervision (radiology prose + structured EHR codes) on native 3D volumes, validated across 44,098 external CTs.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Supports zero-shot abnormality classification, cross-modal retrieval, 5-year chronic disease risk prediction, and 3D organ segmentation.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Among the most thoroughly externally validated 3D CT foundation models; evidence remains retrospective.

name: Deep Autoencoder
summary: 逐层 RBM 生成式预训练初始化深层对称 encoder–decoder，再以全局重建误差微调非线性 bottleneck。
summary_en: Layer-by-layer Restricted Boltzmann Machine (RBM) generative pretraining initializing a deep symmetric encoder–decoder fine-tuned via global reconstruction error.

nodes.label: 高维输入 x
nodes.description: 像素或其他连续/二值高维观测进入深层非线性压缩器。
nodes.description_en: Ingests high-dimensional input vector or flattened image patch and prepares initial tensor representations (input x).

nodes.label: 逐层 RBM 预训练
nodes.description: 从底到顶依次训练受限玻尔兹曼机，每层学习上一层表示的生成模型。
nodes.description_en: Executes RBM pretraining to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: Encoder 下层
nodes.description: 把输入投影到逐渐更窄的隐藏层，提取局部到抽象特征。
nodes.description_en: Performs Encoder within the core layerwise pretrained symmetric bottleneck computation pathway.

nodes.label: Encoder 高层
nodes.description: 继续压缩并为 bottleneck 提供初始化良好的深层表示。
nodes.description_en: Performs Encoder within the core layerwise pretrained symmetric bottleneck computation pathway.

nodes.label: 低维 Code
nodes.description: 网络最窄层是非线性降维坐标，也是供下游使用的 latent。
nodes.description_en: Performs Code within the core layerwise pretrained symmetric bottleneck computation pathway.

nodes.label: Decoder 高层
nodes.description: 将 encoder 权重展开为近似镜像解码路径并逐步扩维。
nodes.description_en: Performs Decoder within the core layerwise pretrained symmetric bottleneck computation pathway.

nodes.label: Decoder 下层
nodes.description: 把高层 latent 细化回输入维度的重建表示。
nodes.description_en: Performs Decoder within the core layerwise pretrained symmetric bottleneck computation pathway.

nodes.label: 重建 x̂
nodes.description: 输出与输入同维度，度量模型保留的信息。
nodes.description_en: Applies reconstruction x̂ to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: 全局 Fine-Tune
nodes.description: 以重建误差对展开后的整个 encoder–decoder 反向传播微调。
nodes.description_en: Produces low-dimensional non-linear bottleneck code z and reconstructed input x̂ via global Fine-Tune.

paper.title: Reducing the Dimensionality of Data with Neural Networks

paper_figure.label: Figure 1 · PDF p.2
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: PCA 与手工字典只能表达线性或预设结构
keypoints.核心想法: 用深层 encoder-decoder 学非线性低维 latent 并重建输入
keypoints.关键改进: 可学习的 bottleneck 表征与逐层预训练
keypoints.医学适配: 奠定医学去噪、异常检测、压缩和 latent generative 接口
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 思想基础；普通 AE 的采样、不确定性和 L2 模糊有限

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Linear PCA could not capture curved data manifolds, while deep non-linear autoencoders failed to optimize from random initialization.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Pretrain stacked RBMs greedily layer-by-layer, then unfold into a symmetric encoder–decoder fine-tuned by backpropagation.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Demonstrated that deep non-linear bottleneck manifolds could be stably optimized to compress high-dimensional perceptual data.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Conceptual ancestor of medical denoising autoencoders, unsupervised anomaly detection, and latent-space compression.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Historical foundation; deterministic L2 autoencoders blur high-frequency details and lack a tractable generative sampling density.

name: GAN
summary: 生成器与判别器通过同一 value function 对抗优化，以数据驱动判别器替代固定重建损失。
summary_en: Generator and discriminator networks engage in a two-player minimax game, replacing hand-crafted pixel reconstruction losses with a learned adversarial critic.

nodes.label: 先验噪声 z
nodes.description: 从简单分布采样的 latent 随机向量提供生成多样性。
nodes.description_en: Ingests latent noise vector z ~ p_z(z) and real data samples x ~ p_data(x) and prepares initial tensor representations (Prior Latent Noise z).

nodes.label: Generator G
nodes.description: 可微网络把 z 映射为数据空间样本 G(z)。
nodes.description_en: Executes Generator G to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: 生成样本
nodes.description: 由 G 产生、训练时应逐渐接近真实分布的候选样本。
nodes.description_en: Performs Synthesized Sample within the core adversarial generator discriminator game computation pathway.

nodes.label: 真实样本 x
nodes.description: 从未知真实数据分布采样，作为判别器正例。
nodes.description_en: Performs Real Data Sample x within the core adversarial generator discriminator game computation pathway.

nodes.label: Discriminator D
nodes.description: 同一判别网络对真实和生成样本输出为真的概率。
nodes.description_en: Performs Discriminator D within the core adversarial generator discriminator game computation pathway.

nodes.label: log D(x)
nodes.description: 奖励判别器把真实样本判断为真。
nodes.description_en: Performs log D(x) within the core adversarial generator discriminator game computation pathway.

nodes.label: log(1−D(G(z)))
nodes.description: 判别器奖励识别假样本；生成器则通过相反方向欺骗 D。
nodes.description_en: Applies log(1−D(G(z to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: 生成分布 p_g
nodes.description: 训练后丢弃判别器，通过采样 z 直接生成新数据。
nodes.description_en: Produces synthesized samples g(z) approximating the real data distribution via p_g.

paper.title: Generative Adversarial Nets

paper_figure.label: Figure 1 · PDF p.4
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 显式 likelihood 生成模型难训练且样本常过度平滑
keypoints.核心想法: generator 与 discriminator 进行对抗式分布学习
keypoints.关键改进: min-max 学习可直接产生锐利样本而无需显式密度
keypoints.医学适配: 推动 MR-CT 翻译、低剂量增强和合成数据
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 历史基础；mode collapse、训练不稳和 hallucination 风险突出

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Pixel-wise L1/L2 and maximum-likelihood generative models averaged over uncertain modes, producing blurry textures.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Pit a generator G against an adversarial discriminator D trained to distinguish real samples from synthesized ones.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Implicit density learning via Jensen-Shannon divergence minimization yielding sharp, high-frequency visual samples.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Catalyzed medical cross-modality synthesis (MR-to-CT), low-dose perceptual enhancement, and synthetic cohort augmentation.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Foundational generative paradigm; training instability, mode collapse, and anatomically unfaithful hallucinations pose severe clinical risks.

name: pix2pix
summary: 以 U-Net 生成器保持逐像素空间对应，70×70 conditional PatchGAN 学局部真实感，并用配对 L1 锚定结构。
summary_en: Pairs a U-Net generator (preserving pixel-level spatial alignment) with a 70×70 conditional PatchGAN discriminator and paired L1 structural anchoring.

nodes.label: 条件图像 x
nodes.description: 源域图像同时输入 generator 和 discriminator，限定生成内容。
nodes.description_en: Ingests spatially co-registered paired source image x and target ground-truth image y and prepares initial tensor representations (Stage 01).

nodes.label: U-Net Encoder
nodes.description: 逐层下采样提取从局部纹理到全局语义的条件特征。
nodes.description_en: Executes U-Net Encoder to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: Generator Bottleneck
nodes.description: 最深层压缩表示捕获整体结构；训练时 dropout 可提供随机性。
nodes.description_en: Performs Generator Bottleneck within the core paired conditional unet patchgan computation pathway.

nodes.label: U-Net Decoder
nodes.description: 转置卷积/上采样逐级恢复目标域分辨率。
nodes.description_en: Performs U-Net Decoder within the core paired conditional unet patchgan computation pathway.

nodes.label: 长 Skip Concats
nodes.description: 同尺度 encoder 特征拼接到 decoder，直接传递边缘与空间位置。
nodes.description_en: Performs Skip Concats within the core paired conditional unet patchgan computation pathway.

nodes.label: 生成目标 G(x)
nodes.description: 与输入逐像素对齐的目标域预测。
nodes.description_en: Performs objective G(x within the core paired conditional unet patchgan computation pathway.

nodes.label: 配对真值 y
nodes.description: 同一对象/位置的真实目标域图像。
nodes.description_en: Performs Stage 07 within the core paired conditional unet patchgan computation pathway.

nodes.label: 70×70 PatchGAN
nodes.description: 判别器对 x 与 y/G(x) 的局部 patch 对输出真假网格，而非单一全图分数。
nodes.description_en: Performs 70×70 PatchGAN within the core paired conditional unet patchgan computation pathway.

nodes.label: cGAN Loss
nodes.description: 鼓励生成局部纹理落在真实条件目标分布。
nodes.description_en: Applies cGAN Loss to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: L1 Fidelity
nodes.description: 像素 L1 保持配对图的低频结构与整体对应，并与对抗损失加权相加。
nodes.description_en: Produces spatially aligned translated target-domain image g(x) via L1 Fidelity.

paper.title: Image-to-Image Translation with Conditional Adversarial Networks

paper_figure.label: Figure 2 · PDF p.3
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 纯 L1/L2 输出过平滑，普通 GAN 不保证输入输出对应
keypoints.核心想法: 以输入为条件训练 PatchGAN，并以 L1 保持配对结构
keypoints.关键改进: paired fidelity 与 learned local texture loss 结合，常用 U-Net generator
keypoints.医学适配: 用于 paired 低剂量、PET、MR-CT 和骨抑制映射
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 强 mapping 基线；不保证测量一致，可能生成逼真但错误结构

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Pure L1/L2 regression blurs high-frequency textures, while unconditional GANs do not preserve patient-specific spatial anatomy.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Condition both U-Net generator and patch-level discriminator on the input image x while anchoring low-frequency structure via L1 loss.
keypoints_en.关键改进: U-Net skip generator + 70×70 Markovian PatchGAN critic + λ||y − G(x)||_1 structural constraint.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Workhorse baseline for paired low-dose-to-full-dose PET/CT, MR-to-synthetic-CT radiation planning, and virtual histological staining.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Strong paired image-translation baseline; remains an image-domain mapping without physical sensor consistency guarantees.

name: CycleGAN
summary: 双生成器、双 PatchGAN 与 X→Y→X / Y→X→Y 两个 cycle L1 闭环，使不成对域转换可训练。
summary_en: Couples dual generators (G: X→Y, F: Y→X) and dual PatchGAN discriminators with forward and backward L1 cycle-consistency loops for unpaired translation.

nodes.label: 真实域 X
nodes.description: 从源域边缘分布独立采样，无需与 Y 样本一一对应。
nodes.description_en: Ingests two unpaired collections of images from source domain x and target domain y and prepares initial tensor representations (Stage 01).

nodes.label: 真实域 Y
nodes.description: 从目标域边缘分布独立采样，不要求同患者或配准。
nodes.description_en: Executes Stage 02 to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: Generator G:X→Y
nodes.description: 残差式 generator 把 X 图像映射为 Y 风格。
nodes.description_en: Performs Generator G:X→Y within the core unpaired bidirectional cycle consistent gan computation pathway.

nodes.label: Generator F:Y→X
nodes.description: 第二个 generator 学习反方向 Y→X 映射。
nodes.description_en: Performs Generator F:Y→X within the core unpaired bidirectional cycle consistent gan computation pathway.

nodes.label: 生成 Ŷ
nodes.description: G(x) 应在外观上不可与真实域 Y 区分。
nodes.description_en: Performs Ŷ within the core unpaired bidirectional cycle consistent gan computation pathway.

nodes.label: 生成 X̂
nodes.description: F(y) 应在外观上不可与真实域 X 区分。
nodes.description_en: Performs X̂ within the core unpaired bidirectional cycle consistent gan computation pathway.

nodes.label: PatchGAN D_Y
nodes.description: 区分真实 y 与 G(x)，约束 X→Y 的目标域局部纹理。
nodes.description_en: Performs PatchGAN D_Y within the core unpaired bidirectional cycle consistent gan computation pathway.

nodes.label: PatchGAN D_X
nodes.description: 区分真实 x 与 F(y)，约束 Y→X 的目标域局部纹理。
nodes.description_en: Performs PatchGAN D_X within the core unpaired bidirectional cycle consistent gan computation pathway.

nodes.label: Cycle 重建 x̃
nodes.description: F(G(x)) 应回到原 x，以 L1 cycle loss 约束前向映射可逆。
nodes.description_en: Applies Cycle reconstruction x̃ to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: Cycle 重建 ỹ
nodes.description: G(F(y)) 应回到原 y，以 L1 cycle loss 约束反向映射可逆。
nodes.description_en: Produces bi-directional domain-translated images g(x) ∈ y and f(y) ∈ x via Cycle reconstruction ỹ.

paper.title: Unpaired Image-to-Image Translation using Cycle-Consistent Adversarial Networks

paper_figure.label: Figure 3 · PDF p.3
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 医学跨模态病例常不成对，pix2pix 无法直接训练
keypoints.核心想法: 用双向生成器、两个判别器和 cycle consistency 学无配对域转换
keypoints.关键改进: cycle loss 缩小任意 domain mapping 的解空间
keypoints.医学适配: 用于 MR-CT、MRI contrast 和 scanner harmonization
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 探索与 style transfer 仍有用；cycle 不保证解剖或定量值保持

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Acquiring perfectly co-registered paired multi-modality scans (e.g., same-patient paired MR and CT) is often clinically infeasible.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Constrain unpaired cross-domain mapping by requiring that translating X→Y and back Y→X recovers the original input image.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Dual adversarial critics + forward/backward cycle-consistency L1 loss + identity mapping regularizer.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Widely used for unpaired MR-to-CT synthesis, stain normalization in pathology, and cross-vendor scanner style harmonization.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Useful for exploratory domain adaptation, but cycle consistency is under-constrained and can hallucinate or erase lesions when pathology prevalence differs across domains.

name: FBPConvNet
summary: 解析 FBP 与单次残差 U-Net 串联，而非端到端替代投影算子或进行 unrolled data consistency。
summary_en: Cascades analytical Filtered Backprojection (FBP) with a multi-scale residual U-Net in the image domain to remove sparse-view streaking artifacts.

nodes.label: 投影 y
nodes.description: 稀疏角度线积分测量；几何决定前向算子 A
nodes.description_en: Ingests sparse-view ct sinogram measurements y with known acquisition geometry and prepares initial tensor representations (projection y).

nodes.label: FBP / A*
nodes.description: 滤波后反投影；这里的 A* 含解析滤波，不是可学习层
nodes.description_en: Executes FBP / A* to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: 初始 CT
nodes.description: x0=FBP(y)，保留条纹和欠采样伪影
nodes.description_en: Performs CT within the core analytic reconstruction postprocess computation pathway.

nodes.label: 残差 U-Net
nodes.description: 多尺度卷积编码—解码器只在图像域学习伪影校正
nodes.description_en: Performs residual U-Net within the core analytic reconstruction postprocess computation pathway.

nodes.label: 校正残差
nodes.description: R_theta(x0)，与解析初值相加得到重建
nodes.description_en: Performs residual within the core analytic reconstruction postprocess computation pathway.

nodes.label: x_hat
nodes.description: x_hat=x0+R_theta(x0)
nodes.description_en: Performs x_hat within the core analytic reconstruction postprocess computation pathway.

nodes.label: 前投影 A
nodes.description: 可将 x_hat 投影回测量域做离线核查
nodes.description_en: Performs projection A within the core analytic reconstruction postprocess computation pathway.

nodes.label: DC 审计
nodes.description: 比较 A(x_hat) 与 y；原结构不把残差反馈给网络
nodes.description_en: Applies DC to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: 单次后处理
nodes.description: K=0 个展开迭代；无交替 data-consistency 更新
nodes.description_en: Produces artifact-suppressed ct image x̂ = x_fbp + r_θ(x_fbp) via Stage 09.

paper.title: Deep Convolutional Neural Network for Inverse Problems in Imaging

paper_figure.label: Figure 2 · PDF p.8
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 解析稀疏 CT 重建存在条纹，而直接端到端学习难扩展
keypoints.核心想法: 先做解析 FBP，再用 residual U-Net/CNN 去除稀疏视角伪影
keypoints.关键改进: 保留快速成熟的 FBP，并只学习 image-domain artifact residual
keypoints.医学适配: 成为 sparse-view CT 极强 post-processing 基线
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 历史与实用价值高；推理后无 projection data consistency

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Analytical FBP suffers from severe streaking under sparse views, while traditional iterative MBIR takes minutes to hours per volume.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Exploit the fact that normal-operator streaking artifacts in 2D CT have a translational convolutional structure well matched to a multi-scale residual U-Net.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Fast analytical FBP inversion + residual U-Net learning the difference between streaked FBP and full-view ground truth.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Canonical, fast image-domain post-processing baseline for sparse-view and low-dose CT reconstruction.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: High practical speed and historical impact, but enforces zero projection-domain data consistency at inference—risking hallucinated or smoothed subtle lesions.

name: Learned Primal-Dual
summary: 同时学习 measurement-domain dual 与 image-domain primal 更新，并在每个 unrolled stage 显式调用 A 和 A*。
summary_en: Unrolls primal–dual proximal optimization into K stages of paired measurement-domain (dual) and image-domain (primal) residual CNNs calling A and A* at every stage.

nodes.label: 测量 y
nodes.description: CT sinogram 等 measurement-domain 数据
nodes.description_en: Ingests raw tomographic measurements y, forward projection operator a, and adjoint backprojection operator a* and prepares initial tensor representations (Stage 01).

nodes.label: Primal h_k
nodes.description: 多通道图像域记忆；首通道最终作为重建
nodes.description_en: Executes Primal h_k to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: A
nodes.description: 把当前 primal 图像投影到测量域
nodes.description_en: Performs A within the core unrolled primal dual reconstruction computation pathway.

nodes.label: Dual f_k
nodes.description: 多通道测量域记忆，保留历史残差与特征
nodes.description_en: Performs Dual f_k within the core unrolled primal dual reconstruction computation pathway.

nodes.label: Dual 更新
nodes.description: f_{k+1}=Gamma_{theta_k}(f_k,A(h_k),y)
nodes.description_en: Performs Dual update within the core unrolled primal dual reconstruction computation pathway.

nodes.label: A*
nodes.description: 把更新后的 dual 特征反投影回图像域
nodes.description_en: Performs A* within the core unrolled primal dual reconstruction computation pathway.

nodes.label: Primal 更新
nodes.description: h_{k+1}=Lambda_{theta_k}(h_k,A*(f_{k+1}))
nodes.description_en: Performs Primal update within the core unrolled primal dual reconstruction computation pathway.

nodes.label: K 级展开
nodes.description: 每级显式经过 A、dual update、A*、primal update
nodes.description_en: Applies K unrolled to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: x_hat
nodes.description: 读取最终 primal 状态的图像通道
nodes.description_en: Produces reconstructed image x^{(k)} after k unrolled primal–dual iterations via x_hat.

paper.title: Learned Primal-Dual Reconstruction

paper_figure.label: Figure 2 · PDF p.7
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 仅在图像域学习 proximal 难利用 sinogram/k-space 结构
keypoints.核心想法: 在展开迭代中同时学习 measurement-domain dual 与 image-domain primal 更新
keypoints.关键改进: 每个 stage 显式调用 A 与 A*，保留 measurement residual
keypoints.医学适配: 在 CT 上建立网络作为可解释优化算法的范式
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 仍值得复现；3D projector、operator mismatch 与内存是限制

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Image-domain post-processing discards sinogram residuals, while hand-crafted TV primal–dual algorithms require ratusan iterations and produce patchy cartoons.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Replace both the dual proximal operator in measurement space and the primal proximal operator in image space with small multi-channel residual CNNs across K≈10 stages.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Explicitly embeds forward operator A and adjoint A* inside every unrolled layer with multi-channel memory states in both primal and dual spaces.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Established the gold-standard paradigm for physics-informed unrolled CT and tomographic reconstruction.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Strong measurement-consistent baseline; requires storing K stages of 2D/3D activations during backpropagation and accurate projector calibration.

name: Variational Network
summary: 把多线圈 MRI 的变分梯度下降展开，并联合学习卷积滤波器、势函数与每级更新权重。
summary_en: Unrolls K steps of gradient descent on a generalized Fields-of-Experts variational energy for multi-coil MRI, jointly learning convolutional filters, non-linear potentials, and data weights.

nodes.label: 多线圈 y
nodes.description: PFSx 加噪后的欠采样 k-space
nodes.description_en: Ingests undersampled multi-coil k-space data y, sampling mask p, and pre-estimated coil sensitivity maps s and prepares initial tensor representations (multi-coil y).

nodes.label: A=PFS
nodes.description: 灵敏度调制、傅里叶变换与采样掩膜
nodes.description_en: Executes A=PFS to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: A*=S*F*P*
nodes.description: 零填充逆 FFT 后做线圈组合
nodes.description_en: Performs A*=S*F*P* within the core unrolled variational mri computation pathway.

nodes.label: 图像 x_k
nodes.description: 由 A*y 初始化并在复数图像域更新
nodes.description_en: Performs x_k within the core unrolled variational mri computation pathway.

nodes.label: 数据梯度
nodes.description: A*(A x_k-y)，把采样点残差带回图像域
nodes.description_en: Performs Data Fidelity Gradient within the core unrolled variational mri computation pathway.

nodes.label: 学习滤波器
nodes.description: K_i x_k 提取局部特征，K_i* 回传正则梯度
nodes.description_en: Performs Stage 06 within the core unrolled variational mri computation pathway.

nodes.label: 势函数 phi
nodes.description: 学习非线性 influence functions，替代手工正则项
nodes.description_en: Performs phi within the core unrolled variational mri computation pathway.

nodes.label: 变分更新
nodes.description: x_{k+1}=x_k-dcgrad-ΣK_i*phi_i(K_i x_k)
nodes.description_en: Applies Variational Update to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: x_hat
nodes.description: K 个 stage 后的复数重建与幅度图
nodes.description_en: Produces complex-valued reconstructed mri image x^{(k)} after k unrolled variational steps via x_hat.

paper.title: Learning a Variational Network for Reconstruction of Accelerated MRI Data

paper_figure.label: Figure 1 · PDF p.7
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 手工 regularizer 和 potential 表达能力有限
keypoints.核心想法: 展开变分梯度下降，学习滤波器、势函数并显式使用多线圈 forward model
keypoints.关键改进: 端到端学习每步 variational update 与数据项
keypoints.医学适配: 在 accelerated MRI 中已有临床工作流速度和质量证据
keypoints.适用范围与证据: unrolled MRI 的核心祖型；序列与厂商迁移仍有限

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Compressed-sensing MRI with fixed wavelet/TV regularizers reconstructed slowly and introduced staircasing or over-smoothing.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Unfold K=10 gradient descent steps of a variational energy combining learned convolutional filter-bank potentials with exact multi-coil k-space data consistency.
keypoints_en.关键改进: End-to-end training of stage-specific filter kernels, spline activation derivatives (potentials), and data-consistency step weights.
keypoints_en.医学适配: First unrolled MRI reconstruction architecture validated in clinical reader studies to achieve 4× accelerated knee MRI acquisition.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Foundational clinical unrolled MRI milestone; shallow Fields-of-Experts regularizers were later deepened into U-Net cascades in E2E-VarNet.

name: MoDL
summary: 共享 CNN prior 与可微共轭梯度 data-consistency 子问题交替展开。
summary_en: Alternates a weight-shared multi-layer CNN denoiser prior D_θ with a differentiable numerical Conjugate Gradient (CG) solver enforcing exact data consistency (A*A + λI)^{-1}.

nodes.label: 测量 y
nodes.description: MRI k-space 或其他线性成像测量
nodes.description_en: Ingests undersampled multi-coil k-space measurements b, forward operator a (incorporating coil maps + fft + mask), and adjoint a* and prepares initial tensor representations (Stage 01).

nodes.label: A / A*
nodes.description: 成像 forward/adjoint；构成 A*A 与 A*y
nodes.description_en: Executes A / A* to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: 状态 x_k
nodes.description: A*y 初始化的当前图像
nodes.description_en: Performs x_k within the core unrolled denoiser cg reconstruction computation pathway.

nodes.label: 共享 CNN
nodes.description: D_theta(x_k) 在各级复用同一组卷积参数
nodes.description_en: Performs CNN within the core unrolled denoiser cg reconstruction computation pathway.

nodes.label: 先验变量 z_k
nodes.description: CNN 给出的去伪影/去噪候选
nodes.description_en: Performs prior z_k within the core unrolled denoiser cg reconstruction computation pathway.

nodes.label: CG 数据一致性
nodes.description: 近似求解 (A*A+lambda I)x=A*y+lambda z_k
nodes.description_en: Performs CG data consistency within the core unrolled denoiser cg reconstruction computation pathway.

nodes.label: 权重共享
nodes.description: D_theta 和 lambda 跨 unrolled iterations 共享
nodes.description_en: Performs Stage 07 within the core unrolled denoiser cg reconstruction computation pathway.

nodes.label: K 次展开
nodes.description: CNN prior 与 CG/DC 子问题交替
nodes.description_en: Applies K unrolled to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: x_hat
nodes.description: 最后一次 CG 解
nodes.description_en: Produces reconstructed mri image x_k after k weight-shared alternating minimization stages via x_hat.

paper.title: MoDL: Model-Based Deep Learning Architecture for Inverse Problems

paper_figure.label: Figure 1 · PDF p.3
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 各展开 stage 独立参数导致模型大且数据需求高
keypoints.核心想法: 共享 CNN denoiser，并用有限次共轭梯度近似求解每步 data-consistency 子问题
keypoints.关键改进: 跨迭代共享 learned prior，加 A* A 线性系统的 CG 更新
keypoints.医学适配: 成为多线圈 MRI 和 CT model-based deep learning 强基线
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 基础设施级方法；依赖 operator/coil maps 且迭代计算较重

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Gradient-step unrolled networks converged slowly for complex multi-coil forward operators A whose normal operator A*A is not diagonally invertible.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Share a single CNN denoiser across all K unrolled stages to reduce parameters, and solve the quadratic data-consistency sub-problem accurately via internal CG iterations.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Weight-shared plug-and-play regularizer + backpropagation through numerical Conjugate Gradient steps handling arbitrary linear operators A.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Core infrastructure baseline for multi-coil parallel MRI, dynamic cardiac MRI, and physics-based CT reconstruction.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Mandatory unrolled baseline; depends on accurate coil sensitivity maps and incurs inner-loop CG compute cost.

name: VarNet
summary: 灵敏度估计网络加多级 k-space variational cascades，将图像正则与采样点 DC 工程化为统一流程。
summary_en: End-to-End Variational Network combining a joint U-Net coil sensitivity estimation module (SME) with K k-space variational cascades using U-Net image regularizers.

nodes.label: 多线圈 k-space
nodes.description: 原始欠采样 y，采样位置由 M 标记
nodes.description_en: Ingests raw undersampled multi-coil k-space y and cartesian undersampling mask m (including auto-calibration lines) and prepares initial tensor representations (Multi-Coil k-Space).

nodes.label: 灵敏度网络
nodes.description: 从中心 k-space 估计并归一化 coil sensitivity maps S
nodes.description_en: Executes Sensitivity Map Network to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: A / A*
nodes.description: A=PFS；A* 逆 FFT 后按 S* 做 sensitivity reduction
nodes.description_en: Performs A / A* within the core cascaded kspace variational network computation pathway.

nodes.label: k-space 状态
nodes.description: 每个 cascade 维护完整多线圈频域估计 k_t
nodes.description_en: Performs k-space within the core cascaded kspace variational network computation pathway.

nodes.label: 图像正则器
nodes.description: A* 折叠到图像域，经 U-Net 后由 A 展回多线圈 k-space
nodes.description_en: Performs regularization within the core cascaded kspace variational network computation pathway.

nodes.label: 采样点 DC
nodes.description: M(k_t-y) 的软数据一致性更新
nodes.description_en: Performs Sampled k-Space DC within the core cascaded kspace variational network computation pathway.

nodes.label: K 级展开迭代
nodes.description: 每级执行 k_{t+1}=k_t-eta_t M(k_t-y)-A R_t(A* k_t)，构成固定深度 variational cascade
nodes.description_en: Applies K unrolled iterative to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: RSS 图像
nodes.description: 最终 k-space 逆 FFT 后做 root-sum-of-squares
nodes.description_en: Produces root-sum-of-squares or coil-combined mri magnitude image x̂ via RSS.

paper.title: End-to-End Variational Networks for Accelerated MRI Reconstruction

paper_figure.label: Figure 1 · PDF p.4
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 多线圈 benchmark、coil handling 和训练流程碎片化
keypoints.核心想法: 多级 learned regularizer 与 k-space data consistency 交替，并估计 coil sensitivity maps
keypoints.关键改进: 把 variational cascade 工程化到 fastMRI 原始 k-space 标准评测
keypoints.医学适配: 形成公开 MRI 重建基线；同类变分/展开式 AI reconstruction 另有前瞻膝 MRI 诊断等效证据
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 长期价值已证明；前瞻证据不等同于公开 VarNet 本身，且显存、采样 mask 和厂商域移位仍需验证
