keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Prior unrolled MRI methods depended on external offline ESPIRiT coil maps that broke down under narrow calibration regions or motion.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Estimate smooth coil sensitivity maps end-to-end from low-frequency ACS k-space via a dedicated U-Net, feeding directly into K k-space variational U-Net cascades.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Self-contained raw-k-space-to-image pipeline standardized on the public fastMRI multi-coil benchmark.
keypoints_en.医学适配: De facto public benchmark champion and baseline for accelerated multi-coil knee and brain MRI reconstruction.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Proven long-term value; high GPU memory during unrolled training and sensitivity to out-of-distribution k-space sampling patterns remain key considerations.

name: DnCNN
summary: 深 CNN 回归噪声残差，再与输入显式相减，而非直接回归 clean image。
summary_en: Trains a deep plain CNN with BatchNorm and ReLU to regress the additive noise residual R_θ(y) ≈ n rather than the clean image, recovering x̂ = y − R_θ(y).

nodes.label: 含噪图像
nodes.description: 原论文主要建模加性白高斯噪声
nodes.description_en: Ingests noisy observation y = x + n and prepares initial tensor representations (Noisy Input Image).

nodes.label: Conv+ReLU
nodes.description: 首层从 y 提取浅层局部噪声/纹理特征
nodes.description_en: Executes Conv+ReLU to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: 深卷积栈
nodes.description: 多层 3×3 Conv+BN+ReLU 扩大感受野
nodes.description_en: Performs convolution within the core residual noise cnn computation pathway.

nodes.label: 线性 Conv
nodes.description: 末层回归与图像同尺寸的噪声残差
nodes.description_en: Performs Conv within the core residual noise cnn computation pathway.

nodes.label: n_hat
nodes.description: R_theta(y) 逼近噪声而非直接复制干净图像
nodes.description_en: Performs n_hat within the core residual noise cnn computation pathway.

nodes.label: 残差相减
nodes.description: x_hat=y-n_hat，保留显式 identity path
nodes.description_en: Applies Residual Subtraction to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: x_hat
nodes.description: 恢复后的图像
nodes.description_en: Produces denoised image estimate x̂ = y − r_θ(y) via x_hat.

paper.title: Beyond a Gaussian Denoiser: Residual Learning of Deep CNN for Image Denoising

paper_figure.label: Figure 1 · PDF p.4
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 直接回归 clean image 还需复制大部分解剖信号
keypoints.核心想法: 预测噪声残差 r(y)，以 xhat=y-r(y) 保留 identity path
keypoints.关键改进: 深残差噪声学习和可扩展的 noise-level 训练
keypoints.医学适配: 广泛作为低剂量 CT、PET、X-ray 和 MRI 去噪基线
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 基础设施级 baseline；原版 AWGN 与 BatchNorm 假设不匹配真实医学噪声

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Directly mapping a noisy image to a clean image forced deep networks to re-synthesize all low-frequency anatomical structures.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Predict only the zero-mean noise residual R_θ(y) so the target mapping is much closer to zero than to the identity image.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Synergy between residual noise learning and batch normalization, supporting single-model blind Gaussian denoising across noise levels.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Universal lightweight baseline for low-dose CT, planar X-ray, ultrasound, and MRI image-space denoising.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Foundational restoration baseline; i.i.d. AWGN assumptions fail on spatially correlated CT sinogram streaks or Poisson PET noise without domain adaptation.

name: Noise2Noise
summary: 使用同一信号的两次独立无偏噪声实现进行 noisy-to-noisy 监督，训练阶段不需要干净靶图。
summary_en: Trains a denoising network using pairs of independent noisy realizations (y_1, y_2) of the same underlying anatomy without ever observing clean ground truth.

nodes.label: 潜在图像 x
nodes.description: 训练时不可见；两次采集共享同一真实信号
nodes.description_en: Ingests two independent noisy observations (y_1, y_2) of the exact same underlying clean signal x and prepares initial tensor representations (Stage 01).

nodes.label: 噪声 n1
nodes.description: 与 n2 条件独立且 E[n1|x]=0
nodes.description_en: Executes noise n1 to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: 噪声 n2
nodes.description: 独立、条件无偏的第二次噪声实现
nodes.description_en: Performs noise n2 within the core paired noisy self supervision computation pathway.

nodes.label: 输入 y1
nodes.description: y1=x+n1
nodes.description_en: Performs input y1 within the core paired noisy self supervision computation pathway.

nodes.label: 恢复网络
nodes.description: f_theta(y1)，架构可为 U-Net/CNN
nodes.description_en: Performs Stage 05 within the core paired noisy self supervision computation pathway.

nodes.label: 目标 y2
nodes.description: y2=x+n2，不要求 clean target
nodes.description_en: Performs objective y2 within the core paired noisy self supervision computation pathway.

nodes.label: N2N 损失
nodes.description: 最小化 ||f_theta(y1)-y2||^2；总体最优为条件均值
nodes.description_en: Applies N2N loss to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: x_hat
nodes.description: 推理时只需一个 noisy input
nodes.description_en: Produces clean conditional expectation estimate x̂ = f_θ(y_1) via x_hat.

paper.title: Noise2Noise: Learning Image Restoration without Clean Data

paper_figure.label: Official repository network.py, lines 59–114 · PDF p.Repository source lines 59–114
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: clean target 昂贵或无法采集
keypoints.核心想法: 用同一潜在图像的两次独立、条件无偏 noisy observations 进行监督
keypoints.关键改进: 证明 noisy-to-noisy MSE 与 clean-target MSE 具有相同最优条件均值
keypoints.医学适配: 可用于拆分 PET counts、MRI k-space 或可重复低剂量测量
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 长期有用；独立性、运动和 uptake mismatch 会造成目标偏差

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Acquiring noiseless ground-truth scans (e.g., high-dose CT or long-exposure microscopy) is often clinically unethical or physically impossible.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Exploit the statistical property that replacing a clean L2 regression target x with an independent zero-mean noisy target y_2 leaves the optimal Bayes estimator unchanged.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Eliminates the need for clean training targets whenever two independent noisy measurements of static anatomy can be acquired or split.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Directly applicable to splitting list-mode PET counts, multi-NEX MRI averages, dose-split CT projections, and cryo-EM / fluorescence microscopy.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Enduring mathematical principle; breaks down if inter-scan patient motion occurs or if noise realizations share correlated bias.

name: Noise2Self
summary: 通过 J-invariant 遮挡使单幅 noisy image 同时提供输入与 held-out 监督目标。
summary_en: Formalizes single-image self-supervised denoising via J-invariant functions whose prediction for pixel subset J does not depend on the observed noisy values in J.

nodes.label: 单幅 y
nodes.description: 唯一含噪观测，不需要配对或 clean target
nodes.description_en: Ingests single noisy image y (no paired second scan and no clean ground truth) and prepares initial tensor representations (Stage 01).

nodes.label: 索引分组 J
nodes.description: 把像素/体素索引划分为若干 held-out 子集
nodes.description_en: Executes Stage 02 to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: 遮挡 J
nodes.description: 预测 J 时替换或移除 y_J，阻止信息泄漏
nodes.description_en: Performs masked J within the core single image j invariant denoising computation pathway.

nodes.label: J-invariant 网络
nodes.description: f_theta(y) 在 J 上只能读取补集 J^c
nodes.description_en: Performs J-invariant within the core single image j invariant denoising computation pathway.

nodes.label: held-out 预测
nodes.description: 从邻域上下文预测被遮挡位置
nodes.description_en: Performs held-out prediction within the core single image j invariant denoising computation pathway.

nodes.label: 自监督风险
nodes.description: 仅在 J 上比较预测与原始 noisy y_J
nodes.description_en: Performs self-supervised within the core single image j invariant denoising computation pathway.

nodes.label: 分组聚合
nodes.description: 轮换所有 J 并拼回完整预测
nodes.description_en: Applies Grouped Aggregation to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: x_hat
nodes.description: 单图像自监督去噪结果
nodes.description_en: Produces denoised image x̂ predicted from j-invariant masked neighborhoods via x_hat.

paper.title: Noise2Self: Blind Denoising by Self-Supervision

paper_figure.label: Figure 1 · PDF p.2
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: Noise2Noise 仍需同一解剖的第二个独立观测
keypoints.核心想法: 以 J-invariance 让预测某像素集合时不能读取该集合输入
keypoints.关键改进: 在条件独立零均值噪声下将单幅 noisy image 变成自监督风险
keypoints.医学适配: 可用于显微、PET、MRI 等无 clean target 场景
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 方法基础重要；空间相关噪声和孤立病灶可能被错误去除

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Noise2Noise still required two independent co-registered noisy acquisitions of the same patient or specimen.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Partition pixels into subsets J and train a J-invariant network to predict pixels in J strictly from their complement J^c under pixel-wise independent noise.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Provides the rigorous statistical proof and optimal combination theorem for blind-spot single-image self-supervised denoising.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Used in single-shot fluorescence microscopy, low-count nuclear medicine, and unrepeatable dynamic medical acquisitions.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Theoretical cornerstone of blind-spot denoising; fails when noise is spatially correlated (e.g., FBP CT streaks) and can erase isolated 1-pixel micro-structures.

name: DDPM
summary: 预设离散高斯前向链，加训练稳定的 epsilon/score 网络，再按学习到的随机逆链逐步采样。
summary_en: Defines a fixed discrete Markov Gaussian forward noising chain and trains a noise-prediction U-Net (ε_θ) across all noise scales for iterative reverse sampling.

nodes.label: 数据 x0
nodes.description: 训练分布中的干净图像
nodes.description_en: Ingests clean training image x_0 (during training); pure gaussian noise x_t ~ n(0,i) (during sampling) and prepares initial tensor representations (x0).

nodes.label: 前向 q
nodes.description: q(x_t|x_{t-1}) 逐步加入预设方差的高斯噪声
nodes.description_en: Executes Stage 02 to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: 噪声 epsilon
nodes.description: 重参数化 x_t=sqrt(alpha_bar_t)x0+sqrt(1-alpha_bar_t)epsilon
nodes.description_en: Performs noise epsilon within the core discrete diffusion computation pathway.

nodes.label: 噪声状态 x_t
nodes.description: t 越大越接近标准高斯，x_T 作为生成起点
nodes.description_en: Performs noise x_t within the core discrete diffusion computation pathway.

nodes.label: 时间 t
nodes.description: 正弦/学习嵌入条件化去噪网络
nodes.description_en: Performs Stage 05 within the core discrete diffusion computation pathway.

nodes.label: epsilon / score
nodes.description: 网络预测 epsilon_theta；等价 score s_theta=-epsilon_theta/sigma_t
nodes.description_en: Performs epsilon / score within the core discrete diffusion computation pathway.

nodes.label: 逆转移 p_theta
nodes.description: 由 epsilon_theta 参数化 p(x_{t-1}|x_t) 的均值并注入随机噪声
nodes.description_en: Performs p_theta within the core discrete diffusion computation pathway.

nodes.label: T 步随机链
nodes.description: x_T→…→x_0，原始 DDPM 需要数百至千步
nodes.description_en: Performs Stage 08 within the core discrete diffusion computation pathway.

nodes.label: ODE 路径
nodes.description: 原始 DDPM 不使用 ODE；后续可由对应 score 构造 probability-flow ODE
nodes.description_en: Applies ODE to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: 生成样本
nodes.description: 最终 x0_hat
nodes.description_en: Produces sample x̂_0 synthesized via t iterative stochastic reverse denoising steps via Synthesized Sample.

paper.title: Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models

paper_figure.label: Figure 2 · PDF p.2
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: GAN min-max 训练不稳、mode coverage 差，VAE 高频模糊
keypoints.核心想法: 通过逐步高斯加噪并训练网络在各噪声尺度预测噪声来生成数据
keypoints.关键改进: 稳定的多噪声尺度监督回归与可解释逆扩散链
keypoints.医学适配: 成为医学重建、生成、去噪和跨模态 diffusion 的基础
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 生成建模基础设施；原始数百至千步采样不适合常规部署

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: GANs suffered from adversarial instability and mode dropping, while likelihood-based flows and VAEs struggled with sample sharpness.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Destroy data structure gradually via a fixed Gaussian diffusion process and learn the reverse Markov transition via stable multi-scale L2 noise regression.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Re-weighted ε-prediction objective + time-conditioned U-Net achieving stable optimization and high mode coverage.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Foundational prior for medical image synthesis, counterfactual generation, denoising, and diffusion-based inverse problem solvers.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Core generative infrastructure; standard 1,000-step ancestral sampling is too slow for real-time clinical workflows without acceleration.

name: DDIM
summary: 在相同 DDPM 训练边缘下采用隐式非 Markov、可确定性的跳步轨迹。
summary_en: Constructs non-Markovian, deterministic reverse sampling trajectories that share the exact same marginal training distributions as DDPM.

nodes.label: 数据 x0
nodes.description: 训练时的干净样本
nodes.description_en: Ingests pretrained ddpm noise-prediction network ε_θ and initial gaussian noise x_t and prepares initial tensor representations (x0).

nodes.label: 训练加噪
nodes.description: 沿 DDPM 边缘分布 q(x_t|x0) 采样，不改变训练目标
nodes.description_en: Executes training to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: 噪声 epsilon
nodes.description: 构造任意时间 t 的 x_t
nodes.description_en: Performs noise epsilon within the core implicit deterministic diffusion computation pathway.

nodes.label: epsilon / score
nodes.description: 复用 epsilon_theta(x_t,t)，可换算为 score
nodes.description_en: Performs epsilon / score within the core implicit deterministic diffusion computation pathway.

nodes.label: x0 估计
nodes.description: 由 x_t 与 epsilon_theta 解析估计 x0_hat
nodes.description_en: Performs x0 within the core implicit deterministic diffusion computation pathway.

nodes.label: DDIM 更新
nodes.description: 跳步计算 x_{t'}；eta=0 时无额外随机噪声
nodes.description_en: Performs DDIM update within the core implicit deterministic diffusion computation pathway.

nodes.label: 非 Markov 路径
nodes.description: 保持训练边缘分布但重定义生成联合路径
nodes.description_en: Performs Markov within the core implicit deterministic diffusion computation pathway.

nodes.label: ODE-like 极限
nodes.description: 确定性轨迹对应连续极限的概率流视角
nodes.description_en: Applies ODE-like to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: x0_hat
nodes.description: 用选定时间子序列少步生成
nodes.description_en: Produces sample x̂_0 generated in 10–50 deterministic (or tunable-stochasticity) subsequence steps via x0_hat.

paper.title: Denoising Diffusion Implicit Models

paper_figure.label: Figure 2 · PDF p.5
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: DDPM 需要大量逐步逆扩散
keypoints.核心想法: 在相同训练目标下构造 non-Markov、可确定性采样轨迹
keypoints.关键改进: 无需重训即可大幅减少 time steps，并支持 deterministic ODE-like sampling
keypoints.医学适配: 用于加速医学 diffusion reconstruction 与生成实验
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 部署研究必需；大步长离散误差会先损害细小结构

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: DDPM required hundreds to thousands of sequential network evaluations, making inference prohibitively slow.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Reformulate the forward process as non-Markovian while preserving marginal distributions p(x_t|x_0), enabling exact reuse of pretrained DDPM weights with strided step schedules.
keypoints_en.关键改进: 10×–50× sampling acceleration without retraining + deterministic latent-to-image invertible mapping (DDIM inversion).
keypoints_en.医学适配: Standard sampler for accelerating medical diffusion reconstruction, counterfactual editing, and latent interpolation.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Essential deployment accelerator; overly coarse step strides first degrade fine anatomical vessels and micro-calcifications.

name: Score-SDE
summary: 以连续 score field 同时定义 reverse-time SDE、predictor-corrector sampler 与同边缘的 probability-flow ODE。
summary_en: Unifies discrete diffusion and score matching into a continuous-time Stochastic Differential Equation (SDE) with a corresponding deterministic Probability-Flow ODE.

nodes.label: 数据 x(0)
nodes.description: 未知数据分布 p0
nodes.description_en: Ingests continuous data sample x(0); prior noise distribution x(t) at terminal time t and prepares initial tensor representations (x(0).

nodes.label: 前向 SDE
nodes.description: dx=f(x,t)dt+g(t)dW，把 p0 连续扰动到简单先验
nodes.description_en: Executes SDE to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: 先验 pT
nodes.description: 终点通常接近高斯噪声
nodes.description_en: Performs prior pT within the core continuous score sde computation pathway.

nodes.label: Score 网络
nodes.description: s_theta(x,t)≈∇_x log p_t(x)，用连续时间 denoising score matching 训练
nodes.description_en: Performs Score within the core continuous score sde computation pathway.

nodes.label: Reverse SDE
nodes.description: 漂移含 -g(t)^2 s_theta，并保留随机扩散项
nodes.description_en: Performs Reverse SDE within the core continuous score sde computation pathway.

nodes.label: Predictor
nodes.description: 数值离散 reverse SDE 前进一步
nodes.description_en: Performs Predictor within the core continuous score sde computation pathway.

nodes.label: Corrector
nodes.description: Langevin MCMC 在当前噪声尺度校正分布
nodes.description_en: Performs Corrector within the core continuous score sde computation pathway.

nodes.label: PF-ODE
nodes.description: dx=[f-0.5g^2 s_theta]dt，与 SDE 共享边缘分布且为确定性
nodes.description_en: Applies PF-ODE to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: 生成样本
nodes.description: reverse SDE/PC 或 PF-ODE 的 t=0 端点
nodes.description_en: Produces samples generated via predictor-corrector reverse sde or exact likelihoods via probability-flow ode via Synthesized Sample.

paper.title: Score-Based Generative Modeling through Stochastic Differential Equations

paper_figure.label: Figure 2 · PDF p.4
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 离散 diffusion 和 score matching 缺少统一连续框架
keypoints.核心想法: 以连续时间 score network 统一 reverse SDE、probability-flow ODE 与采样器
keypoints.关键改进: 反向 SDE、predictor-corrector 与同边缘分布的确定性 PF-ODE
keypoints.医学适配: 为 MRI/CT posterior sampling 和 likelihood guidance 提供理论接口
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 核心数学基础；posterior 与采样仍受 score/likelihood mismatch 影响

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: SMLD (score matching) and DDPM (diffusion) were developed as separate discrete heuristics lacking a unified continuous mathematical theory.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Cast forward corruption as a continuous Itô SDE whose reverse-time SDE and deterministic PF-ODE depend solely on the time-dependent score ∇_x log p_t(x).
keypoints_en.关键改进: Unified VE/VP/sub-VP SDE taxonomy + Predictor-Corrector (PC) samplers + exact log-likelihood computation + controllable inverse conditional sampling.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Provides the rigorous continuous-time mathematical foundation for MRI/CT score-based posterior reconstruction.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Foundational mathematical framework; practical medical inverse solving still depends on accurate likelihood score approximations.

name: Latent Diffusion
summary: 先以 autoencoder 压缩图像，再在 latent grid 上运行可 cross-attention 条件化的 diffusion。
summary_en: Perceptually compresses high-resolution images into a lower-dimensional spatial latent grid via a VQ/KL autoencoder before running cross-attention-conditioned diffusion.

nodes.label: 图像 x
nodes.description: 像素空间训练样本
nodes.description_en: Ingests high-resolution image x (encoded to z_0 = e(x)) + optional multimodal conditioning c (text, mask, layout) and prepares initial tensor representations (Stage 01).

nodes.label: VAE 编码器
nodes.description: 感知/对抗正则的 autoencoder 将 x 压缩到 z0
nodes.description_en: Executes VAE encoder to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: latent z0
nodes.description: 较低空间分辨率、较高语义密度的连续网格
nodes.description_en: Performs latent z0 within the core latent conditional diffusion computation pathway.

nodes.label: latent 加噪
nodes.description: q(z_t|z0) 在潜空间逐步加入高斯噪声
nodes.description_en: Performs latent within the core latent conditional diffusion computation pathway.

nodes.label: 条件 c
nodes.description: 文本或其他模态经 cross-attention 注入
nodes.description_en: Performs Stage 05 within the core latent conditional diffusion computation pathway.

nodes.label: U-Net score
nodes.description: epsilon_theta(z_t,t,c) 在 latent grid 上预测噪声/score
nodes.description_en: Performs U-Net score within the core latent conditional diffusion computation pathway.

nodes.label: 逆 SDE / ODE
nodes.description: DDPM、DDIM 等 solver 从 zT 迭代到 z0_hat
nodes.description_en: Performs SDE / ODE within the core latent conditional diffusion computation pathway.

nodes.label: VAE 解码器
nodes.description: 把 z0_hat 映射回像素空间
nodes.description_en: Applies VAE decoder to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: x_hat
nodes.description: 高分辨率生成或条件转换结果
nodes.description_en: Produces high-resolution synthesized image x̂ = d(ẑ_0) decoded from denoised latent grid via x_hat.

paper.title: High-Resolution Image Synthesis with Latent Diffusion Models

paper_figure.label: Figure 3 · PDF p.4
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: pixel-space diffusion 在高分辨率和 3D 上计算过重
keypoints.核心想法: 先用 autoencoder 压缩图像，再在 latent grid 上扩散并以 cross-attention 条件化
keypoints.关键改进: 用较小空间网格建模语义，支持更大 backbone 与多模态条件
keypoints.医学适配: 用于医学合成、跨模态 translation 和高分辨生成
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 现实的大模型路线；autoencoder ceiling 可能丢微钙化、小血管和定量强度

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Pixel-space diffusion scaled poorly in compute and VRAM on high-resolution 2D images and 3D medical volumes.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Separate perceptual high-frequency compression (autoencoder) from semantic generative modeling (diffusion U-Net in latent space) with cross-attention conditioning.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Dramatic spatial token reduction (e.g., 8× downsampling per axis) + flexible cross-attention conditioning mechanism.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Dominant architecture for high-resolution 2D/3D medical image synthesis, report-to-image generation, and synthetic data augmentation.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Pragmatic scaling route; the frozen first-stage autoencoder sets an upper bound on fidelity and can bottleneck tiny micro-lesions or quantitative HU values.

name: DDRM
summary: 在退化算子 SVD 基中把预训练 diffusion prior 与线性观测条件分量逐时间步耦合。
summary_en: Couples an unconditional pretrained diffusion prior with a linear forward operator y = Hx + z by running conditional reverse diffusion in the SVD spectral domain of H.

nodes.label: 测量 y
nodes.description: 含已知噪声水平的线性观测
nodes.description_en: Ingests linearly degraded measurement y = hx + z, known svd of operator h, and an unconditional pretrained diffusion model and prepares initial tensor representations (Stage 01).

nodes.label: A / A*
nodes.description: 已知线性退化及其伴随；A=U Sigma V*
nodes.description_en: Executes A / A* to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: SVD 坐标
nodes.description: 将可观测、弱观测和零空间方向分离
nodes.description_en: Performs SVD within the core svd conditioned diffusion inverse computation pathway.

nodes.label: Diffusion 加噪
nodes.description: 无条件 prior 的预设噪声层级与前向高斯过程
nodes.description_en: Performs Diffusion within the core svd conditioned diffusion inverse computation pathway.

nodes.label: 去噪 / score
nodes.description: 预训练网络提供各 t 的 clean/noise 估计，无需为 A 重训
nodes.description_en: Performs denoising / score within the core svd conditioned diffusion inverse computation pathway.

nodes.label: 谱域 DC
nodes.description: 按 singular value 和观测噪声对每个方向做条件更新
nodes.description_en: Performs DC within the core svd conditioned diffusion inverse computation pathway.

nodes.label: T 步恢复
nodes.description: 每个逆扩散时间步交替 prior 预测与 SVD 条件采样
nodes.description_en: Performs Stage 07 within the core svd conditioned diffusion inverse computation pathway.

nodes.label: ODE 路径边界
nodes.description: 原始 DDRM 使用离散条件逆扩散；未给出保持 SVD 条件更新的 PF-ODE 版本
nodes.description_en: Applies ODE to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: x_hat
nodes.description: 由 V 基变换回图像域的恢复样本
nodes.description_en: Produces restored image x̂ consistent with both linear measurements y and the pretrained diffusion prior via x_hat.

paper.title: Denoising Diffusion Restoration Models

paper_figure.label: Figure 2 · PDF p.3
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 每种线性退化都需重新训练专用模型
keypoints.核心想法: 利用线性退化算子 A 的 SVD 构造 diffusion restoration posterior
keypoints.关键改进: 将无条件 diffusion prior 与已知线性 forward model 解耦
keypoints.医学适配: 同一 prior 可研究 MRI、去模糊、超分辨和部分 CT 线性逆问题
keypoints.适用范围与证据: inverse solver 重要节点；大规模 CT 的 SVD 和非线性 likelihood 不便

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Supervised restoration required retraining a separate model whenever the degradation operator, blur kernel, or undersampling mask changed.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Transform the reverse diffusion process into the Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) basis of H, conditioning spectral coefficients directly on observed measurements and noise level.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Zero-shot plug-and-play linear inverse solver requiring only 20 DDIM-style steps and zero task-specific retraining.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Applicable to super-resolution, deblurring, inpainting, and compressed sensing MRI where the forward operator admits tractable spectral decomposition.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Important zero-shot inverse solver milestone; computing explicit full SVD is intractable for large 3D cone-beam CT or non-linear forward operators.

name: DPS
summary: 在每个 diffusion 逆时间步，把预训练先验 score 与经 x0 估计反传的测量 likelihood gradient 相加。
summary_en: Approximates intractable time-dependent measurement likelihood scores ∇_{x_t} log p_t(y|x_t) via backpropagation through the Tweedie posterior mean estimate x̂_0(x_t).

nodes.label: 测量 y
nodes.description: 可为线性或非线性、带噪观测
nodes.description_en: Ingests corrupted measurement y, general differentiable forward operator a(·), and pretrained unconditional score network s_θ and prepares initial tensor representations (Stage 01).

nodes.label: A / A*
nodes.description: 可微 forward A；反向传播/伴随 A* 传递 likelihood gradient
nodes.description_en: Executes A / A* to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: Diffusion 加噪
nodes.description: 训练 prior 的前向噪声过程，生成从 x0 到 xT 的尺度
nodes.description_en: Performs Diffusion within the core likelihood guided diffusion inverse computation pathway.

nodes.label: 状态 x_t
nodes.description: 从高斯 xT 开始的当前后验采样状态
nodes.description_en: Performs x_t within the core likelihood guided diffusion inverse computation pathway.

nodes.label: 先验 score
nodes.description: s_theta(x_t,t) 或等价 epsilon predictor
nodes.description_en: Performs prior score within the core likelihood guided diffusion inverse computation pathway.

nodes.label: x0 估计
nodes.description: 由 x_t 与 score 构造去噪估计 x0_hat(x_t)
nodes.description_en: Performs x0 within the core likelihood guided diffusion inverse computation pathway.

nodes.label: Likelihood 梯度
nodes.description: 对 ||y-A(x0_hat)||^2 求梯度；线性情形含 A*(A x0_hat-y)
nodes.description_en: Performs Likelihood within the core likelihood guided diffusion inverse computation pathway.

nodes.label: 后验 score
nodes.description: 先验 score 与近似 measurement guidance 相加
nodes.description_en: Performs score within the core likelihood guided diffusion inverse computation pathway.

nodes.label: 逆 SDE / ODE
nodes.description: T 个数值步骤反复计算 score、x0_hat 与 DC guidance
nodes.description_en: Applies SDE / ODE to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: x_hat
nodes.description: t=0 的近似 posterior sample
nodes.description_en: Produces posterior sample x̂ ~ p(x|y) satisfying noisy linear or non-linear measurement constraints via x_hat.

paper.title: Diffusion Posterior Sampling for General Noisy Inverse Problems

paper_figure.label: Figure 3 · PDF p.6
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 早期 diffusion inverse 方法难处理 noisy 或 nonlinear operators
keypoints.核心想法: 把 learned score prior 与可微 measurement likelihood gradient 结合
keypoints.关键改进: 通过 x0 估计近似 posterior score guidance，支持通用 differentiable A
keypoints.医学适配: 可用于 MRI、CT、PET 等测量模型耦合的 posterior sampling
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 研究主干；guidance 调参、NFE 和 posterior calibration 仍是限制

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Projection-based diffusion solvers failed under heavy measurement noise or non-linear operators without closed-form SVD.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Approximate p(y|x_t) ≈ p(y | x̂_0(x_t)) using Tweedie's formula and take a gradient step ∇_{x_t} ||y − A(x̂_0(x_t))||² at every reverse diffusion step.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Handles general noisy linear and non-linear differentiable forward operators without SVD or task-specific retraining.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Widely used in accelerated multi-coil MRI, sparse-view CT, phase retrieval, and PET posterior sampling research.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Core diffusion inverse baseline; requires backpropagation through the score network at every step (high memory/latency) and sensitive guidance-scale tuning.

name: DiffusionMBIR
summary: 把预训练 2D diffusion slice prior 嵌入 3D MBIR/data-consistency 外循环，并显式加跨切片约束。
summary_en: Embeds a pretrained 2D slice diffusion score prior into an alternating 3D Model-Based Iterative Reconstruction (MBIR) loop with explicit z-axis total variation regularization.

nodes.label: 3D 测量 y
nodes.description: 稀疏/有限角 CT 投影或欠采样 MRI 数据
nodes.description_en: Ingests 3d tomographic measurements y, 3d forward/adjoint operators a/a*, and a pretrained 2d axial diffusion model and prepares initial tensor representations (3D y).

nodes.label: A / A*
nodes.description: 真实 3D forward 与 adjoint，提供 volume-level 数据项
nodes.description_en: Executes A / A* to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: 前向噪声状态 x_t
nodes.description: 沿预训练 2D prior 的 forward/noise schedule 定义尺度，并从 x_T/初始化反向更新
nodes.description_en: Performs noise x_t within the core slice diffusion 3d mbir computation pathway.

nodes.label: 2D 切片视图
nodes.description: 把体按一个或多个正交方向拆成 2D slices
nodes.description_en: Performs 2D slice within the core slice diffusion 3d mbir computation pathway.

nodes.label: 2D diffusion prior
nodes.description: 预训练 2D score/denoiser 在每个噪声尺度处理切片
nodes.description_en: Performs 2D diffusion prior within the core slice diffusion 3d mbir computation pathway.

nodes.label: 重组 3D 体
nodes.description: 把切片 prior 更新重新堆叠到共享体坐标
nodes.description_en: Performs 3D within the core slice diffusion 3d mbir computation pathway.

nodes.label: 跨切片约束
nodes.description: 3D 正则/一致性项抑制独立切片造成的不连续
nodes.description_en: Performs slice constraint within the core slice diffusion 3d mbir computation pathway.

nodes.label: MBIR / DC
nodes.description: 利用 A*(A x-y) 与 3D regularizer 更新体状态
nodes.description_en: Performs MBIR / DC within the core slice diffusion 3d mbir computation pathway.

nodes.label: 逆扩散外循环
nodes.description: 各 t 交替 2D prior、3D regularization 与 measurement update；原方法走离散 reverse updates，不是 PF-ODE
nodes.description_en: Applies reverse diffusion to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: x_hat
nodes.description: t=0 的 3D 重建
nodes.description_en: Produces volumetric 3d reconstruction x̂ maintaining 3d measurement fidelity and inter-slice smoothness via x_hat.

paper.title: Solving 3D Inverse Problems using Pre-trained 2D Diffusion Models

paper_figure.label: Figure 2 · PDF p.3
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 训练真正 3D diffusion 的数据与显存成本很高
keypoints.核心想法: 以预训练 2D diffusion prior 配合 3D measurement fidelity/MBIR
keypoints.关键改进: 跨切片/体积一致性正则把 2D prior 复用于 3D inverse tasks
keypoints.医学适配: 用于 sparse/limited-angle CT 与 compressed-sensing MRI
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 有代表性的 3D 折中；2D slice prior 不等于真实 3D anatomy

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Training native whole-volume high-resolution 3D diffusion models is bottlenecked by scarce 3D cohorts and extreme GPU memory.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Apply a data-efficient pretrained 2D axial score prior slice-by-slice while enforcing 3D physical data consistency and z-axis TV continuity in an outer splitting loop.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Pragmatically bridges 2D generative score priors to 3D cone-beam/helical CT and 3D MRI reconstruction without 3D diffusion training.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Used for sparse-view CT, limited-angle CT, and volumetric compressed-sensing reconstruction.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Practical 2D-to-3D reconstruction compromise; slice-wise 2D priors plus z-TV still cannot fully capture complex 3D non-local anatomical priors.

name: Flow Matching
summary: 在已知 probability path 上回归 velocity（而非 score），再直接积分神经 ODE 完成分布运输。
summary_en: Trains continuous normalizing flows without ODE simulation by directly regressing the marginal vector field u_t(x) along conditional probability paths.

nodes.label: 源噪声 x0
nodes.description: 易采样的 base distribution，通常 N(0,I)
nodes.description_en: Ingests source prior sample x_0 ~ p_0 and target data sample x_1 ~ p_1 interpolated along a conditional path x_t and prepares initial tensor representations (noise x0).

nodes.label: 数据 x1
nodes.description: 训练数据分布中的样本
nodes.description_en: Executes x1 to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: 样本 coupling
nodes.description: 联合抽取 (x0,x1)，决定条件概率路径的配对
nodes.description_en: Performs coupling within the core probability path velocity ode computation pathway.

nodes.label: 前向概率路径
nodes.description: 构造 x_t 与已知 p_t(x|x1)；直线路径常写 x_t=(1-t)x0+t x1
nodes.description_en: Performs Stage 04 within the core probability path velocity ode computation pathway.

nodes.label: 目标速度 u_t
nodes.description: 条件路径的解析 velocity target；训练目标不是 score
nodes.description_en: Performs objective u_t within the core probability path velocity ode computation pathway.

nodes.label: 速度场 v_theta
nodes.description: 普通 U-Net/Transformer 回归 v_theta(x_t,t)
nodes.description_en: Performs velocity field v_theta within the core probability path velocity ode computation pathway.

nodes.label: FM 回归
nodes.description: 最小化 ||v_theta-u_t||^2；无需求解 score 或 likelihood
nodes.description_en: Performs FM within the core probability path velocity ode computation pathway.

nodes.label: 生成 ODE
nodes.description: dx/dt=v_theta(x,t)，从 t=0 数值积分到 t=1
nodes.description_en: Applies ODE to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: 生成样本
nodes.description: ODE 终点 x(1)
nodes.description_en: Produces samples generated by integrating the learned velocity field dx/dt = v_θ(x_t, t) from t=0 to t=1 via Synthesized Sample.

paper.title: Flow Matching for Generative Modeling

paper_figure.label: Figure 2 · PDF p.6
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: normalizing flow 受可逆层和 Jacobian 限制，diffusion 采样步骤多
keypoints.核心想法: 在选定概率路径上回归条件 velocity field，再解 ODE 从 source transport 到 data
keypoints.关键改进: 普通 U-Net/DiT 即可训练，无需 exact invertibility；直路径可少步积分
keypoints.医学适配: 启发 operator-conditioned 医学 inverse solver 与少步跨模态生成
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 高速发展；医学 coupling、likelihood 耦合与临床 superiority 尚未解决

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Continuous Normalizing Flows required costly backpropagation through ODE solvers, while diffusion models relied on curved stochastic paths.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Construct conditional probability paths (e.g., optimal transport straight lines) with closed-form conditional velocities and train v_θ via simple L2 regression.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Simulation-free training with unconstrained U-Net/DiT backbones + straight optimal-transport paths enabling fast few-step ODE integration.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Rapidly adopted for fast medical image synthesis, cross-modality translation, and operator-conditioned inverse reconstruction.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: High-momentum generative paradigm; clinical superiority and calibrated posterior uncertainty over unrolled/diffusion baselines remain open research.

name: Rectified Flow
summary: 以直线端点路径训练 velocity，并通过 reflow 重新耦合端点以进一步拉直 ODE 轨迹。
summary_en: Learns an ODE velocity field along straight linear interpolations x_t = (1−t)x_0 + t x_1 and iteratively straightens trajectories via reflow recoupling.

nodes.label: 源噪声 z0
nodes.description: 标准高斯等 base sample
nodes.description_en: Ingests coupled pairs (x_0, x_1) from source distribution π_0 and target distribution π_1 and prepares initial tensor representations (noise z0).

nodes.label: 目标 x1
nodes.description: 数据分布样本
nodes.description_en: Executes objective x1 to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: 初始 coupling
nodes.description: 配对 z0 与 x1；配对质量决定交叉轨迹复杂度
nodes.description_en: Performs coupling within the core straightened transport ode computation pathway.

nodes.label: 直线前向路径
nodes.description: x_t=(1-t)z0+t x1，目标速度为 x1-z0
nodes.description_en: Performs Stage 04 within the core straightened transport ode computation pathway.

nodes.label: 速度场 v_theta
nodes.description: 回归 E[x1-z0|x_t]；目标为 velocity 而非 score
nodes.description_en: Performs velocity field v_theta within the core straightened transport ode computation pathway.

nodes.label: Rectified ODE
nodes.description: dx/dt=v_theta(x,t)，从噪声积分到数据
nodes.description_en: Performs Rectified ODE within the core straightened transport ode computation pathway.

nodes.label: 生成端点对
nodes.description: 用当前 ODE 将 z0 映射为 x1_hat，形成新 coupling
nodes.description_en: Performs Stage 07 within the core straightened transport ode computation pathway.

nodes.label: Reflow
nodes.description: 在新端点对上重训，使轨迹进一步变直、减少交叉
nodes.description_en: Performs Reflow within the core straightened transport ode computation pathway.

nodes.label: 少步求解
nodes.description: 直轨迹可用 Euler 等粗步长积分，甚至蒸馏为单步
nodes.description_en: Applies Stage 09 to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: x_hat
nodes.description: ODE 终点生成样本
nodes.description_en: Produces nearly straight-line ode transport trajectories enabling high-fidelity 1-to-few-step euler generation via x_hat.

paper.title: Flow Straight and Fast: Learning to Generate and Transfer Data with Rectified Flow

paper_figure.label: Figure 2 · PDF p.4
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 弯曲生成轨迹需要更多 ODE steps 才能准确积分
keypoints.核心想法: 从 source-target coupling 学直线速度场，并用 reflow 进一步拉直轨迹
keypoints.关键改进: 优化 trajectory straightness，降低 coarse-step integration error
keypoints.医学适配: 为少步医学生成与 translation 提供速度路线
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 少步潜力真实；高频和病灶 fidelity、uncertainty 仍需专门验证

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Curved ODE transport trajectories accumulate high discretization error under large Euler step sizes.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Drive transport paths as close to straight lines as possible by regressing the constant displacement (x_1 − x_0) and iteratively re-pairing (z_0, ẑ_1) via reflow.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Simple ODE velocity formulation + Reflow procedure that provably reduces transport cost and straightens trajectories for 1-step distillation.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Provides a principled mathematical route for real-time few-step medical domain translation and generative modeling.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Genuine algorithmic speed advantage; reflow distillation can subtly smooth high-frequency diagnostic textures if not audited.

name: Consistency Models
summary: 学习沿 PF-ODE 轨迹不变的 endpoint map，使任意噪声尺度可直接一步映射到 clean sample。
summary_en: Learns a self-consistent function f_θ(x_t, t) = x_ε that maps any point along a Probability-Flow ODE trajectory directly to its clean origin in a single step.

nodes.label: 数据 x0
nodes.description: 训练分布样本
nodes.description_en: Ingests noisy state x_t along a pf-ode trajectory (distilled from a pretrained score model or trained standalone) and prepares initial tensor representations (x0).

nodes.label: 前向加噪
nodes.description: 在多个时间尺度生成 x_t 与 x_s
nodes.description_en: Executes Forward Gaussian Noising to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: 噪声 x_T
nodes.description: 生成时的起始高斯状态
nodes.description_en: Performs noise x_T within the core probability flow consistency computation pathway.

nodes.label: Score / PF-ODE
nodes.description: 蒸馏时用 diffusion score teacher 的 probability-flow ODE 连接相邻时间
nodes.description_en: Performs Score / PF-ODE within the core probability flow consistency computation pathway.

nodes.label: 同轨迹时间对
nodes.description: 构造 (x_t,t) 与 (x_s,s)，二者位于同一 PF-ODE 轨迹
nodes.description_en: Performs Stage 05 within the core probability flow consistency computation pathway.

nodes.label: 一致性函数 f_theta
nodes.description: 把任意轨迹点直接映射到共同的 clean endpoint
nodes.description_en: Performs f_theta within the core probability flow consistency computation pathway.

nodes.label: 一致性损失
nodes.description: 匹配 f_theta(x_t,t) 与 EMA target f_bar(x_s,s)，并满足边界 f(x,epsilon)=x
nodes.description_en: Performs loss within the core probability flow consistency computation pathway.

nodes.label: 一步路径
nodes.description: x_T→f_theta(x_T,T)，无需完整 ODE 积分
nodes.description_en: Performs Stage 08 within the core probability flow consistency computation pathway.

nodes.label: 少步路径
nodes.description: 输出后再加受控噪声并重复 f_theta 以提升质量
nodes.description_en: Applies Stage 09 to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: x_hat
nodes.description: one/few-step clean sample
nodes.description_en: Produces one-step or few-step clean sample estimate x̂_0 via x_hat.

paper.title: Consistency Models

paper_figure.label: Figure 2 · PDF p.3
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 高质量 diffusion 需要许多 solver steps
keypoints.核心想法: 把同一 probability-flow ODE 轨迹上的任意点直接映射到相同 clean endpoint
keypoints.关键改进: 可由预训练 diffusion 蒸馏或独立训练，实现 one/few-step generation
keypoints.医学适配: 对实时医学重建和交互生成有直接吸引力
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 速度方向重要；医学 raw-data benchmark 和校准证据不足

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Even accelerated ODE/DDIM samplers required 10–50 sequential neural evaluations, limiting real-time intraoperative or streaming use.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Enforce that any two adjacent points on the same PF-ODE trajectory map to the exact same clean endpoint under an EMA target network.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Supports single-step generation (1 NFE) as well as zero-shot multi-step iterative refinement trading compute for quality.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Highly attractive for real-time medical reconstruction, interactive synthesis, and low-latency clinical workflows.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Important speed frontier; raw-data medical inverse benchmarks and quantitative bias audits at 1–2 NFEs remain limited.

name: DiT
summary: 把 noisy latent patch 化，以 adaLN-Zero 条件化的 Transformer blocks 作为 diffusion score/velocity backbone。
summary_en: Replaces the convolutional U-Net backbone in Latent Diffusion with an isotropic Vision Transformer over latent patches conditioned via Adaptive LayerNorm-Zero (adaLN-Zero).

nodes.label: latent z0
nodes.description: 通常由预训练 VAE 编码图像得到
nodes.description_en: Ingests noisy latent tensor z_t, diffusion timestep t, and conditioning embedding c and prepares initial tensor representations (latent z0).

nodes.label: 前向加噪
nodes.description: q(z_t|z0) 生成各噪声尺度的 latent
nodes.description_en: Executes Forward Gaussian Noising to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: 噪声 z_t
nodes.description: 训练输入；生成从 z_T 开始
nodes.description_en: Performs noise z_t within the core transformer diffusion backbone computation pathway.

nodes.label: Patch tokens
nodes.description: 将 z_t 分块、线性投影并加入位置编码
nodes.description_en: Performs Patch tokens within the core transformer diffusion backbone computation pathway.

nodes.label: t / class
nodes.description: 时间与类别嵌入生成 adaLN 的 scale、shift、gate
nodes.description_en: Performs t / class within the core transformer diffusion backbone computation pathway.

nodes.label: DiT blocks
nodes.description: 全局 self-attention+MLP；adaLN-Zero 条件化并零初始化残差门
nodes.description_en: Performs DiT blocks within the core transformer diffusion backbone computation pathway.

nodes.label: epsilon / score
nodes.description: 线性头输出每个 latent patch 的噪声预测；原论文 ADM-style 配置还学习方差，epsilon 可按噪声尺度换算为 score
nodes.description_en: Performs epsilon / score within the core transformer diffusion backbone computation pathway.

nodes.label: 逆 SDE / ODE
nodes.description: 用 DDPM、DDIM 等 sampler 反复调用 DiT
nodes.description_en: Performs SDE / ODE within the core transformer diffusion backbone computation pathway.

nodes.label: VAE 解码器
nodes.description: 将去噪 latent 还原为像素图像
nodes.description_en: Applies VAE decoder to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: 生成图像
nodes.description: 最终解码结果
nodes.description_en: Produces predicted noise ε_θ, diagonal covariance σ_θ, or velocity v_θ on the latent token grid via Generated Image.

paper.title: Scalable Diffusion Models with Transformers

paper_figure.label: Figure 3 · PDF p.3
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: U-Net diffusion 的扩展规律和多模态 token 接口有限
keypoints.核心想法: 将 latent image patch 化，用 Transformer blocks 与 adaptive LayerNorm 做 diffusion backbone
keypoints.关键改进: 以模型规模和计算量系统提升生成质量，条件以 adaLN 注入
keypoints.医学适配: 适合医学多模态、3D patch 和 report/image cross-attention 研究
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 生成 backbone 重要演化；3D token、数据规模和微小结构仍是风险

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Convolutional U-Net inductive biases plateaued under massive compute scaling and lacked a uniform token interface across modalities.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Tokenize latent feature maps into patches and process them through standard Transformer blocks modulated by scale/shift/gate parameters regressed from (t, c).
keypoints_en.关键改进: adaLN-Zero initialization (initializing each residual block as exact identity) + predictable Gflops scaling laws improving FID monotonically with compute.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Backbone of choice for scalable 3D volumetric latent diffusion, spatio-temporal video generation, and multimodal medical synthesis.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Major generative backbone shift; requires well-trained 3D/2D VAEs and large training cohorts to justify Transformer compute.

name: Spatial Transformer Network
summary: 定位网络预测变换参数，grid generator 与可微 sampler 将任务梯度传回几何坐标。
summary_en: Predicts geometric transformation parameters θ via a localization network, generates a transformed sampling grid, and warps feature maps via a differentiable sampler.

nodes.label: 输入 U
nodes.description: 图像或中间特征图
nodes.description_en: Ingests input image or feature map u and prepares initial tensor representations (input U).

nodes.label: 定位网络
nodes.description: CNN/MLP 从 U 预测变换参数
nodes.description_en: Executes Localization Network to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: 参数 theta
nodes.description: 仿射、TPS 等低维几何参数
nodes.description_en: Performs theta within the core differentiable coordinate warp computation pathway.

nodes.label: 网格生成器
nodes.description: 对每个输出坐标计算其输入采样位置 T_theta(G)
nodes.description_en: Performs Grid Generator within the core differentiable coordinate warp computation pathway.

nodes.label: 可微采样器
nodes.description: 双线性插值；梯度可传至输入与 theta
nodes.description_en: Performs Differentiable Sampler within the core differentiable coordinate warp computation pathway.

nodes.label: 变换后 V
nodes.description: 与下游网络尺寸约定一致的重采样结果
nodes.description_en: Applies Stage 06 to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: 下游损失
nodes.description: 分类/配准等任务损失反传到定位网络
nodes.description_en: Produces spatially warped feature map v resampled over learned coordinates t_θ(g) via loss.

paper.title: Spatial Transformer Networks

paper_figure.label: Figure 2 · PDF p.3
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 普通 CNN 无法对采样坐标和几何变换端到端求导
keypoints.核心想法: 用 localization network、grid generator 与可微 sampler 学习空间变换
keypoints.关键改进: 把重采样写成可微算子，使下游 loss 可反传到变换参数
keypoints.医学适配: 成为 VoxelMorph、可微配准和 2D/3D warping 的算子基础
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 基础设施；本身不保证变换平滑、可逆或物理合理

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Standard CNN pooling offered only tiny local translation invariance and could not differentiate through spatial coordinate warping.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Formulate coordinate transformation and sub-pixel bilinear/trilinear interpolation as an explicit, sub-differentiable neural module.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Sub-gradients with respect to sampling grid coordinates allow upstream networks to learn affine, projective, or thin-plate-spline warps end-to-end.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Provides the foundational differentiable warping operator (`grid_sample`) underlying VoxelMorph and all modern learned medical registration.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Essential differentiable geometry primitive; requires explicit regularization when generalized from low-DOF affine to dense displacement fields.

name: VoxelMorph
summary: 3D U-Net 一次前向预测 dense displacement，并用可微 warping、图像相似度和平滑项无监督训练。
summary_en: Amortizes pairwise 3D deformable registration into a single U-Net forward pass predicting a dense displacement field u trained unsupervised via image similarity and diffusion smoothness.

nodes.label: m 与 f
nodes.description: 同维度 2D/3D moving/fixed image pair
nodes.description_en: Ingests pair of 3d moving volume m and fixed volume f and prepares initial tensor representations (m f).

nodes.label: 通道拼接
nodes.description: 把 m、f 作为联合输入，不依赖真实位移标签
nodes.description_en: Executes Channel Concatenation to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: 3D U-Net
nodes.description: encoder-decoder 提取多尺度对应与形变上下文
nodes.description_en: Performs 3D U-Net within the core amortized dense registration computation pathway.

nodes.label: 位移场 u
nodes.description: 卷积头一次前向预测每体素 displacement；phi=Id+u
nodes.description_en: Performs Displacement Field u within the core amortized dense registration computation pathway.

nodes.label: 空间变换器
nodes.description: 可微插值计算 m∘phi
nodes.description_en: Performs Spatial Transformer within the core amortized dense registration computation pathway.

nodes.label: 图像相似度
nodes.description: NCC/MSE 等无监督数据项比较 m∘phi 与 f
nodes.description_en: Performs Image Similarity Loss within the core amortized dense registration computation pathway.

nodes.label: 平滑正则
nodes.description: 惩罚位移空间梯度，控制局部粗糙与 folding 风险
nodes.description_en: Applies Smoothness Regularizer to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: 配准结果
nodes.description: phi 与 warped moving image
nodes.description_en: Produces dense 3d deformation field φ = id + u (or velocity field integrated via scaling-and-squaring) and warped volume m ∘ φ via Registered Output.

paper.title: VoxelMorph: A Learning Framework for Deformable Medical Image Registration

paper_figure.label: Figure 3 · PDF p.4
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 经典 deformable registration 每对病例都需迭代优化，速度慢
keypoints.核心想法: 3D U-Net 接收固定/移动图像并一次 forward 预测 dense displacement
keypoints.关键改进: 以图像相似度加平滑正则做无监督 amortized registration
keypoints.医学适配: 成为 CT/MRI 快速配准最常用的学习式基线
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 基础设施级 baseline；跨域、相似度选择和 folding 仍是问题

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Classical iterative deformable registration (ANTs/SyN, Elastix) optimized every image pair from scratch, taking minutes to hours on CPU.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Train a 3D convolutional U-Net over a population of scans to predict the dense deformation field in sub-second GPU inference without ground-truth warps.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Amortized U-Net displacement/velocity prediction + Spatial Transformer warping + unsupervised LNCC/MSE + anatomical segmentation Dice auxiliary loss.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Foundational fast learning-based baseline for brain MRI, chest CT inspiration–expiration, and longitudinal registration.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Core registration infrastructure; simple gradient smoothing does not strictly prevent topological folding (|J_φ| ≤ 0) under large deformations.

name: GradICON
summary: 通过双向预测与复合映射 Jacobian 的 gradient inverse-consistency 正则获得近似微分同胚。
summary_en: Enforces diffeomorphic regularity without tuning sensitive multi-scale smoothness weights by penalizing the Frobenius norm of the composed forward–backward Jacobian deviation from identity.

nodes.label: 图像 A/B
nodes.description: 交换顺序后分别预测两个方向
nodes.description_en: Ingests ordered pairs (i^a, i^b) and (i^b, i^a) fed symmetrically to a registration network and prepares initial tensor representations (A/B).

nodes.label: 共享配准网络
nodes.description: 多尺度卷积网络 g_theta 对两个方向复用权重
nodes.description_en: Executes registration to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: Phi_AB

paper_figure.label: Figure 2 · PDF p.5

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 单纯平滑位移会过度平滑，直接 inverse-consistency 优化不稳
keypoints.核心想法: 同时预测正反变换并惩罚复合映射 Jacobian 偏离单位阵
keypoints.关键改进: 用逆一致性的梯度结构获得规则、近似微分同胚的变换
keypoints.医学适配: 在多数据集统一 protocol 上提供强通用配准基线
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 比单纯换 encoder 更具长期价值；仍需病理保持和极端域移位验证

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Penalizing displacement norm ||Φ^AB(Φ^BA(x)) − x||² required tedious hyperparameter schedules and still permitted local Jacobian folding.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Penalize the spatial gradient (Jacobian) of the composed forward–backward transformation relative to the identity matrix I via first-order Taylor expansion.
keypoints_en.关键改进: First-order Gradient Inverse Consistency (GradICON) loss yielding near-zero folding and fast convergence across multi-step cascades.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Provides a highly regular, topology-preserving 3D registration baseline across brain MRI, lung CT, and abdominal scans.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Superior theoretical and empirical regularity over raw smoothness penalties; space-occupying tumors without topological correspondence still require special handling.

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: task-specific registration 网络迁移到新器官或模态时脆弱
keypoints.核心想法: 在多解剖、多模态、多数据集联合训练 GradICON，支持 zero-shot 与微调
keypoints.关键改进: 共享跨任务的对应特征与形变先验，同时保留 inverse consistency
keypoints.医学适配: 是 registration foundation model 的早期可信实例
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 高速发展；尚未覆盖所有临床域和细结构

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Conventional learning-based registration required training a separate network for every organ, modality, and FOV.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Unify diverse public 3D registration cohorts (brain, lung, abdomen, knee; CT & MRI) under a single GradICON training objective.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Demonstrates that a single frozen registration weight set achieves strong out-of-the-box zero-shot accuracy on unseen anatomical domains and fast one-shot adaptation.
keypoints_en.医学适配: First credible, open-weight foundation model for 3D medical deformable image registration.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Rapidly advancing registration foundation baseline; extreme cross-modality contrasts (e.g., ultrasound-to-MRI) still benefit from domain adaptation.

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 直接 pose regression 跨病人/视角泛化差，纯优化捕获范围有限
keypoints.核心想法: 用合成 DRR 自监督 pose regressor 初始化，再以可微 X-ray renderer 和 SE(3) 几何测试时优化
keypoints.关键改进: 学习初始化、真实投影 forward model、geodesic pose 与 sparse multiscale LNCC 闭环
keypoints.医学适配: 用于术中 X-ray 到术前 CT 的 2D/3D 配准
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 几何融合范式价值高；标定、散射、金属和外部设备仍会致败

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Direct CNN pose regression generalized poorly outside training poses, while pure gradient-based DRR optimization had a narrow capture range.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Generate synthetic DRRs across SE(3) for a patient's preoperative CT to train a rapid pose regressor, then refine the estimate at test time via differentiable DRR gradients.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Double-geodesic SE(3) loss + sparse patch-based differentiable rendering accelerating test-time optimization to sub-second latency.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Enables accurate intraoperative 2D X-ray to 3D CT registration for orthopedic, spinal, and endovascular image-guided surgery.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Exemplary hybrid learning + projective physics loop; requires accurate C-arm calibration and robustness to surgical tool occlusion.

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 2D 投影到 3D 体积高度欠定，早期方法缺统一端到端表示
keypoints.核心想法: 将双正交 X-ray 的 2D 特征 reshape/fuse 为 3D CT，并联合 MSE 与 adversarial loss
keypoints.关键改进: 双视图 encoder、2D-to-3D generation 与跨视图 feature fusion
keypoints.医学适配: 奠定深度 2D-to-3D CT 生成的历史基线
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 重要但不唯一；逼真纹理不等于患者真实 anatomy

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Reconstructing a 3D volume from 1–2 planar X-ray projections is severely ill-posed, and standard 2D networks lack a 3D spatial bottleneck.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Encode PA and lateral radiographs via parallel 2D DenseNet-like encoders, expand 2D feature maps along the orthogonal depth axes, and fuse them inside a 3D decoder.
keypoints_en.关键改进: View-specific 2D-to-3D feature liftingconnections + bi-planar orthogonal fusion + 3D PatchGAN + projection consistency losses.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Canonical baseline for bi-planar 2D X-ray to 3D CT volumetric lifting.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Historically important 2D-to-3D baseline; must never be treated as a diagnostic replacement for true CT acquisition due to null-space hallucination.

paper_figure.label: Figure 7 · PDF p.18

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 离散 voxel/mesh 分辨率固定，novel-view fidelity 受限
keypoints.核心想法: 连续坐标 MLP 表示密度和视角相关颜色，并沿射线可微体渲染
keypoints.关键改进: positional encoding、per-scene optimization 与连续 volumetric rendering
keypoints.医学适配: 启发稀疏投影 attenuation fields、内镜场建模和医学 INR
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 场表示基础；原始可见光 alpha-compositing 不能直接当 X-ray 物理

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Discrete voxel grids scaled cubically in memory, while triangle meshes struggled to optimize complex topology via gradient descent.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Encode continuous spatial coordinates with high-frequency sinusoids so a compact MLP memorizes a continuous volumetric density and radiance field.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Fourier positional encoding overcoming MLP spectral bias + hierarchical coarse-to-fine stratified ray sampling.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Catalyzed medical Implicit Neural Representations (INRs), sparse-view CBCT attenuation fields (NAF), and surgical endoscopy scene reconstruction.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Foundational neural field paradigm; visible-light occlusion/emission rendering must be rewritten into Beer–Lambert transmission for X-ray/CT.

paper.title: Neural Attenuation Fields for Sparse-View CBCT Reconstruction

paper_figure.label: Figure 1 · PDF p.3
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 稀疏 CBCT 重建缺细节，监督网络需大量成对训练数据
keypoints.核心想法: 用坐标网络表示 X-ray attenuation，并最小化输入投影的重投影误差
keypoints.关键改进: 将 NeRF 改为符合 Beer-Lambert 的 attenuation field，并用 hash encoding 加速
keypoints.医学适配: 适用于 phantom/人体 sparse-view CBCT 的自监督 per-case reconstruction；需区分模拟投影与真实 acquisition
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 正确的医学 NeRF 改写；无外部 prior 时仍不能创造缺失信息

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Applying RGB NeRF directly to X-ray projections violated transmission physics, while Fourier MLP encodings took hours to optimize per patient.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Model a view-independent scalar attenuation field μ(x) using multi-resolution hash grid encoding (Instant-NGP) supervised purely by line-integral projection residuals.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Physically faithful Beer–Lambert line integral + multi-resolution learnable hash table reducing self-supervised 3D CBCT reconstruction to minutes.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Fast, self-supervised per-patient sparse-view CBCT reconstruction requiring zero external training datasets.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Correct physics adaptation of NeRF to tomography; without an external population prior, extreme view sparsity still exhibits null-space streaks.

paper_figure.label: Figure 2 · PDF p.5
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: NeRF 每射线 MLP 查询使训练与渲染较慢
keypoints.核心想法: 以显式各向异性 3D Gaussians 和 visibility-aware splatting 表示场景
keypoints.关键改进: 直接优化 Gaussian 位置、协方差、不透明度和颜色，实现实时渲染
keypoints.医学适配: 启发 X-ray radiative Gaussian splatting 和动态 tomography
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 实时渲染优势真实；不自动保证 HU、解剖或成像物理

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Continuous coordinate MLPs in NeRF required querying hundreds of points along every ray, bottlenecking real-time rendering and interactive editing.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Replace implicit continuous MLPs with explicit 3D Gaussian primitives projected directly to 2D screen space via closed-form EWA covariance splatting.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Anisotropic 3D covariance optimization (R S S^T R^T) + adaptive clone/split/prune density control + fast tile-based GPU sorting rasterizer.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Rapidly adapted to surgical endoscopy 3D reconstruction (EndoGaussian) and radiative X-ray Gaussian tomography (R2-Gaussian).
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Genuine real-time rendering breakthrough; discrete Gaussian primitives can still produce needle-like artifacts under sparse views.

name: GCN
summary: 以加自环的对称归一化邻接执行共享线性变换后的固定权重邻居聚合。
summary_en: First-order spectral graph convolution approximation that aggregates 1-hop neighbor features weighted by the symmetrically normalized adjacency matrix with self-loops.

nodes.label: 图与特征
nodes.description: 节点特征 X、邻接 A；边定义允许的信息传递范围
nodes.description_en: Ingests graph g=(v,e) with node feature matrix x ∈ r^{n×c} and adjacency matrix a and prepares initial tensor representations (feature).

nodes.label: 加入自环
nodes.description: A_tilde=A+I，使节点保留自身特征
nodes.description_en: Executes Stage 02 to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: 归一化邻接
nodes.description: D_tilde^{-1/2} A_tilde D_tilde^{-1/2} 稳定不同度数的聚合
nodes.description_en: Performs Normalized Adjacency within the core normalized graph convolution computation pathway.

nodes.label: 线性变换
nodes.description: H^l W^l 把节点特征映射到新通道
nodes.description_en: Performs Stage 04 within the core normalized graph convolution computation pathway.

nodes.label: 邻居聚合
nodes.description: 按归一化邻接对一跳邻居做加权求和
nodes.description_en: Performs Neighborhood Aggregation within the core normalized graph convolution computation pathway.

nodes.label: 激活 / 堆叠
nodes.description: sigma 后得到 H^{l+1}；L 层覆盖 L-hop 邻域
nodes.description_en: Performs Stage 06 within the core normalized graph convolution computation pathway.

nodes.label: 任务读出
nodes.description: 节点分类头或 pooling 后的图级分类头
nodes.description_en: Applies Stage 07 to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: 预测
nodes.description: 节点标签、图标签或连续值
nodes.description_en: Produces updated node embeddings h^{(l)} for node classification, link prediction, or pooled graph classification via prediction.

paper.title: Semi-Supervised Classification with Graph Convolutional Networks

paper_figure.label: Figure 1 · PDF p.4
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 谱图卷积需特征分解，难扩展且参数不易共享
keypoints.核心想法: 用归一化邻接矩阵的一阶谱近似做邻居特征聚合
keypoints.关键改进: 局部 message passing 的简单可训练形式
keypoints.医学适配: 用于 population graph、血管/气道树和解剖 mesh
keypoints.适用范围与证据: GNN 基础；深层 over-smoothing 与构图泄漏需警惕

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Exact spectral graph CNNs required O(N³) Laplacian eigendecomposition and could not transfer across graphs of varying topology.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Truncate Chebyshev spectral polynomials to first order, yielding a localized spatial 1-hop neighborhood averaging operator with shared linear weights.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Simple, parameter-efficient message passing scaling linearly with number of graph edges O(|E|).
keypoints_en.医学适配: Foundational GNN used across brain connectomes (fMRI/DTI), vascular/airway trees, cortical surface meshes, and spatial cell graphs.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Core GNN baseline; stacking many GCN layers causes over-smoothing, and transductive patient-similarity graphs risk severe cohort leakage.

name: GAT
summary: 对预定义邻域内的边计算 masked multi-head attention，再以数据依赖权重聚合邻居特征。
summary_en: Replaces fixed degree-normalized edge weights with content-dependent multi-head masked self-attention coefficients α_{ij} computed over 1-hop graph neighborhoods.

nodes.label: 节点与边
nodes.description: 预定义邻域 N(i) 限制可注意的节点对
nodes.description_en: Ingests graph g=(v,e) and node feature vectors {h_i} and prepares initial tensor representations (Stage 01).

nodes.label: 特征投影
nodes.description: 共享 W 将 h_i、h_j 映射到 attention 空间
nodes.description_en: Executes feature projection to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: 边注意力 e_ij
nodes.description: LeakyReLU(a^T[Wh_i || Wh_j]) 计算相邻节点兼容性
nodes.description_en: Performs Edge Attention Logits e_ij within the core masked graph attention computation pathway.

nodes.label: 邻域 Softmax
nodes.description: 仅在 j∈N(i) 上归一化得到 alpha_ij
nodes.description_en: Performs Neighborhood Softmax within the core masked graph attention computation pathway.

nodes.label: 多头聚合
nodes.description: 各 head 独立加权求和 Σ_j alpha_ij W h_j
nodes.description_en: Performs aggregation within the core masked graph attention computation pathway.

nodes.label: Concat / 平均
nodes.description: 中间层拼接多头，最终层可平均以稳定预测
nodes.description_en: Performs Concat within the core masked graph attention computation pathway.

nodes.label: 图层堆叠
nodes.description: 激活后进入下一层，扩大多跳上下文
nodes.description_en: Performs Stage 07 within the core masked graph attention computation pathway.

nodes.label: 任务读出
nodes.description: 节点头或图 pooling/head
nodes.description_en: Applies Stage 08 to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: 预测
nodes.description: 节点、边或图级输出
nodes.description_en: Produces anisotropically aggregated node representations h'_i and attention edge weights α_{ij} via prediction.

paper.title: Graph Attention Networks

paper_figure.label: Figure 1 · PDF p.4
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: GCN 对邻居使用固定归一化权重，难表达异质关系
keypoints.核心想法: 以 masked attention 为不同邻居自适应分配权重
keypoints.关键改进: 多头图注意力仍需预定义 adjacency/neighborhood，但不需预设已有边的权重
keypoints.医学适配: 适合血管分支、病人关系和细胞相互作用图
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 重要图模型；attention 权重不自动等于医学解释

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: GCN weighted neighbors solely by static node degrees, preventing the network from prioritizing diagnostically critical neighbors.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Compute learnable attention scores e_{ij} = a^T [W h_i || W h_j] normalized via softmax over each node's 1-hop neighborhood N_i.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Inductive, degree-agnostic anisotropic neighborhood weighting + multi-head stabilization.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Widely applied to histopathology cell- microenvironment graphs, brain functional connectivity, and multimodal patient networks.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Standard anisotropic GNN; learned attention weights α_{ij} aid inspection but do not guarantee causal biological importance.

name: LSTM
summary: 带门控的加性 cell memory 与 recurrent hidden state 分离，使长期信息可选择性保留和读出。
summary_en: Separates an additive linear cell memory state c_t (governed by forget and input gates) from the non-linear recurrent hidden state h_t to preserve long-term temporal gradients.

nodes.label: 输入 x_t
nodes.description: 当前 ECG/EEG/临床变量向量
nodes.description_en: Ingests sequential physiological waveform or longitudinal clinical time series x_1 … x_t and prepares initial tensor representations (input x_t).

nodes.label: h_{t-1}, c_{t-1}
nodes.description: 前一时刻短期隐藏状态与长期 cell memory
nodes.description_en: Executes h_{t-1}, c_{t-1} to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: i/f/o 门
nodes.description: sigmoid 门控制写入、保留与读出；forget gate 属后来成为标准的现代 LSTM 式
nodes.description_en: Performs i/f/o within the core gated recurrent memory computation pathway.

nodes.label: 候选记忆 g_t
nodes.description: tanh(W_x x_t+W_h h_{t-1}+b) 提议写入内容
nodes.description_en: Performs g_t within the core gated recurrent memory computation pathway.

nodes.label: Cell 更新
nodes.description: 现代式 c_t=f_t⊙c_{t-1}+i_t⊙g_t，形成加性记忆通路
nodes.description_en: Performs Cell update within the core gated recurrent memory computation pathway.

nodes.label: Hidden 更新
nodes.description: h_t=o_t⊙tanh(c_t)
nodes.description_en: Performs Hidden update within the core gated recurrent memory computation pathway.

nodes.label: 时间/序列头
nodes.description: 对 h_t 逐点预测，或聚合 h_1…h_T 做序列分类
nodes.description_en: Applies sequence to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: 预测
nodes.description: 事件、节律、状态或连续值
nodes.description_en: Produces step-wise hidden states h_t or sequence-level diagnostic prediction via prediction.

paper.title: Long Short-Term Memory

paper_figure.label: Figure 1 · PDF p.7
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: vanilla RNN 长依赖中梯度消失或爆炸
keypoints.核心想法: 用 cell state 和 input/forget/output gates 保留长期信息
keypoints.关键改进: 带近恒等记忆通路的门控循环更新
keypoints.医学适配: 长期用于小中型 ECG、EEG、EMG 与纵向临床序列
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 仍是低数据序列基线；串行训练慢且长窗口扩展有限

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Vanilla RNNs multiplied recurrent weight matrices repeatedly across time, causing gradients to vanish or explode over >20 steps.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Introduce a linear self-connected memory cell c_t regulated by multiplicative sigmoid input, forget, and output gates.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Additive cell-state highway enabling gradient propagation across hundreds of time steps.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Long-standing workhorse for 12-lead ECG arrhythmia classification, ICU vitals early-warning scores, and irregular EHR trajectories.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Reliable low-data sequential baseline; sequential step-by-step recurrence prevents parallel training across ultra-long multi-thousand-sample waveforms.

name: Temporal Convolutional Network (TCN)
summary: 以因果、指数扩张的 1D 卷积残差块并行覆盖长历史，而不使用循环状态。
summary_en: Stacks 1D causal convolutions with exponentially increasing dilation factors d = 2^l inside residual blocks to cover long historical receptive fields in parallel.

nodes.label: 序列 X
nodes.description: 形状为 time×channels；可按任务做因果或固定窗口输入
nodes.description_en: Ingests multi-channel continuous physiological time series x ∈ r^{c×t} and prepares initial tensor representations (sequence X).

nodes.label: 因果卷积
nodes.description: 左侧 padding 保证时刻 t 不读取未来样本
nodes.description_en: Executes Causal 1D Convolution to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: 扩张卷积
nodes.description: d=1,2,4… 的 1D kernel 指数扩大感受野
nodes.description_en: Performs Dilated 1D Convolution within the core causal dilated temporal convolution computation pathway.

nodes.label: 残差块
nodes.description: 两层 dilated Conv、非线性、dropout/weight norm 加 residual branch
nodes.description_en: Performs residual block within the core causal dilated temporal convolution computation pathway.

nodes.label: Residual / 1×1
nodes.description: 通道不同时用 1×1 projection，再与 block 输出相加
nodes.description_en: Performs Residual / 1×1 within the core causal dilated temporal convolution computation pathway.

nodes.label: 层级堆叠
nodes.description: 多个 dilation level 并行训练，覆盖固定的长历史窗口
nodes.description_en: Performs hierarchical within the core causal dilated temporal convolution computation pathway.

nodes.label: 有效感受野
nodes.description: 由 kernel、dilation 和层数预先确定；超出窗口的信息不可见
nodes.description_en: Performs receptive field within the core causal dilated temporal convolution computation pathway.

nodes.label: 任务头
nodes.description: 逐时刻 1×1 head 或全局 pooling 后分类/回归
nodes.description_en: Applies Task Head to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: 预测
nodes.description: 序列标签、分割或连续值
nodes.description_en: Produces causal step-wise sequence predictions or pooled episode classification via prediction.

paper.title: An Empirical Evaluation of Generic Convolutional and Recurrent Networks for Sequence Modeling

paper_figure.label: Figure 1 · PDF p.4
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: RNN 串行计算且有效记忆长度不稳定
keypoints.核心想法: 用 causal dilated 1D convolution 与 residual blocks 建模长序列
keypoints.关键改进: 并行卷积、指数扩张感受野和稳定残差优化
keypoints.医学适配: 成为 ECG/EEG 等生理信号强、便宜、稳定的 baseline
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 长期实用；感受野由 dilation/depth 固定且全局自适应关系有限

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Recurrent networks (LSTM/GRU) could not parallelize across time during training and exhibited unstable effective memory horizons.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Combine strict causal padding (no future leakage) with exponentially dilated 1D convolutions (d=1, 2, 4, 8…) and residual shortcuts.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Full temporal parallelization during training + exact, deterministic receptive field calculation R = 1 + Σ (k−1)·d_l + low streaming memory.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Highly competitive, fast, and stable baseline for continuous ECG, EEG seizure detection, PPG, and EMG envelope decoding.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Practical first-line waveform baseline; receptive field is fixed by network depth/dilation and weights remain static across inputs.

name: HeartBEiT
summary: 将标准版式 ECG 渲染为图像，以 BEiT 式离散 masked-patch prediction 预训练专用 ViT。
summary_en: Renders standard 12-lead ECG waveforms as 2D layout images and pretrains a Vision Transformer via BEiT-style discrete masked patch token prediction on 8.5 million ECGs.

nodes.label: 12 导联波形
nodes.description: 原始 ECG 被裁切、标度并排版为临床样式图像
nodes.description_en: Ingests standardized 2d image rendering of a 12-lead clinical electrocardiogram and prepares initial tensor representations (12).

nodes.label: ECG 渲染图
nodes.description: 模型实际输入是二维波形图，不是原始采样序列 token
nodes.description_en: Executes ECG to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: 图像 patches
nodes.description: 切分固定大小 patch 并线性嵌入为 ViT tokens
nodes.description_en: Performs patches within the core ecg image masked pretraining transformer computation pathway.

nodes.label: 随机遮挡
nodes.description: 大比例 patch 替换为 mask token，保留可见上下文
nodes.description_en: Performs masked within the core ecg image masked pretraining transformer computation pathway.

nodes.label: 离散视觉目标
nodes.description: BEiT-style tokenizer 为被遮挡 patch 提供离散 code targets
nodes.description_en: Performs discrete objective within the core ecg image masked pretraining transformer computation pathway.

nodes.label: HeartBEiT 编码器
nodes.description: Vision Transformer 从可见 ECG 形态建模跨导联与长程空间关系
nodes.description_en: Performs HeartBEiT encoder within the core ecg image masked pretraining transformer computation pathway.

nodes.label: 掩码预测头
nodes.description: 预训练时预测 masked patch 的离散 token
nodes.description_en: Performs masked prediction within the core ecg image masked pretraining transformer computation pathway.

nodes.label: 诊断微调头
nodes.description: 用全局 token/pooled representation 做多标签分类
nodes.description_en: Applies fine-tuning to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: 诊断输出
nodes.description: 节律、结构或其他 ECG 标签概率
nodes.description_en: Produces pretrained ecg vit representation for low-label arrhythmia, lvef, and stemi classification via output.

paper.title: A Foundational Vision Transformer Improves Diagnostic Performance for Electrocardiograms

paper_figure.label: Figure 1 · PDF p.2
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: ImageNet 初始化与小型监督模型难覆盖 ECG 形态及标签稀缺
keypoints.核心想法: 把 ECG 渲染为图像并用 BEiT 式 masked image modeling 进行大规模领域预训练
keypoints.关键改进: 在 850 万 ECG、210 万患者上做领域 masked pretraining
keypoints.医学适配: 提高 ECG 少标签迁移和外部分类表现
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 证明领域预训练价值；渲染、截断和缩放可能损失精确采样、幅值及采集元数据，并依赖固定版式

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Small supervised ECG models overfit single-center cohorts, while natural-image ViT weights did not capture fine QRS/ST-segment morphology.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Convert clinical 12-lead ECGs into standardized 2D visual plots and pretrain a ViT to reconstruct masked waveform patches via discrete visual tokens.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Large-scale in-domain masked pretraining across 8.5M ECGs from 2.1M patients, directly compatible with printed/scanned paper ECGs.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Improves label-efficient transfer for reduced LVEF screening, hypertrophic cardiomyopathy, and myocardial infarction detection.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Demonstrates the power of scale in ECG SSL; rasterizing 1D voltage time series into 2D pixels discards microvolt resolution and ties the model to a fixed plot layout.

name: LaBraM
summary: 以 VQ neural tokenizer 提供离散 EEG patch 目标，再用跨通道/时间 Transformer 做 masked code prediction。
summary_en: Trains a vector-quantized (VQ) neural spectrum tokenizer to predict Fourier amplitude/phase spectra of EEG patches, then pretrains a cross-channel Transformer via masked code prediction.

nodes.label: 多通道 EEG
nodes.description: 不同 montage、记录长度和采样条件的脑电序列
nodes.description_en: Ingests multi-channel continuous eeg recordings with arbitrary montage channel counts and recording lengths and prepares initial tensor representations (channel EEG).

nodes.label: 通道时间 patches
nodes.description: 每个通道沿时间切片并映射为 neural embeddings
nodes.description_en: Executes channel patches to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: 时空身份编码
nodes.description: 加入时间位置与电极/通道标识，保留 montage 结构
nodes.description_en: Performs Stage 03 within the core eeg masked neural token transformer computation pathway.

nodes.label: Neural tokenizer
nodes.description: 向量量化网络把连续 EEG patch 编成离散 neural codes
nodes.description_en: Performs Neural tokenizer within the core eeg masked neural token transformer computation pathway.

nodes.label: Masked patches
nodes.description: 遮挡部分 channel-time tokens，只给编码器可见上下文
nodes.description_en: Performs Masked patches within the core eeg masked neural token transformer computation pathway.

nodes.label: 大规模 Transformer
nodes.description: 在跨通道、跨时间 token 上做 self-attention
nodes.description_en: Performs Transformer within the core eeg masked neural token transformer computation pathway.

nodes.label: Code 预测头
nodes.description: 预测被遮挡位置的离散 tokenizer targets
nodes.description_en: Performs Code prediction within the core eeg masked neural token transformer computation pathway.

nodes.label: 下游任务头
nodes.description: 对预训练 tokens 做分类、检测或 BCI 解码
nodes.description_en: Applies Stage 08 to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: EEG 输出
nodes.description: 事件/状态标签或任务表征
nodes.description_en: Produces universal eeg representation transferable across seizure detection, sleep staging, emotion, and motor bci via EEG output.

paper.title: Large Brain Model for Learning Generic Representations with Tremendous EEG Data in BCI

paper_figure.label: Figure 1 · PDF p.3
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 电极数、记录长度和任务差异使一任务一模型难迁移
keypoints.核心想法: 以 channel patches、VQ neural tokenizer 和 masked code prediction 统一异质 EEG
keypoints.关键改进: 跨约 20 个数据集、约 2500 小时 EEG 预训练离散神经信号 tokenizer 与 Transformer
keypoints.医学适配: 支持 EEG 分类、检测和 BCI 的迁移与少样本学习
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 原论文在四类下游任务报告优势；跨设备、跨人群和独立临床验证仍不足

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: EEG datasets vary wildly in electrode montage (16 to 128 channels), sampling rates, and low SNR, preventing cross-dataset pretraining.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Segment each EEG channel into fixed-duration temporal patches, learn a discrete neural codebook predicting frequency amplitude/phase, and pretrain a Transformer with spatial+temporal embeddings via masked code prediction.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Spectrum-guided discrete neural tokenizer + factorized electrode-spatial and temporal embeddings unifying ~2,500 hours across 20 heterogeneous EEG cohorts.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Canonical foundation model for cross-montage EEG abnormality classification, event detection, and brain–computer interfaces.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Significant methodological leap for heterogeneous neurophysiology; clinical cross-hospital sensitivity and false-alarm calibration require ongoing validation.

name: VGG-16/19
summary: 以高度同质的 3×3 plain-convolution blocks 规律加深到 16/19 层，无残差连接。
summary_en: Homogeneous stacking of 3×3 plain convolutional blocks systematically deepened to 16–19 layers without residual shortcuts.

nodes.label: 输入图像
nodes.description: 经典配置为 224×224；医学任务可替换通道与尺寸
nodes.description_en: Ingests fixed-size rgb or 2d grayscale medical image and prepares initial tensor representations (Input Image).

nodes.label: Conv Block 1
nodes.description: 2×3×3 Conv-64 后 2×2 max-pool
nodes.description_en: Executes Conv Block 1 to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: Conv Block 2
nodes.description: 2×3×3 Conv-128 后 max-pool
nodes.description_en: Performs Conv Block 2 within the core deep plain small kernel cnn computation pathway.

nodes.label: Conv Block 3
