nodes.description: VGG-16 为 3 层、VGG-19 为 4 层 3×3 Conv-256
nodes.description_en: Performs Conv Block 3 within the core deep plain small kernel cnn computation pathway.

nodes.label: Conv Block 4
nodes.description: 3/4 层 3×3 Conv-512 后 max-pool
nodes.description_en: Performs Conv Block 4 within the core deep plain small kernel cnn computation pathway.

nodes.label: Conv Block 5
nodes.description: 3/4 层 3×3 Conv-512 后 max-pool
nodes.description_en: Performs Conv Block 5 within the core deep plain small kernel cnn computation pathway.

nodes.label: 全连接头
nodes.description: 两层 4096-unit FC+ReLU+dropout，再接分类层
nodes.description_en: Applies Fully Connected Head to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: 类别输出
nodes.description: softmax logits；卷积块也常被截取作 encoder/感知特征
nodes.description_en: Produces classification logits or multi-stage intermediate convolutional feature maps via Class Logits Output.

paper.title: Very Deep Convolutional Networks for Large-Scale Image Recognition

paper_figure.label: Table 1 · PDF p.3
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 早期 CNN 使用较大卷积核且结构异质，深度扩展规律不清
keypoints.核心想法: 用连续 3×3 卷积和周期性池化把网络规律地加深到 16/19 层
keypoints.关键改进: 以小卷积堆叠扩大有效感受野并形成可迁移的层级特征
keypoints.医学适配: 长期作为医学影像迁移学习、感知损失和编码器基线
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 历史主干与表征参照；参数量大、缺残差连接，现已少作首选

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Early CNNs relied on heterogeneous large kernels (11×11, 7×7) with unclear scaling rules for network depth.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Replace large kernels with homogeneous stacks of 3×3 convolutions interleaved with 2×2 max-pooling up to 16–19 weight layers.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Stacked 3×3 filters capture equivalent large receptive fields with fewer parameters and deeper non-linearities.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Widely used for early medical transfer learning, perceptual feature losses, and 2D encoder initialization.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Historical reference and perceptual loss extractor; heavy FC parameters and lack of residual paths limit modern primary use.

name: GoogLeNet / Inception-v1
summary: 在每个 Inception module 中并行执行 1×1、降维后 3×3/5×5 和 pooling 分支，再通道拼接。
summary_en: Parallel multi-scale branches (1×1, bottlenecked 3×3, 5×5 convolutions, and pooling) concatenated within each Inception module.

nodes.label: 卷积 Stem
nodes.description: 大步长卷积/池化先降低空间分辨率
nodes.description_en: Ingests 2d image tensor and prepares initial tensor representations (Convolutional Stem).

nodes.label: 1×1 分支
nodes.description: 直接 1×1 Conv 捕获通道组合
nodes.description_en: Executes 1×1 to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: 3×3 分支
nodes.description: 1×1 bottleneck 降维后接 3×3 Conv
nodes.description_en: Performs 3×3 within the core multibranch inception cnn computation pathway.

nodes.label: 5×5 分支
nodes.description: 1×1 bottleneck 后接 5×5 Conv，覆盖更大局部尺度
nodes.description_en: Performs 5×5 within the core multibranch inception cnn computation pathway.

nodes.label: Pooling 分支
nodes.description: 3×3 max-pool 后接 1×1 projection
nodes.description_en: Performs Pooling within the core multibranch inception cnn computation pathway.

nodes.label: 通道拼接
nodes.description: 将四个空间对齐分支沿 channel 维合并
nodes.description_en: Performs Channel Concatenation within the core multibranch inception cnn computation pathway.

nodes.label: Inception 堆叠
nodes.description: 多个模块与阶段间池化构成 22-layer 主干
nodes.description_en: Performs Inception within the core multibranch inception cnn computation pathway.

nodes.label: 辅助分类器
nodes.description: 训练时从中间层接 auxiliary heads 改善梯度与正则化
nodes.description_en: Performs Auxiliary Classifier within the core multibranch inception cnn computation pathway.

nodes.label: GAP 分类头
nodes.description: 全局平均池化、dropout、线性分类，替代大型 FC 堆叠
nodes.description_en: Applies GAP to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: 类别输出
nodes.description: 主分类 logits
nodes.description_en: Produces global classification logits and multi-scale intermediate representations via Class Logits Output.

paper.title: Going Deeper with Convolutions

paper_figure.label: Figure 2 · PDF p.4
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 单一路径卷积难同时覆盖多尺度，直接增加宽度计算昂贵
keypoints.核心想法: 在同一层并行组合 1×1、3×3、5×5 卷积和池化后拼接
keypoints.关键改进: 以 1×1 bottleneck 降维并用 Inception 模块高效聚合多尺度
keypoints.医学适配: 启发医学多尺度病灶检测和多分支 2D/3D 编码器
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 多尺度设计仍重要；原始模块已被更简洁的残差和层级结构取代

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Single-kernel convolutional layers struggled to capture multi-scale structures simultaneously, while naively widening layers exploded FLOPs.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Execute parallel 1×1, 3×3, 5×5 convolutions and pooling within each layer and concatenate their outputs channel-wise.
keypoints_en.关键改进: 1×1 bottleneck projections compress channel dimensions prior to expensive spatial kernels for efficient multi-scale aggregation.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Inspired multi-branch 2D/3D medical encoders and multi-scale lesion detection networks.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Multi-scale branching remains influential, though complex hand-tuned Inception topologies are largely superseded by residual/ConvNeXt blocks.

name: ResNeXt
summary: 在 residual bottleneck 中以 cardinality 控制的 grouped 3×3 convolution 聚合多个等拓扑变换。
summary_en: Aggregates multiple homogeneous residual branches via grouped 3×3 convolutions governed by a cardinality hyperparameter.

nodes.label: 输入 x
nodes.description: 当前 stage feature map
nodes.description_en: Ingests input image or preceding stage feature map and prepares initial tensor representations (input x).

nodes.label: 1×1 降维
nodes.description: 把通道映射到分组变换的 bottleneck 宽度
nodes.description_en: Executes 1×1 to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: 分组 3×3
nodes.description: cardinality C 个同拓扑分支，以 grouped convolution 高效实现
nodes.description_en: Performs Grouped 3×3 Conv within the core aggregated grouped residual cnn computation pathway.

nodes.label: 1×1 扩维
nodes.description: 融合分组输出并恢复 block 输出通道
nodes.description_en: Performs 1×1 within the core aggregated grouped residual cnn computation pathway.

nodes.label: Identity / 投影
nodes.description: 尺寸相同时直连，stage 切换时用 projection shortcut
nodes.description_en: Performs Identity / projection within the core aggregated grouped residual cnn computation pathway.

nodes.label: 残差相加
nodes.description: y=shortcut(x)+Σ_i T_i(x)
nodes.description_en: Performs Residual Addition within the core aggregated grouped residual cnn computation pathway.

nodes.label: 层级堆叠
nodes.description: 在多个空间尺度重复 aggregated residual blocks
nodes.description_en: Applies hierarchical to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: GAP / 任务头
nodes.description: 全局分类或作为检测、分割 encoder 输出
nodes.description_en: Produces grouped aggregated residual representations and downstream task predictions via GAP.

paper.title: Aggregated Residual Transformations for Deep Neural Networks

paper_figure.label: Figure 3 · PDF p.4
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 仅靠加深或加宽网络的计算收益递减且设计空间复杂
keypoints.核心想法: 在残差块中并行聚合等拓扑分支，以 cardinality 控制表示容量
keypoints.关键改进: 引入 grouped convolution 实现可扩展的 split-transform-merge
keypoints.医学适配: 常用于 2D/3D 医学分类、检测和分割编码器
keypoints.适用范围与证据: grouped convolution 已成现代 CNN 基础构件；原始主干不是当前唯一强基线

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Scaling depth or width alone yielded diminishing returns and required intricate per-branch hyperparameter tuning.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Aggregate C parallel identical-topology transformations inside a residual bottleneck, introducing cardinality C as a third scaling axis.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Formulates split–transform–merge cleanly as grouped convolution with minimal engineering overhead.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Frequently adopted in 2D/3D medical classification, nodule detection, and volumetric encoder backbones.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Grouped/depthwise convolution is now a permanent staple of modern CNNs.

name: SENet
summary: 全局平均池化 squeeze 后经 bottleneck MLP 产生每通道 sigmoid 门，对卷积特征逐通道重标定。
summary_en: Global average pooling (Squeeze) followed by a lightweight bottleneck MLP (Excitation) producing per-channel sigmoid gates.

nodes.label: 特征 X
nodes.description: 任意主干 block 产生的 H×W×C 特征
nodes.description_en: Ingests multi-channel convolutional feature tensor x and prepares initial tensor representations (feature X).

nodes.label: 主变换 F
nodes.description: ResNet/Inception 等原有卷积变换得到 U
nodes.description_en: Executes Stage 02 to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: Squeeze
nodes.description: 对 U 每通道做 global average pooling 得到 z∈R^C
nodes.description_en: Performs Squeeze within the core channel recalibration cnn computation pathway.

nodes.label: FC 降维
nodes.description: W1 z 后 ReLU，按 reduction ratio 压缩通道描述
nodes.description_en: Performs FC within the core channel recalibration cnn computation pathway.

nodes.label: FC+Sigmoid
nodes.description: W2 恢复 C 维并输出 0–1 通道门 s
nodes.description_en: Performs FC+Sigmoid within the core channel recalibration cnn computation pathway.

nodes.label: 通道缩放
nodes.description: U_hat_c=s_c·U_c，对整张 feature map 逐通道重标定
nodes.description_en: Performs Channel Scaling within the core channel recalibration cnn computation pathway.

nodes.label: 残差合并
nodes.description: 在 SE-ResNet 中将 U_hat 与 shortcut 相加
nodes.description_en: Applies residual to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: 任务输出
nodes.description: 进入后续 stage 或分类/分割头
nodes.description_en: Produces input-adaptively channel-recalibrated feature tensor or classification output via Task Output.

paper.title: Squeeze-and-Excitation Networks

paper_figure.label: Figure 1 · PDF p.2
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 普通卷积隐式混合通道，缺少输入自适应的通道选择
keypoints.核心想法: 全局汇聚通道统计后用小型门控网络重标定各通道响应
keypoints.关键改进: 以极低开销显式建模通道依赖并可插入任意主干
keypoints.医学适配: 广泛用于器官分割、病灶分类和多模态通道融合
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 通道注意力经典模块；解释性有限，空间定位仍需其他机制

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Standard convolutions fuse channels with fixed learned weights, lacking global content-aware channel selection.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Squeeze global spatial statistics per channel and excite a small gating MLP to dynamically recalibrate channel responses.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Models inter-channel dependencies explicitly at negligible parameter and compute overhead; plug-and-play across backbones.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Ubiquitous across medical organ segmentation, lesion classification, and multi-sequence MRI channel fusion.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Canonical channel-attention module; provides global channel weighting rather than spatial localization.

name: EfficientNet
summary: 以 NAS 设计的 MBConv+SE 基线配合 depth/width/resolution 三维 compound scaling。
summary_en: NAS-discovered MBConv+SE baseline scaled jointly across depth, width, and input resolution via a compound coefficient φ.

nodes.label: 复合缩放
nodes.description: depth=alpha^phi、width=beta^phi、resolution=gamma^phi，并满足近似计算约束
nodes.description_en: Ingests 2d image scaled according to compound coefficient φ and prepares initial tensor representations (Compound Scaling).

nodes.label: 输入图像
nodes.description: 分辨率随 B0→B7 同步扩大
nodes.description_en: Executes Input Image to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: 卷积 Stem
nodes.description: 3×3 stride-2 Conv 建立浅层特征
nodes.description_en: Performs Convolutional Stem within the core compound scaled mbconv cnn computation pathway.

nodes.label: Block 输入
nodes.description: 前一 MBConv 的输出；identity shortcut 从这里绕过主变换
nodes.description_en: Performs Block input within the core compound scaled mbconv cnn computation pathway.

nodes.label: MBConv 扩维
nodes.description: 1×1 expansion 形成高维 inverted bottleneck；首类 MBConv1 可不扩维
nodes.description_en: Performs MBConv within the core compound scaled mbconv cnn computation pathway.

nodes.label: Depthwise Conv
nodes.description: 3×3/5×5 逐通道空间卷积，stride 控制 stage 下采样
nodes.description_en: Performs Depthwise Conv within the core compound scaled mbconv cnn computation pathway.

nodes.label: SE 门控
nodes.description: global pooling 与小 MLP 对 expanded channels 重标定
nodes.description_en: Performs SE within the core compound scaled mbconv cnn computation pathway.

nodes.label: 线性投影
nodes.description: 1×1 project 回低维；尺寸相同时接 identity skip 与 stochastic depth
nodes.description_en: Performs projection within the core compound scaled mbconv cnn computation pathway.

nodes.label: NAS-B0 Stages
nodes.description: 按搜索得到的 kernel、扩张率、通道和重复数堆叠 MBConv
nodes.description_en: Applies NAS-B0 Stages to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: GAP 分类头
nodes.description: 1×1 head、global average pooling、dropout 与 FC
nodes.description_en: Produces compute-efficient classification logits or multi-scale feature pyramid via GAP.

paper.title: EfficientNet: Rethinking Model Scaling for Convolutional Neural Networks

paper_figure.label: Table 1 · PDF p.5
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 任意单独加深、加宽或提高分辨率常造成计算失衡
keypoints.核心想法: 用复合系数联合缩放网络深度、宽度和输入分辨率
keypoints.关键改进: 以 NAS 获得 B0 基线，并系统研究、经验确定 compound scaling 系数
keypoints.医学适配: 后续被用于算力受限的医学分类、超声和移动端筛查
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 仍是效率基线；高分辨率 3D 医学任务的内存瓶颈需另行处理

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Scaling network depth, width, or image resolution in isolation rapidly saturates accuracy and wastes FLOPs.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Couple depth (α^φ), width (β^φ), and resolution (γ^φ) under a unified compound scaling constraint.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Combines MobileInvertedBottleneck (MBConv + SE) with empirically calibrated compound scaling laws.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Widely deployed in resource-constrained 2D medical classification, point-of-care ultrasound, and dermatology/fundus screening.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Strong 2D efficiency baseline; depthwise separable kernels and high resolution require separate activation-memory audits in 3D.

name: U-Net++
summary: 以 X_i,j 嵌套稠密卷积节点重写 U-Net 跳连，并从多个顶层节点施加深监督。
summary_en: Rewrites U-Net skip pathways as a dense nested grid of intermediate convolutional nodes X_{i,j} with multi-depth deep supervision.

nodes.label: 输入图像
nodes.description: 进入多尺度卷积 encoder
nodes.description_en: Ingests 2d or 3d medical image and prepares initial tensor representations (Input Image).

nodes.label: X_i,0 编码器
nodes.description: 沿 i 增大逐级下采样，形成不同语义深度的特征
nodes.description_en: Executes X_i,0 encoder to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: 上采样邻级
nodes.description: 将 X_{i+1,j-1} 上采样到第 i 层分辨率
nodes.description_en: Performs upsampling within the core nested dense skip unet computation pathway.

nodes.label: 嵌套节点 X_i,j
nodes.description_en: Performs X_i,j within the core nested dense skip unet computation pathway.

nodes.label: Dense skip 路径
nodes.description: 同分辨率早期节点全部拼接，逐步缩小 encoder/decoder 语义差
nodes.description_en: Performs Dense skip within the core nested dense skip unet computation pathway.

nodes.label: 嵌套 U 网格
nodes.description: 不同 j 构成由浅到深的多个可用 U-Net 子网络
nodes.description_en: Performs U mesh within the core nested dense skip unet computation pathway.

nodes.label: 深监督 heads
nodes.description: 从 X_0,1…X_0,J 接多个 segmentation heads 联合训练
nodes.description_en: Applies deep supervision heads to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: 分割输出
nodes.description: 平均多头或剪枝后选定一个深度 head
nodes.description_en: Produces deeply supervised ensemble or depth-pruned segmentation probability map via Segmentation Output.

paper.title: UNet++: Redesigning Skip Connections to Exploit Multiscale Features in Image Segmentation

paper_figure.label: Figure 1 · PDF p.2
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 原始 U-Net 直接拼接低层与高层特征，语义不匹配且多尺度融合粗糙
keypoints.核心想法: 以嵌套稠密跳连和深监督逐步缩小 encoder 与 decoder 特征语义差距
keypoints.关键改进: 在跳连路径中引入中间卷积节点并支持可剪枝的多深度输出
keypoints.医学适配: 常用于器官、息肉、细胞和小病灶分割
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 医学分割经典变体；复杂跳连的增益需与 nnU-Net 等强基线公平比较

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Standard U-Net directly concatenates raw shallow encoder features with high-level decoder features across a large semantic gap.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Bridge the encoder–decoder semantic gap via dense intermediate convolutional skip pathways and multi-scale deep supervision.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Nested dense skip nodes X_{i,j} progressively fuse multi-scale features and support inference-time model pruning.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Widely used in polyp, nuclei, liver, and small-lesion medical segmentation studies.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Classic U-Net skip variant; practical gains must always be verified against a properly configured nnU-Net baseline.

name: Attention U-Net
summary: 由粗尺度 decoder gating signal 计算空间 attention coefficients，在拼接前逐位置筛选 encoder skip。
summary_en: Computes spatial soft-attention coefficients α ∈ [0,1] from coarse decoder gating signals to filter encoder skips prior to concatenation.

nodes.label: 输入图像
nodes.description: 进入标准 U-Net encoder
nodes.description_en: Ingests 2d or 3d medical image and prepares initial tensor representations (Input Image).

nodes.label: Encoder skip x_l
nodes.description: 高分辨率浅层特征，含目标边界与大量背景
nodes.description_en: Executes Encoder skip x_l to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: Decoder gate g
nodes.description: 较粗尺度深层语义信号，为注意力提供目标上下文
nodes.description_en: Performs Decoder gate g within the core gated skip unet computation pathway.

nodes.label: 加性注意力
nodes.description: 1×1 投影 x_l 与 g，对齐后相加、ReLU，再经 psi 计算 logits
nodes.description_en: Performs attention within the core gated skip unet computation pathway.

nodes.label: 空间系数 alpha
nodes.description: sigmoid 得到逐位置软门，通常在通道间共享
nodes.description_en: Performs spatial alpha within the core gated skip unet computation pathway.

nodes.label: 门控 skip
nodes.description: x_hat_l=alpha⊙x_l，抑制与目标无关的背景响应
nodes.description_en: Performs skip within the core gated skip unet computation pathway.

nodes.label: Decoder 融合
nodes.description: 将 gated skip 与上采样 decoder feature 拼接并卷积
nodes.description_en: Applies Decoder fusion to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: 分割输出
nodes.description: 全分辨率类别概率图
nodes.description_en: Produces segmentation map decoded from spatially gated skip connections via Segmentation Output.

paper.title: Attention U-Net: Learning Where to Look for the Pancreas

paper_figure.label: Figure 1 · PDF p.3
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: U-Net 跳连把大量背景细节无差别传给 decoder，小器官易被淹没
keypoints.核心想法: 用 decoder gating 信号对 skip 特征做空间注意力筛选
keypoints.关键改进: 在不额外裁剪 ROI 的情况下突出与目标相关的局部区域
keypoints.医学适配: 广泛用于小器官和病灶分割以及级联定位
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 注意力门控仍实用；提升通常依赖数据、损失和基线配置

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Unfiltered U-Net skip connections pass cluttered background activations to the decoder, degrading small-organ false-positive rates.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Gate high-resolution encoder skip features spatially using contextual gating signals from the coarser decoder stage.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Lightweight additive attention gates suppress irrelevant background regions without requiring explicit two-stage ROI localization.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Frequently integrated into pancreas, small-lesion, and multi-organ segmentation networks.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Practical and lightweight spatial gating module, though improvements depend heavily on loss and pipeline setup.

name: H-DenseUNet
summary: 先以 2D DenseUNet 学切片内细节，再将特征堆叠进 3D DenseUNet，并通过 hybrid feature fusion 联合预测。
summary_en: Extracts intra-slice features via a 2D DenseUNet, stacks them into a 3D DenseUNet, and fuses both via a hybrid feature fusion (HFF) layer.

nodes.label: CT 体
nodes.description: 按轴位切片供 2D 分支，同时保留 3D 体坐标
nodes.description_en: Ingests high-resolution volumetric abdominal ct scan and prepares initial tensor representations (CT).

nodes.label: 2D DenseUNet
nodes.description: 逐切片 dense blocks+U-shaped decoder 提取高分辨率平面纹理
nodes.description_en: Executes 2D DenseUNet to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: 2D 先验特征
nodes.description: 切片预测/特征保留细粒度边界与纹理
nodes.description_en: Performs 2D prior feature within the core hybrid 2d 3d dense unet computation pathway.

nodes.label: 2D→3D 堆叠
nodes.description: 将对应切片特征重排为与体数据对齐的 3D feature volume
nodes.description_en: Performs 2D→3D within the core hybrid 2d 3d dense unet computation pathway.

nodes.label: 3D DenseUNet
nodes.description: 在较受控容量下用 3D dense blocks 学跨切片上下文
nodes.description_en: Performs 3D DenseUNet within the core hybrid 2d 3d dense unet computation pathway.

nodes.label: Hybrid Feature Fusion
nodes.description: 融合 2D intra-slice 与 3D inter-slice 特征并支持联合优化
nodes.description_en: Performs Hybrid Feature Fusion within the core hybrid 2d 3d dense unet computation pathway.

nodes.label: 3D 分割头
nodes.description: 1×1×1 卷积映射到肝脏/肿瘤类别 logits
nodes.description_en: Applies 3D to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: 概率体
nodes.description: 完整体素级 segmentation mask
nodes.description_en: Produces 3d volumetric liver and tumor segmentation probability volume via Stage 08.

paper.title: H-DenseUNet: Hybrid Densely Connected UNet for Liver and Tumor Segmentation From CT Volumes

paper_figure.label: Figure 2 · PDF p.4
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 纯 2D 缺跨切片信息，纯 3D 在高分辨率 CT 上显存和数据需求过高
keypoints.核心想法: 先以 2D DenseUNet 提取丰富切片内特征，再用 3D DenseUNet 融合体上下文
keypoints.关键改进: 混合 2D/3D 稠密连接在计算可控下同时建模纹理与体结构
keypoints.医学适配: 是 Dense U-Net 系列在肝脏与肿瘤 3D 分割中的代表
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 历史强基线；现代 patch-based 3D 与自动配置框架通常更易复现

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Pure 2D networks miss z-axis continuity, whereas pure 3D networks cannot fit deep high-resolution encoders in GPU memory.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Cascade a deep 2D DenseUNet for high-resolution in-plane representation with a 3D DenseUNet for volumetric context.
keypoints_en.关键改进: End-to-end joint Hybrid Feature Fusion (HFF) reconciling 2D transferability with 3D volumetric continuity.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Landmark hybrid 2.5D/3D architecture for volumetric CT liver and tumor segmentation.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Historically strong hybrid design; modern patch-based 3D nnU-Net and MedNeXt pipelines offer simpler reproducibility.

name: DeiT
summary: 增加 distillation token 和专用 head，使 CNN teacher 信号通过 Transformer attention 注入 ViT。
summary_en: Augments ViT with a learnable distillation token that interacts with patch tokens via self-attention to distill inductive biases from a CNN teacher.

nodes.label: 输入图像
nodes.description: 经强增强与常规 ImageNet 规模监督训练
nodes.description_en: Ingests 2d image (plus cnn teacher hard predictions during training) and prepares initial tensor representations (Input Image).

nodes.label: Patch tokens
nodes.description: 固定大小 image patches 线性投影并加位置编码
nodes.description_en: Executes Patch tokens to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: CLS + Distill
nodes.description: 两个可学习 token 分别服务真实标签与 teacher 蒸馏
nodes.description_en: Performs CLS + Distill within the core distilled data efficient vit computation pathway.

nodes.label: ViT Encoder
nodes.description: 多层 MHSA+MLP 共同更新 patch、class 和 distillation tokens
nodes.description_en: Performs ViT Encoder within the core distilled data efficient vit computation pathway.

nodes.label: CNN Teacher
nodes.description: 训练时提供 hard/soft teacher target，不进入部署主干
nodes.description_en: Performs CNN Teacher within the core distilled data efficient vit computation pathway.

nodes.label: Class head
nodes.description: CLS token 对真实类别标签优化
nodes.description_en: Performs Class head within the core distilled data efficient vit computation pathway.

nodes.label: Distill head
nodes.description: distillation token 对 teacher 预测优化
nodes.description_en: Performs Distill head within the core distilled data efficient vit computation pathway.

nodes.label: 双头融合
nodes.description: 推理时通常平均 class 与 distillation head 预测
nodes.description_en: Applies fusion to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: 类别输出
nodes.description: 最终分类 logits/probabilities
nodes.description_en: Produces fused class-token and distillation-token classification prediction via Class Logits Output.

paper.title: Training Data-Efficient Image Transformers & Distillation through Attention

paper_figure.label: Figure 2 · PDF p.4
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 原始 ViT 依赖超大私有数据，常规数据规模下训练不稳
keypoints.核心想法: 用强增强、正则化和蒸馏 token 在 ImageNet 上高效训练 ViT
keypoints.关键改进: 把 CNN 教师知识通过 attention distillation 注入 Transformer
keypoints.医学适配: 降低医学 ViT 从头训练或小数据微调的门槛
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 训练 recipe 影响巨大；医学域仍需领域预训练与严格外部验证

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Original ViT required hundreds of millions of proprietary images (JFT-300M) and failed to generalize when trained on medium-sized datasets.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Combine aggressive data augmentation/regularization with a dedicated distillation token that learns from a convnet teacher.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Attention-based token distillation (distinct from logit averaging) + RandAugment, Mixup, CutMix, and Stochastic Depth recipe.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Lowered the barrier for training and fine-tuning Vision Transformers on moderate-sized medical imaging cohorts.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Established standard ViT training recipes; in-domain medical SSL pretraining still outperforms purely supervised recipes.

name: PVT
summary: 以逐级降低 token 分辨率的 Transformer pyramid 和 spatial-reduction attention 提供多尺度 dense-prediction backbone。
summary_en: Constructs a progressive four-stage token pyramid using Spatial-Reduction Attention (SRA) to compress K/V resolution before attention.

nodes.label: 输入图像
nodes.description: 高分辨率输入，目标是替代 CNN feature pyramid
nodes.description_en: Ingests high-resolution 2d image and prepares initial tensor representations (Input Image).

nodes.label: Stage-1 patches
nodes.description: 非重叠 patch embedding 生成最高分辨率 token map
nodes.description_en: Executes Stage-1 patches to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: SRA
nodes.description: Spatial-Reduction Attention 在计算 K/V 前按比例下采样 token，Q 保持原分辨率
nodes.description_en: Performs SRA within the core pyramidal spatial reduction transformer computation pathway.

nodes.label: Transformer block
nodes.description: SRA、MLP、LayerNorm 与 residual 组成各 stage 编码块
nodes.description_en: Performs Transformer block within the core pyramidal spatial reduction transformer computation pathway.

nodes.label: Patch 下采样
nodes.description: 阶段间重排/嵌入降低 H×W、增加 channel，形成金字塔
nodes.description_en: Performs Patch downsampling within the core pyramidal spatial reduction transformer computation pathway.

nodes.label: 四级特征
nodes.description: 输出 {F1,F2,F3,F4}，空间分辨率逐级降低
nodes.description_en: Performs feature within the core pyramidal spatial reduction transformer computation pathway.

nodes.label: 任务头
nodes.description: 分类 head 或 FPN/检测/分割 decoder 消费多尺度特征
nodes.description_en: Applies Task Head to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: 预测
nodes.description: 分类或密集输出
nodes.description_en: Produces four-stage multi-scale feature pyramid (1/4 to 1/32 stride) for detection and segmentation via prediction.

paper.title: Pyramid Vision Transformer: A Versatile Backbone for Dense Prediction without Convolutions

paper_figure.label: Figure 3 · PDF p.4
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 平坦 ViT 保持固定 token 尺度，密集预测计算高且缺多尺度层级
keypoints.核心想法: 逐级降低 token 分辨率并增加通道，形成 Transformer 金字塔
keypoints.关键改进: 用 spatial-reduction attention 高效构建可替换 CNN 的层级主干
keypoints.医学适配: 适配医学检测、分割和高分辨率病理特征金字塔
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 奠定层级视觉 Transformer；后续 Swin、MiT 等结构更常用

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Columnar ViTs output single-scale low-resolution feature maps unsuitable for FPN/U-Net style dense prediction.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Progressively shrink patch stride across four stages while spatially downsampling Key and Value tensors inside self-attention.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Pyramid token shrinking + Spatial-Reduction Attention (SRA) reducing attention memory and compute on high-resolution grids.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Frequently used as a drop-in hierarchical Transformer encoder for polyp, skin lesion, and ultrasound segmentation.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Pioneered pyramid Vision Transformers; often succeeded by Swin or SegFormer (MiT) in recent pipelines.

name: SegFormer
summary: 层级 MiT 编码器结合 overlap patch、K/V 缩减 attention 与含 depthwise Conv 的 Mix-FFN，再接全 MLP 轻量 decoder。
summary_en: Hierarchical Mix Transformer (MiT) encoder with overlapping patches, sequence-reduced attention, and 3×3 depthwise Mix-FFN paired with an all-MLP decoder.

nodes.label: 输入图像
nodes.description: 无需固定绝对位置编码尺寸
nodes.description_en: Ingests 2d image of arbitrary test resolution and prepares initial tensor representations (Input Image).

nodes.label: Overlap Patch
nodes.description: 带重叠的卷积式 patch embedding 保留局部连续性并逐级下采样
nodes.description_en: Executes Overlap Patch to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: Efficient Attention
nodes.description: 按 reduction ratio 压缩 K/V token 数，Q 保持当前 stage 分辨率
nodes.description_en: Performs Efficient Attention within the core hierarchical mit mlp segmentation computation pathway.

nodes.label: Mix-FFN
nodes.description: MLP 中插入 3×3 depthwise Conv，引入局部位置偏置而不需显式位置编码
nodes.description_en: Performs Mix-FFN within the core hierarchical mit mlp segmentation computation pathway.

nodes.label: MiT 四级编码器
nodes.description: 重复 overlap embedding、efficient attention 与 Mix-FFN，通道递增
nodes.description_en: Performs MiT encoder within the core hierarchical mit mlp segmentation computation pathway.

nodes.label: 多尺度 F1–F4
nodes.description: 从高分辨边界到低分辨语义的四级特征
nodes.description_en: Performs multi-scale F1–F4 within the core hierarchical mit mlp segmentation computation pathway.

nodes.label: MLP 投影
nodes.description: 各尺度独立线性投影到共同通道数并上采样到同一分辨率
nodes.description_en: Performs MLP projection within the core hierarchical mit mlp segmentation computation pathway.

nodes.label: 轻量融合头
nodes.description: concat 后用 MLP/1×1 Conv 融合，接 dropout 与分类层
nodes.description_en: Applies fusion to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: 分割图
nodes.description: 上采样到输入大小的类别 logits/probabilities
nodes.description_en: Produces full-resolution semantic segmentation probability map via Segmentation Map.

paper.title: SegFormer: Simple and Efficient Design for Semantic Segmentation with Transformers

paper_figure.label: Figure 2 · PDF p.3
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: Transformer 分割器常依赖重型 decoder 与固定位置编码，跨分辨率泛化受限
keypoints.核心想法: MiT 层级编码器结合轻量全 MLP decoder 融合多尺度特征
keypoints.关键改进: overlap patch embedding、efficient attention 和简洁解码器兼顾精度与效率
keypoints.医学适配: 常作为 2D 医学分割、内镜和病理的 Transformer 基线
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 强通用密集预测基线；3D 体数据仍需专门内存设计

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Early Transformer segmenters relied on heavy decoders and fixed interpolated positional embeddings that degraded across resolutions.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Pair a hierarchical multi-scale Transformer encoder (using 3×3 depthwise convolutions for positional cues) with a lightweight all-MLP decoder.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Overlapping patch merging, spatial-reduction self-attention, Mix-FFN without fixed positional encodings, and MLP multi-scale fusion.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Popular lightweight Transformer baseline for 2D endoscopy, dermatology, ultrasound, and histopathology segmentation.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Strong 2D dense-prediction baseline; extending sequence-reduced attention to 3D still requires careful memory engineering.

name: BEiT
summary: BEiT 的辨识点是预测外部 tokenizer 产生的离散视觉码，而非 MAE 式像素重建或普通对比学习。
summary_en: Pretrains Vision Transformers via BERT-style Masked Image Modeling by predicting discrete visual tokens generated by an external dVAE tokenizer.

nodes.label: 原始图像
nodes.description: 同一图像同时产生学生输入和离散监督目标
nodes.description_en: Ingests raw image (for dvae tokenizer) + block-wise masked patch sequence (for vit encoder) and prepares initial tensor representations (Stage 01).

nodes.label: 离散视觉 tokenizer
nodes.description: 预训练 dVAE 将图像 patch 映射为视觉词表索引，训练 BEiT 时固定
nodes.description_en: Executes discrete tokenizer to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: Patch embedding 与 mask
nodes.description: 图像切块并用可学习 mask token 替换随机位置
nodes.description_en: Performs Patch embedding mask within the core discrete visual token mim computation pathway.

nodes.label: BEiT Transformer encoder
nodes.description: 对可见 patch 与 mask token 做全局上下文建模
nodes.description_en: Performs BEiT Transformer encoder within the core discrete visual token mim computation pathway.

nodes.label: Masked-token head
nodes.description: 仅在被遮挡位置预测视觉词表概率
nodes.description_en: Performs Masked-token head within the core discrete visual token mim computation pathway.

nodes.label: 离散 token 交叉熵
nodes.description: 预测分布与 tokenizer 给出的码索引对齐
nodes.description_en: Applies discrete token to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: 预训练视觉表示
nodes.description: 丢弃预测头后供分类、检测或分割微调
nodes.description_en: Produces categorical distribution over discrete visual codes at masked positions; transferable vit backbone via pretraining.

paper.title: BEiT: BERT Pre-Training of Image Transformers

paper_figure.label: Figure 1 · PDF p.2
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 监督预训练依赖标签，早期图像 SSL 难直接复用 BERT 的 masked objective
keypoints.核心想法: 把图像 patch 映射为离散视觉 token，随机遮挡后预测 tokenizer 码
keypoints.关键改进: 以离散 VAE token 作为视觉词表实现 masked image modeling
keypoints.医学适配: 启发 HeartBEiT 与医学 ViT 的 masked image modeling 预训练
keypoints.适用范围与证据: MIM 关键里程碑；tokenizer 偏差和预训练数据覆盖仍决定上限

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Directly regressing raw RGB pixel values in BERT-style masked pretraining wasted model capacity on high-frequency local noise.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Quantize image patches into discrete visual tokens via a discrete VAE, then train a ViT to predict the hidden token IDs of masked patches.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Decouples continuous pixel array into a continuous patch embedding input view and a discrete semantic token target view.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Directly inspired HeartBEiT (12-lead ECG) and LaBraM (neural VQ tokenizer for EEG) biomedical foundation pretraining.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Pioneering MIM milestone; offline tokenizer training is often simplified by MAE pixel regression or iBOT online teachers.

name: BYOL
summary: 没有负样本队列或聚类码本，核心稳定器是 stop-gradient、EMA 教师和仅在线侧存在的 predictor。
summary_en: Negative-free self-supervised representation learning stabilized by an asymmetric online predictor MLP, stop-gradient, and an EMA target encoder.

nodes.label: 双增强视图
nodes.description: 裁剪、颜色扰动、模糊等产生 v1 与 v2
nodes.description_en: Ingests two differently augmented views (v, v') of the same image and prepares initial tensor representations (Stage 01).

nodes.label: 在线 encoder
nodes.description: 可训练主干提取当前视图表示
nodes.description_en: Executes encoder to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: 在线 projector
nodes.description: 把 backbone 表示映射到自监督空间
nodes.description_en: Performs projector within the core negative free ema self distillation computation pathway.

nodes.label: 非对称 predictor
nodes.description: 仅在线分支存在，预测目标分支投影
nodes.description_en: Performs symmetric predictor within the core negative free ema self distillation computation pathway.

nodes.label: 目标 encoder + projector
nodes.description: 参数由在线分支指数滑动平均更新，不接收梯度
nodes.description_en: Performs objective encoder + projector within the core negative free ema self distillation computation pathway.

nodes.label: Stop-gradient target
nodes.description: 目标表示归一化后作为固定回归靶
nodes.description_en: Performs Stop-gradient target within the core negative free ema self distillation computation pathway.

nodes.label: 对称余弦回归损失
nodes.description: v1 预测 v2 与 v2 预测 v1 两个方向求和
nodes.description_en: Applies symmetric loss to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: 迁移表示
nodes.description: 下游只使用在线 encoder
nodes.description_en: Produces augmentation-invariant representation from the online encoder f_θ via Stage 08.

paper.title: Bootstrap Your Own Latent: A New Approach to Self-Supervised Learning

paper_figure.label: Figure 2 · PDF p.4
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 对比学习依赖大批量负样本，假负例可能破坏语义
keypoints.核心想法: 在线网络预测目标网络的增强视图表示，目标参数用指数滑动平均更新
keypoints.关键改进: 在无显式负样本下，以不对称预测器和 EMA 教师经验上避免坍塌；其机制有多种理论解释
keypoints.医学适配: 适合无标签医学图像预训练和跨增强一致性学习
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 非对比 SSL 经典方法；增强策略与域内多样性对医学迁移至关重要

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Contrastive methods were sensitive to negative sample batch sizes and false-negative collisions among clinically similar scans.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Train an online network (with an extra predictor head) to regress the stop-gradient representation of a momentum-updated target network.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Eliminates explicit negative pairs entirely while avoiding representation collapse via architectural asymmetry and EMA dynamics.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Widely used for unlabeled chest X-ray, fundus, and histopathology pretraining where same-disease negatives are prevalent.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Classic non-contrastive SSL framework; requires careful normalization and domain-valid augmentations.

name: SwAV
summary: 以在线平衡原型分配作为跨视图预测目标，区别于 BYOL 的 EMA 表示回归和 SimCLR 的实例负样本。
summary_en: Replaces pairwise instance comparisons with online Sinkhorn-Knopp balanced prototype cluster assignment and swapped cross-view prediction.

nodes.label: Multi-crop views
nodes.description: 高分辨率全局视图配合低分辨率局部视图扩大上下文组合
nodes.description_en: Ingests 2 global high-resolution views + m small local crops of the same image and prepares initial tensor representations (Multi-crop views).

nodes.label: 共享 ConvNet encoder
nodes.description: 各视图共享 ResNet 等主干
nodes.description_en: Executes ConvNet encoder to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: 投影与 L2 归一化
nodes.description: 得到适合原型匹配的单位向量
nodes.description_en: Performs projection L2 normalization within the core online prototype swapped clustering computation pathway.

nodes.label: 可学习 prototypes
nodes.description: 特征与原型点积形成聚类 logits
nodes.description_en: Performs prototypes within the core online prototype swapped clustering computation pathway.

nodes.label: Sinkhorn-Knopp 分配
nodes.description: 对全局视图求近似均衡的在线软聚类码
nodes.description_en: Performs Sinkhorn-Knopp within the core online prototype swapped clustering computation pathway.

nodes.label: Swapped prediction loss
nodes.description: 一视图预测另一视图的 prototype 分配
nodes.description_en: Applies Swapped prediction loss to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: 预训练表示
nodes.description: 下游复用共享 encoder
nodes.description_en: Produces transferable visual backbone and online learnable prototype codebook via pretraining.

paper.title: Unsupervised Learning of Visual Features by Contrasting Cluster Assignments

paper_figure.label: Figure 1 · PDF p.4
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 实例级对比需要大量负样本且把语义相近图像当作负例
keypoints.核心想法: 让不同增强视图预测彼此的在线 prototype 聚类分配
keypoints.关键改进: 用 balanced online clustering 与 multi-crop 训练学习可扩展表征
keypoints.医学适配: 可用于大规模病理 patch 和放射影像无标签预训练
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 聚类式 SSL 重要路线；prototype 数量与采样偏差需谨慎控制

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Instance discrimination treated every distinct image as a negative, ignoring shared semantic clusters and scaling poorly.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Compute online soft cluster assignments over learnable prototypes using Sinkhorn-Knopp equipartition and predict view A's code from view B.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Online balanced clustering + multi-crop augmentation strategy enabling memory-efficient small-batch SSL training.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Applied to large-scale unlabeled histopathology patch clustering and radiographic representation learning.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Foundational clustering-based SSL method; multi-crop strategy became standard in DINO and DINOv2.

name: ALIGN
summary: ALIGN 的主要贡献不是新交互模块，而是简单 EfficientNet/BERT 双塔在十亿级未精洗图文对上的规模化训练。
summary_en: Demonstrates that a simple EfficientNet + BERT dual encoder trained on over one billion noisy web image–alt-text pairs learns robust cross-modal representations.

nodes.label: 网页图像
nodes.description: 弱监督图像侧输入
nodes.description_en: Ingests web image + minimally filtered raw alt-text description and prepares initial tensor representations (Stage 01).

nodes.label: 噪声 alt-text
nodes.description: 大规模但存在错配、缺漏与模板噪声
nodes.description_en: Executes noise alt-text to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: EfficientNet-L2
nodes.description: 独立图像 encoder 生成全局视觉特征
nodes.description_en: Performs EfficientNet-L2 within the core billion scale noisy dual encoder clip computation pathway.

nodes.label: BERT-Large
nodes.description: 独立文本 encoder 生成句级特征
nodes.description_en: Performs BERT-Large within the core billion scale noisy dual encoder clip computation pathway.

nodes.label: 投影与归一化
nodes.description: 两模态映射到同维单位球
nodes.description_en: Performs projection normalization within the core billion scale noisy dual encoder clip computation pathway.

nodes.label: 批内相似度矩阵
nodes.description: 所有图像与所有文本做点积并除以温度
nodes.description_en: Performs matrix within the core billion scale noisy dual encoder clip computation pathway.

nodes.label: 双向对比交叉熵
nodes.description: image-to-text 与 text-to-image 两方向识别配对项
nodes.description_en: Applies Stage 07 to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: 零样本/检索表示
nodes.description: 文本提示可充当分类原型
nodes.description_en: Produces shared-space image and text embeddings for cross-modal retrieval and zero-shot classification via zero-shot.

paper.title: Scaling Up Visual and Vision-Language Representation Learning With Noisy Text Supervision

paper_figure.label: Figure 1 · PDF p.2
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 高质量人工图文配对昂贵，早期 VLM 数据规模受限
keypoints.核心想法: 用双编码器在十亿级噪声网页图文对上做对比对齐
keypoints.关键改进: 在其网页语料与评测条件下，以极大规模弱监督缓解标签噪声并获得零样本迁移
keypoints.医学适配: 方法上启发从报告、图注和病历构建医学图文预训练数据
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 规模化 VLM 里程碑；原论文不是医学验证，医学隐私、噪声和临床语义错配更突出

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Curating clean, human-verified image captions was expensive and bottlenecked dataset scale.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Trade stringent manual data cleaning for sheer data scale (1.8B noisy pairs) using a simple dual-encoder contrastive objective.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Proved that massive scale can empirically overcome high caption noise in web-scale vision–language pretraining.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Methodologically inspired harvesting large-scale noisy hospital PACS archives and scientific figure-caption corpora.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Web-scale VLM milestone; in clinical medicine, uncurated label/report noise and privacy leakage require far stricter governance.

name: BLIP
summary: 区别于纯双塔，BLIP 用共享 MED 同时承担对齐、跨注意力匹配和因果生成，并把 captioner-filter 作为数据循环的一部分。
summary_en: Unifies vision–language understanding and generation via a Multimodal Mixture of Encoder–Decoder (MED) coupled with a CapFilt data bootstrapping loop.

nodes.label: 噪声图文对
nodes.description: 原始网页配对是训练语料起点
nodes.description_en: Ingests image + noisy web caption + synthetically generated and filtered captions and prepares initial tensor representations (noise).

nodes.label: CapFilt
nodes.description: captioner 生成补充描述，filter 剔除与图像不一致的原始或合成文本
nodes.description_en: Executes CapFilt to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: ViT 图像 encoder
nodes.description: 输出视觉 token，供三种文本模式共享
nodes.description_en: Performs ViT encoder within the core multimodal encoder decoder capfilt computation pathway.

nodes.label: Unimodal text encoder
nodes.description: 与图像全局表示计算 image-text contrastive 目标
nodes.description_en: Performs Unimodal text encoder within the core multimodal encoder decoder capfilt computation pathway.

nodes.label: Image-grounded text encoder
nodes.description: 双向自注意力加视觉 cross-attention，执行 image-text matching
nodes.description_en: Performs Image-grounded text encoder within the core multimodal encoder decoder capfilt computation pathway.

nodes.label: Image-grounded text decoder
nodes.description: 因果自注意力加视觉 cross-attention，自回归生成描述
nodes.description_en: Performs Image-grounded text decoder within the core multimodal encoder decoder capfilt computation pathway.

nodes.label: ITC + ITM + LM
nodes.description: 对齐、细粒度匹配与语言建模联合训练
nodes.description_en: Applies ITC + ITM + LM to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: 理解与生成输出
nodes.description: 统一支持检索、匹配、问答适配和 caption
nodes.description_en: Produces unimodal embeddings (itc), cross-modal matching scores (itm), and autoregressive captions (lm) via output.

paper.title: BLIP: Bootstrapping Language-Image Pre-training for Unified Vision-Language Understanding and Generation

paper_figure.label: Figure 2 · PDF p.2
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 网页图文噪声大，理解与生成模型往往分开训练
keypoints.核心想法: 以统一 encoder-decoder 架构结合图文对比、匹配和生成目标
keypoints.关键改进: 用 captioner-filter 构造更干净合成描述并统一多任务预训练
keypoints.医学适配: 为医学报告生成、问答与跨模态检索提供通用范式
keypoints.适用范围与证据: VLM 数据清洗与多目标训练仍关键；临床事实性需独立约束

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Pure dual encoders (CLIP) cannot generate free text, while noisy web captions degrade generative language modeling.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Share weights across a multimodal encoder–decoder trained jointly on contrastive, matching, and generative objectives while bootstrapping clean captions.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Weight-shared MED architecture + CapFilt (a captioner generates synthetic descriptions while a filter removes noisy image–text pairs).
keypoints_en.医学适配: Provides a versatile blueprint for joint radiology report retrieval, image-report matching verification, and caption generation.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Data bootstrapping remains highly relevant; in medicine, synthetic captions must be audited against hallucinated clinical findings.

name: Florence-2
summary: 核心不是增加多个 head，而是用任务提示和位置 token 将 caption、检测、grounding、分割全部改写为 seq2seq。
summary_en: Reformulates captioning, object detection, phrase grounding, and segmentation into a single prompt-driven sequence-to-sequence generation task with quantized coordinate tokens.

nodes.label: 输入图像
nodes.description: 所有视觉任务共享同一图像接口
nodes.description_en: Ingests 2d image + task-specific text prompt (e.g., <od>, <caption>, <referring_expression_segmentation>) and prepares initial tensor representations (Input Image).

nodes.label: 任务文本提示
nodes.description: 特殊任务 token 指定描述、检测、定位或分割
nodes.description_en: Executes prompt to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: DaViT vision encoder
nodes.description: 产生层级视觉 token
nodes.description_en: Performs DaViT vision encoder within the core prompted unified vision seq2seq computation pathway.

nodes.label: Linear projection + LayerNorm
nodes.description: 把视觉 token 对齐到语言维度
nodes.description_en: Performs Linear projection + LayerNorm within the core prompted unified vision seq2seq computation pathway.

nodes.label: 多模态 Transformer encoder
nodes.description: 拼接视觉 token 与提示 token 后联合编码
nodes.description_en: Performs multimodal Transformer encoder within the core prompted unified vision seq2seq computation pathway.

nodes.label: 自回归 Transformer decoder
nodes.description: 按统一词表逐 token 生成任务答案
nodes.description_en: Performs Transformer decoder within the core prompted unified vision seq2seq computation pathway.

nodes.label: 扩展位置词表
nodes.description: 量化坐标 token 表示 box、quad 与 polygon 顶点
nodes.description_en: Applies Stage 07 to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: 任务后处理
nodes.description: 把生成序列解析成 caption、检测框或分割多边形
nodes.description_en: Produces unified token sequence decoding text descriptions, class labels, and quantized 0–999 bounding-box or polygon coordinates via Stage 08.

paper.title: Florence-2: Advancing a Unified Representation for a Variety of Vision Tasks

paper_figure.label: Figure 2, section 1 · PDF p.3
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 视觉任务通常需要不同 head、标签格式和专用模型
keypoints.核心想法: 把检测、分割、描述与定位统一为基于提示的序列到序列任务
keypoints.关键改进: 以统一文本提示和位置 token 在多任务数据上训练单一生成模型
keypoints.医学适配: 可作为医学 VLM 的通用视觉接口和弱标注工具，但需领域适配
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 通用视觉基础模型前沿；医学细粒度定位和安全性尚未充分验证

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Multi-task vision systems required separate specialized task heads, loss functions, and architectural branches for boxes, masks, and text.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Represent spatial coordinates as discrete vocabulary tokens (1,000 bins) so a single DaViT + seq2seq Transformer handles all vision tasks.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Unified coordinate-token sequence interface + FLD-5B (5.4B multi-task annotations across 126M images) unified pretraining.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Offers a unified promptable foundation interface adaptable to medical lesion detection, grounded reporting, and polygon annotation.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Frontier generalist vision interface; clinical precision on sub-millimeter boundaries and 3D volumes requires dedicated adaptation.

name: MedCLIP
summary: MedCLIP 的关键不是更深双塔，而是用医学知识构造任意图像—文本间的软语义配对。
summary_en: Replaces hard binary 1-to-1 image–report pairing with a soft semantic similarity matrix derived from clinical entity extraction, enabling unpaired contrastive learning.

nodes.label: 非配对胸片批次
nodes.description: 图像不必与同批文本来自同一检查
nodes.description_en: Ingests independently sampled chest radiographs and clinical report sentences with extracted umls/chexpert entities and prepares initial tensor representations (chest X-ray (CXR).

nodes.label: 非配对报告句子
nodes.description: 从独立文本库采样
nodes.description_en: Executes Stage 02 to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: 医学知识抽取
nodes.description: 把图像标签与报告实体映射到共同的 14 类临床语义向量
nodes.description_en: Performs Stage 03 within the core soft semantic unpaired medical clip computation pathway.

nodes.label: 视觉 encoder
nodes.description: ResNet 或 ViT 生成胸片 embedding
nodes.description_en: Performs encoder within the core soft semantic unpaired medical clip computation pathway.

nodes.label: ClinicalBERT text encoder
nodes.description: 编码报告或类别提示
nodes.description_en: Performs ClinicalBERT text encoder within the core soft semantic unpaired medical clip computation pathway.

nodes.label: 语义相似度软矩阵
nodes.description: 由图像/文本临床标签余弦相似度构成非二元目标
nodes.description_en: Performs matrix within the core soft semantic unpaired medical clip computation pathway.

nodes.label: 双向 semantic matching loss
nodes.description: 预测 embedding 相似度分布拟合软语义目标
nodes.description_en: Applies semantic matching loss to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: 零样本与检索接口
nodes.description: 类别提示、图像与报告可直接比较
nodes.description_en: Produces shared medical image–text embeddings and zero-shot disease probabilities via zero-shot.

paper.title: MedCLIP: Contrastive Learning from Unpaired Medical Images and Text

paper_figure.label: Figure 3 · PDF p.4
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 医学影像与文本严格配对数据有限，CLIP 式一一对应假设过强
keypoints.核心想法: 通过语义匹配把不严格配对的胸片和报告句子用于对比预训练
keypoints.关键改进: 基于临床标签/语义相似度构造软配对，扩大可用监督
keypoints.医学适配: 用于胸片零样本分类、检索和少样本迁移
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 医学 CLIP 代表；主要受限于胸片单域、标签抽取噪声及缺少细粒度定位

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Standard CLIP treats other patients sharing the exact same pathology in a batch as false negatives and requires strictly paired data.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Construct a soft semantic target similarity matrix between any image and any text using extracted clinical entities, training via KL divergence.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Decouples contrastive training from strict 1-to-1 pairs and eliminates same-pathology false-negative penalties.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Applied to label-efficient chest X-ray zero-shot classification, semantic retrieval, and unpaired pretraining.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Important medical CLIP modification; bounded by the accuracy of rule-based clinical entity extractors and chest X-ray scope.

name: Med-Flamingo
summary: 区别于单一投影接 LLM，Med-Flamingo 用 Perceiver 固定视觉 latent，并在多层冻结 LLM 中反复注入门控跨注意力。
summary_en: Compresses variable-number medical images via a Perceiver Resampler and injects them into a frozen LLM through tanh-gated cross-attention layers for few-shot in-context learning.

nodes.label: 交错图文上下文
nodes.description: 支持一张或多张图像与示例问答顺序混排
nodes.description_en: Ingests interleaved sequence of exemplar medical images, clinical text, and a query medical image/question and prepares initial tensor representations (Stage 01).

nodes.label: CLIP ViT-L/14
nodes.description: 预训练视觉 encoder；Flamingo 训练中保持冻结
nodes.description_en: Executes CLIP ViT-L/14 to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: Perceiver Resampler
nodes.description: 把可变数量视觉特征压成固定数量 latent token
nodes.description_en: Performs Perceiver Resampler within the core perceiver gated cross attention vlm computation pathway.

nodes.label: LLaMA-7B 文本 token
nodes.description: 医学提示、示例和待答问题进入冻结语言主干
nodes.description_en: Performs LLaMA-7B token within the core perceiver gated cross attention vlm computation pathway.

nodes.label: Gated cross-attention layers
nodes.description: 插入语言层之间，门控地读取最近图像 latent
nodes.description_en: Performs Gated cross-attention layers within the core perceiver gated cross attention vlm computation pathway.

nodes.label: 冻结 LLaMA language model
nodes.description: 保留通用生成能力，主要训练连接模块
nodes.description_en: Performs LLaMA language model within the core perceiver gated cross attention vlm computation pathway.

nodes.label: 医学持续预训练
nodes.description: PMC-OA 与医学教材图文数据更新 resampler/cross-attention
nodes.description_en: Applies pretraining to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: Few-shot 生成
nodes.description: 按 next-token 概率生成回答或 rationale
nodes.description_en: Produces autoregressive medical vqa answer or clinical rationale conditioned on in-context exemplars via Few-shot.

paper.title: Med-Flamingo: a Multimodal Medical Few-shot Learner

paper_figure.label: Figure 2 · PDF p.3
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 通用多模态模型医学知识不足，专用模型又难做少样本对话
keypoints.核心想法: 在冻结的语言模型中插入跨注意力层，接收交错医学图像与文本上下文
keypoints.关键改进: 基于 Flamingo 进行医学图文持续预训练并支持 in-context few-shot
keypoints.医学适配: 用于 few-shot 医学视觉问答与 rationale generation 原型
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 早期医学 MLLM；评测规模小，语言先验可能掩盖视觉不足

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: General-purpose VLMs lacked medical domain knowledge, while task-specific medical models could not adapt on the fly from a few examples.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Continue pretraining a Flamingo-style gated cross-attention architecture on interleaved biomedical textbook/article figures and text.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Perceiver Resampler fixed-token visual compression + zero-initialized tanh-gated cross-attention interleaved inside a frozen LLM.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Prototype for few-shot in-context medical visual question answering and clinical rationale generation.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Early medical MLLM milestone; human evaluation cohorts were small and LLM priors can still generate plausible-sounding errors.

name: LLaVA-Med
summary: 其贡献主要是将 LLaVA 两阶段训练移到生物医学域：PMC 图注概念对齐后再做合成医学指令微调。
summary_en: Adapts the LLaVA visual-instruction-tuning paradigm to biomedicine via two-stage training: PMC figure–caption alignment followed by GPT-4-synthesized biomedical instruction tuning.

nodes.label: 生物医学图像
nodes.description: 来自 PMC 图文对及下游医学问答数据
nodes.description_en: Ingests biomedical image + user clinical question or conversational instruction and prepares initial tensor representations (Stage 01).

nodes.label: 文本指令
nodes.description: 由论文图注和 GPT-4 辅助构造的对话式任务
nodes.description_en: Executes Stage 02 to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: CLIP ViT vision encoder
nodes.description: 提取 patch-level 视觉 token
nodes.description_en: Performs CLIP ViT vision encoder within the core biomedical visual instruction tuned mllm computation pathway.

nodes.label: 线性 multimodal projector
nodes.description: 把视觉特征映射到 LLM token embedding 维度
nodes.description_en: Performs multimodal projector within the core biomedical visual instruction tuned mllm computation pathway.

nodes.label: 生物医学概念对齐阶段
nodes.description: 用过滤后的 PMC 图像—图注数据先训练视觉语言连接
nodes.description_en: Performs Stage 05 within the core biomedical visual instruction tuned mllm computation pathway.

nodes.label: LLaVA/Vicuna language model
nodes.description: 接收视觉 token 与指令 token 并自回归解码
nodes.description_en: Performs LLaVA/Vicuna language model within the core biomedical visual instruction tuned mllm computation pathway.

nodes.label: 医学指令微调
nodes.description: 对生成的多模态问答/对话数据继续优化
nodes.description_en: Applies fine-tuning to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: 医学多模态回答
nodes.description: 图像问答、描述或研究辅助文本
nodes.description_en: Produces open-ended autoregressive biomedical explanation, visual qa response, or figure analysis via multimodal.

paper.title: LLaVA-Med: Training a Large Language-and-Vision Assistant for Biomedicine in One Day

paper_figure.label: Figure 3 · PDF p.5
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 通用 LLaVA 缺医学术语和科研图像知识，人工指令数据昂贵
keypoints.核心想法: 将生物医学视觉编码器通过投影连接到 LLM，并用合成指令数据微调
keypoints.关键改进: 利用 PubMed 图注生成大规模医学多模态指令并高效训练
keypoints.医学适配: 用于生物医学图像问答、解释与研究辅助
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 重要开放基线；合成指令偏差和临床真实性限制直接部署

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: General LLaVA lacked biomedical terminology and figure interpretation skills, while manual clinician instruction datasets were unavailable.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Project BiomedCLIP/ViT visual tokens into an LLM and fine-tune on multi-turn biomedical instructions synthesized from PubMed captions.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Fast 15-hour two-stage curriculum: Stage 1 linear projection concept alignment on PMC-15M + Stage 2 end-to-end synthetic instruction tuning.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Widely adopted open-source baseline for biomedical VQA, conversational research assistance, and MLLM benchmarking.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Foundational open medical MLLM; synthetic caption-derived instructions cannot substitute for verified clinical DICOM ground truth.

name: RadFM
summary: RadFM 的模型特异性在于统一 2D/3D 视觉 encoder 与 Perceiver 扫描聚合，再接生成式 LLM。
summary_en: Unifies 2D radiographs and 3D volumetric scans (CT/MRI) via a 2D/3D ViT + Perceiver 3D aggregator feeding into a generative radiology LLM.

nodes.label: 2D/3D 扫描序列
nodes.description: 允许不同模态、体积深度、时间点或多图组合
nodes.description_en: Ingests single/multiple 2d radiographs or 3d ct/mri volumes + natural-language clinical instruction and prepares initial tensor representations (2D/3D sequence).

nodes.label: 文本指令
nodes.description: 描述任务与问题上下文
nodes.description_en: Executes Stage 02 to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: 统一视觉 encoder
nodes.description: 把 2D 图像与 3D 体积编码为可变长度视觉特征
nodes.description_en: Performs encoder within the core unified 2d 3d perceiver radiology mllm computation pathway.

nodes.label: Perceiver aggregator
nodes.description: 跨切片/扫描聚合为固定数量视觉 token
nodes.description_en: Performs Perceiver aggregator within the core unified 2d 3d perceiver radiology mllm computation pathway.

nodes.label: 放射视觉 token
nodes.description: 保留多图和体积上下文后对齐语言空间
nodes.description_en: Performs token within the core unified 2d 3d perceiver radiology mllm computation pathway.

nodes.label: 自回归 LLM
nodes.description: 联合读取视觉 token 与文本提示
nodes.description_en: Performs Autoregressive LLM within the core unified 2d 3d perceiver radiology mllm computation pathway.

nodes.label: 多任务放射指令训练
nodes.description: 2D、3D 与图文任务共享生成目标
nodes.description_en: Applies multi-task training to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: 自由文本响应
nodes.description: 问答、报告与分类可表达为文本
nodes.description_en: Produces free-text radiology report, vqa answer, abnormality diagnosis, or rationale via Stage 08.

paper.title: Towards Generalist Foundation Model for Radiology by Leveraging Web-scale 2D&3D Medical Data

paper_figure.label: Figure 5(c) · PDF p.12
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 多数医学 VLM 只支持单张 2D 图像且任务和模态碎片化
keypoints.核心想法: 统一编码 2D 图像、3D 体积和文本，并以自回归 LLM 完成放射学多任务
keypoints.关键改进: 引入可变长度 3D visual tokens 与跨模态指令数据
keypoints.医学适配: 覆盖 CT、MRI、X-ray 等问答、报告与识别任务
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 通用放射模型 proof-of-concept；外部临床可靠性和幻觉仍是核心风险

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Most medical MLLMs accepted only single 2D slices, failing to ingest volumetric 3D CT/MRI studies natively.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Encode both 2D images and 3D volumetric patches into unified visual tokens compressed by a Perceiver resampler before an autoregressive LLM.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Unified 2D/3D visual tokenization + RadMD 16M multi-modal radiology instruction dataset + RadBench evaluation.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Addresses multi-modality radiology VQA, report generation, and disease triage across X-ray, CT, and MRI.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Important 3D-capable radiology MLLM proof-of-concept; hallucination rates and external clinical calibration remain critical hurdles.

name: MAIRA-1
summary: MAIRA-1 不是通用图文预训练模型，而是冻结胸片 RAD-DINO、使用四层 adapter，并完整微调 Vicuna-7B 的专用报告生成器。
summary_en: Specialist chest X-ray report generator pairing a frozen CXR-specific RAD-DINO visual encoder, a 4-layer MLP adapter, and a fully fine-tuned Vicuna-7B LLM.

nodes.label: 胸片输入
nodes.description: 高分辨率正位胸片；训练域为 MIMIC-CXR
nodes.description_en: Ingests frontal chest x-ray + clinical indication/history prompt and prepares initial tensor representations (chest X-ray (CXR) input).

nodes.label: Indication/提示文本
nodes.description: 可提供检查问题和生成格式
nodes.description_en: Executes Indication/ prompt to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: 冻结 RAD-DINO ViT-B
nodes.description: 518 像素胸片专用视觉 encoder，输出较密集图像 token
nodes.description_en: Performs RAD-DINO ViT-B within the core specialist cxr adapter report llm computation pathway.

nodes.label: 四层前馈 adapter
nodes.description: 把 RAD-DINO token 映射到 Vicuna embedding 空间
nodes.description_en: Performs adapter within the core specialist cxr adapter report llm computation pathway.

nodes.label: Vicuna-7B
nodes.description: 对报告生成任务进行完整 fine-tuning，而非只训练 adapter
nodes.description_en: Performs Vicuna-7B within the core specialist cxr adapter report llm computation pathway.

nodes.label: GPT-3.5 文本增强
nodes.description: 对训练报告进行改写，增加叙述多样性
nodes.description_en: Performs GPT-3.5 within the core specialist cxr adapter report llm computation pathway.

nodes.label: 报告 next-token loss
nodes.description: 视觉与文本条件下教师强制训练
nodes.description_en: Applies next-token loss to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: Findings 草稿
nodes.description: 自动生成胸片所见段落
nodes.description_en: Produces structured clinical radiology findings narrative via Findings.

paper.title: MAIRA-1: A Specialised Large Multimodal Model for Radiology Report Generation

paper_figure.label: Table 3 · PDF p.6
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 通用 VLM 报告缺结构化临床表述且易遗漏异常
keypoints.核心想法: 将胸片专用视觉编码器与 Vicuna-7B 对齐并针对放射学报告生成完整微调
keypoints.关键改进: 使用 CXR 专用视觉编码、文本数据增强与完整 LLM fine-tuning 强化胸片叙述
keypoints.医学适配: 面向胸片 findings/impression 自动草拟与研究基线
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 报告生成代表模型；需逐项事实核验和放射科医生复核

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: General-purpose VLMs produced stylistically generic reports and frequently omitted subtle thoracic abnormalities.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Combine a domain-pretrained chest X-ray self-supervised encoder (RAD-DINO) with full LLM fine-tuning tailored specifically to CXR reporting.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Frozen high-resolution RAD-DINO ViT-B/14 (49×49 grid) + 4-layer MLP adapter + text augmentation + RadGraph/radiologist evaluation.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Dedicated baseline for automated chest X-ray Findings drafting and clinical factuality evaluation.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Representative specialist report generator; lacks explicit spatial bounding-box grounding (addressed in MAIRA-2).

name: MAIRA-2
summary: 相较 MAIRA-1，MAIRA-2 增加多视图/既往/报告上下文，并把报告句子与生成式 bounding-box token 绑定。
summary_en: Extends MAIRA-1 with multi-view (AP/PA + lateral), prior study/report longitudinal context, and interleaved quantized bounding-box tokens for grounded reporting.

nodes.label: 当前正/侧位胸片
nodes.description: 正位为主要定位画布，侧位提供补充视角
nodes.description_en: Ingests current frontal & lateral cxr, prior cxr, prior report, indication, technique, comparison + task prompt and prepares initial tensor representations (chest X-ray (CXR).

nodes.label: 既往图像与报告
nodes.description: 用于比较时间变化，可为空
nodes.description_en: Executes Stage 02 to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: Indication/Technique/Comparison
nodes.description: 以交错文本 token 提供真实报告上下文
nodes.description_en: Performs Indication/Technique/Comparison within the core longitudinal grounded box report mllm computation pathway.

nodes.label: 冻结 RAD-DINO-MAIRA-2 ViT-B
nodes.description: 87M 参数胸片视觉 encoder
nodes.description_en: Performs RAD-DINO-MAIRA-2 ViT-B within the core longitudinal grounded box report mllm computation pathway.

nodes.label: 四层 MLP adapter
nodes.description: 从零训练，将一个或多个图像 token 映射到语言维度
nodes.description_en: Performs MLP adapter within the core longitudinal grounded box report mllm computation pathway.

nodes.label: 完整微调 Vicuna-7B v1.5
nodes.description: 接收交错图像与文本上下文，按任务提示生成
nodes.description_en: Performs fine-tuning Vicuna-7B v1.5 within the core longitudinal grounded box report mllm computation pathway.

nodes.label: 句子—对象—框 token
nodes.description: 可生成对象标记与量化 box，实现描述和定位绑定
nodes.description_en: Performs token within the core longitudinal grounded box report mllm computation pathway.

nodes.label: Grounded/ungrounded 多任务 LM
nodes.description: 普通报告、grounded 报告与 phrase grounding 共享生成训练
nodes.description_en: Applies Grounded/ungrounded multi-task LM to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: 可定位报告输出
nodes.description: 解析为纯文本或带边界框的句子序列
nodes.description_en: Produces ungrounded findings, spatially grounded findings (linking each clinical sentence to bounding boxes), or phrase grounding via output.

paper.title: MAIRA-2: Grounded Radiology Report Generation

paper_figure.label: Figure 1(b) · PDF p.3
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 纯文本报告难追溯到影像证据，模型错误不易审计
keypoints.核心想法: 在报告生成时同时输出与叙述实体对应的图像区域定位
keypoints.关键改进: 把检测式 grounding 与长文本生成统一，并接收当前/既往胸片、既往报告、检查指征及比较信息
keypoints.医学适配: 用于成人胸片的可定位报告与研究性人机复核
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 可审计报告生成的重要方向；grounding 正确不等于诊断正确

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Un-grounded text reports cannot be visually audited on the image, and single-image inputs ignore longitudinal interval change.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Condition the LLM on full longitudinal clinical context (multi-view + prior study/report) while emitting spatial bounding-box tokens inline with findings.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Unified sequence generation of clinical prose and quantized spatial coordinates + comprehensive longitudinal chest X-ray context.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Sets the standard for auditable, spatially grounded adult chest X-ray report drafting and human-in-the-loop review.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Major step toward verifiable clinical VLMs; accurate box localization still requires mandatory radiologist verification.

name: BiomedGPT
summary: BiomedGPT 以模态无关、任务无关的 encoder—decoder token 化接口统一生物医学视觉、语言和多模态输出。
summary_en: Modality- and task-agnostic encoder–decoder Transformer unifying biomedical images, clinical text, and bounding boxes into a discrete token sequence interface.

nodes.label: 多模态输入
nodes.description: 医学图像、自然语言与结构化任务提示
nodes.description_en: Ingests 2d biomedical image patches, text tokens, and task-specifying instruction prompt and prepares initial tensor representations (multimodal input).

nodes.label: ResNet patch front-end
nodes.description: 图像经卷积块稀疏编码为视觉 patch token
nodes.description_en: Executes ResNet patch front-end to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: BPE + token embedding
nodes.description: 文本和任务提示编码到共享维度
nodes.description_en: Performs BPE + token embedding within the core unified token encoder decoder generalist computation pathway.

nodes.label: 统一输入序列
nodes.description: 模态、位置和任务标记区分不同 token 语义
nodes.description_en: Performs input sequence within the core unified token encoder decoder generalist computation pathway.

nodes.label: Transformer encoder
nodes.description: 跨模态上下文编码并形成共享语义表示
nodes.description_en: Performs Transformer encoder within the core unified token encoder decoder generalist computation pathway.

nodes.label: Transformer decoder
nodes.description: 条件于 encoder 表示自回归预测目标 token
nodes.description_en: Performs Transformer decoder within the core unified token encoder decoder generalist computation pathway.

nodes.label: 统一多任务预训练
nodes.description: 文本、图像、视觉语言与定位任务按 seq2seq 格式混合
nodes.description_en: Applies multi-task pretraining to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: 任务化输出
nodes.description: 解码为回答、标签、区域或生成内容
nodes.description_en: Produces unified autoregressive token stream representing free text, classification labels, or spatial coordinates via output.

paper.title: A Generalist Vision-Language Foundation Model for Diverse Biomedical Tasks

paper_figure.label: Figure 2(a) · PDF p.5
