keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 生物医学模型按模态和任务分散，难共享知识与接口
keypoints.核心想法: 以统一序列到序列框架处理生物医学图像、文本和多种输出格式
keypoints.关键改进: 在多领域多任务数据上联合预训练并用任务提示统一预测
keypoints.医学适配: 覆盖放射、病理、皮肤、文本理解和生成任务
keypoints.适用范围与证据: generalist 医学模型代表；跨中心临床价值仍依赖专门验证

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Biomedical AI models were siloed by modality (radiology vs. pathology vs. text) and task head architecture.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Map vision patches, text subwords, and spatial locations into a shared discrete vocabulary processed by a unified BART/OFA-style encoder–decoder.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Multi-task, multi-specialty pretraining + instruction fine-tuning across vision, language, VQA, captioning, and detection.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Generalist biomedical foundation baseline spanning radiology, pathology, ophthalmology, dermatology, and biomedical NLP.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Representative generalist architecture; specialist models often retain an edge on high-stakes quantitative or 3D tasks.

name: Virchow
summary: Virchow 是 632M ViT-H/14 的病理 tile foundation encoder，以约 150 万临床 WSI 的 DINOv2 自监督规模取胜。
summary_en: 632M-parameter ViT-H/14 computational pathology tile foundation model pretrained with DINOv2 on 2 billion tiles from 1.5 million clinical H&E whole-slide images.

nodes.label: H&E whole-slide images
nodes.description: 约 150 万 WSI 的临床病理训练库
nodes.description_en: Ingests 224×224 h&e histopathology tissue tile (with global and local crops during pretraining) and prepares initial tensor representations (H&E whole-slide images).

nodes.label: 组织 tile 与多裁剪
nodes.description: WSI 切块后形成全局和局部组织视图
nodes.description_en: Executes tile to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: ViT-H/14 student
nodes.description: 632M 参数 tile encoder 学习 patch 与全局表征
nodes.description_en: Performs ViT-H/14 student within the core clinical scale dinov2 vith tile encoder computation pathway.

nodes.label: EMA teacher
nodes.description: 按 DINOv2 更新，提供跨视图自蒸馏目标
nodes.description_en: Performs EMA teacher within the core clinical scale dinov2 vith tile encoder computation pathway.

nodes.label: DINOv2 多视图目标
nodes.description: 结合全局/局部自蒸馏与 patch-level 学习
nodes.description_en: Performs DINOv2 multi-view objective within the core clinical scale dinov2 vith tile encoder computation pathway.

nodes.label: Virchow tile embedding
nodes.description: 可冻结抽取局部组织形态表示
nodes.description_en: Performs Virchow tile embedding within the core clinical scale dinov2 vith tile encoder computation pathway.

nodes.label: 下游 WSI aggregator
nodes.description: MIL/attention 等任务模型汇聚数千 tile；不是 Virchow 预训练主体
nodes.description_en: Applies WSI aggregator to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: 临床任务 head
nodes.description: 癌症检测、稀有癌、细胞或 biomarker 预测
nodes.description_en: Produces 2560-d tile representation ([cls] concatenated with mean patch token) feeding downstream wsi aggregators via head.

paper.title: A Foundation Model for Clinical-Grade Computational Pathology and Rare Cancers Detection

paper_figure.label: Figure 1(e–f) · PDF p.Official full-size Figure 1 asset
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 病理监督标签稀缺且稀有癌种难覆盖，ImageNet 特征域差距大
keypoints.核心想法: 在百万级全切片 patch 上自监督预训练大规模 ViT 病理编码器
keypoints.关键改进: 利用海量临床 WSI 和 DINOv2 式预训练提升低样本与稀有任务迁移
keypoints.医学适配: 支持 pan-cancer detection、稀有癌、细胞识别和 biomarker prediction
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 病理 FM 关键里程碑；患者级去重、扫描域移位和独立比较仍重要

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Smaller pathology models struggled on rare cancer variants and cross-laboratory staining variations.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Scale both model capacity (ViT-H/14, 632M) and clinical data volume (1.5M WSIs from MSKCC) under DINOv2 self-supervised learning.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Institutional gigapixel scale (1.5M slides) + 632M ViT-H architecture demonstrating strong pan-cancer and rare-cancer generalization.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Supports pan-cancer detection, rare tumor identification, biomarker prediction, and cell-level pathology tasks.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Landmark high-capacity pathology tile encoder; independent benchmarks show ensemble diversity with UNI/CONCH remains valuable.

name: CHIEF
summary: CHIEF 明确串联 CTransPath tile 自监督和带解剖条件的 WSI attention 弱监督，而非只发布局部 patch encoder。
summary_en: Couples self-supervised tile encoding (CTransPath) with anatomical-site-conditioned whole-slide attention aggregation trained across 60,530 WSIs.

nodes.label: Whole-slide image
nodes.description: 多中心、多癌种 WSI 输入
nodes.description_en: Ingests h&e whole-slide image tiles + anatomical primary site text/categorical embedding and prepares initial tensor representations (Whole-slide image).

nodes.label: WSI tile 序列
nodes.description: 从组织区域采样局部 patch
nodes.description_en: Executes WSI tile sequence to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: CHIEF-CTransPath
nodes.description: 自监督 Swin Transformer tile encoder，输出 768 维局部特征
nodes.description_en: Performs CHIEF-CTransPath within the core two stage tile and site wsi foundation computation pathway.

nodes.label: 解剖部位 token/监督
nodes.description: 向 WSI 模型提供组织来源上下文
nodes.description_en: Performs token within the core two stage tile and site wsi foundation computation pathway.

nodes.label: Attention WSI aggregator
nodes.description: 对可变数量 tile 加权汇聚并识别关键实例
nodes.description_en: Performs Attention WSI aggregator within the core two stage tile and site wsi foundation computation pathway.

nodes.label: WSI 弱监督预训练
nodes.description: 用 slide-level 癌症相关标签训练全片模式识别
nodes.description_en: Performs WSI weakly supervised pretraining within the core two stage tile and site wsi foundation computation pathway.

nodes.label: CHIEF WSI embedding
nodes.description: 可冻结迁移的 768 维全片表示
nodes.description_en: Applies CHIEF WSI embedding to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: 诊断/分子/生存 heads
nodes.description: 肿瘤来源、biomarker 与预后模型
nodes.description_en: Produces slide-level diagnostic representation for cancer detection, tumor origin, genomic mutation, and survival prediction via heads.

paper.title: A Pathology Foundation Model for Cancer Diagnosis and Prognosis Prediction

paper_figure.label: Figure 1(a) · PDF p.Official full-size Figure 1 asset
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: patch encoder 与 slide-level 预后模型割裂，跨癌种迁移有限
keypoints.核心想法: 联合自监督图像预训练与弱监督全切片聚合学习癌症表征
keypoints.关键改进: 在多中心多癌种 WSI 上学习可用于诊断和生存预测的通用表示
keypoints.医学适配: 用于癌种识别、分子标志物和预后风险建模
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 临床广度突出；回顾性关联不等同于前瞻性决策效益

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Standalone patch encoders lacked pre-trained slide-level aggregators conditioned on anatomical site context.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Combine a pretrained hybrid CNN-Transformer tile encoder with a weakly supervised WSI attention aggregator conditioned on anatomical site.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Two-stage tile + slide pretraining across 19 anatomical sites with broad multi-center external validation.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Applied to cancer detection, tumor origin identification, genomic profile inference, and survival risk stratification.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Demonstrates broad multi-center retrospective validation; prognostic risk scores still require prospective trial verification.

name: TITAN
summary: TITAN 的特异性是三阶段 whole-slide 预训练：特征网格 iBOT、ROI caption CoCa、WSI report CoCa。
summary_en: Three-stage multimodal whole-slide foundation model pretrained via iBOT on 2D tile feature grids, CoCa on synthetic ROI captions, and CoCa on whole-slide pathology reports.

nodes.label: 空间化 patch feature grid
nodes.description: 病理 patch encoder 特征按 WSI 二维坐标重新排列
nodes.description_en: Ingests pre-extracted 2d spatial grid of wsi patch embeddings (conch v1.5) + roi descriptions / clinical pathology reports and prepares initial tensor representations (spatial patch feature grid).

nodes.label: TITAN slide ViT
nodes.description: 把 patch feature 当作 ViT patch embedding，建模全片上下文
nodes.description_en: Executes TITAN slide ViT to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: Stage 1 iBOT student–teacher
nodes.description: 在 ROI/WSI 特征网格上做掩码建模与知识蒸馏
nodes.description_en: Performs Stage 1 iBOT student–teacher within the core three stage ibot coca wsi foundation computation pathway.

nodes.label: Stage 2 ROI-caption pairs
nodes.description: 8k×8k ROI 与 PathChat 合成细粒度形态描述
nodes.description_en: Performs Stage 2 ROI-caption pairs within the core three stage ibot coca wsi foundation computation pathway.

nodes.label: Stage 3 WSI-report pairs
nodes.description: 全切片与临床病理报告对齐
nodes.description_en: Performs Stage 3 WSI-report pairs within the core three stage ibot coca wsi foundation computation pathway.

nodes.label: CoCa text encoder
nodes.description: 编码 ROI caption 和 slide report
nodes.description_en: Performs CoCa text encoder within the core three stage ibot coca wsi foundation computation pathway.

nodes.label: CoCa multimodal decoder
nodes.description: 对视觉表示做 cross-attention 并生成描述/报告
nodes.description_en: Performs CoCa multimodal decoder within the core three stage ibot coca wsi foundation computation pathway.

nodes.label: 对比对齐 + captioning
nodes.description: ROI 与 WSI 两个尺度联合优化检索和生成
nodes.description_en: Applies contrastive alignment + captioning to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: TITAN slide 表示与语言能力
nodes.description: 支持零样本、检索、报告生成和线性探测
nodes.description_en: Produces general-purpose whole-slide embedding, zero-shot slide classification, cross-modal report retrieval, and slide report generation via TITAN slide.

paper.title: A Multimodal Whole-Slide Foundation Model for Pathology

paper_figure.label: Figure 1(d) · PDF p.5
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 仅 patch 级预训练缺整片上下文，纯视觉模型难接入语言任务
keypoints.核心想法: 以 slide encoder 汇聚 gigapixel WSI，并与病理报告文本进行跨模态对齐
keypoints.关键改进: 在整片尺度联合视觉自监督和图文对齐，支持零样本与生成任务
keypoints.医学适配: 用于 WSI 分类、检索、报告和生物标志物预测
keypoints.适用范围与证据: whole-slide 多模态 FM 前沿；公开权重移除了多模态 decoder，论文报告生成功能不能完整复现

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Most pathology foundation models stopped at the tile level, requiring task-specific MIL training from scratch for every slide-level task.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Pretrain a Vision Transformer slide encoder directly over spatial grids of tile embeddings using progressive visual and clinical report supervision.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Progressive 3-stage slide-level curriculum (335K WSIs) bridging spatial tile grids, synthetic ROI morphology captions, and clinical reports.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Enables zero-shot whole-slide subtyping, rare cancer retrieval, biomarker prediction, and slide-level representation reuse.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Frontier multimodal slide foundation model; note that the publicly released weights omit the generative text decoder.

name: PRISM2
summary: PRISM2 明确提供双嵌入：Perceiver 的通用 base embedding，以及 Phi-3 隐状态导出的诊断 embedding。
summary_en: Pairs a Perceiver slide encoder over Virchow2 tile embeddings with a Phi-3 LLM trained on single-turn clinical dialogues derived from pathology reports, exposing dual embeddings.

nodes.label: 病例 WSI tiles
nodes.description: 一张或多张超大 WSI 先切成组织 tiles
nodes.description_en: Ingests multi-slide h&e case tile embeddings (virchow2) + clinical prompt / diagnostic query and prepares initial tensor representations (WSI tiles).

nodes.label: Virchow2 tile encoder
nodes.description: 逐 tile 产生冻结病理 embedding
nodes.description_en: Executes Virchow2 tile encoder to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: Perceiver slide encoder
nodes.description: 跨大量 tile 交叉注意力压缩为 slide latents
nodes.description_en: Performs Perceiver slide encoder within the core perceiver phi3 dual embedding pathology fm computation pathway.

nodes.label: Base embedding
nodes.description: Perceiver pooling 的 2560 维轻量通用全片表示
nodes.description_en: Performs Base embedding within the core perceiver phi3 dual embedding pathology fm computation pathway.

nodes.label: BioGPT text encoder
nodes.description: Stage 1 提供诊断摘要文本 embedding 的对比目标
nodes.description_en: Performs BioGPT text encoder within the core perceiver phi3 dual embedding pathology fm computation pathway.

nodes.label: Phi-3 Mini 128k
nodes.description: Stage 1 自回归生成；Stage 2 冻结 slide encoder 后微调临床对话
nodes.description_en: Performs Phi-3 Mini 128k within the core perceiver phi3 dual embedding pathology fm computation pathway.

nodes.label: Stage 1 对比 + 自回归
nodes.description: slide 表示同时对齐 BioGPT 摘要并支持 Phi-3 文本生成
nodes.description_en: Performs Stage 1 + within the core perceiver phi3 dual embedding pathology fm computation pathway.

nodes.label: Stage 2 dialogue tuning
nodes.description: 报告、开放问答、是非题和选择题；仅优化语言接口
nodes.description_en: Applies Stage 2 dialogue tuning to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: Diagnostic embedding/文本
nodes.description: 固定图像提示下取 Phi-3 assistant 位置隐状态，或直接生成单轮回答
nodes.description_en: Produces 2560-d base slide embedding, 3072-d llm diagnostic embedding, or autoregressive pathology text response via Diagnostic embedding.

paper.title: End-to-End Multimodal Pathology Foundation Model with Clinical Dialogue

paper_figure.label: Figure 1(a) · PDF p.Official full-size Figure 1 asset
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 两阶段 patch/slide/LLM 管线信息瓶颈多且难统一适配
keypoints.核心想法: 将 Virchow2 tile embeddings 输入 Perceiver slide encoder，再连接 Phi-3 进行临床对话式推理
keypoints.关键改进: 第一阶段训练 slide encoder，第二阶段冻结它并训练语言接口与 prompt-based inference
keypoints.医学适配: 以临床对话作为监督和病理全切片推理接口，不以部署聊天代理为目标
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 新近前沿；需要独立复现、病理医生盲评和部署安全证据

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Two-stage MIL + LLM pathology pipelines suffered from rigid task heads and disconnected visual vs. linguistic representations.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Connect a Perceiver slide aggregator to a clinical LLM (Phi-3) via conversational report supervision, extracting both visual and LLM-contextualized embeddings.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Exposes dual reusable interfaces (Perceiver base embedding + LLM last-token diagnostic embedding) alongside promptable zero-shot inference.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Designed as a promptable whole-slide diagnostic representation and conversational reasoning engine rather than a patient-facing chatbot.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Emerging 2025/2026 frontier preprint; requires independent multi-center replication and pathologist workflow validation.

name: BME-X
summary: BME-X 不是通用 MRI encoder，而是先预测组织标签、再用组织感知 DU-Net 生成增强图像的两阶段恢复模型。
summary_en: Two-stage brain MRI enhancement foundation model that first estimates tissue probability maps and then conditions a Dual U-Net (DU-Net) to restore harmonized images.

nodes.label: 低质量结构脑 MRI
nodes.description: 覆盖运动、降采样、噪声、对比/扫描仪差异等退化
nodes.description_en: Ingests structural brain mri degraded by motion, low resolution, noise, or cross-scanner field-strength shifts and prepares initial tensor representations (MRI).

nodes.label: Tissue-classification DU-Net
nodes.description: 密集连接 U-Net 从退化图像预测背景、CSF、灰质、白质等组织标签
nodes.description_en: Executes Tissue-classification DU-Net to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: 软组织标签图
nodes.description: 作为解剖条件，不是最终分割产品
nodes.description_en: Performs soft tissue within the core tissue prior dual unet mri harmonization computation pathway.

nodes.label: 图像—组织条件融合
nodes.description: 将低质量 MRI 与预测组织图拼接
nodes.description_en: Performs fusion within the core tissue prior dual unet mri harmonization computation pathway.

nodes.label: Tissue-aware enhancement DU-Net
nodes.description: 在组织先验约束下恢复清晰度、分辨率与标准化对比
nodes.description_en: Performs Tissue-aware enhancement DU-Net within the core tissue prior dual unet mri harmonization computation pathway.

nodes.label: 合成退化—高质量配对训练
nodes.description: 从高质量结构 MRI 构造多种退化，联合学习组织和增强目标
nodes.description_en: Performs training within the core tissue prior dual unet mri harmonization computation pathway.

nodes.label: 增强 MRI
nodes.description: 一个固定模型覆盖多类结构脑 MRI 增强任务
nodes.description_en: Applies MRI to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: 下游验证链
nodes.description: 组织分割、皮层测量、配准和诊断模型检验实际效用与偏差
nodes.description_en: Produces harmonized, artifact-corrected, high-resolution brain mri ready for downstream morphometry, registration, and diagnosis via Stage 08.

paper.title: A Foundation Model for Enhancing Magnetic Resonance Images and Downstream Segmentation, Registration and Diagnostic Tasks

paper_figure.label: Figure 1(a) · PDF p.Official full-size Figure 1 asset
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: MRI 增强模型通常按 degradation 或扫描仪分别训练，且增强质量与下游价值脱节
keypoints.核心想法: 先预测组织标签，再用 tissue-aware enhancement network 统一结构脑 MRI 的运动校正、超分、去噪和扫描仪协调化
keypoints.关键改进: 以组织标签约束增强，并验证增强图像能改善后续分割、配准与诊断模型
keypoints.医学适配: 面向结构脑 MRI 的多任务图像增强，而非多器官通用编码器
keypoints.适用范围与证据: MRI enhancement foundation 路线代表；真实世界协议差异和前瞻证据仍有限

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: MRI restoration networks were typically trained per degradation or scanner, often smoothing tissue boundaries needed by downstream tools.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Pre-estimate anatomical tissue segmentation probabilities to explicitly guide a tissue-aware enhancement network across diverse degradations.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Couples anatomical tissue priors with unified motion correction, super-resolution, denoising, and multi-site scanner harmonization.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Serves as a universal structural brain MRI pre-processing and harmonization front-end improving downstream FreeSurfer/segmentation consistency.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Representative restoration-oriented MRI foundation model; must be audited to ensure subtle focal lesions are not harmonized away.

name: Prima
summary: Prima 的核心链路是 32×32×4 子体积 VQ-VAE token、sequence ViT、study ViT，再以神经放射报告做 CLIP 对齐。
summary_en: Hierarchical clinical brain MRI study foundation model chaining 32×32×4 sub-volume VQ-VAE tokenization, a sequence-level ViT, and a study-level ViT aligned with radiology reports.

nodes.label: 多序列 MRI study
nodes.description: 一个检查包含不同序列、方向和数量的 3D volumes
nodes.description_en: Ingests complete clinical brain mri study (multiple heterogeneous 3d sequences + sequence metadata) + paired neuroradiology report and prepares initial tensor representations (multi-sequence MRI study).

nodes.label: 3D VQ-VAE volume tokenizer
nodes.description: 体积切为 32×32×4 子块，去背景并编码为离散/潜在 token；以方向置换增强不变性
nodes.description_en: Executes 3D VQ-VAE volume tokenizer to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: 序列名称 embedding
nodes.description: 自由文本序列描述提示扫描平面与对比类型
nodes.description_en: Performs sequence embedding within the core hierarchical vqvae study vit mri clip computation pathway.

nodes.label: Sequence ViT
nodes.description: 融合一个 volume 的 token、位置编码和序列描述，输出 series register
nodes.description_en: Performs Sequence ViT within the core hierarchical vqvae study vit mri clip computation pathway.

nodes.label: Study ViT
nodes.description: 汇聚所有 series registers，形成完整检查表示
nodes.description_en: Performs Study ViT within the core hierarchical vqvae study vit mri clip computation pathway.

nodes.label: 神经放射学文本 encoder
nodes.description: 编码经 LLM 摘要的阳性报告要点
nodes.description_en: Performs encoder within the core hierarchical vqvae study vit mri clip computation pathway.

nodes.label: MRI-report CLIP + patient discrimination
nodes.description: 对齐 study 与报告并减少同患者/批采样带来的低效
nodes.description_en: Performs MRI-report CLIP + patient discrimination within the core hierarchical vqvae study vit mri clip computation pathway.

nodes.label: Prima study embedding
nodes.description: 用于零样本检索、解释与迁移
nodes.description_en: Applies Prima study embedding to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: 冻结特征 MLP probes
nodes.description: 冻结 tokenizer 与两级 ViT 后训练诊断、优先级和转诊 heads
nodes.description_en: Produces study-level multimodal embedding supporting zero-shot retrieval and 52 neurological diagnostic/triage mlp probes via feature MLP probes.

paper.title: Learning Neuroimaging Models from Health System-Scale Data

paper_figure.label: Extended Data Figure 1(c) · PDF p.30
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 研究队列规模有限且筛选偏差大，模型难覆盖真实临床异质性
keypoints.核心想法: 以 VQ-VAE 把 MRI 体积离散化，再用 sequence ViT、study ViT 和 MRI-report CLIP 学习层级检查表征
keypoints.关键改进: 以报告摘要对齐层级神经影像表示，冻结表示后训练 MLP probes
keypoints.医学适配: 用于 52 种诊断、优先级与转诊建议等脑 MRI 任务
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 有一年 health-system-wide 与外部评估；仍主要来自单一卫生系统，尚未证明工作流结局改善

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Curated research MRI models fail on real-world hospital studies containing variable numbers of sequences, protocols, and artifacts.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Tokenize 3D sub-volumes via VQ-VAE and aggregate variable multi-sequence studies through hierarchical sequence- and study-level Transformers aligned with reports.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Trained on >200,000 uncurated clinical MRI series (~30,000 studies) with LLM-summarized report alignment and health-system-wide evaluation.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Evaluated across 52 neuroimaging diagnoses, acuity triage, and specialist referral recommendations over a 1-year health-system cohort.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Strong health-system-scale study-level evidence; predominantly validated within a single health system and retrospective workflow.

name: MARS
summary: MARS 用 3D Swin 加结构/序列双支路、元数据与对比约束，并通过重建/合成把 anatomy-invariant 与 sequence-specific 信息解耦。
summary_en: Multi-sequence 3D MRI foundation model pairing a 3D Swin backbone with dual structure/sequence branches and acquisition metadata to disentangle anatomy from contrast.

nodes.label: 多器官多序列 MRI
nodes.description: 336,476 个体积，覆盖不同序列和扫描协议
nodes.description_en: Ingests multi-sequence 3d mri volumes across 10 anatomical regions with sequence metadata and cross-sequence masking and prepares initial tensor representations (organ multi-sequence MRI).

nodes.label: 3D Swin Transformer
nodes.description: 层级窗口注意力提取多尺度体积特征
nodes.description_en: Executes 3D Swin Transformer to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: Structure branch
nodes.description: 1×1×1 卷积头分离 anatomy-invariant 结构特征
nodes.description_en: Performs Structure branch within the core anatomy sequence disentangled 3d swin fm computation pathway.

nodes.label: Sequence branch
nodes.description: 独立头分离与对比度、扫描参数相关的 sequence-specific 特征
nodes.description_en: Performs Sequence branch within the core anatomy sequence disentangled 3d swin fm computation pathway.

nodes.label: 结构/序列对比 heads
nodes.description: 分别约束同解剖跨序列一致性与序列差异
nodes.description_en: Performs sequence heads within the core anatomy sequence disentangled 3d swin fm computation pathway.

nodes.label: 部位与采集参数 heads
nodes.description: 结构支路预测解剖部位；序列支路预测 TR、TE、flip angle 等元数据
nodes.description_en: Performs heads within the core anatomy sequence disentangled 3d swin fm computation pathway.

nodes.label: 3D reconstruction/synthesis decoder
nodes.description: 从遮挡输入重建，并可通过噪声映射调制 sequence 特征做序列合成
nodes.description_en: Performs 3D reconstruction/synthesis decoder within the core anatomy sequence disentangled 3d swin fm computation pathway.

nodes.label: 残差特征再融合
nodes.description: 结构与序列支路拼接聚合回主 latent
nodes.description_en: Applies residual feature fusion to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: 多任务迁移
nodes.description: 预训练 3D Swin 接分割、分类、TransMorph 配准或报告生成适配器
nodes.description_en: Produces disentangled anatomical and sequence representations transferable across 44 segmentation, classification, registration, and report tasks via multi-task.

paper.title: Large-Scale Multi-Sequence Pretraining for Generalizable MRI Analysis in Versatile Clinical Applications

paper_figure.label: Figure 6 · PDF p.17
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 单序列、单器官预训练难处理临床 MRI 协议和对比度异质性
keypoints.核心想法: 在大规模多序列 MRI 上解耦 anatomy-invariant 表征与 sequence-specific variation
keypoints.关键改进: 以 sequence-disentangled pretraining 迁移到 44 个分割、分类、配准、进展预测和报告生成任务
keypoints.医学适配: 适配多器官 MRI 分割、诊断、配准、进展预测与报告生成
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 原作者在 44 个任务中报告 41 个第一；不等于独立或前瞻验证

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Single-sequence or single-organ MRI models brittlely fail when clinical pulse sequences, TR/TE parameters, or contrasts vary.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Explicitly factorize 3D MRI representations into an anatomy-invariant structural branch and a sequence-specific contrast branch guided by acquisition metadata.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Pretrained on ~160,000 3D MRI scans via cross-sequence synthesis, masked reconstruction, and contrastive disentanglement.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Adapts across 44 diverse downstream MRI tasks spanning segmentation, diagnosis, deformable registration, progression, and reporting.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Broad multi-task scope reported by authors; independent external replication under standardized baselines remains necessary.

name: Decipher-MR
summary: Decipher-MR 明确采用 8³ patch 的 3D ViT-Base、DINOv2/iBOT 视觉预训练、PubMedBERT MLM，再做器官感知的 MRI-report CLIP 对齐。
summary_en: 3D MRI vision–language foundation model combining an 8³-patch 3D ViT-Base (pretrained via 3D DINOv2/iBOT) with PubMedBERT MLM and organ-aware MRI–report CLIP alignment.

nodes.label: 3D MRI series
nodes.description: 跨器官、序列和病理；预处理后形成可变尺寸体积
nodes.description_en: Ingests 3d mri series volume + paired study-level organ-parsed radiology report text and prepares initial tensor representations (3D MRI series).

nodes.label: 8×8×8 volume patches
nodes.description: 非重叠子体积线性投影；三线性位置插值支持不同尺寸
nodes.description_en: Executes 8×8×8 volume patches to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: 3D ViT-Base student
nodes.description: 86M 参数、768 维视觉 encoder
nodes.description_en: Performs 3D ViT-Base student within the core organ aware 3d vit mri report clip computation pathway.

nodes.label: EMA teacher + iBOT
nodes.description: 图像级多裁剪自蒸馏和遮挡 patch 预测联合预训练
nodes.description_en: Performs EMA teacher + iBOT within the core organ aware 3d vit mri report clip computation pathway.

nodes.label: 器官级 MRI 报告
nodes.description: 清洗后提取与当前器官相关的描述和结论
nodes.description_en: Performs organ MRI within the core organ aware 3d vit mri report clip computation pathway.

nodes.label: PubMedBERT text encoder
nodes.description: 先在 MRI 报告上以 MLM 继续预训练
nodes.description_en: Performs PubMedBERT text encoder within the core organ aware 3d vit mri report clip computation pathway.

nodes.label: 双线性投影到 512 维
nodes.description: 视觉和文本 [CLS] 映射到共享空间
nodes.description_en: Performs projection 512 within the core organ aware 3d vit mri report clip computation pathway.

nodes.label: Image-report contrastive stage
nodes.description: 同 study series/report 为正，器官内采样硬负并避免同 study 假负
nodes.description_en: Applies Image-report contrastive stage to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: 冻结 encoder + 轻量 decoder
nodes.description: 分类、回归、检索、分割和定位任务
nodes.description_en: Produces 512-d shared 3d mri–text embedding and frozen 3d visual features for lightweight downstream decoders via encoder + decoder.

paper.title: Decipher-MR: A Vision-Language Foundation Model for 3D MRI Representations

paper_figure.label: Figure 1 with enlarged Figure 1(b) · PDF p.3
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 3D MRI 标签稀缺且传统视觉预训练难吸收放射学语义
keypoints.核心想法: 先以 DINOv2 式视觉自监督学习 3D MRI 表示，再做 report-guided contrastive alignment
keypoints.关键改进: 在约 200000 个 MRI series、22000 余个 studies 上连接体积级视觉 token、多序列 MRI 与临床文本
keypoints.医学适配: 用于 3D MRI 检索、分类和跨任务迁移
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 新近 3D 医学 VLM；数据覆盖、文本泄漏和独立复现仍需检验，专属预训练代码/权重未开放

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: 3D MRI lacks massive manual labels, while naive global report alignment ignores which series or organ corresponds to which report sentence.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Pretrain a 3D ViT via self-distillation on ~200,000 MRI series, then align series embeddings with organ-parsed radiology report segments.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Native 8×8×8 3D patch ViT + 3D DINOv2/iBOT visual SSL + organ-gated cross-modal contrastive learning.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Supports zero-shot 3D MRI retrieval, disease classification, and label-efficient segmentation/grading across organs.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Recent 3D MRI VLM preprint; pretraining weights/code are not fully public, requiring independent verification.

name: Noise2Void
summary: Noise2Void 通过输入操纵构造 blind spot，只从单张 noisy 图像回归其被隐藏中心，而非需要成对噪声或 clean target。
summary_en: Implements practical single-image blind-spot denoising by randomly masking center pixels via neighborhood replacement so a standard U-Net predicts held-out pixels.

nodes.label: 单张 noisy image
nodes.description: 不需要 clean target 或重复采集
nodes.description_en: Ingests single noisy image (with random center pixels replaced by neighboring values during training) and prepares initial tensor representations (noisy image).

nodes.label: 随机像素采样
nodes.description: 选择少量中心像素作为本轮监督位置
nodes.description_en: Executes pixel sampling to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: Blind-spot manipulation
nodes.description: 把中心值替换为邻域随机值，使网络不能复制目标像素
nodes.description_en: Performs Blind-spot manipulation within the core single image blind spot denoising computation pathway.

nodes.label: CNN/U-Net denoiser
nodes.description: 仅从周围空间上下文预测被替换中心
nodes.description_en: Performs CNN/U-Net denoiser within the core single image blind spot denoising computation pathway.

nodes.label: 采样位置回归损失
nodes.description: 输出与原 noisy 中心值比较，未采样像素不计损失
nodes.description_en: Performs sampling loss within the core single image blind spot denoising computation pathway.

nodes.label: 全图普通前向
nodes.description: 推理时不再替换像素，网络一次输出所有位置
nodes.description_en: Applies Stage 06 to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: 去噪图像
nodes.description: 估计由邻域条件决定的 clean signal
nodes.description_en: Produces denoised image estimate x̂ from a single forward pass via Denoised Image.

paper.title: Noise2Void - Learning Denoising From Single Noisy Images

paper_figure.label: Figures 2 and 3 · PDF pp.4 and 5
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 监督去噪需要干净目标，Noise2Noise 仍需独立噪声配对
keypoints.核心想法: 通过 blind-spot 预测遮挡中心像素，仅用单张噪声图像训练去噪网络
keypoints.关键改进: 利用条件独立、零均值噪声假设从同一图像构造自监督目标
keypoints.医学适配: 用于显微、低剂量和无法重复采集的医学图像去噪
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 自监督去噪经典方法；结构化噪声和相关噪声会违反假设

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Exact J-invariant mask-by-mask forward passes were computationally slow, while supervised denoising required unavailable clean targets.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Create a receptive-field blind spot via a simple input masking scheme (replacing target pixels with a random neighbor) so gradients flow only through surrounding context.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Efficient multi-pixel blind-spot training recipe applicable to any standard U-Net without paired or clean training data.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Widely used in biomedical microscopy, OCT speckle reduction, and single-acquisition low-dose imaging.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Classic self-supervised denoiser; structured/correlated noise violates pixel-wise independence and gets preserved as signal.

name: RED-Net
summary: 相较普通 autoencoder，RED-Net 在每个镜像卷积—反卷积层之间建立对称加法 skip，而不只保留少数 U-Net 尺度跳连。
summary_en: Deep symmetric convolutional–deconvolutional autoencoder connected by layer-by-layer additive residual skip connections at every mirrored depth.

nodes.label: 退化图像
nodes.description: 去噪、去块或超分等恢复输入
nodes.description_en: Ingests noisy, blurry, or low-dose degraded image and prepares initial tensor representations (Stage 01).

nodes.label: 深卷积 encoder
nodes.description: 连续卷积与 ReLU 扩大感受野并压缩局部信息
nodes.description_en: Executes convolution encoder to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: 深层语义特征
nodes.description: 包含退化上下文但细节传递路径较长
nodes.description_en: Performs feature within the core symmetric conv deconv residual autoencoder computation pathway.

nodes.label: 镜像反卷积 decoder
nodes.description: 逐层重建空间分辨率与图像结构
nodes.description_en: Performs transposed convolution decoder within the core symmetric conv deconv residual autoencoder computation pathway.

nodes.label: 对称 skip additions
nodes.description: encoder 第 i 层直接加到镜像 decoder 层，传递边缘并改善梯度
nodes.description_en: Performs symmetric skip additions within the core symmetric conv deconv residual autoencoder computation pathway.

nodes.label: 重建层
nodes.description: 融合深层上下文和浅层高频特征
nodes.description_en: Applies reconstruction to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: 恢复图像
nodes.description: 以像素级监督训练的最终输出
nodes.description_en: Produces restored clean image recovered via multi-depth additive residual shortcuts via Stage 07.

paper.title: Image Restoration Using Very Deep Convolutional Encoder-Decoder Networks with Symmetric Skip Connections

paper_figure.label: Figures 1 and 2 · PDF pp.3 and 4
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 早期浅层去噪/超分模型感受野有限，深层编解码器易丢局部信息
keypoints.核心想法: 深卷积 encoder-decoder 通过对称 skip 连接重建高频图像细节
keypoints.关键改进: 把卷积与反卷积层镜像连接，改善梯度和细节传递
keypoints.医学适配: 启发 CT/MRI 去噪、低剂量恢复和残差式重建网络
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 历史恢复基线；缺显式成像物理与现代注意力建模

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Deep convolutional autoencoders lost fine spatial details through bottleneck compression and suffered from vanishing gradients.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Pair every convolutional encoding layer with a mirrored deconvolutional decoding layer linked by an element-wise additive residual skip.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Preserves full spatial resolution options and shortens backpropagation paths across 10–30+ layer restoration autoencoders.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Popularized residual encoder–decoder (RED-CNN) architectures as a primary baseline for low-dose CT image-domain denoising.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Historically influential in low-dose CT denoising; purely image-domain L2 training can still over-smooth low-contrast liver lesions.

name: SwinIR
summary: SwinIR 把多个带卷积残差的 RSTB 置于浅层卷积和任务重建头之间，以移窗注意力服务高分辨率恢复。
summary_en: Sandwiches multiple Residual Swin Transformer Blocks (RSTBs, each ending in a 3×3 convolutional residual) between a shallow CNN extractor and a reconstruction head.

nodes.label: 退化图像
nodes.description: 任务不同但共享主干接口
nodes.description_en: Ingests low-resolution, noisy, or artifact-corrupted image and prepares initial tensor representations (Stage 01).

nodes.label: Shallow Conv
nodes.description: 提取低频基础特征并建立长残差支路
nodes.description_en: Executes Shallow Conv to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: Residual Swin Transformer Blocks
nodes.description: 每个 RSTB 含多层 shifted-window attention、MLP 与块内卷积残差
nodes.description_en: Performs Residual Swin Transformer Blocks within the core residual swin transformer restoration computation pathway.

nodes.label: Window/shifted-window attention
nodes.description: 窗口内建模，交替移窗让相邻窗口通信
nodes.description_en: Performs Window/shifted-window attention within the core residual swin transformer restoration computation pathway.

nodes.label: Deep feature fusion
nodes.description: 多个 RSTB 后卷积并与浅层特征相加
nodes.description_en: Performs Deep feature fusion within the core residual swin transformer restoration computation pathway.

nodes.label: 任务特定重建 head
nodes.description: 超分用 pixel-shuffle/上采样；去噪与去伪影用卷积输出
nodes.description_en: Applies reconstruction head to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: 恢复图像
nodes.description: 与输入同尺寸或按设定倍率放大
nodes.description_en: Produces super-resolved, denoised, or artifact-restored high-resolution image via Stage 07.

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: CNN 恢复网络局部感受野限制长程依赖，全局 attention 成本过高
keypoints.核心想法: 以浅层卷积、深层残差 Swin blocks 和重建 head 统一多类图像恢复
keypoints.关键改进: 用 shifted-window attention 在高分辨率下高效建模非局部结构
keypoints.医学适配: 常用于低剂量 CT、MRI、显微图像去噪与超分辨率迁移
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 强恢复 backbone；未显式保证数据一致性或病灶保真

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Pure CNN restoration networks had content-independent local kernels, while naive ViTs lost fine pixel boundaries and translation equivariance.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Combine local shifted-window self-attention (for content-adaptive long-range self-similarity) with residual convolutional layers for translational stability.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Shallow feature CNN + deep RSTB cascade + long global skip connection achieving state-of-the-art PSNR across restoration benchmarks.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Widely adopted backbone for MRI super-resolution, low-dose CT/PET denoising, and microscopy image restoration.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Strong modern restoration backbone; remains an image-space mapping unless embedded inside an unrolled physics data-consistency loop.

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 标准自注意力对像素数呈二次复杂度，难处理大图
keypoints.核心想法: 用通道维 transposed attention 和门控深度卷积前馈网络恢复高分辨率图像
keypoints.关键改进: 在线性空间复杂度下兼顾全局通道交互与局部空间建模
keypoints.医学适配: 适合高分辨率病理、CT/MRI 去噪和运动伪影校正
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 高效 restoration 基线；医学成像算子和不确定性仍需额外约束

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Even windowed spatial self-attention restricted receptive fields or incurred heavy memory overhead on megapixel medical scans.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Compute cross-covariance attention across feature channels (C×C instead of HW×HW) after applying 3×3 depthwise convolutions for local spatial context.
keypoints_en.关键改进: O(HW · C²) linear spatial scaling via MDTA + element-wise gated depthwise convolutional FFN controlling fine detail propagation.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Well-suited for high-resolution digital pathology restoration, whole-slice MRI motion correction, and low-dose CT denoising.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Compute-efficient high-resolution Transformer restorer; must be audited for quantitative intensity preservation.

name: AUTOMAP

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 传统重建需手工推导逆算子且难联合优化所有处理步骤
keypoints.核心想法: 以全连接域变换层加卷积网络端到端学习测量域到图像域映射
keypoints.关键改进: 首次展示跨 MRI、CT 等成像问题直接学习重建映射的统一思路
keypoints.医学适配: 奠定端到端医学重建范式并推动 learned reconstruction
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 历史里程碑；全连接层参数巨大、算子迁移和物理一致性较弱

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Conventional pipelines treated Fourier/Radon inversion as fixed analytical steps separate from downstream denoising.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Frame tomographic reconstruction as a data-driven manifold mapping between sensor and image domains parameterized by dense fully connected layers.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Unified end-to-end neural domain transformation across arbitrary k-space trajectories and projection geometries on small grids.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Historically provocative demonstration of learned sensor-to-image inversion in low-resolution MRI and PET.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Historical curiosity rather than a scalable baseline: O(N⁴) fully connected parameters cannot scale to clinical 512²/3D grids and discard known Fourier/Radon physics.

name: LEARN
summary: LEARN 每个展开阶段并行计算 CT 数据梯度和 learned experts CNN 正则梯度，再做残差更新。
summary_en: Unrolls K iterative sparse-view CT reconstruction stages where each stage combines an explicit projection residual gradient A^T(Ax^t − y) with a stage-specific 3-layer CNN regularizer.

nodes.label: 稀疏投影 y
nodes.description: 校准与对数变换后的 CT measurement
nodes.description_en: Ingests sparse-view ct sinogram y, system projection matrix a / backprojection a^t, and initial image x^0 and prepares initial tensor representations (projection y).

nodes.description_en: Performs reconstruction x0 within the core unrolled ct gradient expert cascade computation pathway.

nodes.label: 阶段特异 3-layer CNN

nodes.description_en: Performs 3-layer CNN within the core unrolled ct gradient expert cascade computation pathway.

nodes.label: 残差迭代更新

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: FBP 后处理忽略投影域一致性，传统迭代正则设计耗时且手工
keypoints.核心想法: 把 CT 数据保真梯度和学习到的正则梯度交替展开为固定阶段网络
keypoints.关键改进: 显式嵌入系统矩阵并学习每阶段正则更新，实现端到端 sparse-view CT
keypoints.医学适配: 是 CT model-based deep learning 和 unrolling 的早期代表
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 仍具方法论价值；固定几何和训练分布限制跨扫描器泛化

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Post-processing FBP ignored sinogram data consistency, while classical Fields-of-Experts required slow iterative convergence.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Unfold a fixed number of gradient descent steps on a variational CT objective, replacing hand-crafted regularizer gradients with stage-specific 3-layer CNNs.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Direct integration of CT projection/backprojection operators into an end-to-end trainable unrolled residual cascade.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Early foundational milestone for model-based deep learning in sparse-view and low-dose CT reconstruction.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Methodologically important unrolled CT baseline; fixed system matrices and stage-specific parameters require significant memory.

name: DDNM
summary: DDNM 用 A†y 固定 range-space 信息，只让 diffusion denoiser 生成 null-space 分量。
summary_en: Decomposes reverse diffusion intermediate estimates x̂_{0|t} via the Moore–Penrose pseudoinverse A† into a fixed measurement range-space component A†y and a generated null-space component (I − A†A)x̂_{0|t}.

nodes.label: 测量 y 与算子 A
nodes.description: 超分、修复、去模糊、压缩感知等线性逆问题
nodes.description_en: Ingests linear measurement y = ax + n, known operator a with pseudoinverse a†, and a pretrained unconditional diffusion model and prepares initial tensor representations (y A).

nodes.label: 扩散状态 xt
nodes.description: 从高斯噪声开始的逆扩散变量
nodes.description_en: Executes xt to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: 预训练 diffusion denoiser
nodes.description: 无任务再训练地从 xt 估计 clean x0|t
nodes.description_en: Performs pretraining diffusion denoiser within the core range null space decomposed diffusion computation pathway.

nodes.label: A† 范围空间锚点
nodes.description: A†y 给出由测量确定的解分量
nodes.description_en: Performs A† range space within the core range null space decomposed diffusion computation pathway.

nodes.label: 零空间投影
nodes.description: (I−A†A)x0|t 保留生成先验只能在 null space 补充的分量
nodes.description_en: Performs null space projection within the core range null space decomposed diffusion computation pathway.

nodes.label: x̂0|t 数据一致估计
nodes.description: A†y+(I−A†A)x0|t；含噪版按噪声方差调整
nodes.description_en: Performs x̂0|t within the core range null space decomposed diffusion computation pathway.

nodes.label: DDPM 逆步更新
nodes.description: 由校正的 clean estimate 采样下一时间步
nodes.description_en: Applies DDPM update to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: 零样本恢复结果
nodes.description: 循环到 t=0 得到一个或多个可行样本
nodes.description_en: Produces zero-shot restored image satisfying a x̂ = y while filling null-space details via the diffusion prior via zero-shot.

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 通用扩散先验直接采样不满足观测，任务专用训练成本高
keypoints.核心想法: 把扩散采样分解为满足线性测量的范围空间部分与可生成的零空间部分
keypoints.关键改进: 利用伪逆投影在每步注入数据一致性，实现零样本多退化恢复
keypoints.医学适配: 可用于 MRI、CT、去模糊和缺失数据的扩散逆问题研究
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 零样本基线重要；依赖已知线性算子与准确噪声模型

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Unconditional diffusion samples violate measurement constraints, whereas backpropagating likelihood gradients through U-Nets (DPS) is memory-heavy.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Directly replace the range-space component of each step's denoised estimate x̂_{0|t} with A†y, leaving the diffusion model to synthesize only the null-space component.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Backpropagation-free zero-shot linear inverse solver with a noise-aware extension (DDNM+) handling additive measurement noise.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Used in zero-shot MRI reconstruction, sparse CT restoration, super-resolution, and inpainting.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Clean mathematical decomposition of range vs. null space; highlights directly that null-space anatomy is synthesized purely by the prior.

name: RealNVP
summary: RealNVP 以三角 Jacobian 的 affine coupling 获得同时精确可逆、可采样且可算 log-likelihood 的映射。
summary_en: Constructs an exactly invertible normalizing flow using stacked affine coupling layers whose triangular Jacobians permit O(D) log-determinant and exact likelihood evaluation.

nodes.description_en: Performs s,t conditioner within the core affine coupling exact likelihood flow computation pathway.

nodes.description: ya=xa；yb=xb·exp(s(xa))+t(xa)，可显式求逆
nodes.description_en: Performs Affine coupling within the core affine coupling exact likelihood flow computation pathway.

paper.title: Density Estimation Using Real NVP

paper_figure.label: Figures 2 and 4 · PDF pp.4, 6
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 一般生成网络缺精确似然，早期 flow 的可扩展性和可逆设计有限
keypoints.核心想法: 用仿射 coupling layers 构造可逆网络并精确计算 log-determinant
keypoints.关键改进: 通过三角 Jacobian 实现高效双向变换、采样与精确密度估计
keypoints.医学适配: 用于医学图像生成、异常检测和可逆重建先验
keypoints.适用范围与证据: normalizing flow 基础；coupling 表达受限且高维似然未必对应临床异常

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: GANs and VAEs lacked exact tractable likelihood evaluation, while autoregressive density models were slow to sample.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Split dimensions in each coupling layer so half remain unchanged while scaling and translating the other half via unconstrained neural networks s(·), t(·).
keypoints_en.关键改进: Triangular Jacobian with closed-form sum-of-logs determinant + exact single-pass forward density estimation and inverse sampling.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Applied to invertible medical image priors, exact-likelihood out-of-distribution detection, and bijective registration.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Foundational normalizing flow; coupling layers require deep stacking for expressivity and raw pixel likelihoods often mis-score semantic OOD anomalies.

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: RealNVP 固定通道置换限制特征混合，深层训练初始化不稳
keypoints.核心想法: 在多尺度 flow 中用 actnorm、可逆 1×1 卷积和仿射 coupling 学习精确似然
keypoints.关键改进: 可学习可逆通道混合与数据依赖归一化提升生成质量
keypoints.医学适配: 常作医学 normalizing-flow 生成和异常检测结构基础
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 经典 flow 架构；内存与似然语义问题限制临床直接应用

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Fixed channel permutations in RealNVP restricted cross-channel mixing, and small-batch flow training suffered from activation instability.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Replace fixed channel reversals with a learnable invertible 1×1 convolution and stabilize deep flow training via data-dependent ActNorm.
keypoints_en.关键改进: ActNorm (scale/bias per channel) + LU-factored invertible 1×1 convolution reducing log-det cost from O(C³) to O(C).
keypoints_en.医学适配: Used as an exact-likelihood generative prior for medical inverse problems and unsupervised brain MRI anomaly scoring.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Classic flow milestone; bijective dimensionality preservation makes high-resolution 3D flows memory-intensive compared to latent diffusion.

nodes.description_en: Applies Poisson flow ODE to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: 生成样本
nodes.description: 落回数据超平面得到 x
nodes.description_en: Produces samples generated by integrating the learned augmented electric field ode back to the z=0 hyperplane via Synthesized Sample.

paper.title: PFGM++: Unlocking the Potential of Physics-Inspired Generative Models

paper_figure.label: Figure 1 · PDF p.2
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 原始 PFGM 与 diffusion 的关系和可扩展调节机制不清
keypoints.核心想法: 在增广空间用高维电场/Poisson flow 连接数据分布与简单先验
keypoints.关键改进: 以增广维度 D 连续统一 Poisson flow 与 diffusion，并改善鲁棒性和采样
keypoints.医学适配: 提供医学生成与逆问题的新型 score/flow 先验选择
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 有理论吸引力但医学实证有限；仍需与强 diffusion 公平比较

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Diffusion models rely on Gaussian kernels with thin tails, whereas original PFGM (D=1) was difficult to scale to large conditional architectures.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Generalize the augmented electrostatic dimension from D=1 to arbitrary D, proving that as D→∞ and r=σ√D, the Poisson kernel converges to Gaussian diffusion.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Provides a tunable robustness–rigidity knob D (e.g., D=64 or 2048) that improves ODE integration stability and error tolerance over standard EDM diffusion.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Evaluated on low-dose CT denoising and medical image generation as a more perturbation-robust drop-in alternative to score models.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Theoretically elegant unification of electrostatic flows and diffusion; clinical adoption remains at an early research stage.

name: SiT
summary: SiT 将 DiT 放入 stochastic interpolant 框架，用统一模型显式比较 velocity、score 和 diffusion 参数化。
summary_en: Places the Diffusion Transformer (DiT) backbone inside a continuous-time Stochastic Interpolant framework to systematically decouple interpolation schedules, model targets, and samplers.

nodes.label: 数据与噪声端点
nodes.description: x0 来自数据，ε 来自简单高斯先验
nodes.description_en: Ingests data sample x_0 (or latent), gaussian noise ε, continuous time t ∈ [0,1], and conditioning label c and prepares initial tensor representations (noise).

nodes.label: Stochastic interpolant xt
nodes.description: 由 α(t)x0、σ(t)ε 与可选随机项定义连续概率路径
nodes.description_en: Executes Stochastic interpolant xt to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: Patch/time/condition embedding
nodes.description: 把 xt 切成 token，并加入时间和类别条件
nodes.description_en: Performs Patch/time/condition embedding within the core scalable stochastic interpolant transformer computation pathway.

nodes.label: Scalable Interpolant Transformer
nodes.description: DiT 式 AdaLN 条件 Transformer 建模全局 token 交互
nodes.description_en: Performs Scalable Interpolant Transformer within the core scalable stochastic interpolant transformer computation pathway.

nodes.label: v/score/noise prediction head
nodes.description: 根据参数化选择输出 velocity、score 或 noise
nodes.description_en: Performs v/score/noise prediction head within the core scalable stochastic interpolant transformer computation pathway.

nodes.label: 加权 interpolant loss
nodes.description: 路径、预测参数化与时间权重可独立选择
nodes.description_en: Performs interpolant loss within the core scalable stochastic interpolant transformer computation pathway.

nodes.label: Probability-flow ODE / SDE solver
nodes.description: 从噪声端沿预测场积分到数据端
nodes.description_en: Applies Probability-flow ODE / SDE solver to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: 生成样本
nodes.description: 可配 classifier-free guidance
nodes.description_en: Produces samples generated via configurable deterministic ode or stochastic sde integrators from the same sit backbone via Synthesized Sample.

paper.title: SiT: Exploring Flow and Diffusion-Based Generative Models with Scalable Interpolant Transformers

paper_figure.label: Table 1 · PDF p.2
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 扩散与流匹配实现分散，目标和采样路径的关系难系统比较
keypoints.核心想法: 以 stochastic interpolants 统一 diffusion 与 flow objectives，并用 Transformer 扩展生成
keypoints.关键改进: 在统一连续时间框架中选择插值、预测参数化和损失权重
keypoints.医学适配: 适合比较医学 latent/3D diffusion 与 flow matching 的训练设计
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 生成建模重要统一视角；医学保真和逆问题证据仍早期

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Comparisons between diffusion and flow matching conflated backbone architecture (U-Net vs. DiT), noise schedules, and ODE vs. SDE sampling.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Use the Scalable Interpolant Transformer (SiT) to modularly ablate path interpolants (linear vs. trig), prediction targets (velocity vs. score), and diffusion coefficients.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Demonstrates that linear stochastic interpolants with velocity prediction and tunable SDE diffusion coefficients consistently outperform rigid DDPM schedules.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Provides a clean modern recipe for training 2D/3D medical latent transformers across both ODE flow and SDE diffusion regimes.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Important unifying generative framework; medical inverse-problem conditioning and quantitative audits remain active extensions.

name: LapIRN
summary: LapIRN 把配准写成 Laplacian 金字塔上的三层残差流：每层先 warp，再让下一层只修正剩余误差。
summary_en: Decomposes large-deformation 3D registration into a 3-level coarse-to-fine Laplacian image pyramid where each level warps the previous estimate and refines only the residual displacement.

nodes.label: Moving/fixed 图像金字塔
nodes.description: 建立低、中、高分辨率三层输入
nodes.description_en: Ingests 3d moving volume i_m and fixed volume i_f decomposed into a 3-level gaussian/laplacian pyramid and prepares initial tensor representations (Moving/fixed).

nodes.label: Level 1 coarse network
nodes.description: 在最低分辨率预测大尺度位移 φ1
nodes.description_en: Executes Level 1 coarse network to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: Spatial transformer 1
nodes.description: 用上采样 φ1 先形变 moving，作为下一层初始化
nodes.description_en: Performs Spatial transformer 1 within the core laplacian pyramid residual registration computation pathway.

nodes.label: Level 2 residual network
nodes.description: 结合中尺度 fixed、已形变 moving 与粗场，预测残差 Δφ2
nodes.description_en: Performs Level 2 residual network within the core laplacian pyramid residual registration computation pathway.

nodes.label: Spatial transformer 2
nodes.description: 组合粗场和中尺度残差后再次形变
nodes.description_en: Performs Spatial transformer 2 within the core laplacian pyramid residual registration computation pathway.

nodes.label: Level 3 refinement network
nodes.description: 在全分辨率预测局部残差 Δφ3
nodes.description_en: Performs Level 3 refinement network within the core laplacian pyramid residual registration computation pathway.

nodes.label: 无监督相似度 + 平滑正则
nodes.description: 每层比较 warped moving 与 fixed，并约束位移梯度；diffeomorphic 版可积分速度场
nodes.description_en: Applies unsupervised + regularization to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: 最终组合形变
nodes.description: φ1、Δφ2、Δφ3 逐级组合并输出配准图像
nodes.description_en: Produces composed full-resolution deformation field (or stationary velocity diffeomorphism) and warped volume via Stage 08.

paper.title: Laplacian Pyramid Networks for Fast Deformable Registration of Large Deformation

paper_figure.label: Figure 1 · PDF p.3
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 单尺度配准捕获范围有限，大形变时易落入局部最优
keypoints.核心想法: 在由粗到细的图像金字塔上逐级预测并组合位移场
keypoints.关键改进: 每级以前一级形变为初始化，兼顾大位移捕获和局部精化
keypoints.医学适配: 用于 3D 脑、腹部和胸部 CT/MRI 快速无监督配准
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 经典 coarse-to-fine 学习式基线；可逆性与拓扑保持仍需额外约束

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Single-scale 3D registration networks failed on large respiratory or inter-subject displacements due to local minima and limited receptive fields.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Solve registration progressively from 1/4 → 1/2 → 1/1 resolution using feature-skip pyramid networks that predict incremental residual warps.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Coarse-to-fine residual warping + warm-start curriculum training + optional scaling-and-squaring diffeomorphic parameterization.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Widely used benchmark baseline for large-deformation lung CT inspiration–expiration and brain MRI registration.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Classic multi-scale registration architecture; subsequent GradICON/uniGradICON offer stronger inverse-consistency guarantees.

name: TransMorph
summary: TransMorph 用层级 Swin encoder 取代纯 CNN 配准编码器，同时保留 U-Net 式 decoder 和可微 warping。
summary_en: Replaces the convolutional encoder in VoxelMorph with a 3D hierarchical Swin Transformer encoder while retaining a convolutional U-Net decoder and Spatial Transformer warping.

nodes.label: Moving/fixed pair
nodes.description: 按通道拼接的 2D 或 3D 医学图像
nodes.description_en: Ingests concatenated 3d moving and fixed volumes (i_m, i_f) and prepares initial tensor representations (Moving/fixed pair).

nodes.label: Patch partition/embedding
nodes.description: 将图像对变为层级视觉 token
nodes.description_en: Executes Patch partition/embedding to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: Swin Transformer encoder
nodes.description: 窗口与 shifted-window attention 建模局部和长程对应
nodes.description_en: Performs Swin Transformer encoder within the core swin transformer hybrid registration computation pathway.

nodes.label: 多尺度 Transformer features
nodes.description: patch merging 产生不同分辨率的对应线索
nodes.description_en: Performs multi-scale Transformer features within the core swin transformer hybrid registration computation pathway.

nodes.label: U-Net 式卷积 decoder
nodes.description: 逐级上采样并融合 encoder skip features
nodes.description_en: Performs U-Net convolution decoder within the core swin transformer hybrid registration computation pathway.

nodes.label: Displacement field head
nodes.description: 卷积输出每体素位移向量 φ
nodes.description_en: Performs Displacement field head within the core swin transformer hybrid registration computation pathway.

nodes.label: Spatial transformer
nodes.description: 以可微插值计算 Im∘φ
nodes.description_en: Performs Spatial transformer within the core swin transformer hybrid registration computation pathway.

nodes.label: NCC/相似度 + 平滑正则
nodes.description: 无需真实形变标签；可扩展 diffeomorphic 或 Bayesian 版本
nodes.description_en: Applies NCC/ + regularization to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: 配准结果
nodes.description: 稠密场、warped image 和可选 uncertainty
nodes.description_en: Produces dense 3d displacement field φ, warped moving image i_m ∘ φ, and optional bayesian uncertainty via Registered Output.

paper.title: TransMorph: Transformer for Unsupervised Medical Image Registration

paper_figure.label: Figure 1 · PDF p.4
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: CNN 配准局部感受野难处理远距离解剖对应
keypoints.核心想法: 用 Swin Transformer 编码固定/移动图像的长程对应，再由卷积 decoder 输出形变
keypoints.关键改进: 层级窗口注意力结合 U-Net 式多尺度解码增强全局匹配
keypoints.医学适配: 成为脑 MRI 和腹部 CT Transformer 配准的常用基线
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 重要架构基线；长程 attention 本身不保证拓扑、对称或跨域稳健

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Small 3×3×3 CNN kernels in early encoder stages struggled to establish long-range spatial correspondence across large anatomical displacements.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Leverage 3D Swin Transformer blocks in the encoder to capture larger effective receptive fields for cross-volume matching.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Hybrid 3D Swin encoder + CNN skip decoder + diffeomorphic/Bayesian variants benchmarked across brain MRI and CT.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Standard Transformer-based 3D medical image registration baseline.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Important architectural comparison point; attention in the encoder does not automatically prevent folding without GradICON/diffeomorphic constraints.

name: IDIR
summary: IDIR 将位移场本身作为坐标神经场，并在测试图像对上直接优化，而不是由训练好的网络一次预测 flow。
summary_en: Parameterizes the continuous 3D deformation field φ(x) = x + u_θ(x) for a single image pair directly as a coordinate-based Implicit Neural Representation (SIREN MLP) optimized at test time.

nodes.label: Fixed 与 moving 图像
nodes.description: 每一对病例单独优化，不需要跨病例预训练
nodes.description_en: Ingests continuous 3d spatial coordinates x ∈ [-1,1]³ sampled over a fixed/moving volume pair (i_f, i_m) and prepares initial tensor representations (Fixed moving).

nodes.label: 连续坐标采样
nodes.description: 从归一化 2D/3D 空间采样 x
nodes.description_en: Executes continuous sampling to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: 坐标/傅里叶特征
nodes.description: 可将 x 映射到更高频的位置表示
nodes.description_en: Performs feature within the core implicit coordinate mlp registration computation pathway.

nodes.label: Implicit coordinate MLP
nodes.description: 以 θ 表示连续函数 x→uθ(x)
nodes.description_en: Performs Implicit coordinate MLP within the core implicit coordinate mlp registration computation pathway.

nodes.label: 坐标变换 x+uθ(x)
nodes.description: 将 fixed 网格映射到 moving 采样位置
nodes.description_en: Performs x+uθ(x within the core implicit coordinate mlp registration computation pathway.

nodes.label: 可微 moving interpolator
nodes.description: 在变换坐标处查询 moving 强度
nodes.description_en: Performs differentiable moving interpolator within the core implicit coordinate mlp registration computation pathway.

nodes.label: 图像相似度 + 形变正则
nodes.description: 逐病例反向传播更新 θ，可加 Jacobian、hyperelastic 或 bending 约束
nodes.description_en: Applies + regularization to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: 连续形变场
nodes.description: 优化后可在任意分辨率查询并生成 warped image
nodes.description_en: Produces resolution-independent continuous deformation field φ_θ(x) with exact autograd spatial derivatives via continuous deformation field.

paper.title: Implicit Neural Representations for Deformable Image Registration

paper_figure.label: Figure 1 · PDF p.2
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 离散位移网格受分辨率限制，学习式配准受训练分布约束
keypoints.核心想法: 以坐标 MLP 连续表示单对图像的位移场，并按相似度逐病例优化
keypoints.关键改进: 连续可微形变表示无需预训练，可在任意坐标查询并正则化
keypoints.医学适配: 用于 MRI/CT 个体化配准和连续形变建模
keypoints.适用范围与证据: INR 配准代表；逐病例优化较慢且相似度仍可能歧义

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Discrete voxel-grid registration is tied to grid resolution, relies on finite-difference derivative approximations, and suffers from training-cohort bias.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Represent the displacement vector field u_θ(x) as a periodic-activation coordinate MLP optimized directly on the test pair via stochastic coordinate sampling.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Grid-free continuous parameterization + exact analytical Jacobian/hyperelastic/bending-energy derivatives via automatic differentiation.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Used for high-precision lung 4D-CT landmark tracking and patient-specific registration without training datasets.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Representative implicit neural registration method; per-case optimization takes seconds to minutes rather than milliseconds.

name: DeepDRR
summary: DeepDRR 不是纯 GAN 渲染器，而是 3D 材料分解网络、解析材料/能谱 ray tracing、学习散射和解析噪声的组合 forward model。
summary_en: Physics-based X-ray fluoroscopy simulator combining CNN 3D tissue material decomposition, analytical energy-dependent Beer–Lambert ray-casting, learned Rayleigh/Compton scatter, and quantum noise.

nodes.label: CT volume
nodes.description: HU 体积与可选器械/植入物模型
nodes.description_en: Ingests volumetric 3d ct scan, c-arm source–detector geometry, x-ray spectrum e, and photon flux and prepares initial tensor representations (CT volume).

nodes.label: 成像几何与能谱
nodes.description: 源、探测器、姿态、像素尺寸和 X-ray spectrum
nodes.description_en: Executes Stage 02 to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: 3D material-decomposition V-Net
nodes.description: 把 CT 分成空气、软组织和骨等材料概率/体积
nodes.description_en: Performs 3D material-decomposition V-Net within the core physics informed deep drr simulator computation pathway.

nodes.label: 材料与能谱感知 ray tracer
nodes.description: 按 Beer–Lambert 衰减积分计算 primary projection 和 beam hardening
nodes.description_en: Performs ray tracer within the core physics informed deep drr simulator computation pathway.

nodes.label: 2D neural scatter estimator
nodes.description: 从 primary/相关物理量预测低频散射成分，训练靶来自 Monte Carlo
nodes.description_en: Performs 2D neural scatter estimator within the core physics informed deep drr simulator computation pathway.

nodes.label: Primary + scatter 合成
nodes.description: 在探测器域组合直接光子与散射信号
nodes.description_en: Performs Primary + scatter within the core physics informed deep drr simulator computation pathway.

nodes.label: 解析噪声注入
nodes.description: 按 photon statistics 与电子噪声生成曝光相关随机性
nodes.description_en: Applies noise to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: Realistic DeepDRR
nodes.description: 供 2D/3D 配准、器械检测和导航训练使用
nodes.description_en: Produces photorealistic synthetic fluoroscopy / digitally reconstructed radiograph (drr) with physical scatter and noise via Realistic DeepDRR.

paper.title: DeepDRR: A Catalyst for Machine Learning in Fluoroscopy-Guided Procedures

paper_figure.label: Figure 1 · PDF p.3
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 简单线积分 DRR 与真实透视在散射、噪声和设备响应上差距大
keypoints.核心想法: 结合 CT 材料分解、解析射线追踪与学习散射/噪声模型生成逼真 DRR
keypoints.关键改进: 把物理 forward model 与深度学习散射估计结合，缩小合成到真实域差
keypoints.医学适配: 为 2D/3D 配准、器械定位和术中导航生成训练数据
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 医学 X-ray 合成基础设施；仿真质量仍取决于扫描与设备标定

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Naive monochrome line-integral DRRs lacked polychromatic beam hardening, Compton scatter, and quantum noise, creating a severe sim-to-real gap.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Decompose CT voxels into air/soft-tissue/bone/metal via a 3D CNN, integrate analytical mass attenuation across energy spectra, and add CNN-estimated scatter + Poisson noise.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Hybrid physics + deep learning forward model that allows models trained purely on synthetic CT projections to transfer zero-shot to real clinical C-arm X-rays.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Foundational simulation engine for training intraoperative 2D/3D registration, surgical tool tracking, and pelvic/spinal landmark detection.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Core medical projective simulation infrastructure; fidelity still depends on CT slice thickness and accurate C-arm spectrum modeling.

name: pixelNeRF
summary: pixelNeRF 将每个 3D 点与其投影像素的 CNN 特征绑定，使 NeRF 从单场景优化器变为跨场景条件模型。
summary_en: Conditions a coordinate NeRF MLP on pixel-aligned 2D CNN feature vectors projected from 1 or a few input views, turning NeRF from a per-scene optimizer into a feed-forward cross-scene prior.

nodes.label: 带 pose 的参考图像
nodes.description: 单视图或少视图，可来自此前未见场景
nodes.description_en: Ingests 1 to k calibrated input images + query 3d point x projected into each input view's camera coordinates and prepares initial tensor representations (pose).

nodes.label: 共享 CNN image encoder
nodes.description: 为每张参考图像生成保留空间位置的特征图
nodes.description_en: Executes CNN image encoder to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: 目标射线 3D sample points
nodes.description: 沿每个目标像素射线采样 x 与 view direction d
nodes.description_en: Performs objective 3D sample points within the core pixel aligned feature conditioned nerf computation pathway.

nodes.label: 相机投影与双线性采样
nodes.description: 把 3D 点投到每张参考图，读取 pixel-aligned feature
nodes.description_en: Performs projection sampling within the core pixel aligned feature conditioned nerf computation pathway.

nodes.label: Feature-conditioned NeRF MLP
nodes.description: 联合位置编码、方向和像素特征预测 density 与 color
nodes.description_en: Performs Feature-conditioned NeRF MLP within the core pixel aligned feature conditioned nerf computation pathway.

nodes.label: 多视图 feature aggregation
nodes.description: 对各参考视图的中间特征平均/汇聚
nodes.description_en: Performs multi-view feature aggregation within the core pixel aligned feature conditioned nerf computation pathway.

nodes.label: Differentiable volume rendering
nodes.description: 按透射率和密度沿射线积分颜色
nodes.description_en: Applies Differentiable volume rendering to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: 新视角输出
nodes.description: 跨场景一次 encoder 前向后即可条件化渲染
nodes.description_en: Produces feed-forward novel-view rendering and 3d volumetric density field from sparse views via Novel-View Rendering.

paper.title: pixelNeRF: Neural Radiance Fields from One or Few Images

paper_figure.label: Figure 2 · PDF p.4
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 原始 NeRF 每个场景都需多视图和长时间优化
keypoints.核心想法: 从输入图像提取像素对齐特征并条件化 NeRF，使其跨场景推断新对象
keypoints.关键改进: 学习跨场景先验，实现单张或少量视图的前馈条件化重建
keypoints.医学适配: 启发 sparse-view X-ray、内镜和解剖场的患者先验建模
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 少视图 NeRF 基础；自然图像辐射假设不能直接替代医学投影物理

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Original NeRF had no cross-scene prior and collapsed completely when given only 1–3 input views.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Extract a spatial CNN feature pyramid from each input view, project any 3D query point x onto the 2D image planes via camera intrinsics/extrinsics, and feed the bilinearly sampled features into the NeRF MLP.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Preserves explicit projective geometry via pixel-aligned local features rather than compressing the input into a single global latent vector.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Directly inspires sparse-view dual/single X-ray to 3D CT neural field priors (e.g., PerX2CT, DIF-Net).
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Foundational few-view conditional neural field; projective feature occlusion must be adapted for transmission X-ray imaging.

name: Instant-NGP
summary: Instant-NGP 的速度来自可学习多分辨率 hash-grid encoding 和空空间跳跃，而不是更深的 NeRF MLP。
summary_en: Replaces fixed sinusoidal positional encodings with a multi-resolution hierarchy of learnable hash tables paired with a tiny fused-CUDA MLP, accelerating neural fields by 100×–1000×.

nodes.label: 坐标 x 与方向 d
nodes.description: 沿相机射线采样的连续位置和视角
nodes.description_en: Ingests continuous 3d coordinate x ∈ r³ mapped across l resolution grids via spatial hashing and prepares initial tensor representations (x d).

nodes.label: 多分辨率网格 levels
nodes.description: 从粗到细设置指数增长的 3D 网格分辨率
nodes.description_en: Executes mesh levels to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: 可学习 hash tables

paper_figure.label: Figure 3 · PDF p.4

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 坐标 MLP 的 Fourier features 训练慢，细节与速度难兼顾
keypoints.核心想法: 用多分辨率哈希网格编码坐标并以小 MLP 表示场景
keypoints.关键改进: 可学习哈希表在不同尺度存储局部特征，使 NeRF 训练缩短到秒/分钟级
keypoints.医学适配: 加速 CBCT attenuation fields、医学 INR 和配准场优化
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 高效坐标编码基础；哈希碰撞和显存参数需按医学分辨率调节

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Deep coordinate MLPs (8 layers × 256 channels) were computationally expensive to evaluate millions of times per optimization step.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Store trainable feature vectors directly in compact multi-resolution hash tables indexed by voxel corners, letting a tiny 2-layer MLP resolve hash collisions.
keypoints_en.关键改进: O(1) multi-scale hash lookup + implicit gradient-based collision resolution + occupancy grid empty-space skipping.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Core acceleration engine inside NAF (CBCT), implicit deformable registration, and real-time surgical scene neural fields.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Essential coordinate-encoding infrastructure; high-frequency hash levels can fit measurement noise if not regularized.

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 单视图到 3D 高度欠定，原始 NeRF 依赖多视图且建模可见光
keypoints.核心想法: 以 GAN 条件先验和 NeRF 式场表示从单张 X-ray 生成视角可控的 CT 投影
keypoints.关键改进: 学习跨病例生成先验并引入医学投影数据生成新视角
keypoints.医学适配: 直接任务是单 X-ray 的 3D-aware projection synthesis；数据增强与表示学习属于潜在用途
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 概念性医学 NeRF；生成投影不等价于患者真实 3D 解剖重建

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Single-view X-ray to 3D reconstruction lacked multi-view supervision, while 2D GANs could not enforce 3D viewpoint consistency.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Train a 3D-aware conditional generative radiance field on 2D X-ray projections with a multi-scale PatchGAN discriminator, then invert latent codes (z_s, z_a) from a single test X-ray.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Disentangled shape/appearance conditioning + volumetric feature rendering + test-time latent + generator fine-tuning.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Explored for single-view chest and knee X-ray 3D-aware view synthesis and data augmentation.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Conceptual proof-of-concept; synthesized projections reflect a population GAN prior rather than guaranteed patient-specific 3D tomography.

paper.title: EndoNeRF: Neural Radiance Fields for Endoscopic View Synthesis

paper_figure.label: Figure 1 · PDF p.3
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 静态 NeRF 无法处理组织形变、器械遮挡和稀疏内镜视角
keypoints.核心想法: 用可变形 NeRF 联合建模内镜场景外观、几何和手术组织动态
keypoints.关键改进: 通过时间条件形变场与遮挡掩膜合成动态手术新视角
keypoints.医学适配: 用于微创手术场景重建、导航和动态视图合成
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 动态内镜 NeRF 早期代表；拓扑变化、镜面反射和临床标定仍困难

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Robotic surgical scenes violate static NeRF assumptions due to non-rigid tissue deformation, smoke/specularities, and severe surgical instrument occlusion.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Warp 3D points at time t via a displacement MLP Δx(x, t) into a shared canonical radiance field while masking out rays occluded by surgical instruments.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Tool-mask-guided importance ray sampling + stereo depth cue supervision + canonical-plus-deformation spatiotemporal factorization.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Pioneered neural field 3D soft-tissue reconstruction for DaVinci robotic prostatectomy and minimally invasive surgery.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Landmark surgical NeRF baseline; cannot handle topological tissue cutting/resection and requires minutes of offline optimization (later accelerated by EndoGaussian).

name: GraphSAGE
summary: GraphSAGE 学的是可应用到新节点的聚合器，并用固定邻居采样实现归纳式 mini-batch GNN。

paper.title: Inductive Representation Learning on Large Graphs

paper_figure.label: Figure 1 · PDF p.2
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 谱 GCN 偏传导式且全邻居计算难扩展到新节点和大图
keypoints.核心想法: 通过采样固定数量邻居并聚合其特征生成节点嵌入
keypoints.关键改进: 可学习聚合器支持 mini-batch、归纳迁移与未见节点
keypoints.医学适配: 用于患者相似图、细胞图、血管树和大规模病理图
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 归纳 GNN 基础；邻居采样和构图偏差会直接影响医学结论

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Full-batch transductive GCNs required holding the entire graph Laplacian in memory and could not embed unseen test nodes without retraining.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Learn aggregator functions over uniformly sampled fixed-size k-hop neighborhoods while explicitly concatenating a node's own previous state with its aggregated neighborhood.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Mini-batch neighborhood sampling bounding memory footprint + explicit self-feature concatenation preserving node identity against over-smoothing.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Enables scalable inductive training on million-cell whole-slide pathology graphs and dynamic clinical EHR cohorts.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Essential scalable inductive GNN; uniform random neighbor sampling can miss rare diagnostic hub cells if degree distributions are skewed.

name: Graphormer
summary: Graphormer 不做局部消息传递堆叠，而在全局 attention logits 中显式加入最短路径和边特征偏置。
summary_en: Enables global all-pair Transformer self-attention over graphs by injecting degree centrality encodings into nodes and shortest-path spatial + edge-feature biases into attention logits.

nodes.label: Attributed graph

nodes.label: Node feature embedding

nodes.description_en: Executes Node feature embedding to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: Centrality encoding
nodes.description: 入度/出度 embedding 加到节点 token，表达节点重要性
nodes.description_en: Performs Centrality encoding within the core structural bias global graph transformer computation pathway.

nodes.label: Shortest-path spatial encoding

nodes.description_en: Performs Shortest-path spatial encoding within the core structural bias global graph transformer computation pathway.

nodes.description: 聚合最短路径上的边特征并注入节点对注意力
nodes.description_en: Performs Edge encoding within the core structural bias global graph transformer computation pathway.

nodes.description_en: Performs Virtual graph token within the core structural bias global graph transformer computation pathway.

nodes.description_en: Produces globally contextualized node representations and graph-level predictions via Graph prediction head.

paper.title: Do Transformers Really Perform Bad for Graph Representation?

paper_figure.label: Figure 1 · PDF p.3
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 普通 Transformer 忽略图拓扑，消息传递 GNN 长程传播易过平滑
keypoints.核心想法: 把最短路径距离、节点中心性和边特征作为 attention bias 注入 Transformer
keypoints.关键改进: 以结构编码让全局 self-attention 保留图归纳偏置
keypoints.医学适配: 适用于分子、细胞相互作用、脑网络和患者关系图
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 图 Transformer 代表；O(N²) 成本和拓扑构造限制大医学图扩展

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Message-passing GNNs are bounded by the 1-WL isomorphism test and suffer from over-squashing across long graph bottlenecks.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Allow every node to attend to every other node globally while encoding graph topology directly as additive biases inside the softmax attention matrix.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Centrality encoding + Shortest-Path Distance (SPD) spatial bias + multi-hop edge feature encoding along shortest paths.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Excels on molecular property prediction, drug discovery, protein structure, and compact brain region connectome graphs (~100–500 ROIs).
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Leading Graph Transformer; O(N²) all-pair attention and shortest-path computation prohibit direct application to 100,000-node WSI cell graphs.

paper.title: Voxel2Mesh: 3D Mesh Model Generation from Volumetric Data

paper_figure.label: Figure 1 · PDF p.2
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 体素分割边界台阶化且高分辨率 3D 预测内存昂贵
keypoints.核心想法: 从球形初始网格出发，用体素特征引导图卷积逐级形变和加密 mesh
keypoints.关键改进: 联合体素编码与显式 mesh 顶点/拓扑学习直接输出表面
keypoints.医学适配: 用于心脏、肝脏等器官可解释表面重建
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 医学 mesh 深度学习代表；固定拓扑难处理孔洞和复杂拓扑变化

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Voxel segmentation followed by Marching Cubes produced staircase artifacts, topological holes, and disconnected floating islands.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Sample multi-scale 3D U-Net encoder/decoder features directly at current 3D vertex coordinates and deform the mesh coarse-to-fine via GCN blocks.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Learned neighborhood voxel sampling + adaptive edge subdivision (unpooling) + normal/Laplacian/edge-length geometric regularizers.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Produces smooth, genus-zero topological meshes for liver, hippocampus, synaptic junctions, and cardiac chambers.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Strong explicit 3D surface baseline; fixed sphere topology cannot model organs with holes or variable branching without template modification.
