paper.title: Vox2Cortex: Fast Explicit Reconstruction of Cortical Surfaces from 3D MRI

paper_figure.label: Figure 3 · PDF p.4
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 传统皮层重建流程耗时且多阶段，通用 mesh 模型难满足嵌套皮层拓扑
keypoints.核心想法: 由 3D MRI 体素特征驱动多表面 mesh deformation，同时预测皮层内外表面
keypoints.关键改进: 联合 U-Net 体特征、图卷积和表面正则快速重建多层皮层
keypoints.医学适配: 用于脑 MRI white/pial cortical surface extraction
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 显式神经解剖表面强基线；异常 anatomy 与跨扫描协议仍具挑战

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Classical FreeSurfer cortical surface reconstruction required 4–8 hours of CPU optimization per scan, while voxel segmenters failed to prevent self-intersections in tight sulci.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Drive 4 coupled template meshes simultaneously through multiple Euler-like deformation steps conditioned on multi-scale 3D CNN features sampled at vertex coordinates.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Inter- and intra-surface geometric constraints preventing white/pial self-intersection + 1,000× speedup (<20 seconds vs. hours in FreeSurfer).
keypoints_en.医学适配: High-speed neuroimaging baseline for cortical thickness analysis, Alzheimer's atrophy tracking, and large biobank processing.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Domain-specialized explicit surface landmark; severe brain tumors or strokes that disrupt normal cortical topology remain challenging.

name: GRU
summary: GRU 用 reset/update 两门和单一隐藏状态完成记忆更新，结构比 LSTM 更简洁。
summary_en: Simplifies gated recurrence by merging cell and hidden states into a single vector h_t interpolated via an update gate z_t and a reset gate r_t.

nodes.label: xt 与 ht−1
nodes.description: 当前观测和历史记忆
nodes.description_en: Ingests sequential physiological or clinical feature vector x_t and previous hidden state h_{t-1} and prepares initial tensor representations (xt ht−1).

nodes.label: Reset gate rt
nodes.description: sigmoid(Wr xt+Ur ht−1)，控制候选状态读取多少历史
nodes.description_en: Executes Reset gate rt to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: Update gate zt
nodes.description: sigmoid(Wz xt+Uz ht−1)，控制保留旧状态与写入新候选的比例
nodes.description_en: Performs Update gate zt within the core dual gate recurrent unit computation pathway.

nodes.label: Candidate state h̃t
nodes.description: tanh(Wh xt+Uh(rt⊙ht−1))
nodes.description_en: Performs Candidate state h̃t within the core dual gate recurrent unit computation pathway.

nodes.label: Gated interpolation
nodes.description: 以 zt 在 ht−1 与 h̃t 之间逐维插值形成 ht
nodes.description_en: Performs Gated interpolation within the core dual gate recurrent unit computation pathway.

nodes.label: 共享时间递归
nodes.description: ht 传到下一时刻，参数跨时间共享
nodes.description_en: Applies Stage 06 to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: 序列任务 head
nodes.description: 读取最后状态、池化状态或逐时刻状态完成分类/预测
nodes.description_en: Produces updated hidden state h_t or sequence prediction via sequence head.

paper.title: Learning Phrase Representations Using RNN Encoder-Decoder for Statistical Machine Translation

paper_figure.label: Figures 1 and 2 · PDF pp.2–3
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: vanilla RNN 梯度不稳，LSTM 门控和状态较复杂
keypoints.核心想法: 以 update/reset gates 控制隐藏状态保留与重置，简化门控循环结构
keypoints.关键改进: 仅用单一隐藏状态和两类门，在保留长依赖能力时减少参数
keypoints.医学适配: 常用于 ECG、EEG、生命体征和纵向临床序列的小数据基线
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 仍是轻量时序基线；串行计算和超长依赖能力弱于现代并行模型

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: LSTM required three separate gates and dual state vectors, increasing parameter count and overfitting risk on small clinical cohorts.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Eliminate the separate cell state and control memory retention versus new candidate overwriting with a single complementary update gate z_t.
keypoints_en.关键改进: 25% fewer parameters than LSTM while retaining additive gradient highways via (1 − z_t) ⊙ h_{t-1}.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Widely used in compact wearable biosignal monitors, GRU-D missing-value clinical EHR time series, and edge medical devices.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Lightweight recurrent baseline; like LSTM, remains bottlenecked by sequential step-by-step training on ultra-long sequences.

name: ECGFounder
summary: ECGFounder 是 RegNet/Net1D 风格的 1D CNN foundation model，以超过千万波形和 150 类监督规模为核心，不应误写为通用 Transformer SSL。
summary_en: 1D RegNet-style residual CNN with Squeeze-and-Excitation blocks pretrained via multi-label clinical supervision across >10 million 12-lead ECGs and 150 diagnostic categories.

nodes.label: Raw multi-lead ECG
nodes.description: 滤波、定长切片和逐导联 z-score 后输入
nodes.description_en: Ingests raw multi-lead (12-lead) or lead-masked single-lead 1d ecg voltage waveform tensor and prepares initial tensor representations (Raw multi-lead ECG).

nodes.label: Net1D/RegNet-1D stem
nodes.description: 1D 卷积建立早期局部波形特征并下采样
nodes.description_en: Executes Net1D/RegNet-1D stem to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: 多阶段 residual bottlenecks
nodes.description: 1×1、k×1 group convolution、1×1 卷积组成分阶段 RegNet blocks
nodes.description_en: Performs residual bottlenecks within the core clinical scale 1d regnet ecg foundation computation pathway.

nodes.label: Squeeze-and-Excitation
nodes.description: 按通道重标定导联/特征响应，融合跨导联相关性
nodes.description_en: Performs Squeeze-and-Excitation within the core clinical scale 1d regnet ecg foundation computation pathway.

nodes.label: Temporal global pooling
nodes.description: 汇聚不同时间位置的层级波形特征
nodes.description_en: Performs Temporal global pooling within the core clinical scale 1d regnet ecg foundation computation pathway.

nodes.label: ECG foundation embedding
nodes.description: 可冻结抽取或继续全量微调
nodes.description_en: Performs ECG foundation embedding within the core clinical scale 1d regnet ecg foundation computation pathway.

nodes.label: 150-label sigmoid head
nodes.description: 用心电专家/机器结构化诊断做大规模多标签监督预训练
nodes.description_en: Applies 150-label sigmoid head to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: Out-of-box/transfer heads
nodes.description: 心律失常、结构性心脏病、风险、人口学或单导联任务
nodes.description_en: Produces 150-class diagnostic probability vector and general-purpose 1d ecg representation via Out-of-box/transfer heads.

paper.title: An Electrocardiogram Foundation Model Built on over 10 Million Recordings

paper_figure.label: Figure 1 · PDF p.10
paper_figure.license: retained from existing atlas; rights unchanged

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: ECG 模型多依赖单中心小数据和任务专用标签，跨机构泛化有限
keypoints.核心想法: 在超过千万份原始多导联 ECG 上预训练通用时序编码器并迁移多任务
keypoints.关键改进: 利用卫生系统规模波形和多任务评测学习可复用 ECG 表征
keypoints.医学适配: 用于心律失常、结构性心脏病和风险预测等 ECG 任务
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 超大规模 ECG FM 代表；设备、群体公平性和前瞻效益仍需验证

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Prior ECG models were trained on narrow diagnostic subsets or small single-hospital cohorts, failing on rare arrhythmias and single-lead wearables.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Scale a domain-engineered 1D CNN (Net1D / RegNet with SE channel attention and lead-dropout augmentation) across >10M clinical ECGs annotated with a 150-label hierarchical ontology.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Massive 10M-waveform clinical supervision + lead-masking augmentation enabling seamless transfer from 12-lead hospital ECGs to single-lead wearable patches.
keypoints_en.医学适配: High-performing open-weight ECG foundation baseline for arrhythmia diagnosis, structural heart disease screening, and wearable ECG triage.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Proves that a well-engineered 1D CNN at 10M-sample clinical scale rivals or outperforms complex Transformers; prospective clinical trial validation remains the next frontier.

name: PhyDiCT
summary: 在固定预训练三维扩散先验上交替施加投影观测约束与去噪更新；文本报告、几何和预训练权重都是显式条件。
summary_en: A frozen text-conditioned 3D diffusion prior is guided by differentiable projection consistency during inference; reports, geometry and pretrained weights are explicit conditions.

nodes.label: 观测与几何
nodes.description: 明确投影数量、角度、尺度与坐标。
nodes.description_en: Specify projection count, angles, scale and coordinates.

nodes.label: 冻结先验与报告
nodes.description: 预训练权重与文本条件属于额外信息。
nodes.description_en: Weights and text are explicit additional inputs.

nodes.label: 引导采样
nodes.description: 交替去噪和投影约束。
nodes.description_en: Alternate denoising and projection consistency.

nodes.label: 验证
nodes.description: 分别检查观测一致性与三维准确性。
nodes.description_en: Assess measurement agreement and 3D fidelity separately.

paper.title: PhyDiCT: Plug-and-Play CT Reconstruction from Sparse X-Rays via Differentiable Rendering and Strong Priors

paper_figure.label: Figure 1 · PDF p.3
paper_figure.license: MICCAI paper; original authors

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 少量投影无法唯一确定患者三维结构；通用生成先验可能与实际观测不一致。
keypoints.核心想法: 把冻结的三维先验与可微成像观测结合，在推理阶段约束候选体。
keypoints.关键改进: 作者方案使用 Split Gibbs 思路引导采样，并提供额外计算细化。
keypoints.医学适配: 论文针对肺 CT 和合成 X 光重建；文本条件不是免费获得的信息。
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 本条为 source_route：已核原始源码和根许可证；未执行原模型、未验证临床效果。

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Sparse projections leave unresolved depth; a generative prior may be inconsistent with the observations.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Constrain a frozen 3D prior with the differentiable image-formation model at inference.
keypoints_en.关键改进: The author method uses Split Gibbs guidance and an extra-compute refinement stage.
keypoints_en.医学适配: The paper studies lung CT with simulated X-rays. Report conditioning must be declared.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Source route only: official source and root license checked; original inference and clinical performance were not tested here.

name: MediSyn
summary: 在公开医学图文对上微调 Stable Diffusion 1.4 的条件去噪 U-Net，冻结文本编码器与 VAE，用同一个潜扩散模型根据文本生成跨专科二维医学图像。
summary_en: MediSyn fine-tunes the conditional denoising U-Net of Stable Diffusion 1.4 on public medical image–text pairs while freezing the text encoder and VAE, using one latent diffusion model for text-guided 2D medical image synthesis across specialties.

nodes.label: 医学图像—文本对
nodes.description: 汇集六个专科、十种成像模态。将已有类别标签与模态信息写成文本；尽可能先按患者划分训练、验证与测试数据，再进入生成模型训练。
nodes.description_en: Six specialties and ten imaging modalities supply paired examples. Captions describe existing class labels and modality information; patient-level splitting is used wherever possible before model training.

nodes.label: 冻结 VAE 编码器
nodes.description: 训练阶段把真实图像编码为较小的空间潜表示。这个编码器保持冻结，图像压缩不是本次医学微调的主要学习位置。
nodes.description_en: During training, a frozen VAE encoder maps real images to a smaller spatial latent representation. The image compressor is retained rather than being the main target of medical fine-tuning.

nodes.label: 冻结 CLIP 文本编码器
nodes.description: 从 CLIP ViT-L 取出的文本编码器把提示转成条件表示。发布配置的交叉注意力条件维度为768；最终选定的 MediSyn 配置不更新该编码器。
nodes.description_en: A text encoder taken from CLIP ViT-L embeds the prompt. The released configuration uses a cross-attention condition dimension of 768, and the selected MediSyn configuration keeps this encoder frozen.

nodes.label: 潜空间加噪与时间步
nodes.description: 向训练图像的潜表示加入高斯噪声；带噪潜变量与时间步共同定义当前去噪问题。生成时从随机高斯潜变量开始，而不是先输入某位患者的图像。
nodes.description_en: Gaussian noise corrupts an encoded training image. The noisy latent and timestep define the denoising problem; generation instead starts from a Gaussian latent sample rather than a patient image.

nodes.label: 医学微调条件 U-Net
nodes.label_en: Medical fine-tuning of the conditional U-Net
nodes.description: U-Net 预测噪声，文本通过中间层交叉注意力参与计算。固定发布配置使用4通道潜输入/输出、64的样本空间尺寸、每块2层，以及320、640、1280、1280的块通道宽度。
nodes.description_en: The U-Net predicts noise, with text entering through intermediate cross-attention. The pinned release configuration specifies four input/output latent channels, sample size 64, two layers per block and block widths of 320, 640, 1280 and 1280.

nodes.label: 噪声预测均方误差
nodes.description: 将预测噪声与实际加入的噪声比较，以均方误差更新 U-Net。训练中10%的提示被替换为空文本，为推理时的无分类器引导提供无条件分支。
nodes.description_en: Mean squared error compares predicted noise with the noise actually added, updating the U-Net. Ten percent of training prompts are replaced with empty text to support classifier-free guidance at inference.

nodes.label: 文本引导的迭代采样
nodes.description: 复用已训练 U-Net，在逐步变化的时间步上去噪潜变量。作者演示将其装入 Stable Diffusion 1.4 管线，采用空负提示与7.0的引导尺度；这些是演示配置，不是所有任务的最优值。
nodes.description_en: The trained U-Net repeatedly denoises the latent over successive timesteps. The author demo inserts it into a Stable Diffusion 1.4 pipeline and uses an empty negative prompt with guidance scale 7.0; these are demo settings rather than universal optima.

nodes.label: 冻结 VAE 解码器
nodes.description: 将最后的去噪潜表示映射回像素空间。VAE 解码器在图像合成阶段使用，仍保留基础模型的预训练参数。
nodes.description_en: The frozen VAE decoder maps the final denoised latent back to pixels, retaining the base model's pretrained parameters during image synthesis.

nodes.label: 合成图像与下游评估
nodes.description: 输出二维医学图像，分别评估视觉分布、图文对应和下游分类用途。图像逼真度、生成多样性与对真实数据训练的帮助是不同的评价问题。
nodes.description_en: The output is a 2D medical image. Distributional appearance, text alignment and downstream classifier utility are assessed separately; fidelity, diversity and usefulness for learning from real data are different evaluation questions.

paper.title: A Generalist Model for Diverse Text-Guided Medical Image Synthesis

paper_figure.license: CC-BY-NC-ND-4.0
paper_figure.attribution: Joseph Cho、Mrudang Mathur、Cyril Zakka 等：《A Generalist Model for Diverse Text-Guided Medical Image Synthesis》，arXiv:2405.09806v7，图1。
paper_figure.attribution_en: Joseph Cho, Mrudang Mathur, Cyril Zakka et al., A Generalist Model for Diverse Text-Guided Medical Image Synthesis, arXiv:2405.09806v7, Figure 1.
paper_figure.label: Fig. 1 · arXiv v7

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 为每个专科、模态和部位维护独立生成模型，增加训练、部署与反复加载权重的成本；依赖私有训练数据也不便复现。MediSyn 研究能否让一个模型学习多种医学图像分布。
keypoints.核心想法: 保留 Stable Diffusion 1.4 的潜扩散框架，在统一的医学图文数据上只微调 U-Net。VAE 负责像素与潜表示之间的映射，冻结的文本编码器提供提示条件。
keypoints.关键改进: 通用性来自跨专科数据与训练设计，而非更换一套全新主干。作者比较六种基础模型及微调配置后，选定冻结 VAE 和文本编码器、仅更新 U-Net 的 SD1.4 配置作为 MediSyn。
keypoints.医学适配: 用已有模态信息和类别标签构建提示，覆盖胃肠、放射、病理、外科、皮肤与眼科。用途是可控合成与低数据条件下的数据增强，学习目标仍是生成图像。
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 原文显示图像保真度与多样性存在取舍，下游受益也因类别和数据量而异。已见过的模态与部位不能任意组合为新任务；新疾病提示可能产生不准确图像，且论文未给出形式化隐私保证。

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Maintaining a generator for every specialty, modality and anatomical region adds training, deployment and repeated model-loading costs, while private training data limits reproducibility. MediSyn asks whether one model can learn diverse medical image distributions.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Retain the latent diffusion framework of Stable Diffusion 1.4 and fine-tune only its U-Net on a unified medical image–text collection. The VAE maps between pixels and latents, while a frozen text encoder supplies prompt conditions.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Generality comes from the cross-specialty data and training design rather than a completely new backbone. After comparing six model/training configurations, the authors select SD1.4 with a frozen VAE and text encoder and a fine-tuned U-Net as MediSyn.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Prompts use existing modality information and class labels across gastroenterology, radiology, pathology, surgery, dermatology and ophthalmology. The aim is controlled synthesis and augmentation in limited-data settings, with image generation remaining the learning objective.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: The paper reports tradeoffs between fidelity and diversity, with downstream gains varying by class and data regime. Familiar modalities and anatomy do not combine arbitrarily into unseen tasks; novel disease prompts may be inaccurate, and no formal privacy guarantee is established.

name: Percival
summary: 把三维 CT 与放射学报告分别编码，用对称对比学习对齐全体扫描的视觉和语言表征，再以冻结图像向量支持检索、零样本分类及独立拟合的疾病与风险模型。
summary_en: Separate encoders align whole-volume CT and radiology-report representations through symmetric contrastive learning. Frozen image embeddings support retrieval, zero-shot classification and separately fitted disease or prognostic models.

nodes.label: 体数据标准化
nodes.description: 统一朝向、物理间隔、HU 范围和空间尺寸。XYZ 与 PyTorch 的 DHW 顺序要区分；发布配置把 XYZ 尺寸反转后交给视觉塔，预处理后的间隔不能由张量尺寸直接推断。
nodes.description_en: Standardize orientation, physical spacing, HU range and spatial size. Distinguish XYZ from PyTorch DHW: the release reverses XYZ image dimensions before building the vision tower, and tensor size alone does not establish voxel spacing.

nodes.label: 三维卷积分块
nodes.description: 以空间 XYZ 的 16×16×8 体素为块；实现的 DHW 核与步长为 8×16×16。128×352×352 输入得到 16×22×22=7744 个区域标记，三维卷积将每块映射为 Transformer 特征。
nodes.description_en: Use XYZ patches of 16×16×8 voxels, implemented with DHW kernel and stride 8×16×16. A 128×352×352 volume yields a 16×22×22 grid, or 7,744 regional tokens, projected into Transformer features by a 3D convolution.

nodes.label: 位置编码与全局标记
nodes.description: 为区域标记加入三维空间位置，前置一个 CLS 全局标记。固定代码对 AugReg 位置编码进行空间适配；完整序列包含 7744 个区域标记与 1 个全局标记。
nodes.description_en: Add 3D spatial position information and prepend a CLS token. The pinned implementation adapts AugReg position embeddings; the full sequence contains 7,744 regional tokens and one global token.

nodes.label: AugReg 视觉 Transformer
nodes.description: 在完整体数据序列上做多头自注意力。CLS 与所有区域标记双向交换信息，在多层中聚合扫描级结构；这里不是逐切片独立编码后再做层级注意力。
nodes.description_en: Multi-head self-attention operates on the full volume sequence. CLS exchanges information with all regional tokens and aggregates scan-level structure across layers; this is not independent per-slice encoding followed by hierarchical attention.

nodes.label: 图像投影与归一化
nodes.description: 取最后一层归一化后的 CLS 输出，再以线性头映射到共享维度。Base 为 768 维；计算对比相似度前做 L2 归一化，使内积对应余弦相似度。
nodes.description_en: Take the final normalized CLS output and project it linearly into the shared space, 768 dimensions for Base. L2 normalization before contrastive similarity makes the dot product a cosine similarity.

nodes.label: 报告文本编码
nodes.description: 另一条并行路径将报告分词并提供注意力掩码，送入 CXR-BERT-specialized。固定语言塔取第一个标记的最终隐状态，再通过线性投影与对应视觉变体对齐。
nodes.description_en: A parallel path tokenizes the report, supplies an attention mask and encodes it with CXR-BERT-specialized. The pinned language tower takes the first-token final hidden state and linearly projects it to the matching vision variant’s shared dimension.

nodes.label: 批内图文相似度矩阵
nodes.description: 对 B 个扫描与 B 份报告形成 B×B 相似度矩阵。对角线对应真实图文对，其余项是批内负对；分布式训练先汇集多 GPU 特征，扩充对比集合。
nodes.description_en: A batch of B scans and B reports forms a B×B similarity matrix. The diagonal contains matched pairs and off-diagonal entries provide in-batch negatives. Distributed training gathers features across GPUs before constructing the contrastive set.

nodes.label: 双向对比目标
nodes.description: 同时优化图像找报告与报告找图像，两个方向的交叉熵取平均。相似度的缩放影响 softmax 锐度；公式的除数温度与代码的乘数缩放须按各自约定解释。
nodes.description_en: Optimize image-to-report and report-to-image matching, averaging cross-entropy in the two directions. Similarity scaling controls softmax sharpness; divisor temperature in the formula and multiplier scale in code must be interpreted under their own conventions.

nodes.label: 检索与提示词分类
nodes.description: 推理时可只编码 CT，并与预先编码的报告或“病变存在／不存在”提示比较。图文向量是匹配表示；双编码器本身不逐词生成报告，也不输出分割掩码。
nodes.description_en: At inference, CT embeddings can be compared with pre-encoded reports or pathology-present/pathology-absent prompts. These are matching representations: the dual encoder itself does not generate report tokens or segmentation masks.

nodes.label: 冻结表征后的任务建模
nodes.description: 将图像塔的向量作为独立模型的输入。论文疾病分类使用按解剖视野分别拟合的 L1 逻辑回归，预后使用 ridge Cox 模型；这些拟合目标与图文预训练目标不同。
nodes.description_en: Use vision-tower vectors as inputs to separate models. The paper fits field-of-view-specific L1 logistic regressions for disease classification and ridge Cox models for prognosis. Their fitting objectives differ from image–text pretraining.

paper.title: Generalizable CT vision-language modeling for population health and disease risk

paper_figure.license: CC-BY-4.0
paper_figure.label: Fig. 1 · journal 2026
paper_figure.attribution: Cameron Beeche、Joonghyun Kim、Hamed Tavolinejad 等：Generalizable CT vision-language modeling for population health and disease risk，npj Digital Medicine，2026 年期刊 Article in Press，图 1。完整嵌入图由 CMYK TIFF 转为 RGB PNG 供浏览器显示，未裁剪、重绘或移除面板。
paper_figure.attribution_en: Cameron Beeche, Joonghyun Kim, Hamed Tavolinejad et al., Generalizable CT vision-language modeling for population health and disease risk, npj Digital Medicine, 2026 journal Article in Press, Figure 1. Complete embedded figure converted from CMYK TIFF to RGB PNG for browser display; no cropping, redrawing or panel removal.

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 窄解剖视野、单一造影条件或单一临床任务上的训练，限制了 CT 表征覆盖真实扫描差异的能力。
keypoints.核心想法: 将全体 CT 的三维视觉编码器与报告文本编码器对齐，让医学报告提供扫描级语义监督。
keypoints.关键改进: 期刊路线以 AugReg ViT 的三维分块与 CXR-BERT-specialized 组成双塔，并在不同视野、造影条件和临床用途的配对数据上统一训练。
keypoints.医学适配: 同一 CT 表征被用于跨模态检索、胸部病变提示词分类、实验室指标关联、疾病分类和纵向风险研究；后几项通过独立统计或预测模型实现。
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 外部 CT-RATE、院内验证及生物学关联回答不同问题。相似度分数、疾病概率与风险排序不可互换，观察性关联也不直接给出因果解释。

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Training in narrow anatomical windows, contrast settings or clinical tasks limits coverage of real-world CT variation.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Align a whole-volume 3D vision encoder with a report encoder so that radiology text supplies scan-level semantic supervision.
keypoints_en.关键改进: The journal route pairs a 3D-patch AugReg ViT with CXR-BERT-specialized and trains jointly across fields of view, contrast settings and clinical indications.
keypoints_en.医学适配: The same CT representation supports retrieval, thoracic prompt classification, laboratory associations, disease classification and longitudinal risk research. The latter uses separate statistical or predictive models.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: External CT-RATE validation, internal evaluation and biological association studies answer different questions. Similarity, disease probability and risk rank are not interchangeable, and observational association does not directly establish causality.

name: MedGemma
summary: 以医学图文训练的 MedSigLIP 编码图像，将视觉表示与文本一起送入 Gemma 3，逐词生成医学回答。模型集合包括 4B 与 27B 多模态模型及 27B 纯文本模型。
summary_en: A medically trained MedSigLIP encoder supplies visual representations to Gemma 3 alongside text for autoregressive medical answers. The collection contains 4B and 27B multimodal variants and a 27B text-only variant.

nodes.label: 选择发布变体
nodes.description: 固定作者示例提供 4b-it、27b-it 与 27b-text-it 三个模型标识。先选择多模态或纯文本路径，再决定是否提供图像；4B 与 27B 是参数规模，不是图像分辨率。
nodes.description_en: The pinned example offers 4b-it, 27b-it and 27b-text-it. Choose a multimodal or text-only path before supplying images. 4B and 27B denote parameter scales, not image resolution.

nodes.label: 组织图像与问题
nodes.description: 把图像和文字放进具有角色的消息结构，保留图像与问题之间的对应关系。作者示例用聊天模板构造模型输入，并在最后加入生成提示。
nodes.description_en: Place images and text in role-structured messages while preserving their correspondence. The author example uses a chat template and adds a generation prompt.

nodes.label: 图像预处理
nodes.description: 期刊的多模态编码器使用 896×896 图像和 (−1,1) 像素归一化。处理器管理模型需要的图像张量、文字标记和掩码；输入文件的原始尺寸不等于编码器尺寸。
nodes.description_en: Journal multimodal encoding uses 896×896 images normalized to (−1,1). The processor builds required image tensors, text tokens and masks; a file’s original size is not the encoder size.

nodes.label: MedSigLIP 医学视觉编码
nodes.description: 400M 规模的 SigLIP 视觉编码器经过医学图文增强，提取影像表示。训练同时保留通用领域数据，使专科适配与原有视觉能力在同一编码器中协调。
nodes.description_en: A 400M SigLIP vision encoder is enhanced with medical image–text data to extract image representations. General-domain replay balances medical adaptation with existing visual capability.

nodes.label: 对接视觉与语言
nodes.description: 视觉编码结果沿 Gemma 3 的多模态接口送入语言模型，与文本条件共同形成回答上下文。该节点标明视觉表示与文字条件的衔接位置。
nodes.description_en: Visual encoding enters the Gemma 3 multimodal interface and forms the answer context alongside text. This node locates the connection between visual representations and text conditions.

nodes.label: Gemma 3 语言建模
nodes.description: 模型基于已经训练的 Gemma 3。多模态路线在视觉增强后继续进行包含交错图文的预训练，使解码器适应医学视觉表示；纯文本 27B 路线单独处理。
nodes.description_en: The model starts from pretrained Gemma 3. After vision enhancement, multimodal pretraining with interleaved images and text adapts the decoder to medical visual representations. The text-only 27B route is separate.

nodes.label: 逐标记生成
nodes.description: 作者示例执行 model.generate，限制新生成标记数，并支持确定性解码。输出依赖所给图像、问题和上下文；生成长度与输入长度应分别管理。
nodes.description_en: The author example calls model.generate with a limit on new tokens and deterministic decoding. Outputs depend on images, question and context; input and generated lengths are managed separately.

nodes.label: 提取回答标记
nodes.description: 固定示例先记录输入 token 长度，再从生成序列中去掉输入前缀，以处理器或分词器解码新增部分，避免把问题本身重复当成模型回答。
nodes.description_en: The pinned example records input-token length, removes that prefix from the generated sequence and decodes only the newly generated tokens, avoiding repetition of the prompt as an answer.

nodes.label: 关联影像证据阅读
nodes.description: 问答、报告生成与医学摘要是不同输出任务。阅读回答时检查影像所见、问题要求和遗漏信息；对于分类或检索，可选独立 MedSigLIP 表征与相应评估协议。
nodes.description_en: Visual answering, report generation and summarization are distinct tasks. Read answers against image findings, the question and omissions. Classification or retrieval can instead use standalone MedSigLIP with a suitable evaluation protocol.

nodes.label: 按任务验证结果
nodes.description: 论文区分图像问答、胸片分类、报告评估和医学文本任务。复现时固定数据划分、提示词、模型标识与解码方式，不把不同任务的分数当作同一种准确率。
nodes.description_en: The paper separates visual QA, chest-image classification, report evaluation and medical text tasks. Reproduction fixes splits, prompts, model identifiers and decoding rather than treating all scores as one accuracy.

paper.title: An open vision-language model for diverse medical applications

paper_figure.license: CC-BY-4.0
paper_figure.label: Fig. 1 · journal overview 2026
paper_figure.attribution: Andrew Sellergren、Sahar Kazemzadeh 等：An open vision-language model for diverse medical applications，Nature Medicine，2026，图 1。保留出版社完整原始 PNG，未裁剪、重绘或移除面板。
paper_figure.attribution_en: Andrew Sellergren, Sahar Kazemzadeh et al., An open vision-language model for diverse medical applications, Nature Medicine, 2026, Figure 1. Complete publisher PNG retained without cropping, redrawing or panel removal.

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 通用视觉语言模型能理解多种输入，但医学中的细粒度所见、专科术语和任务协议仍需要专门适配。
keypoints.核心想法: 沿用 Gemma 3 多模态骨架，先增强医学视觉表示，再让语言模型适应新的图像表示与医学任务。
keypoints.关键改进: 把医学视觉编码器、交错图文预训练与任务后训练分开描述，提供多模态 4B/27B 与纯文本 27B 的互补选择。
keypoints.医学适配: 医学图文覆盖放射影像、病理、眼底与皮肤图像，文本任务包括问答和摘要。独立 MedSigLIP 服务于表征型任务。
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 本页解释 2025 年技术报告与 2026 年期刊对应的原始模型集合，并用 2025-07-09 作者示例核对三个模型标识；后续 1.5 属于独立版本。

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: General vision-language models handle diverse inputs, while fine medical findings, terminology and task protocols require domain adaptation.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Retain Gemma 3’s multimodal backbone, enhance medical visual representations, then adapt language modeling to the new representations and tasks.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Separate medical vision enhancement, interleaved multimodal pretraining and task post-training; offer complementary 4B/27B multimodal and 27B text-only variants.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Medical image–text data span radiology, pathology, ophthalmology and dermatology. Text tasks include answering and summarization; standalone MedSigLIP supports representation tasks.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: This page covers the original collection in the 2025 technical report and 2026 journal article, checking all three identifiers against the 2025-07-09 author example. Later 1.5 is a separate release.

name: Brain2Vec
summary: 用三维遮蔽自编码学习 T1 脑 MRI 表征。预训练重建被遮蔽体块，应用时提取 768 维全脑嵌入，或以编码器初始化下游模型。
summary_en: A 3D masked autoencoder learns T1 brain MRI representations. Masked-volume reconstruction trains an encoder that supplies 768-dimensional embeddings or initializes downstream models.

nodes.label: 对齐三维输入
nodes.description: 先去颅骨并配准到共同模板，再缩放与标准化。解剖位置、体素网格和强度空间决定后续表征的可比性。
nodes.description_en: Skull stripping and atlas registration precede resizing and normalization, aligning anatomy, voxel grids and intensity space.

nodes.label: 划分三维体块
nodes.description: 8×8×8 非重叠体块将 128³ 体积化为 4096 个位置。作者用核与步长均为 8 的 Conv3d 投影到 768 维，并加入三维位置编码。
nodes.description_en: An 8³ patch grid creates 4096 positions. A stride-8 Conv3d projects patches to 768 dimensions with 3D positional encoding.

nodes.label: 随机遮蔽 75%
nodes.description: 预训练仅保留 1024 个可见体块，加入 CLS 标记后送入编码器。原始顺序索引用于解码阶段恢复位置。
nodes.description_en: Pretraining retains 1024 visible patches plus CLS. Stored indices restore original positions during decoding.

nodes.label: 编码可见上下文
nodes.description: 基础模型使用 12 层、12 头 ViT。自注意力联合建模可见体块，编码器不接收被遮蔽位置的占位标记。
nodes.description_en: The base model uses twelve ViT layers and twelve heads, attending over visible patches without masked-position placeholders.

nodes.label: 恢复完整位置
nodes.description: 将编码结果投影到 512 维，补入共享可学习遮蔽标记，按 ids_restore 还原 4096 个体块位置并加入解码位置编码。
nodes.description_en: Project to width 512, insert learned mask tokens and use ids_restore to recover all 4096 positions.

nodes.label: 重建体块体素
nodes.description: 8 层、16 头解码器处理完整体块序列；线性预测头为每块输出 512 个体素值。目标是标准化强度空间中的重建。
nodes.description_en: An eight-layer, sixteen-head decoder and linear head predict 512 normalized voxel values per patch.

nodes.label: 只在遮蔽处计分
nodes.description: 按体块求体素均方误差，再只对遮蔽位置求平均。可见体块提供上下文，却不进入这一遮蔽重建损失的分母。
nodes.description_en: Average voxel MSE per patch, then average only masked positions. Visible patches provide context without entering that denominator.

nodes.label: 完整输入提取嵌入
nodes.description: 表征推理关闭遮蔽。作者 inference.py 执行 forward_encoder(mask_ratio=0.0)，再读取 features[:,0,:]，得到基础模型的 768 维 CLS 表征。
nodes.description_en: Inference disables masking and selects features[:,0,:] from forward_encoder: the base model’s 768-dimensional CLS representation.

nodes.label: 选择下游学习方式
nodes.description: 冻结编码器后训练 SVM／SVR，或用预训练参数初始化 ViT 再微调。两条路线的训练对象、输出与评价协议分别记录。
nodes.description_en: Train SVM/SVR models on frozen embeddings, or initialize and fine-tune a ViT. These routes have separate objectives and evaluation protocols.

nodes.label: 检查解剖解释
nodes.description: 论文结合注意力、区域体积相关性与潜变量操纵。解码后的区域变化可帮助研究表征；相关性、注意力与预测因果机制需分别理解。
nodes.description_en: The paper combines attention, regional correlations and latent manipulation. Reconstructed changes aid interpretation while these forms of evidence remain distinct.

paper.title: Brain2Vec: A Self-Supervised 3D Foundation Model for Structural Brain MRI

paper_figure.license: CC-BY-NC-ND-4.0
paper_figure.label: Fig. 1 · arXiv v1 · 2026
paper_figure.attribution: Spiros Maggioros 等：Brain2Vec: A Self-Supervised 3D Foundation Model for Structural Brain MRI，arXiv:2610.28411v1，2026，图 1。完整 SVG 原图按非商业、禁止演绎许可展示；未裁剪、重绘或翻译原图。
paper_figure.attribution_en: Spiros Maggioros et al., Brain2Vec: A Self-Supervised 3D Foundation Model for Structural Brain MRI, arXiv:2610.28411v1, 2026, Figure 1. Complete SVG shared for noncommercial use without cropping, redrawing or translating the original.

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 标注有限的三维 MRI 任务难以逐个从头训练，预设区域体积又只覆盖特定解剖描述。
keypoints.核心想法: 从遮蔽体块重建学习三维结构，再把编码器迁移到脑龄与分类任务。
keypoints.关键改进: 用稀疏可见体块训练重型编码器，以完整序列训练较轻解码器；下游表征关闭遮蔽。
keypoints.医学适配: 统一预处理后的 T1 脑 MRI，支持冻结嵌入和编码器微调两条路线。
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 2026-10-20 首次公开的预印本；本页核对基础模型与固定作者实现，重建质量和下游预测分别解释。

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: Limited labels impede task-by-task 3D MRI training; predefined regional volumes cover selected anatomical descriptions.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Learn 3D structure by reconstructing masked patches, then transfer the encoder to brain age and classification.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Train a heavy encoder on visible patches and a lighter decoder on the complete sequence; disable masking for embeddings.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Standardized T1 brain MRI supports frozen features and encoder fine-tuning.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Preprint first posted 2026-10-20. The base model and pinned implementation are checked; reconstruction and downstream prediction are evaluated separately.

name: EVLF-FM
summary: 将通用视觉、疾病级全局特征与像素级空间特征一起接入语言模型。先以医学指令监督微调，再通过组相对策略优化学习诊断与定位，并对齐解释中的临床发现。
summary_en: A language model combines general visual tokens, global disease features and spatial pixel features. Medical instruction tuning precedes group-relative policy optimization for diagnosis, grounding and clinically aligned explanations.

nodes.label: 准备图像与问题
nodes.description: 同一医学图像按各编码器要求分别预处理，文字指令规定诊断、问答或定位任务。二维切片与完整体积的输入范围分别理解。
nodes.description_en: Preprocess the same image for each encoder. The instruction selects diagnosis, VQA or grounding; a 2D slice has a different scope from a full volume.

nodes.label: 保留通用视觉标记
nodes.description: InternVL3 的视觉路径提取图像标记，经视觉连接器映射到语言嵌入空间，保留通用图文模型的视觉上下文。
nodes.description_en: InternVL3 extracts visual tokens and projects them into the language embedding space, retaining the general VLM context.

nodes.label: 编码全局疾病线索
nodes.description: MedImageInsight 的 DaViT-Huge 路径提取全局疾病表征。独立连接器将该表征转为一个疾病提示标记。
nodes.description_en: The MedImageInsight DaViT-Huge path extracts a global disease representation. A dedicated connector produces a disease-prompt token.

nodes.label: 保留密集空间网格
nodes.description: MedSAM 图像编码器产生空间特征，展平后逐位置投影。作者主配置保留 256 个空间标记，为局部病灶与解剖定位提供细节。
nodes.description_en: MedSAM supplies spatial features that are flattened and projected position by position. The main configuration retains 256 spatial tokens for local anatomy and findings.

nodes.label: 在标记序列中融合
nodes.description: 将通用图像标记、一个疾病标记和空间标记拼接，填入语言模型的图像上下文位置，与文字一起处理。主训练脚本关闭可选的第二疾病编码器。
nodes.description_en: Concatenate general visual, disease and spatial tokens at the LLM image-context positions alongside text. The main script disables the optional second disease encoder.

nodes.label: 以医学指令监督微调
nodes.description: 第一阶段以参考回答的负对数似然学习任务。基础参数冻结，以 LoRA 与连接器适配医学内容；训练脚本显式配置语言与辅助视觉编码器的适配器。
nodes.description_en: Stage one learns reference responses with negative log-likelihood. Frozen base weights are adapted through LoRA and connectors, with explicit language and auxiliary-encoder settings.

nodes.label: 为同一问题采样一组回答
nodes.description: 将合并后的监督微调模型作为策略初始化。对同一图像与问题生成多个候选，组内奖励差异决定相对优势。
nodes.description_en: Initialize the policy from merged SFT adapters. Generate several responses to the same input; reward differences within that group define relative advantages.

nodes.label: 组合任务与解释奖励
nodes.description: 论文用诊断正确性和定位交并比描述任务奖励；归档代码细分为标签集合重合与边界框交并比。解释奖励匹配临床发现，并考虑遗漏、无依据陈述与矛盾。
nodes.description_en: The paper describes diagnostic correctness and grounding IoU; archived code uses label-set overlap and box IoU. Reasoning alignment considers clinical matches, omissions, unsupported statements and contradictions.

nodes.label: 按组相对优势更新
nodes.description: 奖励在组内标准化，裁剪策略比率控制更新，KL 项约束与冻结参考策略的偏移。第二阶段冻结视觉路径和连接器，仅更新语言 LoRA。
nodes.description_en: Normalize rewards within the group, clip policy ratios and regularize against a frozen reference with KL. Stage two freezes vision and connectors and updates language LoRA.

nodes.label: 联合阅读回答与定位
nodes.description: 分别核对诊断标签、边界框与解释中的影像发现。解释属于事后生成的文本；论文通过人工评价与忠实度分析检验它与证据的关系。
nodes.description_en: Check diagnostic labels, boxes and described findings separately. Explanations are post hoc text; the paper examines their evidence alignment through human evaluation and faithfulness analyses.

paper.title: A clinical multimodal vision language foundation model with fine-grain explainability

paper_figure.license: CC-BY-NC-ND-4.0
paper_figure.label: Fig. 1 · Nature Medicine · 2026
paper_figure.attribution: Yang Bai 等：A clinical multimodal vision language foundation model with fine-grain explainability，Nature Medicine，2026，图 1。原图完整展示，未修改；按 CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 作非商业教学使用。
paper_figure.attribution_en: Yang Bai et al., A clinical multimodal vision language foundation model with fine-grain explainability, Nature Medicine, 2026, Figure 1. Complete unmodified original for noncommercial education under CC BY-NC-ND 4.0.

keypoints.上一代瓶颈: 通用视觉语言模型的高层语义未必保留医学诊断线索与局部病灶细节。
keypoints.核心想法: 让通用视觉、全局疾病与局部空间特征共同进入语言模型的上下文。
keypoints.关键改进: 先做医学指令监督微调，再以任务奖励和临床解释对齐奖励优化同一生成策略。
keypoints.医学适配: 统一诊断、图像问答与边界框定位，同时分别评估回答正确性与解释质量。
keypoints.适用范围与证据: 2025-09-29 首次公开预印本，2026-10-29 发表期刊版；本页采用期刊原图与其引用的固定作者归档。

keypoints_en.上一代瓶颈: General VLM semantics can miss disease-specific cues and local findings.
keypoints_en.核心想法: Combine general vision, global disease and local spatial features in the LLM context.
keypoints_en.关键改进: Follow medical instruction tuning with task rewards and clinical reasoning alignment.
keypoints_en.医学适配: Support diagnosis, VQA and box grounding while evaluating answer quality and explanations separately.
keypoints_en.适用范围与证据: Preprint first public on 2025-09-29; journal publication on 2026-10-29. This page uses the journal original and its cited immutable author archive.
